==================== ./app/Domain/Identity/Actions/AcceptInvitationAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Identity\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\Invitation;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;

class AcceptInvitationAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private MintTenantTokenAction $mintTenantToken,
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @return array{plain_text_token: string, user: User, tenant: Tenant}
     */
    public function execute(string $token, string $name, string $password): array
    {
        $invitation = Invitation::where('token', $token)->first();

        if (! $invitation) {
            throw new ApiException('INVITATION_NOT_FOUND', 'This invitation does not exist.', 404);
        }

        if ($invitation->revoked_at !== null) {
            throw new ApiException('INVITATION_REVOKED', 'This invitation has been revoked.', 410);
        }

        if ($invitation->accepted_at !== null) {
            throw new ApiException('INVITATION_ALREADY_ACCEPTED', 'This invitation has already been accepted.', 409);
        }

        if ($invitation->expires_at->isPast()) {
            throw new ApiException('INVITATION_EXPIRED', 'This invitation has expired.', 410);
        }

        $user = User::where('email', $invitation->email)->first();

        if (! $user) {
            $user = User::create([
                'name' => $name,
                'email' => $invitation->email,
                'password' => Hash::make($password),
                // A targeted invitation to a known address stands in for
                // explicit email verification.
                'email_verified_at' => now(),
            ]);
        } else {
            // The email already belongs to an account — whoever invited it
            // doesn't get to choose that account's password. Accepting on
            // behalf of an existing user still requires proving you know
            // it, exactly like a normal login; otherwise inviting someone
            // else's known email would silently mint a token as them.
            if ($user->disabled_at !== null) {
                throw new ApiException('USER_DISABLED', 'This account has been disabled.', 403);
            }

            if (! Hash::check($password, $user->password)) {
                throw new ApiException('INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'These credentials do not match our records.', 401);
            }
        }

        $tenant = $invitation->tenant;

        // model_has_roles is RLS-protected (S1-ANA-03) — this whole flow
        // runs before any middleware binds "the current tenant", so
        // syncRoles() below fails against the restricted DB role the app
        // actually runs as without this (only ever masked in tests, whose
        // default connection is the elevated migrations role).
        TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($tenant, $user, $invitation) {
            TenantUser::updateOrCreate(
                ['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id],
                ['status' => 'active', 'invited_at' => $invitation->created_at, 'joined_at' => now(), 'disabled_at' => null],
            );

            $user->syncRoles([$invitation->role]);

            $invitation->update(['accepted_at' => now()]);
        });

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $tenant,
            actor: $user,
            action: 'invitation.accepted',
            subjectType: Invitation::class,
            subjectId: $invitation->id,
            newValues: ['role' => $invitation->role],
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return [
            'plain_text_token' => $this->mintTenantToken->execute($user, $tenant, 'mobile'),
            'user' => $user,
            'tenant' => $tenant,
        ];
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Identity/Actions/AuthenticateUserAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Identity\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;

/**
 * Mints a Sanctum token scoped to exactly one tenant, chosen at login (see
 * docs/erd.md decision #3). There is no mid-session tenant switch: a member
 * of two practices logs in twice and holds two tokens.
 */
class AuthenticateUserAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private MintTenantTokenAction $mintTenantToken,
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @return array{plain_text_token: string, user: User, tenant: Tenant}
     */
    public function execute(string $tenantSlug, string $email, string $password): array
    {
        $tenant = Tenant::where('slug', $tenantSlug)->first();

        if (! $tenant) {
            throw new ApiException('TENANT_NOT_FOUND', 'No practice matches this identifier.', 404);
        }

        $user = User::where('email', $email)->first();

        if (! $user || ! Hash::check($password, $user->password)) {
            $this->logDenied($tenant, $user, 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS');

            throw new ApiException('INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'These credentials do not match our records.', 401);
        }

        if ($user->disabled_at !== null) {
            $this->logDenied($tenant, $user, 'USER_DISABLED');

            throw new ApiException('USER_DISABLED', 'This account has been disabled.', 403);
        }

        $membership = $user->tenantUsers()->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->first();

        if (! $membership) {
            $this->logDenied($tenant, $user, 'TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED');

            throw new ApiException('TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED', 'This account has no access to this practice.', 403);
        }

        if ($membership->status === 'disabled') {
            $this->logDenied($tenant, $user, 'TENANT_MEMBERSHIP_DISABLED');

            throw new ApiException('TENANT_MEMBERSHIP_DISABLED', 'Access to this practice has been disabled.', 403);
        }

        if ($membership->status === 'invited') {
            $this->logDenied($tenant, $user, 'TENANT_MEMBERSHIP_PENDING');

            throw new ApiException('TENANT_MEMBERSHIP_PENDING', 'This invitation has not been accepted yet.', 403);
        }

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $tenant,
            actor: $user,
            action: 'auth.login_succeeded',
            subjectType: User::class,
            subjectId: $user->id,
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return [
            'plain_text_token' => $this->mintTenantToken->execute($user, $tenant, 'mobile'),
            'user' => $user,
            'tenant' => $tenant,
        ];
    }

    private function logDenied(Tenant $tenant, ?User $user, string $reasonCode): void
    {
        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $tenant,
            actor: $user,
            action: 'auth.login_denied',
            subjectType: User::class,
            subjectId: $user instanceof User ? $user->id : $tenant->id,
            reason: $reasonCode,
            request: $this->request,
        );
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Identity/Actions/CreateInvitationAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Identity\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Mail\InvitationMail;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\Invitation;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class CreateInvitationAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    public function execute(Tenant $tenant, User $invitedBy, string $email, string $role): Invitation
    {
        if ($tenant->users()->where('email', $email)->exists()) {
            throw new ApiException('USER_ALREADY_MEMBER', 'This person already has access to this practice.', 409);
        }

        $alreadyPending = Invitation::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
            ->where('email', $email)
            ->whereNull('accepted_at')
            ->whereNull('revoked_at')
            ->exists();

        if ($alreadyPending) {
            throw new ApiException('INVITATION_ALREADY_PENDING', 'An invitation is already pending for this email.', 409);
        }

        $invitation = Invitation::create([
            'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
            'email' => $email,
            'role' => $role,
            'token' => Str::random(64),
            'invited_by' => $invitedBy->id,
            'expires_at' => now()->addDays(7),
        ]);

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $tenant,
            actor: $invitedBy,
            action: 'invitation.created',
            subjectType: Invitation::class,
            subjectId: $invitation->id,
            newValues: ['email' => $email, 'role' => $role],
            request: $this->request,
        );

        Mail::to($email)->queue(new InvitationMail($invitation));

        return $invitation;
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Identity/Actions/DisableTenantMembershipAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Identity\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/**
 * Disabling a membership revokes access immediately, not just at next
 * login: every token minted for that user+tenant is deleted outright.
 * Users are soft-disabled, never deleted (CLAUDE.md invariant #6) — this
 * only touches the membership/tokens, never the user record's identity.
 */
class DisableTenantMembershipAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    public function execute(TenantUser $membership, User $actor): void
    {
        if ($membership->status !== 'disabled') {
            $membership->update(['status' => 'disabled', 'disabled_at' => now()]);

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $membership->tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'tenant_user.disabled',
                subjectType: TenantUser::class,
                subjectId: $membership->id,
                request: $this->request,
            );
        }

        $membership->user->tokens()->where('tenant_id', $membership->tenant_id)->delete();
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Identity/Actions/MintTenantTokenAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Identity\Actions;

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * A Sanctum token authenticates for exactly one tenant, chosen at the moment
 * it's minted (login, invitation acceptance) — see docs/erd.md decision #3.
 * Shared by every flow that needs to hand back a working token.
 */
class MintTenantTokenAction
{
    public function execute(User $user, Tenant $tenant, string $name = 'api'): string
    {
        $plainTextToken = Str::random(40);

        $token = $user->tokens()->create([
            'name' => $name,
            'token' => hash('sha256', $plainTextToken),
            'abilities' => ['*'],
            'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
        ]);

        return $token->getKey().'|'.$plainTextToken;
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Identity/Actions/RegisterTenantAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Identity\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;

/**
 * Self-serve trial signup: a brand new practice plus its first user, who
 * always becomes `owner` — there is no "invite the first person" case,
 * someone has to be able to create the practice in the first place.
 */
class RegisterTenantAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private SeedTenantRolesAction $seedTenantRoles,
        private MintTenantTokenAction $mintTenantToken,
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @return array{plain_text_token: string, user: User, tenant: Tenant}
     */
    public function execute(string $tenantName, string $tenantSlug, string $ownerName, string $ownerEmail, string $password): array
    {
        if (Tenant::where('slug', $tenantSlug)->exists()) {
            throw new ApiException('TENANT_SLUG_TAKEN', 'This practice identifier is already in use.', 409);
        }

        if (User::where('email', $ownerEmail)->exists()) {
            throw new ApiException('EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED', 'An account already exists for this email.', 409);
        }

        [$tenant, $owner] = DB::transaction(function () use ($tenantName, $tenantSlug, $ownerName, $ownerEmail, $password) {
            $tenant = Tenant::create([
                'name' => $tenantName,
                'slug' => $tenantSlug,
                'plan' => 'trial',
                'status' => 'trialing',
                'trial_ends_at' => now()->addDays(30),
            ]);

            // roles/model_has_roles are RLS-protected (S1-ANA-03) — nothing
            // is "the current tenant" yet at this point in a brand new
            // registration, so without this, SeedTenantRolesAction's own
            // inserts and assignRole() below fail against the restricted
            // DB role the app actually runs as (only ever masked in tests,
            // whose default connection is the elevated migrations role).
            return TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($tenant, $ownerName, $ownerEmail, $password) {
                $owner = User::create([
                    'name' => $ownerName,
                    'email' => $ownerEmail,
                    'password' => Hash::make($password),
                    'email_verified_at' => now(),
                ]);

                TenantUser::create([
                    'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
                    'user_id' => $owner->id,
                    'status' => 'active',
                    'joined_at' => now(),
                ]);

                $this->seedTenantRoles->execute($tenant);
                $owner->assignRole(TenantRole::Owner->value);

                return [$tenant, $owner];
            });
        });

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $tenant,
            actor: $owner,
            action: 'tenant.registered',
            subjectType: Tenant::class,
            subjectId: $tenant->id,
            newValues: ['name' => $tenantName, 'slug' => $tenantSlug],
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return [
            'plain_text_token' => $this->mintTenantToken->execute($owner, $tenant, 'mobile'),
            'user' => $owner,
            'tenant' => $tenant,
        ];
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Identity/Actions/ResolveTenantUsersWithRoleAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Identity\Actions;

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Extracted from SendDigests (UI-28), which had this as a private method —
 * now shared with RequestDataExportAction (UI-29), which needs the exact
 * same "who currently holds this role" resolution to notify practice
 * owners. Raw query rather than spatie/permission's own role-users
 * lookup since that's scoped by the CURRENT permission team id, and
 * queued/scheduled callers often don't have one bound.
 */
class ResolveTenantUsersWithRoleAction
{
    /**
     * @return Collection<int, User>
     */
    public function execute(Tenant $tenant, string $role): Collection
    {
        $userIds = DB::table('model_has_roles')
            ->join('roles', 'roles.id', '=', 'model_has_roles.role_id')
            ->where('model_has_roles.tenant_id', $tenant->id)
            ->where('roles.name', $role)
            ->pluck('model_has_roles.model_uuid');

        return User::whereIn('id', $userIds)->get();
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Identity/Actions/RevokeInvitationAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Identity\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\Invitation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class RevokeInvitationAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    public function execute(Invitation $invitation, User $actor): void
    {
        if ($invitation->accepted_at !== null) {
            throw new ApiException('INVITATION_ALREADY_ACCEPTED', 'An accepted invitation cannot be revoked.', 409);
        }

        if ($invitation->revoked_at === null) {
            $invitation->update(['revoked_at' => now()]);

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $invitation->tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'invitation.revoked',
                subjectType: Invitation::class,
                subjectId: $invitation->id,
                request: $this->request,
            );
        }
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Identity/Actions/SeedTenantRolesAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Identity\Actions;

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Permission;
use Spatie\Permission\Models\Role;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * The six roles from CLAUDE.md, seeded per tenant at creation. Permissions
 * only cover what actually exists today (tenancy/identity) — adding
 * permissions for catalogue/inventory/cycles ahead of those domains
 * shipping would be exactly the kind of premature scaffolding CLAUDE.md
 * says not to do. Extend PERMISSIONS_BY_ROLE as each domain lands.
 */
class SeedTenantRolesAction
{
    private const array PERMISSIONS = [
        'invitations.create',
        'invitations.revoke',
        'memberships.disable',
        'sites.view',
        'sites.manage',
        'audit.view',
        'products.view',
        'products.manage',
        'suppliers.view',
        'suppliers.manage',
        'purchasing.view',
        'purchasing.manage',
        'inventory.view',
        'inventory.manage',
        'alerts.view',
        'alerts.manage',
        'devices.view',
        'devices.manage',
        'cycles.view',
        'cycles.manage',
        'cycles.release',
        'labels.view',
        'labels.manage',
        'patients.view',
        'patients.manage',
        'usages.view',
        'usages.manage',
        'exports.manage',
        'non_conformities.view',
        'non_conformities.manage',
        'data_exports.manage',
        'practice_settings.manage',
    ];

    /**
     * Granted to owner only, never admin — UI-28's "the evidence-affecting
     * sections [label format, DLU rule table] are owner-only" is the first
     * place this codebase distinguishes owner from admin at all; every
     * other permission above treats them identically.
     */
    private const array OWNER_ONLY_PERMISSIONS = [
        'evidence_settings.manage',
    ];

    private const array PERMISSIONS_BY_ROLE = [
        'owner' => [...self::PERMISSIONS, ...self::OWNER_ONLY_PERMISSIONS],
        'admin' => self::PERMISSIONS,
        // "Catalogue, suppliers, orders, receipts, movements, batches,
        // inventories, alerts" (CLAUDE.md) — stock_manager manages the
        // catalogue, suppliers, purchase orders, stock, and alerts;
        // everyone else just reads them. Equipment (devices/programs/
        // maintenance) isn't named for a specific role in CLAUDE.md either,
        // so it follows the same operational-master-data pattern.
        'stock_manager' => [
            'sites.view', 'products.view', 'products.manage',
            'suppliers.view', 'suppliers.manage', 'purchasing.view', 'purchasing.manage',
            'inventory.view', 'inventory.manage', 'alerts.view', 'alerts.manage',
            'devices.view', 'devices.manage', 'cycles.view', 'cycles.manage',
            'labels.view', 'labels.manage', 'patients.view', 'usages.view',
            'non_conformities.view',
        ],
        // releaser is the only role besides owner/admin with cycles.release
        // and non_conformities.manage — they're already the compliance
        // gatekeeper for releasing/rejecting a cycle, so raising/resolving
        // a non-conformity (the same "is this evidence trustworthy?"
        // judgment call, after the fact) sits with the same role.
        'releaser' => ['sites.view', 'products.view', 'suppliers.view', 'purchasing.view', 'inventory.view', 'alerts.view', 'devices.view', 'cycles.view', 'cycles.release', 'labels.view', 'patients.view', 'usages.view', 'non_conformities.view', 'non_conformities.manage'],
        // practitioner is the only non-owner/admin role with patients.manage
        // and usages.manage — they're the one creating a pseudonym and
        // recording label->procedure->patient while treating a patient.
        'practitioner' => ['sites.view', 'products.view', 'suppliers.view', 'purchasing.view', 'inventory.view', 'alerts.view', 'devices.view', 'cycles.view', 'labels.view', 'patients.view', 'patients.manage', 'usages.view', 'usages.manage', 'non_conformities.view'],
        'viewer' => ['sites.view', 'products.view', 'suppliers.view', 'purchasing.view', 'inventory.view', 'alerts.view', 'devices.view', 'cycles.view', 'labels.view', 'patients.view', 'usages.view', 'non_conformities.view'],
    ];

    public function execute(Tenant $tenant): void
    {
        $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
        $previousTeamId = $registrar->getPermissionsTeamId();
        $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);

        try {
            foreach ([...self::PERMISSIONS, ...self::OWNER_ONLY_PERMISSIONS] as $permissionName) {
                Permission::firstOrCreate(['name' => $permissionName, 'guard_name' => 'web']);
            }

            foreach (TenantRole::cases() as $role) {
                $roleModel = Role::firstOrCreate([
                    'name' => $role->value,
                    'guard_name' => 'web',
                    'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
                ]);

                $roleModel->syncPermissions(self::PERMISSIONS_BY_ROLE[$role->value]);
            }
        } finally {
            $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($previousTeamId);
        }
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Identity/Data/InvitationData.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Identity\Data;

use App\Domain\Identity\Models\Invitation;
use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Spatie\LaravelData\Data;

class InvitationData extends Data
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $id,
        public readonly string $email,
        public readonly string $role,
        public readonly CarbonInterface $expires_at,

==================== ./app/Domain/Inventory/Actions/AdjustStockAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Inventory\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\StockMovementType;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\StockMovement;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\StorageLocation;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/**
 * A signed correction (a count discrepancy, damage, loss). Unlike issue/
 * transfer, a negative adjustment is allowed to take a location's recorded
 * quantity below what a naive read would expect — that's the point of an
 * adjustment — but the reason is mandatory (validated at the request
 * layer), since this is the one movement type with no other evidence
 * behind it.
 */
class AdjustStockAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordStockMovementAction $recordStockMovement,
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    public function execute(Batch $batch, StorageLocation $location, int $signedQty, User $actor, string $reason): StockMovement
    {
        $movement = $this->recordStockMovement->execute(
            tenant: $batch->tenant,
            type: StockMovementType::Adjustment,
            batch: $batch,
            location: $location,
            qty: $signedQty,
            reason: $reason,
            actor: $actor,
        );

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $batch->tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'stock.adjusted',
            subjectType: StockMovement::class,
            subjectId: $movement->id,
            newValues: ['batch_id' => $batch->id, 'location_id' => $location->id, 'qty' => $signedQty],
            reason: $reason,
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return $movement;
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Inventory/Actions/DetectAlertsAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Inventory\Actions;

use App\Domain\Catalog\Models\Product;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\AlertSeverity;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\AlertState;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\AlertType;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Alert;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\AlertSettings;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Support\Dashboard\DashboardCache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Deterministic, idempotent: running this twice in a row with nothing
 * changed produces the same open alerts, not duplicates (unique index on
 * tenant_id/type/subject_type/subject_id/state) — and clears an alert as
 * soon as its condition stops being true (restock above threshold, batch
 * fully consumed), rather than leaving stale alerts around.
 *
 * The near-expiry window was originally a hardcoded DECISION NEEDED
 * default (docs/open-questions.md, OQ-6) — UI-28 makes it a real
 * per-tenant setting (AlertSettings::near_expiry_days); DEFAULT_NEAR_EXPIRY_DAYS
 * is only the column's own default for a tenant that's never saved one.
 */
class DetectAlertsAction
{
    /** AlertSettings.near_expiry_days migration default — also the batches list's (UI-15) fallback. */
    public const int DEFAULT_NEAR_EXPIRY_DAYS = 30;

    /**
     * @return array{low_stock: int, near_expiry: int, expired: int}
     */
    public function execute(Tenant $tenant): array
    {
        $opened = ['low_stock' => 0, 'near_expiry' => 0, 'expired' => 0];
        $nearExpiryDays = AlertSettings::forTenant($tenant)->near_expiry_days;

        $stockByProduct = DB::table('stock_levels')
            ->join('batches', 'batches.id', '=', 'stock_levels.batch_id')
            ->where('stock_levels.tenant_id', $tenant->id)
            ->groupBy('batches.product_id')
            ->selectRaw('batches.product_id as product_id, SUM(stock_levels.quantity) as total')
            ->pluck('total', 'product_id');

        Product::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->where('min_threshold', '>', 0)->each(function (Product $product) use ($tenant, $stockByProduct, &$opened) {
            $total = (int) ($stockByProduct[$product->id] ?? 0);

            if ($total < $product->min_threshold) {
                $created = $this->openAlert(
                    $tenant, AlertType::LowStock, AlertSeverity::Warning, Product::class, $product->id,
                    "Stock for \"{$product->name}\" is below threshold ({$total}/{$product->min_threshold}).",
                );
                $opened['low_stock'] += $created ? 1 : 0;
            } else {
                $this->resolveIfOpen($tenant, AlertType::LowStock, Product::class, $product->id);
            }
        });

        $batchIdsWithStock = DB::table('stock_levels')
            ->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
            ->groupBy('batch_id')
            ->havingRaw('SUM(quantity) > 0')
            ->pluck('batch_id');

        Batch::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
            ->whereIn('id', $batchIdsWithStock)
            ->whereNotNull('expiry_date')
            ->each(function (Batch $batch) use ($tenant, $nearExpiryDays, &$opened) {
                if ($batch->expiry_date->isPast()) {
                    $created = $this->openAlert(
                        $tenant, AlertType::Expired, AlertSeverity::Critical, Batch::class, $batch->id,
                        "Batch \"{$batch->batch_number}\" expired on {$batch->expiry_date->toDateString()}.",
                    );
                    $opened['expired'] += $created ? 1 : 0;
                    $this->resolveIfOpen($tenant, AlertType::NearExpiry, Batch::class, $batch->id);
                } elseif ($batch->expiry_date->lte(now()->addDays($nearExpiryDays))) {
                    $created = $this->openAlert(
                        $tenant, AlertType::NearExpiry, AlertSeverity::Warning, Batch::class, $batch->id,
                        "Batch \"{$batch->batch_number}\" expires on {$batch->expiry_date->toDateString()}.",
                    );
                    $opened['near_expiry'] += $created ? 1 : 0;
                } else {
                    $this->resolveIfOpen($tenant, AlertType::NearExpiry, Batch::class, $batch->id);
                }
            });

        DashboardCache::forget($tenant);

        return $opened;
    }

    private function openAlert(Tenant $tenant, AlertType $type, AlertSeverity $severity, string $subjectType, string $subjectId, string $message): bool
    {
        $alert = Alert::firstOrCreate(
            [
                'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
                'type' => $type,
                'subject_type' => $subjectType,
                'subject_id' => $subjectId,
                'state' => AlertState::Open,
            ],
            ['severity' => $severity, 'message' => $message],
        );

        return $alert->wasRecentlyCreated;
    }

    private function resolveIfOpen(Tenant $tenant, AlertType $type, string $subjectType, string $subjectId): void
    {
        Alert::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
            ->where('type', $type)
            ->where('subject_type', $subjectType)
            ->where('subject_id', $subjectId)
            ->where('state', AlertState::Open)
            ->update(['state' => AlertState::Resolved, 'resolved_at' => now()]);
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Inventory/Actions/IssueStockAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Inventory\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\BatchStatus;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\StockMovementType;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\StockLevel;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\StockMovement;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\StorageLocation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Issuing (using up / removing stock) can never take a location negative —
 * checked against the current stock_levels projection inside the same
 * locking transaction RecordStockMovementAction's upsert runs in, so a
 * concurrent issue can't both pass the check and overdraw.
 */
class IssueStockAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordStockMovementAction $recordStockMovement,
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    public function execute(Batch $batch, StorageLocation $location, int $qty, User $actor, ?string $reason): StockMovement
    {
        if ($batch->status === BatchStatus::Quarantined) {
            throw new ApiException('BATCH_QUARANTINED', 'This batch is quarantined following a non-conformity and cannot be issued.', 409);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($batch, $location, $qty, $actor, $reason) {
            $level = StockLevel::where('tenant_id', $batch->tenant_id)
                ->where('batch_id', $batch->id)
                ->where('location_id', $location->id)
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->first();

            $available = $level instanceof StockLevel ? $level->quantity : 0;

            if ($available < $qty) {
                throw new ApiException(
                    'INSUFFICIENT_STOCK',
                    "Only {$available} unit(s) of this batch are available at this location.",
                    409,
                );
            }

            $movement = $this->recordStockMovement->execute(
                tenant: $batch->tenant,
                type: StockMovementType::Issue,
                batch: $batch,
                location: $location,
                qty: -$qty,
                reason: $reason,
                actor: $actor,
            );

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $batch->tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'stock.issued',
                subjectType: StockMovement::class,
                subjectId: $movement->id,
                newValues: ['batch_id' => $batch->id, 'location_id' => $location->id, 'qty' => $qty],
                reason: $reason,
                request: $this->request,
            );

            return $movement;
        });
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Inventory/Actions/RebuildStockLevelsAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Inventory\Actions;

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Proves CLAUDE.md invariant #1 for real: stock_levels is a projection,
 * rebuildable by replaying stock_movements — not just a claim. Wipes and
 * recomputes this tenant's stock_levels from SUM(qty) grouped by
 * (batch_id, location_id). Safe to run any time; the ledger itself is
 * never touched.
 */
class RebuildStockLevelsAction
{
    public function execute(Tenant $tenant): int
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($tenant) {
            DB::table('stock_levels')->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->delete();

            return DB::affectingStatement(<<<'SQL'
                INSERT INTO stock_levels (id, tenant_id, batch_id, location_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at)
                SELECT uuidv7(), tenant_id, batch_id, location_id, SUM(qty), now(), now()
                FROM stock_movements
                WHERE tenant_id = ?
                GROUP BY tenant_id, batch_id, location_id
                SQL, [$tenant->id]);
        });
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Inventory/Actions/RecordStockMovementAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Inventory\Actions;

use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\StockMovementType;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\StockMovement;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\StorageLocation;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Dashboard\DashboardCache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * The one place that writes to stock_movements (CLAUDE.md invariant #1:
 * stock is derived from this ledger, no endpoint sets a quantity
 * directly). stock_levels is updated in the same statement via an atomic
 * upsert (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE) — Postgres takes the row lock
 * as part of the upsert itself, so two concurrent movements against the
 * same (batch, location) can't race and silently drop one increment,
 * without needing a separate SELECT ... FOR UPDATE step first.
 */
class RecordStockMovementAction
{
    public function execute(
        Tenant $tenant,
        StockMovementType $type,
        Batch $batch,
        StorageLocation $location,
        int $qty,
        ?string $groupId = null,
        ?string $reason = null,
        ?User $actor = null,
        ?string $idempotencyKey = null,
    ): StockMovement {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($tenant, $type, $batch, $location, $qty, $groupId, $reason, $actor, $idempotencyKey) {
            $movement = StockMovement::create([
                'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
                'type' => $type,
                'batch_id' => $batch->id,
                'location_id' => $location->id,
                'qty' => $qty,
                'group_id' => $groupId,
                'reason' => $reason,
                'actor_id' => $actor?->id,
                'idempotency_key' => $idempotencyKey,
                'occurred_at' => now(),
            ]);

            DB::statement(<<<'SQL'
                INSERT INTO stock_levels (id, tenant_id, batch_id, location_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at)
                VALUES (uuidv7(), ?, ?, ?, ?, now(), now())
                ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, batch_id, location_id)
                DO UPDATE SET quantity = stock_levels.quantity + excluded.quantity, updated_at = now()
                SQL, [$tenant->id, $batch->id, $location->id, $qty]);

            DashboardCache::forget($tenant);

            return $movement;
        });
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Inventory/Actions/ResolveAlertAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Inventory\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\AlertState;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Alert;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use App\Support\Dashboard\DashboardCache;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/**
 * Manual acknowledgement — resolving here doesn't require the underlying
 * condition to have changed (a manager can dismiss a low-stock alert while
 * a reorder is already in transit). DetectAlertsAction will re-open it on
 * its own if the condition is still true next time it runs.
 */
class ResolveAlertAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    public function execute(Alert $alert, User $actor): Alert
    {
        if ($alert->state === AlertState::Resolved) {
            throw new ApiException('ALERT_ALREADY_RESOLVED', 'This alert has already been resolved.', 409);
        }

        $alert->update(['state' => AlertState::Resolved, 'resolved_by' => $actor->id, 'resolved_at' => now()]);

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $alert->tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'alert.resolved',
            subjectType: Alert::class,
            subjectId: $alert->id,
            request: $this->request,
        );

        DashboardCache::forget($alert->tenant);

        return $alert;
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Inventory/Actions/TransferStockAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Inventory\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\StockMovementType;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\StockLevel;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\StockMovement;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\StorageLocation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * A transfer is two linked stock_movements rows — a debit at the source, a
 * credit at the destination — sharing group_id, not a single "moved" row.
 * See stock_movements' migration docblock for why.
 */
class TransferStockAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordStockMovementAction $recordStockMovement,
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @return array{debit: StockMovement, credit: StockMovement}
     */
    public function execute(Batch $batch, StorageLocation $from, StorageLocation $to, int $qty, User $actor, ?string $reason): array
    {
        if ($from->id === $to->id) {
            throw new ApiException('INVALID_TRANSFER', 'Source and destination locations must be different.', 422);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($batch, $from, $to, $qty, $actor, $reason) {
            $level = StockLevel::where('tenant_id', $batch->tenant_id)
                ->where('batch_id', $batch->id)
                ->where('location_id', $from->id)
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->first();

            $available = $level instanceof StockLevel ? $level->quantity : 0;

            if ($available < $qty) {
                throw new ApiException(
                    'INSUFFICIENT_STOCK',
                    "Only {$available} unit(s) of this batch are available at the source location.",
                    409,
                );
            }

            $groupId = (string) Str::uuid7();

            $debit = $this->recordStockMovement->execute(
                tenant: $batch->tenant,
                type: StockMovementType::Transfer,
                batch: $batch,
                location: $from,
                qty: -$qty,
                groupId: $groupId,
                reason: $reason,
                actor: $actor,
            );

            $credit = $this->recordStockMovement->execute(
                tenant: $batch->tenant,
                type: StockMovementType::Transfer,
                batch: $batch,
                location: $to,
                qty: $qty,
                groupId: $groupId,
                reason: $reason,
                actor: $actor,
            );

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $batch->tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'stock.transferred',
                subjectType: Batch::class,
                subjectId: $batch->id,
                newValues: ['from_location_id' => $from->id, 'to_location_id' => $to->id, 'qty' => $qty],
                reason: $reason,
                request: $this->request,
            );

            return ['debit' => $debit, 'credit' => $credit];
        });
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Inventory/Actions/UpdateAlertSettingsAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Inventory\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\AlertState;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\AlertType;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Alert;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\AlertSettings;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class UpdateAlertSettingsAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    public function execute(Tenant $tenant, User $actor, array $attributes, string $reason): AlertSettings
    {
        $settings = AlertSettings::forTenant($tenant);
        $oldValues = $settings->only(array_keys($attributes));
        $settings->update($attributes);

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'alert_settings.updated',
            subjectType: AlertSettings::class,
            subjectId: $settings->id,
            oldValues: $oldValues,
            newValues: $attributes,
            reason: $reason,
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return $settings;
    }

    /**
     * Read-only — the confirmation dialog shows this BEFORE saving a
     * near_expiry_days change, same pattern as ArchiveSiteAction's blast
     * radius. Mirrors DetectAlertsAction's own batch-with-stock query so
     * the numbers shown can never drift from what actually happens once
     * :command:`alerts:detect` next runs.
     *
     * @return array{appearing: int, disappearing: int}
     */
    public function previewNearExpiryImpact(Tenant $tenant, int $newNearExpiryDays): array
    {
        $batchIdsWithStock = DB::table('stock_levels')
            ->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
            ->groupBy('batch_id')
            ->havingRaw('SUM(quantity) > 0')
            ->pluck('batch_id');

        $wouldBeNearExpiry = Batch::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
            ->whereIn('id', $batchIdsWithStock)
            ->whereNotNull('expiry_date')
            ->where('expiry_date', '>', now())
            ->where('expiry_date', '<=', now()->addDays($newNearExpiryDays))
            ->pluck('id');

        $currentlyOpen = Alert::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
            ->where('type', AlertType::NearExpiry)
            ->where('state', AlertState::Open)
            ->pluck('subject_id');

        return [
            'appearing' => $wouldBeNearExpiry->diff($currentlyOpen)->count(),
            'disappearing' => $currentlyOpen->diff($wouldBeNearExpiry)->count(),
        ];
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Inventory/Actions/UpdateDigestSubscriptionsAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Inventory\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\DigestSubscription;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Role-based, not address-based — see DigestSubscription's docblock.
 * Replaces the tenant's whole subscription set in one save (there are
 * only six roles, this is never a paginated list), one audit event per
 * save rather than per row.
 */
class UpdateDigestSubscriptionsAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<int, array{role: string, frequency: string, enabled: bool}>  $subscriptions
     * @return Collection<int, DigestSubscription>
     */
    public function execute(Tenant $tenant, User $actor, array $subscriptions, string $reason): Collection
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($tenant, $actor, $subscriptions, $reason) {
            $rows = collect($subscriptions)->map(
                fn (array $subscription) => DigestSubscription::updateOrCreate(
                    ['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'role' => $subscription['role']],
                    ['frequency' => $subscription['frequency'], 'enabled' => $subscription['enabled']],
                )
            );

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'digest_subscriptions.updated',
                subjectType: DigestSubscription::class,
                subjectId: $tenant->id,
                newValues: ['subscriptions' => $subscriptions],
                reason: $reason,
                request: $this->request,
            );

            return $rows;
        });
    }
}

==================== ./app/Domain/Inventory/Mail/DigestMail.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Inventory\Mail;

use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Alert;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Mail\Mailable;
use Illuminate\Mail\Mailables\Content;
use Illuminate\Mail\Mailables\Envelope;

/**
 * UI-28's digest — one email per (tenant, subscribed role) send, listing
 * every currently open alert grouped by type. Mirrors InvitationMail's
 * shape (ShouldQueue, envelope()/content() style).
 */
class DigestMail extends Mailable implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable;

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, Alert>  $alerts
     */
    public function __construct(
        public User $recipient,
        public Tenant $tenant,
        public Collection $alerts,
    ) {}

    public function envelope(): Envelope
    {
        $count = $this->alerts->count();

        return new Envelope(
            subject: "SteriQore — {$this->tenant->name}: {$count} open alert".($count === 1 ? '' : 's'),
        );
    }

    public function content(): Content
    {
        return new Content(
            markdown: 'emails.digest',
            with: [
                'recipientName' => $this->recipient->name,
                'tenantName' => $this->tenant->name,
                'alertsByType' => $this->alerts->groupBy(fn ($alert) => $alert->type->value),
            ],
        );
    }
}

<?php

 * @property AlertState $state

 * @property string|null $resolved_by

            'state' => AlertState::class,
            'resolved_at' => 'datetime',

==================== ./app/Domain/Inventory/Models/AlertSettings.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Inventory\Models;

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Support\Concerns\BelongsToTenant;
use App\Support\Concerns\HasUuidv7;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

/**
 * One row per tenant (UI-28). Not evidence-affecting — a plain audited
 * update (old/new values + reason), not versioned like the DLU rule table
 * or label format.
 *
 * @property string $id
 * @property string $tenant_id
 * @property int $near_expiry_days
 * @property int $default_low_stock_threshold
 * @property int|null $control_test_frequency_days
 * @property int|null $control_test_overdue_tolerance_days
 * @property int $failed_cycle_escalation_hours
 * @property bool $digests_enabled
 */
class AlertSettings extends Model
{
    use BelongsToTenant;
    use HasUuidv7;

    protected $fillable = [
        'tenant_id', 'near_expiry_days', 'default_low_stock_threshold',
        'control_test_frequency_days', 'control_test_overdue_tolerance_days',
        'failed_cycle_escalation_hours', 'digests_enabled',
    ];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'near_expiry_days' => 'integer',
            'default_low_stock_threshold' => 'integer',
            'control_test_frequency_days' => 'integer',
            'control_test_overdue_tolerance_days' => 'integer',
            'failed_cycle_escalation_hours' => 'integer',
            'digests_enabled' => 'boolean',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Explicit defaults here (not just the migration's column defaults) —
     * firstOrCreate()'s in-memory model reflects whatever it was given,
     * not what Postgres actually filled in for omitted columns, so a
     * caller reading e.g. near_expiry_days right after creation would
     * otherwise see null/0, not the intended 30.
     */
    public static function forTenant(Tenant $tenant): self
    {
        return self::firstOrCreate(
            ['tenant_id' => $tenant->id],
            [
                'near_expiry_days' => 30,
                'default_low_stock_threshold' => 0,
                'failed_cycle_escalation_hours' => 24,
                'digests_enabled' => true,
            ],
        );
    }
}

==================== ./app/Domain/Labeling/Actions/CreateDluRuleAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Labeling\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\DluRule;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\DluRuleVersion;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * UI-28: the DLU rule table is versioned — every create/update writes an
 * immutable dlu_rule_versions row (actor + required reason + effective
 * date) alongside the mutable dlu_rules projection every existing query
 * still reads. See the 2026_08_07_000002 migration's docblock.
 */
class CreateDluRuleAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    public function execute(Tenant $tenant, User $actor, array $attributes, string $reason): DluRule
    {
        if (
            DluRule::where('packaging_type', $attributes['packaging_type'])
                ->where('storage_condition', $attributes['storage_condition'])
                ->exists()
        ) {
            throw new ApiException('DLU_RULE_ALREADY_EXISTS', 'A rule for this packaging/storage combination already exists.', 409);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($tenant, $actor, $attributes, $reason) {
            $version = DluRuleVersion::create([
                'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
                'packaging_type' => $attributes['packaging_type'],
                'storage_condition' => $attributes['storage_condition'],
                'shelf_life_days' => $attributes['shelf_life_days'],
                'actor_id' => $actor->id,
                'reason' => $reason,
                'effective_from' => now(),
            ]);

            $rule = DluRule::create($attributes + [
                'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
                'current_version_id' => $version->id,
            ]);

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'dlu_rule.created',
                subjectType: DluRule::class,
                subjectId: $rule->id,
                newValues: $attributes,
                reason: $reason,
                request: $this->request,
            );

            return $rule;
        });
    }
}

==================== ./app/Domain/Labeling/Actions/GenerateCycleLabelsAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Labeling\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\DluRule;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Enums\CycleStatus;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\Cycle;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * CLAUDE.md invariant #2: "No label may exist for a cycle that is not
 * released+compliant." Released only ever results from a compliant
 * decision (ReleaseCycleAction never sets it for a rejection), so checking
 * cycle.status === Released is exactly that check.
 */
class GenerateCycleLabelsAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, Label>
     */
    public function execute(Cycle $cycle, User $actor, string $packagingType, string $storageCondition): Collection
    {
        if ($cycle->status !== CycleStatus::Released) {
            throw new ApiException('CYCLE_NOT_RELEASED', 'Labels can only be generated for a released cycle.', 409);
        }

        if ($cycle->items()->whereHas('label')->exists()) {
            throw new ApiException('CYCLE_LABELS_ALREADY_GENERATED', 'Labels have already been generated for this cycle.', 409);
        }

        $rule = DluRule::where('packaging_type', $packagingType)
            ->where('storage_condition', $storageCondition)
            ->first();

        if ($rule === null) {
            throw new ApiException('DLU_RULE_NOT_FOUND', 'No DLU rule is configured for this packaging/storage combination.', 422);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($cycle, $actor, $rule) {
            $sterilizedAt = $cycle->completed_at;
            $useByDate = $sterilizedAt->clone()->addDays($rule->shelf_life_days);

            $labels = $cycle->items()->orderBy('sequence_in_cycle')->get()->map(
                fn ($item) => Label::create([
                    'tenant_id' => $cycle->tenant_id,
                    'cycle_item_id' => $item->id,
                    'status' => 'created',
                    'packaging_type' => $rule->packaging_type,
                    'storage_condition' => $rule->storage_condition,
                    'shelf_life_days' => $rule->shelf_life_days,
                    'sterilized_at' => $sterilizedAt,
                    'use_by_date' => $useByDate,
                    'print_counter' => 0,
                    // UI-28: which DLU rule *version* computed this — the
                    // durable link a dossier reads, replacing the old
                    // dlu_rule_id-in-audit-JSON-only approach below.
                    'dlu_rule_version_id' => $rule->current_version_id,
                ])
            );

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $cycle->tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'labels.generated',
                subjectType: Cycle::class,
                subjectId: $cycle->id,
                newValues: ['count' => $labels->count(), 'dlu_rule_id' => $rule->id, 'dlu_rule_version_id' => $rule->current_version_id],
                request: $this->request,
            );

            return $labels;
        });
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Labeling/Actions/PrintLabelAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Labeling\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Enums\LabelStatus;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\LabelPrint;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * The first print needs no reason. Every print after that is a reprint and
 * CLAUDE.md invariant #4 applies: "A reprint requires a reason, increments
 * print_counter, writes a label_prints row" — enforced here via the
 * ReleaseCycleRequest-style required_if in PrintLabelRequest, keyed off
 * the label's current status rather than another field on the request.
 */
class PrintLabelAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    public function execute(Label $label, User $actor, ?string $reason): Label
    {
        if (in_array($label->status, [LabelStatus::Recalled, LabelStatus::Voided], true)) {
            throw new ApiException('LABEL_NOT_PRINTABLE', 'A recalled or voided label can no longer be printed.', 409);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($label, $actor, $reason) {
            $label = Label::where('id', $label->id)->lockForUpdate()->first();
            $isReprint = $label->status === LabelStatus::Printed;
            $sequence = $label->print_counter + 1;
            // UI-28: which label-format version is rendering THIS print —
            // a print-time concern (see LabelFormatVersion's docblock),
            // recorded per print event rather than frozen on the label.
            $tenant = Tenant::current();
            $formatVersion = $tenant ? UpdateLabelFormatAction::current($tenant) : null;

            LabelPrint::create([
                'tenant_id' => $label->tenant_id,
                'label_id' => $label->id,
                'printed_by_user_id' => $actor->id,
                'sequence' => $sequence,
                'reason' => $reason,
                'printed_at' => now(),
                'label_format_version_id' => $formatVersion?->id,
            ]);

            $label->update(['status' => LabelStatus::Printed, 'print_counter' => $sequence]);

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $label->tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: $isReprint ? 'label.reprinted' : 'label.printed',
                subjectType: Label::class,
                subjectId: $label->id,
                reason: $reason,
                newValues: ['sequence' => $sequence],
                request: $this->request,
            );

            return $label;
        });
    }
}

==================== ./app/Domain/Labeling/Actions/ResolveLabelScanAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Labeling\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Enums\LabelStatus;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * CLAUDE.md invariant #5: "Scanning a recalled/expired label returns 410
 * with a blocking code + audit event." Voided isn't named in that
 * invariant but gets the same treatment — it's the same kind of "this
 * physical label must not be trusted" state. Expiry is lazy: nothing else
 * in the codebase transitions Printed -> Expired yet, so this is where
 * that transition actually happens, the first time anyone scans it past
 * its use-by date.
 */
class ResolveLabelScanAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    public function execute(string $code, User $actor): Label
    {
        $labelId = self::extractLabelId($code);

        // Postgres errors on an invalid UUID literal rather than matching
        // zero rows — a garbage/unknown code must 404 cleanly, not 500.
        $label = Str::isUuid($labelId)
            ? Label::with(['cycleItem.cycle.device.site'])->find($labelId)
            : null;

        if ($label === null) {
            throw new ApiException('LABEL_NOT_FOUND', 'No label matches this code.', 404);
        }

        if ($label->status === LabelStatus::Recalled) {
            $this->blockScan($label, $actor, 'label.scan_blocked_recalled');
            throw new ApiException('LABEL_RECALLED', 'This label has been recalled and must not be used.', 410);
        }

        if ($label->status === LabelStatus::Voided) {
            $this->blockScan($label, $actor, 'label.scan_blocked_voided');
            throw new ApiException('LABEL_VOIDED', 'This label has been voided and must not be used.', 410);
        }

        if ($label->status !== LabelStatus::Expired && $label->use_by_date->isPast()) {
            $label->update(['status' => LabelStatus::Expired]);
        }

        if ($label->status === LabelStatus::Expired) {
            $this->blockScan($label, $actor, 'label.scan_blocked_expired');
            throw new ApiException('LABEL_EXPIRED', 'This label is past its use-by date.', 410);
        }

        if ($label->status === LabelStatus::Printed) {
            $label->update(['status' => LabelStatus::Used]);
            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $label->tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'label.used',
                subjectType: Label::class,
                subjectId: $label->id,
                request: $this->request,
            );
        }

        return $label;
    }

    private function blockScan(Label $label, User $actor, string $action): void
    {
        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $label->tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: $action,
            subjectType: Label::class,
            subjectId: $label->id,
            request: $this->request,
        );
    }

    private static function extractLabelId(string $code): string
    {
        $prefix = 'urn:steriqore:label:';

        return Str::startsWith($code, $prefix) ? Str::after($code, $prefix) : $code;
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Labeling/Actions/UpdateDluRuleAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Labeling\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\DluRule;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\DluRuleVersion;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * UI-28: versioned — see CreateDluRuleAction's docblock. Changing
 * shelf_life_days here never rewrites a label already printed: labels
 * freeze their own copy of it (and now a real FK to the version that
 * produced it) at generation time (CLAUDE.md).
 */
class UpdateDluRuleAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    public function execute(DluRule $rule, User $actor, array $attributes, string $reason): DluRule
    {
        if (
            (isset($attributes['packaging_type']) || isset($attributes['storage_condition']))
            && DluRule::where('packaging_type', $attributes['packaging_type'] ?? $rule->packaging_type)
                ->where('storage_condition', $attributes['storage_condition'] ?? $rule->storage_condition)
                ->where('id', '!=', $rule->id)
                ->exists()
        ) {
            throw new ApiException('DLU_RULE_ALREADY_EXISTS', 'A rule for this packaging/storage combination already exists.', 409);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($rule, $actor, $attributes, $reason) {
            $oldValues = $rule->only(array_keys($attributes));

            $version = DluRuleVersion::create([
                'tenant_id' => $rule->tenant_id,
                'packaging_type' => $attributes['packaging_type'] ?? $rule->packaging_type,
                'storage_condition' => $attributes['storage_condition'] ?? $rule->storage_condition,
                'shelf_life_days' => $attributes['shelf_life_days'] ?? $rule->shelf_life_days,
                'actor_id' => $actor->id,
                'reason' => $reason,
                'effective_from' => now(),
            ]);

            $rule->update($attributes + ['current_version_id' => $version->id]);

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $rule->tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'dlu_rule.updated',
                subjectType: DluRule::class,
                subjectId: $rule->id,
                oldValues: $oldValues,
                newValues: $attributes,
                reason: $reason,
                request: $this->request,
            );

            return $rule;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Labeling\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\LabelFormatVersion;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/**
 * UI-28: versioned — see the 2026_08_07_000003 migration's docblock and
 * CreateDluRuleAction's. Applies to future prints only; every existing
 * label_prints row already recorded which version rendered it.
 */
class UpdateLabelFormatAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    public function execute(Tenant $tenant, User $actor, array $attributes, string $reason): LabelFormatVersion
    {
        $version = LabelFormatVersion::create($attributes + [
            'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
            'actor_id' => $actor->id,
            'reason' => $reason,
            'effective_from' => now(),
        ]);

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'label_format.updated',
            subjectType: LabelFormatVersion::class,
            subjectId: $version->id,
            newValues: $attributes,
            reason: $reason,
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return $version;
    }

    public static function current(Tenant $tenant): ?LabelFormatVersion
    {
        return LabelFormatVersion::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
            ->latest('effective_from')
            ->first();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Labeling\Data;

use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\LabelFormatVersion;
use Spatie\LaravelData\Data;

class LabelFormatVersionData extends Data
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $primary_code,
        public readonly string $sheet_layout,

==================== ./app/Domain/Labeling/Enums/LabelSheetLayout.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Labeling\Enums;

enum LabelSheetLayout: string
{
    case A4_24 = 'a4_24';
    case A4_65 = 'a4_65';
    case Roll = 'roll';

    public function label(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::A4_24 => 'A4 sheet, 24 labels (4 x 6)',
            self::A4_65 => 'A4 sheet, 65 labels (5 x 13)',
            self::Roll => 'Continuous roll',
        };
    }

    /**
     * @return array{0: int, 1: int} [columns, rows] — how a test-print
     *                               sample sheet tiles the layout.
     */
    public function grid(): array
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::A4_24 => [4, 6],
            self::A4_65 => [5, 13],
            self::Roll => [1, 10],
        };
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Labeling\Models;

use App\Domain\Labeling\Enums\LabelStatus;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\CycleItem;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\LabelUsage;
use App\Support\Concerns\BelongsToTenant;
use App\Support\Concerns\HasUuidv7;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOne;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;

/**
 * The 2D payload encoded on the physical label is this row's own id:
 * urn:steriqore:label:<id> (CLAUDE.md) — opaque, never patient data.
 *
 * @property string $id
 * @property string $tenant_id
 * @property string $cycle_item_id
 * @property LabelStatus $status
 * @property string $packaging_type
 * @property string $storage_condition
 * @property int $shelf_life_days
 * @property Carbon $sterilized_at
 * @property Carbon $use_by_date
 * @property int $print_counter
 * @property string|null $dlu_rule_version_id
 */
class Label extends Model
{
    use BelongsToTenant;
    use HasUuidv7;

    protected $fillable = [
        'tenant_id', 'cycle_item_id', 'status', 'packaging_type', 'storage_condition',
        'shelf_life_days', 'sterilized_at', 'use_by_date', 'print_counter', 'dlu_rule_version_id',
    ];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'status' => LabelStatus::class,
            'shelf_life_days' => 'integer',
            'sterilized_at' => 'datetime',
            'use_by_date' => 'date',
            'print_counter' => 'integer',
        ];
    }

    public function urn(): string
    {
        return "urn:steriqore:label:{$this->id}";
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<CycleItem, $this>
     */
    public function cycleItem(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(CycleItem::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<LabelPrint, $this>
     */
    public function prints(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(LabelPrint::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasOne<LabelUsage, $this>
     */
    public function usage(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(LabelUsage::class);
    }

    /**
     * Which DLU rule version computed this label's own use_by_date/
     * shelf_life_days at generation time (UI-28) — the evidentiary link a
     * dossier reads, not something re-resolved live against dlu_rules.
     *
     * @return BelongsTo<DluRuleVersion, $this>
     */
    public function dluRuleVersion(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(DluRuleVersion::class);
    }

==================== ./app/Domain/Labeling/Support/LabelCodeRenderer.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Labeling\Support;

use BaconQrCode\Renderer\Image\SvgImageBackEnd;
use BaconQrCode\Renderer\ImageRenderer;
use BaconQrCode\Renderer\RendererStyle\RendererStyle;
use BaconQrCode\Writer;
use Com\Tecnick\Barcode\Barcode;

/**
 * Both codes encode the same opaque payload (urn:steriqore:label:<uuid> —
 * never patient data, never a secret, per CLAUDE.md). SVG output, not PNG:
 * it's what the label PDF sheet embeds directly as inline markup for
 * Browsershot/Chromium to rasterize, and it's what the standalone code
 * endpoints return too — one code path either way, no Imagick/GD needed
 * just to serve a 2D code.
 */
class LabelCodeRenderer
{
    public static function qrSvg(string $payload): string
    {
        $renderer = new ImageRenderer(new RendererStyle(300), new SvgImageBackEnd);

        return (new Writer($renderer))->writeString($payload);
    }

    public static function dataMatrixSvg(string $payload): string
    {
        $barcode = new Barcode;

        return $barcode->getBarcodeObj(
            type: 'DATAMATRIX',
            code: $payload,
            width: -4,
            height: -4,
            color: 'black',
        )->setBackgroundColor('white')->getSvgCode();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Purchasing\Actions;

use App\Domain\Catalog\Models\Product;
use App\Domain\Purchasing\Models\Supplier;
use App\Domain\Purchasing\Models\SupplierProduct;

/**
 * Links a product to a supplier reference (CLAUDE.md: "Product ↔ supplier
 * reference linked"). Idempotent by (supplier_id, product_id) — calling
 * again updates the existing link rather than erroring or duplicating.
 */
class AttachSupplierProductAction
{
    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    public function execute(Supplier $supplier, Product $product, array $attributes): SupplierProduct
    {
        return SupplierProduct::updateOrCreate(
            ['tenant_id' => $supplier->tenant_id, 'supplier_id' => $supplier->id, 'product_id' => $product->id],
            $attributes,
        );
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Purchasing/Actions/CancelPurchaseOrderAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Purchasing\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Purchasing\Enums\PurchaseOrderStatus;
use App\Domain\Purchasing\Models\PurchaseOrder;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class CancelPurchaseOrderAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    public function execute(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder, User $actor, ?string $reason): PurchaseOrder
    {
        if (! in_array($purchaseOrder->status, [PurchaseOrderStatus::Draft, PurchaseOrderStatus::Ordered], true)) {
            throw new ApiException(
                'INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION',
                "A purchase order can only be cancelled from draft or ordered (currently {$purchaseOrder->status->value}).",
                409,
            );
        }

        $purchaseOrder->update(['status' => PurchaseOrderStatus::Cancelled]);

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $purchaseOrder->tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'purchase_order.cancelled',
            subjectType: PurchaseOrder::class,
            subjectId: $purchaseOrder->id,
            reason: $reason,
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return $purchaseOrder;
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Purchasing/Actions/CreatePurchaseOrderAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Purchasing\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Purchasing\Enums\PurchaseOrderStatus;
use App\Domain\Purchasing\Models\PurchaseOrder;
use App\Domain\Purchasing\Models\Supplier;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class CreatePurchaseOrderAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<int, array{product_id: string, qty_ordered: int, unit_price?: string|null}>  $lines
     */
    public function execute(Tenant $tenant, Supplier $supplier, User $actor, array $lines): PurchaseOrder
    {
        $purchaseOrder = DB::transaction(function () use ($tenant, $supplier, $lines) {
            $purchaseOrder = PurchaseOrder::create([
                'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
                'supplier_id' => $supplier->id,
                'status' => PurchaseOrderStatus::Draft,
            ]);

            foreach ($lines as $line) {
                $purchaseOrder->lines()->create([
                    'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
                    'product_id' => $line['product_id'],
                    'qty_ordered' => $line['qty_ordered'],
                    'unit_price' => $line['unit_price'] ?? null,
                ]);
            }

            return $purchaseOrder;
        });

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'purchase_order.created',
            subjectType: PurchaseOrder::class,
            subjectId: $purchaseOrder->id,
            newValues: ['supplier_id' => $supplier->id, 'lines' => $lines],
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return $purchaseOrder->load('lines');
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Purchasing/Actions/CreateSupplierAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Purchasing\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Purchasing\Models\Supplier;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class CreateSupplierAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    public function execute(Tenant $tenant, User $actor, array $attributes): Supplier
    {
        if (Supplier::where('name', $attributes['name'])->exists()) {
            throw new ApiException('SUPPLIER_NAME_TAKEN', 'A supplier with this name already exists.', 409);
        }

        $supplier = Supplier::create($attributes + ['tenant_id' => $tenant->id]);

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'supplier.created',
            subjectType: Supplier::class,
            subjectId: $supplier->id,
            newValues: $attributes,
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return $supplier;
    }
}

<?php

use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\StockMovementType;
