    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private RecordStockMovementAction $recordStockMovement,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<int, array{purchase_order_line_id: string, batch_number: string, expiry_date: ?string, qty: int, discrepancy_reason?: ?string}>  $lines
     */
    public function execute(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder, StorageLocation $location, User $actor, array $lines): GoodsReceipt
    {
        if (! in_array($purchaseOrder->status, [PurchaseOrderStatus::Ordered, PurchaseOrderStatus::PartiallyReceived], true)) {
            throw new ApiException(
                'INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION',
                "Goods can only be received for an ordered or partially received purchase order (currently {$purchaseOrder->status->value}).",
                409,
            );
        }

        $receipt = DB::transaction(function () use ($purchaseOrder, $location, $actor, $lines) {
            $receipt = GoodsReceipt::create([
                'tenant_id' => $purchaseOrder->tenant_id,
                'purchase_order_id' => $purchaseOrder->id,
                'received_by' => $actor->id,
                'received_at' => now(),
            ]);

            foreach ($lines as $line) {
                // FOR UPDATE: two concurrent receipts against the same line
                // must not race on qty_received (CLAUDE.md cross-cutting
                // requirement — locking on stock-adjacent rows).
                $orderLine = PurchaseOrderLine::where('id', $line['purchase_order_line_id'])
                    ->where('purchase_order_id', $purchaseOrder->id)
                    ->lockForUpdate()
                    ->firstOrFail();

                $batch = Batch::firstOrCreate(
                    [
                        'tenant_id' => $purchaseOrder->tenant_id,
                        'product_id' => $orderLine->product_id,
                        'batch_number' => $line['batch_number'],
                    ],
                    [
                        'supplier_id' => $purchaseOrder->supplier_id,
                        'expiry_date' => $line['expiry_date'] ?? null,
                        'received_at' => now(),
                        'status' => 'active',
                    ],
                );

                $receiptLine = $receipt->lines()->create([
                    'tenant_id' => $purchaseOrder->tenant_id,
                    'purchase_order_line_id' => $orderLine->id,
                    'product_id' => $orderLine->product_id,
                    'batch_id' => $batch->id,
                    'qty' => $line['qty'],
                    'discrepancy_reason' => $line['discrepancy_reason'] ?? null,
                ]);

                $this->recordStockMovement->execute(
                    tenant: $purchaseOrder->tenant,
                    type: StockMovementType::Receipt,
                    batch: $batch,
                    location: $location,
                    qty: $line['qty'],
                    groupId: $receipt->id,
                    reason: $receiptLine->discrepancy_reason,
                    actor: $actor,
                );

                $orderLine->increment('qty_received', $line['qty']);
            }

            $purchaseOrder->refresh();
            $isFullyReceived = $purchaseOrder->lines()->whereColumn('qty_received', '<', 'qty_ordered')->doesntExist();

            $purchaseOrder->update([
                'status' => $isFullyReceived ? PurchaseOrderStatus::Received : PurchaseOrderStatus::PartiallyReceived,
            ]);

            return $receipt;
        });

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $purchaseOrder->tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'goods_receipt.created',
            subjectType: GoodsReceipt::class,
            subjectId: $receipt->id,
            newValues: ['purchase_order_id' => $purchaseOrder->id, 'location_id' => $location->id, 'lines' => $lines],
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return $receipt->load('lines');
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Purchasing/Actions/UpdateSupplierAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Purchasing\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Purchasing\Models\Supplier;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class UpdateSupplierAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    public function execute(Supplier $supplier, User $actor, array $attributes): Supplier
    {
        if (
            isset($attributes['name'])
            && Supplier::where('name', $attributes['name'])->where('id', '!=', $supplier->id)->exists()
        ) {
            throw new ApiException('SUPPLIER_NAME_TAKEN', 'A supplier with this name already exists.', 409);
        }

        $oldValues = $supplier->only(array_keys($attributes));
        $supplier->update($attributes);

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $supplier->tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'supplier.updated',
            subjectType: Supplier::class,
            subjectId: $supplier->id,
            oldValues: $oldValues,
            newValues: $attributes,
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return $supplier;
    }
}

==================== ./app/Domain/Purchasing/Enums/PurchaseOrderStatus.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Purchasing\Enums;

/**
 * draft -> ordered -> partially_received -> received -> closed | cancelled
 * (CLAUDE.md). Transitions are enforced in PurchaseOrderTransitions, not
 * here — they depend on line quantities, not just the current status.
 */
enum PurchaseOrderStatus: string
{
    case Draft = 'draft';
    case Ordered = 'ordered';
    case PartiallyReceived = 'partially_received';
    case Received = 'received';
    case Closed = 'closed';
    case Cancelled = 'cancelled';
}

==================== ./app/Domain/Reporting/Actions/BuildDashboardAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Reporting\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\NonConformity;
use App\Domain\Equipment\Enums\DeviceKind;
use App\Domain\Equipment\Models\Device;
use App\Domain\Equipment\Models\DeviceProgram;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\AlertState;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\AlertType;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Alert;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Enums\LabelStatus;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Data\AttentionCardData;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Data\DashboardData;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Data\OnboardingStepData;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Data\RecentProcedureData;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Data\TodayCycleData;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Enums\CycleStatus;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\Cycle;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Site;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\LabelUsage;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Dashboard\DashboardCache;
use Throwable;

/**
 * UI-30: "what needs me today," not an analytics page. Every count here
 * either IS or mirrors exactly the query its target list screen filters
 * with (see the `missing_non_conformity`/`resolved`/`overdue` filters
 * added to CycleController/NonConformityController/LabelController, and
 * the Alert type/state filters AlertController already had) — never a
 * separately-maintained aggregate that could drift from what clicking
 * through actually shows.
 *
 * The tenant-wide facts (attention counts, today's cycles, onboarding
 * state) are cached and identical for every viewer; per-viewer
 * personalization (which cards this user's permissions allow, their own
 * recent procedures) is applied after the cache read, never inside it, so
 * one tenant-scoped cache entry serves every role.
 *
 * Each attention card's query is its own try/catch: a broken query in one
 * domain marks just that card `error: true` (frontend renders its error
 * state) rather than throwing and blanking the whole page — the same
 * "one failing query degrades that card" isolation applies to today's
 * cycles and the practitioner's recent procedures as their own units.
 *
 * "Control tests overdue/due today" is deliberately not a card here: no
 * per-tenant test frequency/tolerance rule exists to determine "overdue"
 * against (OQ-7) — building one would mean inventing a compliance rule,
 * which the per-task contract forbids. Skipped by explicit user decision,
 * same precedent as UI-17 (inventory counts).
 */
class BuildDashboardAction
{
    public function execute(Tenant $tenant, User $user): DashboardData
    {
        $snapshot = DashboardCache::remember($tenant, fn () => $this->buildSnapshot($tenant));

        if ($snapshot['is_new_practice']) {
            return new DashboardData(
                is_new_practice: true,
                onboarding_steps: $this->onboardingSteps($snapshot['onboarding'], $user),
                attention_cards: [],
                today_cycles: [],
                today_cycles_error: false,
                my_recent_procedures: [],
                my_recent_procedures_error: false,
            );
        }

        $attentionCards = collect($snapshot['attention_cards'])
            ->filter(fn (array $card) => $user->can($card['permission']))
            ->map(fn (array $card) => new AttentionCardData($card['key'], $card['label'], $card['count'], $card['error']))
            ->values()
            ->all();

        $todayCycles = $user->can('cycles.view')
            ? array_map(fn (array $row) => new TodayCycleData(...$row), $snapshot['today_cycles']['rows'])
            : [];

        [$recentProcedures, $recentProceduresError] = $this->myRecentProcedures($user);

        return new DashboardData(
            is_new_practice: false,
            onboarding_steps: [],
            attention_cards: $attentionCards,
            today_cycles: $todayCycles,
            today_cycles_error: $snapshot['today_cycles']['error'],
            my_recent_procedures: $recentProcedures,
            my_recent_procedures_error: $recentProceduresError,
        );
    }

    /**
     * @return array{is_new_practice: true, onboarding: array{site: bool, autoclave: bool, program: bool, cycle: bool}}|array{
     *     is_new_practice: false,
     *     attention_cards: array<int, array{key: string, label: string, permission: string, count: int, error: bool}>,
     *     today_cycles: array{rows: array<int, array{id: string, cycle_number: int, device_name: string, status: string, release_decision: string|null}>, error: bool},
     * }
     */
    private function buildSnapshot(Tenant $tenant): array
    {
        $isNewPractice = ! Device::query()->exists() && ! Cycle::query()->exists();

        if ($isNewPractice) {
            return [
                'is_new_practice' => true,
                'onboarding' => [
                    'site' => Site::query()->exists(),
                    'autoclave' => Device::where('kind', DeviceKind::Autoclave)->exists(),
                    'program' => DeviceProgram::query()->exists(),
                    'cycle' => false,
                ],
            ];
        }

        return [
            'is_new_practice' => false,
            'attention_cards' => $this->buildAttentionCards($tenant),
            'today_cycles' => $this->buildTodayCycles($tenant),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{key: string, label: string, permission: string, count: int, error: bool}>
     */
    private function buildAttentionCards(Tenant $tenant): array
    {
        $timezone = $tenant->timezone;

        $definitions = [
            [
                'key' => 'cycles_awaiting_release',
                'label' => 'Cycles awaiting release',
                'permission' => 'cycles.view',
                'query' => fn () => Cycle::where('status', CycleStatus::AwaitingRelease)->count(),
            ],
            [
                'key' => 'cycles_rejected_no_non_conformity',
                'label' => 'Rejected cycles without a non-conformity',
                'permission' => 'cycles.view',
                'query' => fn () => Cycle::where('status', CycleStatus::Rejected)->whereDoesntHave('nonConformities')->count(),
            ],
            [
                'key' => 'open_non_conformities',
                'label' => 'Open non-conformities & recalls',
                'permission' => 'non_conformities.view',
                'query' => fn () => NonConformity::whereNull('resolved_at')->count(),
            ],
            [
                'key' => 'batches_expired_in_stock',
                'label' => 'Batches expired, still in stock',
                'permission' => 'alerts.view',
                'query' => fn () => Alert::where('type', AlertType::Expired)->where('state', AlertState::Open)->count(),
            ],
            [
                'key' => 'batches_near_expiry',
                'label' => 'Batches expiring soon',
                'permission' => 'alerts.view',
                'query' => fn () => Alert::where('type', AlertType::NearExpiry)->where('state', AlertState::Open)->count(),
            ],
            [
                'key' => 'products_low_stock',
                'label' => 'Products below their low-stock threshold',
                'permission' => 'alerts.view',
                'query' => fn () => Alert::where('type', AlertType::LowStock)->where('state', AlertState::Open)->count(),
            ],
            [
                'key' => 'labels_past_dlu_unused',
                'label' => 'Labels past use-by, never used',
                'permission' => 'labels.view',
                'query' => fn () => Label::whereIn('status', [LabelStatus::Created, LabelStatus::Printed])
                    ->where('use_by_date', '<', now($timezone)->toDateString())
                    ->count(),
            ],
        ];

        return array_map(function (array $def) {
            try {
                return [
                    'key' => $def['key'],
                    'label' => $def['label'],
                    'permission' => $def['permission'],
                    'count' => $def['query'](),
                    'error' => false,
                ];
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                report($e);

                return [
                    'key' => $def['key'],
                    'label' => $def['label'],
                    'permission' => $def['permission'],
                    'count' => 0,
                    'error' => true,
                ];
            }
        }, $definitions);
    }

    /**
     * @return array{rows: array<int, array{id: string, cycle_number: int, device_name: string, status: string, release_decision: string|null}>, error: bool}
     */
    private function buildTodayCycles(Tenant $tenant): array
    {
        try {
            $todayStart = now($tenant->timezone)->startOfDay()->setTimezone('UTC');
            $todayEnd = now($tenant->timezone)->endOfDay()->setTimezone('UTC');

            $rows = Cycle::whereBetween('started_at', [$todayStart, $todayEnd])
                ->with(['device:id,name', 'release:id,cycle_id,decision'])
                ->orderBy('cycle_number')
                ->get()
                ->map(fn (Cycle $cycle) => [
                    'id' => $cycle->id,
                    'cycle_number' => $cycle->cycle_number,
                    'device_name' => $cycle->device->name,
                    'status' => $cycle->status->value,
                    'release_decision' => $cycle->release?->decision?->value,
                ])
                ->all();

            return ['rows' => $rows, 'error' => false];
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            report($e);

            return ['rows' => [], 'error' => true];
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param  array{site: bool, autoclave: bool, program: bool, cycle: bool}  $onboarding
     * @return OnboardingStepData[]
     */
    private function onboardingSteps(array $onboarding, User $user): array
    {
        return [
            new OnboardingStepData('add_site', 'Add a site', $onboarding['site'], $user->can('sites.manage')),
            new OnboardingStepData('add_autoclave', 'Add an autoclave', $onboarding['autoclave'], $user->can('devices.manage')),
            new OnboardingStepData('add_program', 'Add a program', $onboarding['program'], $user->can('devices.manage')),
            new OnboardingStepData('run_first_cycle', 'Run your first cycle', $onboarding['cycle'], $user->can('cycles.manage')),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array{0: RecentProcedureData[], 1: bool}
     */
    private function myRecentProcedures(User $user): array
    {
        if (! $user->can('usages.view')) {
            return [[], false];
        }

        try {
            $procedures = LabelUsage::where('practitioner_id', $user->id)
                ->orderByDesc('used_at')
                ->limit(5)
                ->get()
                ->map(fn (LabelUsage $usage) => new RecentProcedureData($usage->label_id, $usage->procedure, $usage->used_at->toIso8601String()))
                ->all();

            return [$procedures, false];
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            report($e);

            return [[], true];
        }
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Reporting/Actions/ExpireDataExportsAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Reporting\Actions;

use App\Domain\Reporting\Enums\DataExportStatus;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Models\DataExportRequest;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

/**
 * UI-29: once GenerateDataExportJob's expires_at has passed, the archive is
 * no longer meant to be downloadable (GenerateDataExportDownloadUrlAction
 * already refuses at that point) — this reclaims the S3 object itself and
 * flips the row to Expired so the history screen stops offering a download
 * button instead of erroring on click.
 */
class ExpireDataExportsAction
{
    public function execute(Tenant $tenant): int
    {
        $expired = DataExportRequest::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
            ->where('status', DataExportStatus::Completed)
            ->whereNotNull('expires_at')
            ->where('expires_at', '<=', now())
            ->get();

        foreach ($expired as $exportRequest) {
            if ($exportRequest->file_path !== null) {
                Storage::disk('backups')->delete($exportRequest->file_path);
            }

            $exportRequest->update(['status' => DataExportStatus::Expired, 'file_path' => null]);
        }

        return $expired->count();
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Reporting/Actions/GenerateDataExportDownloadUrlAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Reporting\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Enums\DataExportStatus;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Models\DataExportRequest;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

/**
 * UI-29: a stored presigned URL is never rendered — it's generated here, on
 * click, and this call is the thing that gets audited (data_export.downloaded),
 * distinct from the data_export.requested event RequestDataExportAction
 * writes. A 30-minute URL sitting in a page for an hour is both a broken
 * download and a leaked link, so nothing upstream of this Action ever sees
 * or stores the URL.
 */
class GenerateDataExportDownloadUrlAction
{
    public const int URL_TTL_MINUTES = 30;

    public function __construct(private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent, private Request $request) {}

    public function execute(Tenant $tenant, DataExportRequest $exportRequest, User $actor): string
    {
        if ($exportRequest->status !== DataExportStatus::Completed || $exportRequest->file_path === null) {
            throw new ApiException('EXPORT_NOT_READY', 'This export is not ready to download yet.', 409);
        }

        if ($exportRequest->expires_at !== null && $exportRequest->expires_at->isPast()) {
            throw new ApiException('EXPORT_EXPIRED', 'This export has expired. Request a new one.', 410);
        }

        $url = Storage::disk('backups')->temporaryUrl(
            $exportRequest->file_path,
            now()->addMinutes(self::URL_TTL_MINUTES),
        );

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'data_export.downloaded',
            subjectType: DataExportRequest::class,
            subjectId: $exportRequest->id,
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return $url;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Reporting\Actions;

use App\Domain\Labeling\Support\LabelCodeRenderer;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\LabelUsage;
use Spatie\LaravelPdf\Facades\Pdf;

/**
 * "One click produces the inspection-ready evidence dossier PDF"
 * (CLAUDE.md) — the complete chain for one pouch: device, cycle, its
 * control tests, its release decision, the label itself, and who used it
 * on which (pseudonymized) patient for which procedure.

class RenderEvidenceDossierAction

    {

            'label.cycleItem.cycle.deviceProgram',

==================== ./app/Domain/Reporting/Actions/RequestDataExportAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Reporting\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\ResolveTenantUsersWithRoleAction;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Enums\DataExportStatus;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Jobs\GenerateDataExportJob;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Mail\DataExportRequestedMail;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Models\DataExportRequest;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;

/**
 * S6 data portability: an account-wide export is far more sensitive than
 * the S4-ANA-04 evidence dossier (every table, every file, not one
 * filtered slice), hence its own data_exports.manage permission
 * (owner/admin only) rather than reusing exports.manage.
 *
 * UI-29: rate-limited two ways — never more than one in flight per
 * tenant, and a weekly cap. Both numbers are DECISION NEEDED defaults
 * (docs/open-questions.md), not specified by the brief.
 */
class RequestDataExportAction
{
    public const int WEEKLY_LIMIT = 5;

    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private ResolveTenantUsersWithRoleAction $resolveUsersWithRole,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    public function execute(Tenant $tenant, User $actor): DataExportRequest
    {
        if (DataExportRequest::whereIn('status', [DataExportStatus::Pending, DataExportStatus::Processing])->exists()) {
            throw new ApiException('EXPORT_ALREADY_RUNNING', 'An export is already in progress for this practice. Wait for it to finish before requesting another.', 409);
        }

        $recentCount = DataExportRequest::where('created_at', '>=', now()->subWeek())->count();

        if ($recentCount >= self::WEEKLY_LIMIT) {
            throw new ApiException('EXPORT_WEEKLY_LIMIT_REACHED', 'No more than '.self::WEEKLY_LIMIT.' exports can be requested per week for this practice.', 429);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($tenant, $actor) {
            $exportRequest = DataExportRequest::create([
                'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
                'requested_by_user_id' => $actor->id,
                'status' => DataExportStatus::Pending,
            ]);

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'data_export.requested',
                subjectType: DataExportRequest::class,
                subjectId: $exportRequest->id,
                request: $this->request,
            );

            // Out-of-band notification so a compromised admin/owner
            // account quietly exporting everything is detectable — sent
            // to every owner, including when the requester is one.
            foreach ($this->resolveUsersWithRole->execute($tenant, 'owner') as $owner) {
                Mail::to($owner->email)->queue(new DataExportRequestedMail($owner, $tenant, $actor));
            }

            GenerateDataExportJob::dispatch($exportRequest->id);

            return $exportRequest;
        });
    }
}

==================== ./app/Domain/Reporting/Exports/EvidenceExport.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Reporting\Exports;

use App\Domain\Traceability\Actions\SearchEvidenceAction;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\LabelUsage;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\FromQuery;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithHeadings;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithMapping;

/**
 * Exactly the evidence search results (S4-ANA-03) as a file — shares
 * SearchEvidenceAction::query() rather than re-implementing the filters,
 * so the export can never quietly drift from what the search actually
 * returns.
 *
 * @implements WithMapping<LabelUsage>
 */
class EvidenceExport implements FromQuery, WithHeadings, WithMapping
{
    /**
     * @param  array{patient_reference?: string, cycle_number?: int, batch_number?: string, device_id?: string, from?: string, to?: string}  $filters
     */
    public function __construct(private array $filters) {}

    /**
     * @return Builder<LabelUsage>
     */
    public function query(): Builder
    {
        return app(SearchEvidenceAction::class)->query($this->filters);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    public function headings(): array
    {
        return [
            'Label ID', 'Label status', 'Cycle number', 'Device', 'Site',
            'Batch number', 'Patient reference', 'Practitioner', 'Procedure', 'Used at',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, mixed>
     */
    public function map($usage): array
    {
        $item = $usage->label->cycleItem;
        $cycle = $item->cycle;

        return [
            $usage->label_id,
            $usage->label->status->value,
            $cycle->cycle_number,
            $cycle->device->name,
            $cycle->device->site->name,
            $item->batch?->batch_number,
            $usage->patient->reference,
            $usage->practitioner->name,
            $usage->procedure,
            $usage->used_at->toIso8601String(),
        ];
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Reporting/Jobs/GenerateDataExportJob.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Reporting\Jobs;

use App\Domain\Reporting\Enums\DataExportStatus;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Models\DataExportRequest;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\ModelNotFoundException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Bus\Dispatchable;
use Illuminate\Queue\InteractsWithQueue;
use Illuminate\Queue\SerializesModels;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\File;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;
use ZipArchive;

/**
 * S6: "full data+file portability export" — every tenant-owned table
 * (found via information_schema, not a hardcoded list, so a table added
 * later can never be silently missed) plus every file the tenant owns on
 * the 'media' disk, zipped into one archive.
 *
 * A queued job has no "current tenant" bound the way a request does, so
 * every DataExportRequest read/write below is wrapped in its own short
 * TenantContext::run() — the same helper SetCurrentTenant middleware
 * uses — otherwise both the Eloquent TenantScope global scope AND the
 * Postgres RLS policy on data_export_requests fail closed (zero rows),
 * exactly like the RegisterTenantAction bug fixed earlier this session.
 * Each call is its own short transaction rather than one big one wrapping
 * the whole job: TenantContext::run() commits via DB::transaction(), and
 * a single transaction spanning the entire zip/S3 upload would keep the
 * "processing" status invisible to a polling client until the whole job
 * finishes, then jump straight to "completed" — the intermediate state
 * would never actually be observable. The tenant_id itself is learned via
 * a raw 'pgsql_admin' scalar read (RLS-bypassing, not a scoped model)
 * since nothing is bound as "the current tenant" yet at that point.
 *
 * UI-29 added the manifest (per-table row counts, file count, total size)
 * so the ready-state screen can show the user what they're about to
 * download, and expires_at so a scheduled command (ExpireDataExports) can
 * delete the S3 object and mark the row Expired without a human involved.
 * RETENTION_DAYS is a DECISION NEEDED default (docs/open-questions.md),
 * not specified by the brief.
 */
class GenerateDataExportJob implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Dispatchable;
    use InteractsWithQueue;
    use Queueable;
    use SerializesModels;

    public const int RETENTION_DAYS = 7;

    public function __construct(public readonly string $dataExportRequestId) {}

    public function handle(): void
    {
        $tenantId = DB::connection('pgsql_admin')->table('data_export_requests')
            ->where('id', $this->dataExportRequestId)->value('tenant_id');

        if ($tenantId === null) {
            throw (new ModelNotFoundException)->setModel(DataExportRequest::class, [$this->dataExportRequestId]);
        }

        $tenantId = (string) $tenantId;
        $tenant = Tenant::findOrFail($tenantId);

        TenantContext::run($tenant, function () {
            DataExportRequest::findOrFail($this->dataExportRequestId)
                ->update(['status' => DataExportStatus::Processing]);
        });

        $workDir = storage_path("app/data-exports/{$this->dataExportRequestId}");
        File::ensureDirectoryExists($workDir);
        File::ensureDirectoryExists("{$workDir}/files");
        $zipPath = null;

        try {
            $tableManifest = $this->dumpTables($tenantId, $workDir);
            $fileCount = $this->copyMediaFiles($tenantId, "{$workDir}/files");

            $zipPath = storage_path("app/data-exports/{$this->dataExportRequestId}.zip");
            $this->zipDirectory($workDir, $zipPath);

            $diskPath = "data-exports/{$tenantId}/{$this->dataExportRequestId}.zip";
            $sizeBytes = filesize($zipPath);
            $stream = fopen($zipPath, 'r');
            if ($stream === false) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Could not open generated export archive at {$zipPath}.");
            }
            Storage::disk('backups')->put($diskPath, $stream);
            fclose($stream);

            TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($diskPath, $tableManifest, $fileCount, $sizeBytes) {
                DataExportRequest::findOrFail($this->dataExportRequestId)->update([
                    'status' => DataExportStatus::Completed,
                    'file_path' => $diskPath,
                    'completed_at' => now(),
                    'table_manifest' => $tableManifest,
                    'record_count' => array_sum($tableManifest),
                    'file_count' => $fileCount,
                    'size_bytes' => $sizeBytes !== false ? $sizeBytes : null,
                    'expires_at' => now()->addDays(self::RETENTION_DAYS),
                ]);
            });
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($e) {
                DataExportRequest::findOrFail($this->dataExportRequestId)
                    ->update(['status' => DataExportStatus::Failed, 'error' => $e->getMessage()]);
            });
            throw $e;
        } finally {
            File::deleteDirectory($workDir);
            if ($zipPath !== null && file_exists($zipPath)) {
                unlink($zipPath);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, int> table name => row count
     */
    private function dumpTables(string $tenantId, string $workDir): array
    {
        $tables = DB::connection('pgsql_admin')->select(<<<'SQL'
            select table_name from information_schema.columns
            where column_name = 'tenant_id' and table_schema = 'public'
            SQL);

        $manifest = [];

        foreach ($tables as $row) {
            $rows = DB::connection('pgsql_admin')->table($row->table_name)->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)->get();
            file_put_contents("{$workDir}/{$row->table_name}.json", $rows->toJson(JSON_PRETTY_PRINT));
            $manifest[$row->table_name] = $rows->count();
        }

        return $manifest;
    }

    private function copyMediaFiles(string $tenantId, string $filesDir): int
    {
        $mediaRows = DB::connection('pgsql_admin')->table('media')->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)->get();
        $copied = 0;

        foreach ($mediaRows as $media) {
            $diskPath = "{$media->id}/{$media->file_name}";

            if (Storage::disk('media')->exists($diskPath)) {
                file_put_contents("{$filesDir}/{$media->file_name}", Storage::disk('media')->get($diskPath));
                $copied++;
            }
        }

        return $copied;
    }

    private function zipDirectory(string $sourceDir, string $zipPath): void
    {
        $zip = new ZipArchive;
        $zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE);

        $files = new \RecursiveIteratorIterator(
            new \RecursiveDirectoryIterator($sourceDir, \FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
            \RecursiveIteratorIterator::LEAVES_ONLY,
        );

        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $relativePath = substr($file->getPathname(), strlen($sourceDir) + 1);
            $zip->addFile($file->getPathname(), $relativePath);
        }

        $zip->close();
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Reporting/Mail/DataExportRequestedMail.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Reporting\Mail;

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Mail\Mailable;
use Illuminate\Mail\Mailables\Content;
use Illuminate\Mail\Mailables\Envelope;

/**
 * UI-29's out-of-band control: sent to every owner whenever a full-account
 * data export is requested, including when the requester is an owner
 * themselves — a compromised admin/owner quietly exfiltrating a practice's
 * data must be visible outside the audit log too. Mirrors DigestMail's
 * shape (ShouldQueue, envelope()/content() style).
 */
class DataExportRequestedMail extends Mailable implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable;

    public function __construct(
        public User $recipient,
        public Tenant $tenant,
        public User $requestedBy,
    ) {}

    public function envelope(): Envelope
    {
        return new Envelope(
            subject: "SteriQore — {$this->tenant->name}: data export requested",
        );
    }

    public function content(): Content
    {
        return new Content(
            markdown: 'emails.data-export-requested',
            with: [
                'recipientName' => $this->recipient->name,
                'tenantName' => $this->tenant->name,
                'requestedByName' => $this->requestedBy->name,
                'isSelf' => $this->requestedBy->is($this->recipient),
            ],
        );
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Reporting/Models/DataExportRequest.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Reporting\Models;

use App\Domain\Reporting\Enums\DataExportStatus;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Concerns\BelongsToTenant;
use App\Support\Concerns\HasUuidv7;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;

/**
 * @property string $id
 * @property string $tenant_id
 * @property string $requested_by_user_id
 * @property DataExportStatus $status
 * @property string|null $file_path
 * @property string|null $error
 * @property Carbon|null $completed_at
 * @property int|null $size_bytes
 * @property int|null $record_count
 * @property int|null $file_count
 * @property array<string, int>|null $table_manifest
 * @property Carbon|null $expires_at
 * @property Carbon $created_at
 */
class DataExportRequest extends Model
{
    use BelongsToTenant;
    use HasUuidv7;

    protected $fillable = [
        'tenant_id', 'requested_by_user_id', 'status', 'file_path', 'error', 'completed_at',
        'size_bytes', 'record_count', 'file_count', 'table_manifest', 'expires_at',
    ];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'status' => DataExportStatus::class,
            'completed_at' => 'datetime',
            'size_bytes' => 'integer',
            'record_count' => 'integer',
            'file_count' => 'integer',
            'table_manifest' => 'array',
            'expires_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function requestedBy(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'requested_by_user_id');
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Sterilization/Actions/AddCycleItemAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Sterilization\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Enums\CycleStatus;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\Cycle;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\CycleItem;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * The load can only be composed before the door closes — once a cycle is
 * Running, its item list is locked (real autoclaves don't let you add a
 * pouch mid-run).
 */
class AddCycleItemAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    public function execute(Cycle $cycle, User $actor, array $attributes): CycleItem
    {
        if ($cycle->status !== CycleStatus::Draft) {
            throw new ApiException('CYCLE_LOAD_LOCKED', 'Items can only be added to a cycle while it is still in draft.', 409);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($cycle, $actor, $attributes) {
            Cycle::where('id', $cycle->id)->lockForUpdate()->first();

            $nextSequence = ($cycle->items()->max('sequence_in_cycle') ?? 0) + 1;

            $item = $cycle->items()->create($attributes + [
                'tenant_id' => $cycle->tenant_id,
                'sequence_in_cycle' => $nextSequence,
            ]);

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $cycle->tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'cycle_item.created',
                subjectType: CycleItem::class,
                subjectId: $item->id,
                newValues: $attributes + ['sequence_in_cycle' => $nextSequence],
                request: $this->request,
            );

            return $item;
        });
    }
}

namespace App\Domain\Sterilization\Actions;

==================== ./app/Domain/Sterilization/Actions/CreateCycleAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Sterilization\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Equipment\Models\Device;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\Cycle;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class CreateCycleAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    public function execute(Tenant $tenant, Device $device, User $actor, array $attributes): Cycle
    {
        if ($device->status->value !== 'active') {
            throw new ApiException('DEVICE_NOT_ACTIVE', 'This device is not active and cannot start a new cycle.', 409);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($tenant, $device, $actor, $attributes) {
            // Row lock on the device so two concurrent cycle creations on
            // the same autoclave can never compute the same next number
            // (CLAUDE.md's "Transactions with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE").
            Device::where('id', $device->id)->lockForUpdate()->first();

            $nextNumber = (Cycle::where('device_id', $device->id)->max('cycle_number') ?? 0) + 1;

            $cycle = Cycle::create($attributes + [
                'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
                'device_id' => $device->id,
                'operator_id' => $actor->id,
                'cycle_number' => $nextNumber,
                'status' => 'draft',
            ]);
            $cycle->refresh();

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'cycle.created',
                subjectType: Cycle::class,
                subjectId: $cycle->id,
                newValues: $attributes + ['cycle_number' => $nextNumber],
                request: $this->request,
            );

            return $cycle;
        });
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Sterilization/Actions/RecordControlTestAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Sterilization\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\AlertSeverity;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\AlertState;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\AlertType;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Alert;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Enums\ControlTestResult;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Enums\CycleStatus;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\ControlTest;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\Cycle;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/**
 * Allowed any time from Completed through AwaitingRelease — not locked the
 * instant a cycle is submitted, because a biological indicator's result
 * can take 24-48h to incubate and legitimately arrives after submission.
 */
class RecordControlTestAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    public function execute(Cycle $cycle, User $actor, array $attributes): ControlTest
    {
        if (! in_array($cycle->status, [CycleStatus::Completed, CycleStatus::AwaitingRelease], true)) {
            throw new ApiException('CYCLE_NOT_READY_FOR_TESTS', 'Control tests can only be recorded once a cycle has completed running.', 409);
        }

        $test = $cycle->controlTests()->create($attributes + ['tenant_id' => $cycle->tenant_id]);

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $cycle->tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'control_test.recorded',
            subjectType: ControlTest::class,
            subjectId: $test->id,
            newValues: $attributes,
            request: $this->request,
        );

        if ($test->result === ControlTestResult::Fail) {
            Alert::firstOrCreate(
                [
                    'tenant_id' => $cycle->tenant_id,
                    'type' => AlertType::FailedCycle,
                    'subject_type' => Cycle::class,
                    'subject_id' => $cycle->id,
                    'state' => AlertState::Open,
                ],
                [
                    'severity' => AlertSeverity::Critical,
                    'message' => "Cycle #{$cycle->cycle_number} failed a {$test->type->value} control test.",
                ],
            );
        }

        return $test;
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Sterilization/Actions/ReleaseCycleAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Sterilization\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Enums\CycleReleaseDecision;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Enums\CycleStatus;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\Cycle;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\CycleRelease;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use App\Support\Dashboard\DashboardCache;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * The only place a cycle_releases row is ever written — there is no
 * update/delete action for it anywhere (CLAUDE.md invariant #3). Running
 * this twice on the same cycle is impossible: after the first call the
 * cycle is no longer AwaitingRelease, so the second attempt fails the
 * status check before it ever reaches the unique cycle_id constraint.
 */
class ReleaseCycleAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    public function execute(Cycle $cycle, User $actor, CycleReleaseDecision $decision, ?string $reason): CycleRelease
    {
        if ($cycle->status !== CycleStatus::AwaitingRelease) {
            throw new ApiException('CYCLE_INVALID_TRANSITION', 'Only a cycle awaiting release can be released or rejected.', 409);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($cycle, $actor, $decision, $reason) {
            $release = CycleRelease::create([
                'tenant_id' => $cycle->tenant_id,
                'cycle_id' => $cycle->id,
                'decision' => $decision,
                'released_by_user_id' => $actor->id,
                'released_at' => now(),
                'reason' => $reason,
            ]);

            $cycle->update([
                'status' => $decision === CycleReleaseDecision::Compliant ? CycleStatus::Released : CycleStatus::Rejected,
            ]);

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $cycle->tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: $decision === CycleReleaseDecision::Compliant ? 'cycle.released' : 'cycle.rejected',
                subjectType: Cycle::class,
                subjectId: $cycle->id,
                newValues: ['decision' => $decision->value, 'reason' => $reason],
                reason: $reason,
                request: $this->request,
            );

            DashboardCache::forget($cycle->tenant);

            return $release;
        });
    }
}

==================== ./app/Domain/Sterilization/Actions/StartCycleAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Sterilization\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Enums\CycleStatus;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\Cycle;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class StartCycleAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    public function execute(Cycle $cycle, User $actor): Cycle
    {
        if ($cycle->status !== CycleStatus::Draft) {
            throw new ApiException('CYCLE_INVALID_TRANSITION', 'Only a draft cycle can be started.', 409);
        }

        if ($cycle->items()->doesntExist()) {
            throw new ApiException('CYCLE_LOAD_EMPTY', 'At least one item must be in the load before starting the cycle.', 409);
        }

        $cycle->update(['status' => CycleStatus::Running, 'started_at' => now()]);

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $cycle->tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'cycle.started',
            subjectType: Cycle::class,
            subjectId: $cycle->id,
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return $cycle;
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Sterilization/Actions/SubmitCycleForReleaseAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Sterilization\Actions;

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $cycle->tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'cycle.submitted_for_release',
            subjectType: Cycle::class,
            subjectId: $cycle->id,
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return $cycle;
    }

namespace App\Domain\Sterilization\Data;

use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;

{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $id,
        public readonly string $file_name,
        public readonly ?string $mime_type,
        public readonly int $size,
        public readonly string $url,
        public readonly string $created_at,
    ) {}

    public static function fromModel(Media $media): self
    {
        return new self(
            // The base Spatie\MediaLibrary\...\Media class's own docblock

            (string) $media->id,
            $media->file_name,
            $media->mime_type,
            $media->size,
            $media->getTemporaryUrl(now()->addMinutes(10)),
            $media->created_at->toIso8601String(),
        );
    }
}

/**

==================== ./app/Domain/Tenancy/Actions/ArchiveRoomAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Tenancy\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Room;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\StorageLocation;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Never a hard delete — cascades to the room's storage locations so an
 * archived room never leaves an active location still pickable underneath
 * it, same reasoning as ArchiveSiteAction.
 */
class ArchiveRoomAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    public function execute(Room $room, User $actor, string $reason): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($room, $actor, $reason) {
            $locations = $room->storageLocations()->get();

            foreach ($locations as $location) {
                $location->delete();

                $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                    tenant: $room->tenant,
                    actor: $actor,
                    action: 'storage_location.archived',
                    subjectType: StorageLocation::class,
                    subjectId: $location->id,
                    reason: "Cascaded from archiving room \"{$room->name}\": {$reason}",
                    request: $this->request,
                );
            }

            $room->delete();

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $room->tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'room.archived',
                subjectType: Room::class,
                subjectId: $room->id,
                reason: $reason,
                request: $this->request,
            );
        });
    }

    /**
     * @return array{storage_locations: int}
     */
    public function previewImpact(Room $room): array
    {
        return [
            'storage_locations' => $room->storageLocations()->count(),
        ];
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Tenancy/Actions/ArchiveSiteAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Tenancy\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Equipment\Models\Device;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Room;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Site;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\StorageLocation;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Never a hard delete (CLAUDE.md: past evidence — devices, movements,
 * batches — keeps resolving an archived site/room/location by identity,
 * invariant #6's same reasoning applied to the tenancy hierarchy). Archiving
 * a site cascades to its rooms and storage locations so an archived site
 * never leaves an active room/location still pickable underneath it.
 */
class ArchiveSiteAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    public function execute(Site $site, User $actor, string $reason): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($site, $actor, $reason) {
            $rooms = $site->rooms()->get();
            $locations = $site->storageLocations()->get();

            foreach ($locations as $location) {
                $location->delete();

                $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                    tenant: $site->tenant,
                    actor: $actor,
                    action: 'storage_location.archived',
                    subjectType: StorageLocation::class,
                    subjectId: $location->id,
                    reason: "Cascaded from archiving site \"{$site->name}\": {$reason}",
                    request: $this->request,
                );
            }

            foreach ($rooms as $room) {
                $room->delete();

                $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                    tenant: $site->tenant,
                    actor: $actor,
                    action: 'room.archived',
                    subjectType: Room::class,
                    subjectId: $room->id,
                    reason: "Cascaded from archiving site \"{$site->name}\": {$reason}",
                    request: $this->request,
                );
            }

            $site->delete();

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $site->tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'site.archived',
                subjectType: Site::class,
                subjectId: $site->id,
                reason: $reason,
                request: $this->request,
            );
        });
    }

    /**
     * Read-only — the count a confirmation dialog shows BEFORE archiving,
     * same pattern as RaiseNonConformityAction::previewBlastRadius(). Must
     * stay in sync with execute()'s cascade above if either changes.
     *
     * @return array{rooms: int, storage_locations: int, devices: int}
     */
    public function previewImpact(Site $site): array
    {
        return [
            'rooms' => $site->rooms()->count(),
            'storage_locations' => $site->storageLocations()->count(),
            'devices' => Device::where('site_id', $site->id)->count(),
        ];
    }
}

==================== ./app/Domain/Tenancy/Actions/CreateRoomAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Tenancy\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Room;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Site;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class CreateRoomAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    public function execute(Site $site, User $actor, array $attributes): Room
    {
        if (Room::where('site_id', $site->id)->where('name', $attributes['name'])->exists()) {
            throw new ApiException('ROOM_NAME_TAKEN', 'A room with this name already exists at this site.', 409);
        }

        $room = Room::create($attributes + ['tenant_id' => $site->tenant_id, 'site_id' => $site->id]);

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $site->tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'room.created',
            subjectType: Room::class,
            subjectId: $room->id,
            newValues: $attributes,
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return $room;
    }
}

==================== ./app/Domain/Tenancy/Actions/UpdateRoomAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Tenancy\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\StockMovement;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Room;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Site;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class UpdateRoomAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes  May include 'site_id' to move the
     *                                            room to a different site — refused
     *                                            if any of its storage locations has
     *                                            ever recorded a stock movement, since
     *                                            that would misattribute historical
     *                                            evidence to a site it didn't happen at.
     */
    public function execute(Room $room, User $actor, array $attributes): Room
    {
        $targetSiteId = $attributes['site_id'] ?? $room->site_id;

        if (
            isset($attributes['name'])
            && Room::where('site_id', $targetSiteId)->where('name', $attributes['name'])->where('id', '!=', $room->id)->exists()
        ) {
            throw new ApiException('ROOM_NAME_TAKEN', 'A room with this name already exists at this site.', 409);
        }

        if ($targetSiteId !== $room->site_id) {
            $locationIds = $room->storageLocations()->pluck('id');

            if ($locationIds->isNotEmpty() && StockMovement::whereIn('location_id', $locationIds)->exists()) {
                throw new ApiException('ROOM_HAS_STOCK_HISTORY', 'This room has recorded stock movements and cannot be moved to a different site.', 409);
            }
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($room, $actor, $attributes, $targetSiteId) {
            $originalSiteId = $room->site_id;
            $oldValues = $room->only(array_keys($attributes));
            $room->update($attributes);

            if ($targetSiteId !== $originalSiteId) {
                $room->storageLocations()->update(['site_id' => $targetSiteId]);
            }

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $room->tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'room.updated',
                subjectType: Room::class,
                subjectId: $room->id,
                oldValues: $oldValues,
                newValues: $attributes,
                request: $this->request,
            );

            return $room;
        });
    }
}

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Room;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\StorageLocation;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class UpdateStorageLocationAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes  May include 'room_id' to move the
     *                                            location to a different room of
     *                                            the SAME site (the room/location
     *                                            tree only reorganizes within a
     *                                            site — moving stock across
     *                                            practice sites is its own,
     *                                            separate operation).
     */
    public function execute(StorageLocation $location, User $actor, array $attributes): StorageLocation
    {
        if (isset($attributes['room_id'])) {
            $room = Room::findOrFail((string) $attributes['room_id']);

            if ($room->site_id !== $location->site_id) {
                throw new ApiException('STORAGE_LOCATION_ROOM_DIFFERENT_SITE', 'A storage location can only move to a room at the same site.', 409);
            }
        }

        if (
            isset($attributes['name'])
            && StorageLocation::where('site_id', $location->site_id)->where('name', $attributes['name'])->where('id', '!=', $location->id)->exists()
        ) {
            throw new ApiException('STORAGE_LOCATION_NAME_TAKEN', 'A storage location with this name already exists at this site.', 409);
        }

        $oldValues = $location->only(array_keys($attributes));
        $location->update($attributes);

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $location->tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'storage_location.updated',
            subjectType: StorageLocation::class,
            subjectId: $location->id,
            oldValues: $oldValues,
            newValues: $attributes,
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return $location;
    }
}

==================== ./app/Domain/Tenancy/Models/Tenant.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Tenancy\Models;

use App\Domain\Identity\Models\Invitation;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Concerns\HasUuidv7;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsToMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\HasMedia;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\InteractsWithMedia;
use Spatie\Multitenancy\Concerns\UsesMultitenancyConfig;
use Spatie\Multitenancy\Contracts\IsTenant;
use Spatie\Multitenancy\Models\Concerns\ImplementsTenant;

/**
 * Implements spatie/laravel-multitenancy's IsTenant directly (not by
 * extending Spatie\Multitenancy\Models\Tenant, which forces a separate
 * "landlord" database connection we don't have — single shared DB + RLS
 * instead, see docs/erd.md section 4). `switch_tenant_tasks` is empty in
 * config/multitenancy.php, so makeCurrent() only binds this tenant into the
 * container; it does not switch any connection.
 *
 * @property string $id
 * @property string $name
 * @property string $slug
 * @property string $plan
 * @property string $status
 * @property Carbon|null $trial_ends_at
 * @property string|null $legal_name
 * @property string|null $address_line1
 * @property string|null $address_line2
 * @property string|null $postal_code
 * @property string|null $city
 * @property string|null $country_code
 * @property string|null $contact_email
 * @property string|null $contact_phone
 * @property string $timezone
 * @property string $locale
 */
class Tenant extends Model implements HasMedia, IsTenant
{
    use HasUuidv7;
    use ImplementsTenant;
    use InteractsWithMedia;
    use UsesMultitenancyConfig;

    protected $fillable = [
        'name', 'slug', 'plan', 'status', 'trial_ends_at',
        'legal_name', 'address_line1', 'address_line2', 'postal_code', 'city',
        'country_code', 'contact_email', 'contact_phone', 'timezone', 'locale',
    ];

    public function registerMediaCollections(): void
    {
        $this->addMediaCollection('logo')->singleFile();
    }

    /**
     * No per-tenant database in this architecture — required by IsTenant,
     * unused since switch_tenant_tasks never references it.
     */
    public function getDatabaseName(): string
    {
        return $this->slug;
    }

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'trial_ends_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<Site, $this>
     */
    public function sites(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Site::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<TenantUser, $this>
     */
    public function tenantUsers(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(TenantUser::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<Invitation, $this>
     */
    public function invitations(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Invitation::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsToMany<User, $this, TenantUser>
     */
    public function users(): BelongsToMany
    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(User::class, 'tenant_user')
            ->using(TenantUser::class)
            ->withPivot(['status', 'invited_at', 'joined_at', 'disabled_at'])
            ->withTimestamps();
    }
}

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\Patient;
use App\Models\User;

/**

 */
class ArchivePatientAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    {

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $patient->tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'patient.archived',
            subjectType: Patient::class,
            subjectId: $patient->id,
            request: $this->request,
        );
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Traceability/Actions/CreatePatientAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Traceability\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\Patient;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * The only input is "create a new pseudonym" — there is nothing else to
 * capture (see the patients migration's docblock on why). `reference` is
 * generated here, never client-supplied, so it can never accidentally
 * carry real patient data typed into a free-text field.
 */
class CreatePatientAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    public function execute(Tenant $tenant, User $actor): Patient
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($tenant, $actor) {
            DB::table('tenants')->where('id', $tenant->id)->lockForUpdate()->first();

            $nextNumber = (int) Patient::withTrashed()->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
                ->selectRaw('max(cast(substring(reference from 5) as integer)) as max_number')
                ->value('max_number') + 1;

            $patient = Patient::create([
                'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
                'reference' => 'PAT-'.str_pad((string) $nextNumber, 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT),
            ]);

            $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
                tenant: $tenant,
                actor: $actor,
                action: 'patient.created',
                subjectType: Patient::class,
                subjectId: $patient->id,
                newValues: ['reference' => $patient->reference],
                request: $this->request,
            );

            return $patient;
        });
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Traceability/Actions/RecordLabelUsageAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Traceability\Actions;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Enums\LabelStatus;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\LabelUsage;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/**
 * The last link in "pouch -> cycle -> device -> practitioner -> procedure
 * -> pseudonymized patient" (CLAUDE.md). Requires the label to already be
 * Used (LabelScanController transitions Printed -> Used on scan) — the
 * chain is scan first, then link, per CLAUDE.md's own ordering. Recalled/
 * voided is checked explicitly too: normally impossible to reach here in
 * that state (the scan gate already blocks it), except a label recalled
 * -after-use (S4-ANA-05), which is exactly what the backlog's acceptance
 * criterion ("a recalled or rejected label cannot be used") is guarding.
 */
class RecordLabelUsageAction
{
    public function __construct(
        private RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent,
        private Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    public function execute(Label $label, User $actor, array $attributes): LabelUsage
    {
        if (in_array($label->status, [LabelStatus::Recalled, LabelStatus::Voided], true)) {
            throw new ApiException('LABEL_NOT_USABLE', 'A recalled or voided label cannot be linked to a procedure.', 409);
        }

        if ($label->status !== LabelStatus::Used) {
            throw new ApiException('LABEL_NOT_SCANNED', 'A label must be scanned before it can be linked to a procedure.', 409);
        }

        if ($label->usage()->exists()) {
            throw new ApiException('LABEL_USAGE_ALREADY_RECORDED', 'This label already has a recorded usage.', 409);
        }

        $usage = $label->usage()->create($attributes + [
            'tenant_id' => $label->tenant_id,
            'used_at' => $attributes['used_at'] ?? now(),
        ]);

        $this->recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: $label->tenant,
            actor: $actor,
            action: 'label_usage.recorded',
            subjectType: LabelUsage::class,
            subjectId: $usage->id,
            newValues: $attributes,
            request: $this->request,
        );

        return $usage;
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Traceability/Actions/SearchEvidenceAction.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Traceability\Actions;

use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\LabelUsage;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\CursorPaginator;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

/**
 * REC-09: "search by patient/cycle/batch -> complete result < 2s at pilot
 * volume." Filters are all exact/prefix matches on structured columns
 * (a reference code, a cycle number, a batch number, a device id, a date
 * range) — not free text — so plain btree indexes on the relevant foreign
 * keys/columns are the deliberate indexing CLAUDE.md asks for here, not
 * GIN/tsvector (that's for genuine full-text search, which nothing in
 * this filter set actually needs).
 */
class SearchEvidenceAction
{
    /**
     * @param  array{patient_reference?: string, cycle_number?: int, batch_number?: string, device_id?: string, operator_id?: string, from?: string, to?: string}  $filters
     * @return CursorPaginator<int, LabelUsage>
     */
    public function execute(array $filters, int $perPage): CursorPaginator
    {
        return $this->query($filters)->cursorPaginate(perPage: $perPage);
    }

    /**
     * Shared with ExportEvidenceAction (S4-ANA-04) so the export is
     * exactly "these search results as a file," not a second filter
     * implementation that could quietly drift from the first.
     *
     * @param  array{patient_reference?: string, cycle_number?: int, batch_number?: string, device_id?: string, operator_id?: string, from?: string, to?: string}  $filters
     * @return Builder<LabelUsage>
     */
    public function query(array $filters): Builder
    {
        return LabelUsage::query()
            ->with(['label.cycleItem.cycle.device.site', 'label.cycleItem.cycle.operator', 'label.cycleItem.batch', 'patient', 'practitioner'])
            ->when(
                $filters['patient_reference'] ?? null,
                fn ($query, $value) => $query->whereHas('patient', fn ($q) => $q->where('reference', 'like', "%{$value}%"))
            )
            ->when(
                $filters['cycle_number'] ?? null,
                fn ($query, $value) => $query->whereHas('label.cycleItem.cycle', fn ($q) => $q->where('cycle_number', $value))
            )
            ->when(
                $filters['batch_number'] ?? null,
                fn ($query, $value) => $query->whereHas('label.cycleItem.batch', fn ($q) => $q->where('batch_number', 'like', "%{$value}%"))
            )
            ->when(
                $filters['device_id'] ?? null,
                fn ($query, $value) => $query->whereHas('label.cycleItem.cycle', fn ($q) => $q->where('device_id', $value))
            )
            ->when(
                // The cycle's operator (who ran the sterilization cycle) —
                // distinct from the practitioner who performed the
                // procedure on the patient.
                $filters['operator_id'] ?? null,
                fn ($query, $value) => $query->whereHas('label.cycleItem.cycle', fn ($q) => $q->where('operator_id', $value))
            )
            ->when($filters['from'] ?? null, fn ($query, $value) => $query->where('used_at', '>=', $value))
            ->when($filters['to'] ?? null, fn ($query, $value) => $query->where('used_at', '<=', $value))
            ->orderByDesc('used_at');
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Traceability/Data/EvidenceSearchResultData.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Traceability\Data;

use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\LabelUsage;
use Spatie\LaravelData\Data;

/**
 * One row per label usage — the natural unit tying pouch -> cycle ->
 * device -> practitioner -> procedure -> patient together for inspection
 * (CLAUDE.md's core loop), and what S4-ANA-04's evidence dossier export
 * will page through.
 */
class EvidenceSearchResultData extends Data
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $label_id,
        public readonly string $label_status,
        public readonly int $cycle_number,
        public readonly string $device_name,
        public readonly string $site_name,
        public readonly string $operator_name,
        public readonly ?string $batch_number,
        public readonly string $patient_reference,
        public readonly string $practitioner_name,
        public readonly string $procedure,
        public readonly string $used_at,
    ) {}

    public static function fromModel(LabelUsage $usage): self
    {
        $cycleItem = $usage->label->cycleItem;
        $cycle = $cycleItem->cycle;

        return new self(
            $usage->label_id,
            $usage->label->status->value,
            $cycle->cycle_number,
            $cycle->device->name,
            $cycle->device->site->name,
            $cycle->operator->name,
            $cycleItem->batch?->batch_number,
            $usage->patient->reference,
            $usage->practitioner->name,
            $usage->procedure,
            $usage->used_at->toIso8601String(),
        );
    }
}

==================== ./app/Domain/Traceability/Data/PatientUsageEntryData.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Traceability\Data;

use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\LabelUsage;
use Spatie\LaravelData\Data;

/**
 * The patient detail page's procedure history (UI-19) — LabelUsageData
 * (per-label, mobile API) has no reason to know the practitioner's name,
 * a client that already has that id doesn't need it. This is a second,
 * read-only shape over the same label_usages rows, linking out to the
 * label detail page (UI-07) for the full chain rather than repeating it.
 */
class PatientUsageEntryData extends Data
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $id,
        public readonly string $label_id,
        public readonly string $practitioner_name,
        public readonly string $procedure,
        public readonly string $used_at,
        public readonly ?string $notes,
    ) {}

    public static function fromModel(LabelUsage $usage): self
    {
        return new self(
            $usage->id,
            $usage->label_id,
            $usage->practitioner->name,
            $usage->procedure,
            $usage->used_at->toIso8601String(),
            $usage->notes,
        );
    }
}


==================== ./app/Domain/Traceability/Models/LabelUsage.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Domain\Traceability\Models;

use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Concerns\BelongsToTenant;
use App\Support\Concerns\HasUuidv7;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;

/**
 * Append-only (CLAUDE.md invariant #7) — never call ->update()/->delete();
 * the DB refuses it regardless via a trigger.
 *
 * @property string $id
 * @property string $tenant_id
 * @property string $label_id
 * @property string $patient_id
 * @property string $practitioner_id
 * @property string $procedure
 * @property Carbon $used_at
 * @property string|null $notes
 */
class LabelUsage extends Model
{
    use BelongsToTenant;
    use HasUuidv7;

    public const UPDATED_AT = null;

    protected $fillable = ['tenant_id', 'label_id', 'patient_id', 'practitioner_id', 'procedure', 'used_at', 'notes'];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'used_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<Label, $this>
     */
    public function label(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Label::class);
    }

    /**
     * withTrashed(): evidence keeps a patient's identity even after the
     * pseudonym is archived (ArchivePatientAction is a soft delete for
     * exactly this reason) — same principle as invariant #6 for disabled
     * users. Without this, a usage referencing an archived patient would
     * silently resolve to no patient at all.
     *
     * @return BelongsTo<Patient, $this>
     */
    public function patient(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Patient::class)->withTrashed();
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<User, $this>
     */
    public function practitioner(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'practitioner_id');
    }
}
