==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/AuditEventController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Data\AuditEventData;
use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\AuditEvent;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Compliance\ListAuditEventsRequest;
use Spatie\LaravelData\CursorPaginatedDataCollection;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\AllowedFilter;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\QueryBuilder;

class AuditEventController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * The append-only trail for the practice the current token is scoped
     * to — filtered by AuditEvent's TenantScope global scope, not a manual
     * where() here. Newest first; cursor-paginated per the API conventions.
     *
     * @return CursorPaginatedDataCollection<int, AuditEventData>
     */
    public function index(ListAuditEventsRequest $request): CursorPaginatedDataCollection
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', AuditEvent::class);

        $events = QueryBuilder::for(AuditEvent::class)
            ->allowedFilters(
                AllowedFilter::exact('actor_id'),
                AllowedFilter::exact('action'),
                AllowedFilter::exact('subject_type'),
                AllowedFilter::callback('from', function ($query, $value): void {
                    $query->where('occurred_at', '>=', $value);
                }),
                AllowedFilter::callback('to', function ($query, $value): void {
                    $query->where('occurred_at', '<=', $value);
                }),
            )
            ->allowedSorts('occurred_at')
            ->defaultSort('-occurred_at')
            ->cursorPaginate(perPage: (int) $request->integer('limit', 20));

        return AuditEventData::collect($events, CursorPaginatedDataCollection::class);
    }
}


==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Auth/LoginController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Auth;

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\AuthenticateUserAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Data\UserData;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Data\TenantData;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Auth\LoginRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;

class LoginController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Log in and receive a Sanctum token scoped to one practice.
     *
     * The token authenticates for `tenant_slug` only — a user who belongs to
     * more than one practice logs in once per practice and holds a separate
     * token for each. There is no client-supplied tenant on any other
     * endpoint; every subsequent request resolves its tenant from this token.
     */
    public function __invoke(LoginRequest $request, AuthenticateUserAction $action): JsonResponse
    {
        $result = $action->execute(
            $request->string('tenant_slug')->toString(),
            $request->string('email')->toString(),
            $request->string('password')->toString(),
        );

        return response()->json([
            'token' => $result['plain_text_token'],
            'token_type' => 'Bearer',
            'user' => UserData::fromModel($result['user']),
            'tenant' => TenantData::fromModel($result['tenant']),
        ], 200);
    }
}


==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Auth/LogoutController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Auth;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\PersonalAccessToken;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Response;

class LogoutController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Revoke the token used for this request. Other tokens (other devices,
     * other practices) are untouched.
     */
    public function __invoke(Request $request, RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent): Response
    {
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = $request->user();

        $recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: Tenant::current(),
            actor: $user,
            action: 'auth.logout',
            subjectType: User::class,
            subjectId: $user->id,
            request: $request,
        );

        /** @var PersonalAccessToken $token */
        $token = $user->currentAccessToken();
        $token->delete();

        return response()->noContent();
    }
}


==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Auth/LogoutEverywhereController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Auth;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordAuditEventAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\PersonalAccessToken;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Response;

class LogoutEverywhereController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Revoke every token for this practice — not just the one used for this
     * request. Tokens for other practices the same user belongs to are
     * untouched (a token authenticates for exactly one tenant).
     */
    public function __invoke(Request $request, RecordAuditEventAction $recordAuditEvent): Response
    {
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = $request->user();

        /** @var PersonalAccessToken $token */
        $token = $user->currentAccessToken();

        $recordAuditEvent->execute(
            tenant: Tenant::current(),
            actor: $user,
            action: 'auth.logout_everywhere',
            subjectType: User::class,
            subjectId: $user->id,
            request: $request,
        );

        $user->tokens()->where('tenant_id', $token->tenant_id)->delete();

        return response()->noContent();
    }
}

        $product = $action->execute(Tenant::current(), $request->user(), $request->validated());

        return ProductData::fromModel($product);

    {
        $this->authorize('view', $product);

        return ProductData::fromModel($product);
    }

        $this->authorize('update', $product);

        return ProductData::fromModel($action->execute($product, $request->user(), $request->validated()));
    }

    public function destroy(Product $product, Request $request, DeleteProductAction $action): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $product);

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Compliance;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RaiseNonConformityAction;
use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\ResolveNonConformityAction;
use App\Domain\Compliance\Data\NonConformityData;
use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\NonConformity;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\Cycle;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Compliance\RaiseNonConformityRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Compliance\ResolveNonConformityRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Spatie\LaravelData\CursorPaginatedDataCollection;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\AllowedFilter;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\QueryBuilder;

class NonConformityController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * @return CursorPaginatedDataCollection<int, NonConformityData>
     */
    public function index(Request $request): CursorPaginatedDataCollection
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', NonConformity::class);

        $nonConformities = QueryBuilder::for(NonConformity::class)
            ->allowedFilters(AllowedFilter::exact('subject_type'), AllowedFilter::exact('subject_id'))
            ->defaultSort('-raised_at')
            ->allowedSorts('raised_at')
            ->cursorPaginate(perPage: (int) $request->integer('limit', 20));

        return NonConformityData::collect($nonConformities, CursorPaginatedDataCollection::class);
    }

    public function store(RaiseNonConformityRequest $request, RaiseNonConformityAction $action): NonConformityData
    {
        $this->authorize('create', NonConformity::class);

        $subject = $request->string('subject_type')->toString() === 'cycle'
            ? Cycle::findOrFail($request->string('subject_id')->toString())
            : Label::findOrFail($request->string('subject_id')->toString());

        $nonConformity = $action->execute($subject, $request->user(), $request->string('description')->toString());

        return NonConformityData::fromModel($nonConformity);
    }

    public function show(NonConformity $nonConformity): NonConformityData
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $nonConformity);

        return NonConformityData::fromModel($nonConformity);
    }

    public function resolve(NonConformity $nonConformity, ResolveNonConformityRequest $request, ResolveNonConformityAction $action): NonConformityData
    {
        $this->authorize('resolve', $nonConformity);

        return NonConformityData::fromModel($action->execute($nonConformity, $request->user(), $request->string('resolution')->toString()));
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Equipment;

use App\Domain\Equipment\Actions\CreateDeviceProgramAction;
use App\Domain\Equipment\Actions\DeleteDeviceProgramAction;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Equipment\CreateDeviceProgramRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Equipment\UpdateDeviceProgramRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Response;

class DeviceProgramController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * @return array<int, DeviceProgramData>
     */
    public function index(Device $device): array
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $device);

        return $device->programs()->get()
            ->map(fn (DeviceProgram $program) => DeviceProgramData::fromModel($program))
            ->all();
    }

    public function store(Device $device, CreateDeviceProgramRequest $request, CreateDeviceProgramAction $action): DeviceProgramData
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $device);

        $program = $action->execute($device, $request->user(), $request->validated());

        return DeviceProgramData::fromModel($program);
    }

    public function update(Device $device, DeviceProgram $program, UpdateDeviceProgramRequest $request, UpdateDeviceProgramAction $action): DeviceProgramData
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $device);
        abort_if($program->device_id !== $device->id, 404);

        return DeviceProgramData::fromModel($action->execute($program, $request->user(), $request->validated()));
    }

    public function destroy(Device $device, DeviceProgram $program, Request $request, DeleteDeviceProgramAction $action): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $device);
        abort_if($program->device_id !== $device->id, 404);

        $action->execute($program, $request->user());

        return response()->noContent();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Identity;

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\AcceptInvitationAction;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Identity\AcceptInvitationRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;

class AcceptInvitationController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Public — the invitee has no session/token yet. For an email that
     * already belongs to an account, this still requires that account's
     * real password (see AcceptInvitationAction) rather than trusting
     * whoever clicked the link.
     */
    public function __invoke(AcceptInvitationRequest $request, AcceptInvitationAction $action): JsonResponse
    {
        $result = $action->execute(
            token: $request->string('token')->toString(),
            name: $request->string('name')->toString(),
            password: $request->string('password')->toString(),
        );

        return response()->json([
            'token' => $result['plain_text_token'],
            'token_type' => 'Bearer',
            'user' => UserData::fromModel($result['user']),
            'tenant' => TenantData::fromModel($result['tenant']),
        ], 200);
    }
}


==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Identity/InvitationController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Identity;

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\CreateInvitationAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\RevokeInvitationAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Data\InvitationData;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\Invitation;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Identity\CreateInvitationRequest;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Response;

class InvitationController extends Controller
{
    public function store(CreateInvitationRequest $request, CreateInvitationAction $action): InvitationData
    {
        $this->authorize('create', Invitation::class);

        $invitation = $action->execute(
            tenant: Tenant::current(),
            invitedBy: $request->user(),
            email: $request->string('email')->toString(),
            role: $request->string('role')->toString(),
        );

        return InvitationData::fromModel($invitation);
    }

    public function destroy(Invitation $invitation, Request $request, RevokeInvitationAction $action): Response
    {
        // Not BelongsToTenant-scoped (see Invitation's docblock) — checked
        // by hand, before authorize(). 404, not 403: a foreign-tenant
        // invitation id must not even reveal that it exists. The policy
        // re-checks the same tenant match (defense in depth) plus the
        // actual permission once we know we're not leaking anything.
        if ($invitation->tenant_id !== Tenant::current()->id) {
            throw new ApiException('NOT_FOUND', 'The requested resource was not found.', 404);
        }

        $this->authorize('delete', $invitation);

        $action->execute($invitation, $request->user());

        return response()->noContent();
    }
}


==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Identity/MemberController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Identity;

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\DisableTenantMembershipAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Response;

class MemberController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Disables a member's access to this practice — see
     * DisableTenantMembershipAction. Not BelongsToTenant-scoped (same
     * bootstrap reason as Invitation), so the tenant match is checked
     * before authorize(), same IDOR-safe pattern as InvitationController.
     */
    public function destroy(TenantUser $tenantUser, Request $request, DisableTenantMembershipAction $action): Response
    {
        if ($tenantUser->tenant_id !== Tenant::current()->id) {
            throw new ApiException('NOT_FOUND', 'The requested resource was not found.', 404);
        }

        $this->authorize('disable', $tenantUser);

        $action->execute($tenantUser, $request->user());

        return response()->noContent();
    }
}


==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Identity/RegisterTenantController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Identity;

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\RegisterTenantAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Data\UserData;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Data\TenantData;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Identity\RegisterTenantRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;

class RegisterTenantController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Self-serve trial signup. Public — there is no existing account or
     * practice yet. The caller becomes `owner` of the new practice.
     */
    public function __invoke(RegisterTenantRequest $request, RegisterTenantAction $action): JsonResponse
    {
        $result = $action->execute(
            tenantName: $request->string('tenant_name')->toString(),
            tenantSlug: $request->string('tenant_slug')->toString(),
            ownerName: $request->string('owner_name')->toString(),
            ownerEmail: $request->string('owner_email')->toString(),
            password: $request->string('password')->toString(),
        );

        return response()->json([
            'token' => $result['plain_text_token'],
            'token_type' => 'Bearer',
            'user' => UserData::fromModel($result['user']),
            'tenant' => TenantData::fromModel($result['tenant']),
        ], 201);
    }
}

==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Inventory/StockMovementController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Inventory;

use App\Domain\Inventory\Actions\AdjustStockAction;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Actions\IssueStockAction;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Actions\TransferStockAction;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Data\StockMovementData;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\StockMovement;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\StorageLocation;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Inventory\AdjustStockRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Inventory\IssueStockRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Inventory\TransferStockRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;

class StockMovementController extends Controller
{
    public function issue(IssueStockRequest $request, IssueStockAction $action): StockMovementData
    {
        $this->authorize('manage', StockMovement::class);

        $batch = Batch::findOrFail($request->string('batch_id')->toString());
        $location = StorageLocation::findOrFail($request->string('location_id')->toString());

        $movement = $action->execute(
            $batch,
            $location,
            $request->integer('qty'),
            $request->user(),
            $request->string('reason')->toString() ?: null,
        );

        return StockMovementData::fromModel($movement);
    }

    public function transfer(TransferStockRequest $request, TransferStockAction $action): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('manage', StockMovement::class);

        $batch = Batch::findOrFail($request->string('batch_id')->toString());
        $from = StorageLocation::findOrFail($request->string('from_location_id')->toString());
        $to = StorageLocation::findOrFail($request->string('to_location_id')->toString());

        $result = $action->execute(
            $batch,
            $from,
            $to,
            $request->integer('qty'),
            $request->user(),
            $request->string('reason')->toString() ?: null,
        );

        return response()->json([
            'debit' => StockMovementData::fromModel($result['debit']),
            'credit' => StockMovementData::fromModel($result['credit']),
        ], 201);
    }

    public function adjust(AdjustStockRequest $request, AdjustStockAction $action): StockMovementData
    {
        $this->authorize('manage', StockMovement::class);

        $batch = Batch::findOrFail($request->string('batch_id')->toString());
        $location = StorageLocation::findOrFail($request->string('location_id')->toString());

        $movement = $action->execute(
            $batch,
            $location,
            $request->integer('qty'),
            $request->user(),
            $request->string('reason')->toString(),
        );

        return StockMovementData::fromModel($movement);
    }
}

use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Reporting\ExportEvidenceRequest;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Excel as ExcelFormat;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\BinaryFileResponse;

/**
 * A bulk export of evidence is more sensitive than viewing one record at
 * a time — gated on its own exports.manage permission, not usages.view
 * (REC acceptance: "complete export controlled by permissions").
 */
class EvidenceExportController extends Controller
{
    public function index(ExportEvidenceRequest $request): BinaryFileResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('export', LabelUsage::class);

        $format = $request->string('format', 'xlsx')->toString();
        $writerType = $format === 'csv' ? ExcelFormat::CSV : ExcelFormat::XLSX;

        return Excel::download(
            new EvidenceExport($request->safe()->except('format')),
            "evidence-export.{$format}",
            $writerType,
        );
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Sterilization;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Response;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;

class CycleAttachmentController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * @return array<int, CycleAttachmentData>
     */
    public function index(Cycle $cycle): array
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $cycle);

        return $cycle->getMedia('attachments')
            ->map(fn (Media $media) => CycleAttachmentData::fromModel($media))
            ->all();
    }

    public function store(Cycle $cycle, AttachCycleFileRequest $request, AttachCycleFileAction $action): CycleAttachmentData
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $cycle);

        $file = $request->file('file');
        abort_unless($file instanceof UploadedFile, 422);

        $action->execute($cycle, $media, $request->user());

        return response()->noContent();

==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Settings/ProfileController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Settings;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Settings\ProfileDeleteRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Settings\ProfileUpdateRequest;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\MustVerifyEmail;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;

class ProfileController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Show the user's profile settings page.
     */
    public function edit(Request $request): Response
    {
        return Inertia::render('settings/profile', [
            'mustVerifyEmail' => $request->user() instanceof MustVerifyEmail,
            'status' => $request->session()->get('status'),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Update the user's profile information.
     */
    public function update(ProfileUpdateRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->user()->fill($request->validated());

        if ($request->user()->isDirty('email')) {
            $request->user()->email_verified_at = null;
        }

        $request->user()->save();

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => __('Profile updated.')]);

        return to_route('profile.edit');
    }

    /**
     * Delete the user's profile.
     */
    public function destroy(ProfileDeleteRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        Auth::logout();

        $user->delete();

        $request->session()->invalidate();
        $request->session()->regenerateToken();

        return redirect('/');
    }
}


==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Settings/SecurityController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Settings;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Settings\PasswordUpdateRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Settings\TwoFactorAuthenticationRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;
use Laravel\Fortify\Features;

class SecurityController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Show the user's security settings page.
     */
    public function edit(TwoFactorAuthenticationRequest $request): Response
    {
        $props = [
            'canManageTwoFactor' => Features::canManageTwoFactorAuthentication(),
            'canManagePasskeys' => Features::canManagePasskeys(),
            'passkeys' => Features::canManagePasskeys()
                ? $request->user()
                    ->passkeys()
                    ->select(['id', 'name', 'credential', 'created_at', 'last_used_at'])
                    ->latest()
                    ->get()
                    ->map(fn ($passkey) => [
                        'id' => $passkey->id,
                        'name' => $passkey->name,
                        'authenticator' => $passkey->authenticator,
                        'created_at_diff' => $passkey->created_at->diffForHumans(),
                        'last_used_at_diff' => $passkey->last_used_at?->diffForHumans(),
                    ])
                    ->values()
                    ->all()
                : [],
            'passwordRules' => Password::defaults()->toPasswordRulesString(),
        ];

        if (Features::canManageTwoFactorAuthentication()) {
            $request->ensureStateIsValid();

            $props['twoFactorEnabled'] = $request->user()->hasEnabledTwoFactorAuthentication();
            $props['requiresConfirmation'] = Features::optionEnabled(Features::twoFactorAuthentication(), 'confirm');
        }

        return Inertia::render('settings/security', $props);
    }

    /**
     * Update the user's password.
     */
    public function update(PasswordUpdateRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->user()->update([
            'password' => $request->password,
        ]);

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => __('Password updated.')]);

        return back();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web\Catalog;

use App\Domain\Catalog\Actions\CreateProductAction;
use App\Domain\Catalog\Actions\DeleteProductAction;
use App\Domain\Catalog\Actions\UpdateProductAction;
use App\Domain\Catalog\Data\ProductCategoryData;
use App\Domain\Catalog\Data\ProductData;

use App\Domain\Catalog\Models\ProductCategory;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;

use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Catalog\UpdateProductRequest;
use App\Support\Data\OptionData;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;
use Spatie\LaravelData\CursorPaginatedDataCollection;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\AllowedFilter;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\QueryBuilder;

/**
 * Same Product model and ProductData DTO the mobile API uses
 * (Api\V1\Catalog\ProductController) — this is a second, web-only
 * presentation of the identical query, not new domain logic.
 */
class ProductController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Product::class);

        $products = QueryBuilder::for(Product::class)
            ->allowedFilters(
                AllowedFilter::partial('name'),
                AllowedFilter::partial('reference'),
                AllowedFilter::exact('category_id'),
                AllowedFilter::exact('is_sterilizable'),
            )
            ->allowedSorts('name', 'reference', 'created_at')
            ->defaultSort('name')
            ->cursorPaginate(perPage: 25)
            ->withQueryString();

        $categories = ProductCategory::orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (ProductCategory $category) => ProductCategoryData::fromModel($category));

        return Inertia::render('catalog/products/index', [
            'products' => ProductData::collect($products, CursorPaginatedDataCollection::class),
            'categories' => ProductCategoryData::collect($categories),
            'canCreate' => $request->user()->can('create', Product::class),
            'filters' => $request->input('filter', []),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(CreateProductRequest $request, CreateProductAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', Product::class);

        $product = $action->execute(Tenant::current(), $request->user(), $request->validated());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => "Product \"{$product->name}\" created."]);

        return redirect()->route('products.show', $product);
    }

    public function show(Product $product, Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $product);

        $product->loadMissing('category');

        return Inertia::render('catalog/products/show', [
            'product' => ProductData::fromModel($product),
            'category' => $product->category
                ? new OptionData($product->category->id, $product->category->name)
                : null,
            'canManage' => $request->user()->can('update', $product),
            'canDelete' => $request->user()->can('delete', $product),
        ]);
    }

    public function update(Product $product, UpdateProductRequest $request, UpdateProductAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $product);

        $action->execute($product, $request->user(), $request->validated());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => 'Product updated.']);

        return back();
    }

    public function destroy(Product $product, Request $request, DeleteProductAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $product);

        $action->execute($product, $request->user());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => "Product \"{$product->name}\" removed."]);

        return redirect()->route('products.index');

==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Web/Compliance/AuditEventController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web\Compliance;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Data\AuditEventData;
use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\AuditEvent;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Data\OptionData;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;
use Spatie\LaravelData\CursorPaginatedDataCollection;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\AllowedFilter;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\QueryBuilder;

/**
 * Same AuditEvent model/AuditEventData the mobile API uses
 * (Api\V1\AuditEventController) — a second, web-only presentation of the
 * identical query. The actor/action/subject-type filter option lists are
 * built from what's actually in this tenant's log (not a hardcoded
 * enum — new domains keep adding new action strings over time, so a
 * fixed list would just go stale).
 */
class AuditEventController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', AuditEvent::class);

        $events = QueryBuilder::for(AuditEvent::class)
            ->allowedFilters(
                AllowedFilter::exact('actor_id'),
                AllowedFilter::exact('action'),
                AllowedFilter::exact('subject_type'),
                AllowedFilter::callback('from', function ($query, $value): void {
                    $query->where('occurred_at', '>=', $value);
                }),
                AllowedFilter::callback('to', function ($query, $value): void {
                    $query->where('occurred_at', '<=', $value);
                }),
            )
            ->allowedSorts('occurred_at')
            ->defaultSort('-occurred_at')
            ->cursorPaginate(perPage: 25)
            ->withQueryString();

        $tenant = Tenant::current();
        $actors = User::whereHas(
            'tenantUsers',
            fn ($query) => $query->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
        )->orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (User $user) => new OptionData($user->id, $user->name));

        $actions = AuditEvent::query()->distinct()->orderBy('action')->pluck('action');
        $subjectTypes = AuditEvent::query()->distinct()->orderBy('subject_type')->pluck('subject_type')
            ->map(fn (string $type) => new OptionData($type, class_basename($type)));

        return Inertia::render('compliance/audit-log/index', [
            'events' => AuditEventData::collect($events, CursorPaginatedDataCollection::class),
            'actors' => OptionData::collect($actors),
            'actions' => $actions,
            'subjectTypes' => OptionData::collect($subjectTypes),
            'filters' => $request->input('filter', []),
        ]);
    }
}


==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Web/Compliance/NonConformityController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web\Compliance;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RaiseNonConformityAction;
use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\ResolveNonConformityAction;
use App\Domain\Compliance\Data\NonConformityData;
use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\NonConformity;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\Cycle;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Compliance\RaiseNonConformityRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Compliance\ResolveNonConformityRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;
use Spatie\LaravelData\CursorPaginatedDataCollection;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\AllowedFilter;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\QueryBuilder;

/**
 * Same NonConformityData/RaiseNonConformityAction/ResolveNonConformityAction
 * the mobile API uses (Api\V1\Compliance) — a second, web-only
 * presentation. The blast-radius preview shown before confirming a recall
 * lives on the cycle/label detail pages themselves (CycleController::show,
 * LabelController::show), via RaiseNonConformityAction::previewBlastRadius
 * — this controller is just the tenant-wide log + the write endpoints.
 */
class NonConformityController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', NonConformity::class);

        $nonConformities = QueryBuilder::for(NonConformity::class)
            ->allowedFilters(
                AllowedFilter::exact('subject_type'),
                // UI-30's "open non-conformities & recalls" dashboard card
                // shares this exact predicate with the list.
                AllowedFilter::callback('resolved', function ($query, $value): void {
                    $value ? $query->whereNotNull('resolved_at') : $query->whereNull('resolved_at');
                }),
            )
            ->defaultSort('-raised_at')
            ->allowedSorts('raised_at')
            ->cursorPaginate(perPage: 25)
            ->withQueryString();

        return Inertia::render('compliance/non-conformities/index', [
            'nonConformities' => NonConformityData::collect($nonConformities, CursorPaginatedDataCollection::class),
            // NonConformityPolicy::resolve() is a per-instance ability
            // (needs a NonConformity to check against) — the list's
            // "does this user manage non-conformities at all" question
            // is the flat permission itself, same one that ability gates.
            'canManage' => $request->user()->can('non_conformities.manage'),
            'filters' => $request->input('filter', []),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(RaiseNonConformityRequest $request, RaiseNonConformityAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', NonConformity::class);

        $subject = $request->string('subject_type')->toString() === 'cycle'
            ? Cycle::findOrFail($request->string('subject_id')->toString())
            : Label::findOrFail($request->string('subject_id')->toString());

        $action->execute($subject, $request->user(), $request->string('description')->toString());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => 'Non-conformity raised.']);

        return back();
    }

    public function resolve(NonConformity $nonConformity, ResolveNonConformityRequest $request, ResolveNonConformityAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('resolve', $nonConformity);

        $action->execute($nonConformity, $request->user(), $request->string('resolution')->toString());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => 'Non-conformity resolved.']);

        return back();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web\Identity;

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\CreateInvitationAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\DisableTenantMembershipAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\RevokeInvitationAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Data\InvitationData;
use App\Domain\Identity\Data\TeamMemberData;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\Invitation;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Identity\CreateInvitationRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;

/**
 * Same CreateInvitationAction/RevokeInvitationAction/
 * DisableTenantMembershipAction the mobile API uses (Api\V1\Identity) —
 * this is the first list view for either TenantUser or Invitation
 * anywhere (the API only ever had store/destroy, no index), so the
 * membership + invitation queries here are new, read-only additions,
 * not new business logic. TenantUser/Invitation are deliberately NOT
 * BelongsToTenant-scoped (resolved during auth bootstrap, before any
 * "current tenant" exists) — every query and every mutation here checks
 * tenant_id by hand, exactly like MemberController/InvitationController
 * already do.
 */
class TeamController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('create', Invitation::class);

        $tenant = Tenant::current();

        $members = TenantUser::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
            ->with('user')
            ->orderBy('joined_at')
            ->get()
            ->map(fn (TenantUser $membership) => TeamMemberData::fromModel($membership, $membership->user->getRoleNames()->first()));

        $invitations = Invitation::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
            ->with('invitedBy')
            ->orderByDesc('created_at')
            ->get();

        return Inertia::render('team/index', [
            'members' => TeamMemberData::collect($members),
            'invitations' => InvitationData::collect($invitations),
            'currentUserId' => $request->user()->id,
        ]);
    }

    public function storeInvitation(CreateInvitationRequest $request, CreateInvitationAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', Invitation::class);

        $action->execute(
            tenant: Tenant::current(),
            invitedBy: $request->user(),
            email: $request->string('email')->toString(),
            role: $request->string('role')->toString(),
        );

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => 'Invitation sent.']);

        return back();
    }

    public function revokeInvitation(Invitation $invitation, Request $request, RevokeInvitationAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        if ($invitation->tenant_id !== Tenant::current()->id) {
            abort(404);
        }

        $this->authorize('delete', $invitation);

        $action->execute($invitation, $request->user());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => 'Invitation revoked.']);

        return back();
    }

    public function disableMember(TenantUser $tenantUser, Request $request, DisableTenantMembershipAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        if ($tenantUser->tenant_id !== Tenant::current()->id) {
            abort(404);
        }

        $this->authorize('disable', $tenantUser);

        $action->execute($tenantUser, $request->user());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => 'Member access disabled.']);

        return back();
    }
}

==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Web/Inventory/BatchController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web\Inventory;

use App\Domain\Catalog\Models\Product;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Data\BatchListEntryData;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\AlertSettings;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Domain\Purchasing\Models\Supplier;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Support\Data\OptionData;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;
use Spatie\LaravelData\CursorPaginatedDataCollection;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\AllowedFilter;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\QueryBuilder;

/**
 * Batches have no create/update route anywhere in the domain — they only
 * come into existence as a side effect of ReceiveGoodsAction (UI-14), and
 * their only status transition (active -> quarantined) belongs to the
 * non-conformity/recall flow (UI-24), not here. This is a read-only
 * tenant-wide list, same shape as ControlTestController's logbook.
 */
class BatchController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Batch::class);

        $nearExpiryDays = AlertSettings::forTenant(Tenant::current())->near_expiry_days;

        $batches = QueryBuilder::for(Batch::class)
            ->allowedFilters(
                AllowedFilter::exact('product_id'),
                AllowedFilter::exact('supplier_id'),
                AllowedFilter::exact('status'),
                AllowedFilter::callback('expiry', function ($query, $value) use ($nearExpiryDays): void {
                    match ($value) {
                        'expired' => $query->whereNotNull('expiry_date')->where('expiry_date', '<', now()->toDateString()),
                        'near_expiry' => $query->whereNotNull('expiry_date')
                            ->where('expiry_date', '>=', now()->toDateString())
                            ->where('expiry_date', '<=', now()->addDays($nearExpiryDays)->toDateString()),
                        default => null,
                    };
                }),
            )
            ->allowedSorts('expiry_date', 'received_at')
            ->defaultSort('expiry_date')
            // with()/withSum() placed after every spatie-QueryBuilder-only
            // call — see ControlTestController for why the order matters.
            ->with(['product', 'supplier'])
            ->withSum('stockLevels', 'quantity')
            ->cursorPaginate(perPage: 25)
            ->withQueryString();

        $products = Product::orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (Product $product) => new OptionData($product->id, $product->name));

        $suppliers = Supplier::orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (Supplier $supplier) => new OptionData($supplier->id, $supplier->name));

        return Inertia::render('inventory/batches/index', [
            'batches' => BatchListEntryData::collect($batches, CursorPaginatedDataCollection::class),
            'products' => OptionData::collect($products),
            'suppliers' => OptionData::collect($suppliers),
            'filters' => $request->input('filter', []),
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web\Inventory;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\AuditEvent;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Data\QuarantinedBatchData;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\BatchStatus;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;
use Spatie\LaravelData\CursorPaginatedDataCollection;

/**
 * Read-only (UI-24) — the only way a batch's status becomes 'quarantined'
 * is RaiseNonConformityAction, and there is no un-quarantine route
 * anywhere in the domain yet (see QuarantinedBatchData's docblock), so
 * there is nothing to write here, only to surface: which batches are
 * quarantined, and — from the audit trail — who, why, and when.
 */
class QuarantineController extends Controller
{
    public function index(): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Batch::class);

        $batches = Batch::where('status', BatchStatus::Quarantined)
            ->with(['product', 'supplier'])
            ->withSum('stockLevels', 'quantity')
            ->orderByDesc('updated_at')
            ->cursorPaginate(perPage: 25)
            ->withQueryString();

        $quarantineEvents = AuditEvent::where('action', 'batch.quarantined')
            ->whereIn('subject_id', $batches->pluck('id'))
            ->get()
            ->keyBy('subject_id');

        return Inertia::render('inventory/quarantine/index', [
            'batches' => QuarantinedBatchData::collect(
                $batches->through(
                    fn (Batch $batch) => QuarantinedBatchData::fromModel($batch, $quarantineEvents->get($batch->id))
                ),
                CursorPaginatedDataCollection::class
            ),
        ]);
    }
}

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;
use Spatie\LaravelData\CursorPaginatedDataCollection;

use Spatie\QueryBuilder\QueryBuilder;

/**
 * stock_levels is a projection over stock_movements (CLAUDE.md invariant
 * #1) — this screen only ever reads it, same as the mobile API's
 * StockLevelController@index. No web form writes stock directly; issue/
 * transfer/adjust stay mobile-only for now (out of this task's scope).
 */
class StockLevelController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', StockLevel::class);

        $levels = QueryBuilder::for(StockLevel::class)
            ->allowedFilters(
                AllowedFilter::exact('location_id'),
                AllowedFilter::callback('product_id', function ($query, $value): void {
                    $query->whereHas('batch', fn ($q) => $q->where('product_id', $value));
                }),
                AllowedFilter::callback('in_stock_only', function ($query, $value): void {
                    if ($value) {
                        $query->where('quantity', '>', 0);
                    }
                }),
            )
            ->allowedSorts('quantity')
            ->defaultSort('-quantity')
            ->with(['batch.product', 'location'])
            ->cursorPaginate(perPage: 25)
            ->withQueryString();

        $products = Product::orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (Product $product) => new OptionData($product->id, $product->name));

        $locations = StorageLocation::orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (StorageLocation $location) => new OptionData($location->id, $location->name));

        return Inertia::render('inventory/stock/index', [
            'levels' => StockLevelEntryData::collect($levels, CursorPaginatedDataCollection::class),
            'products' => OptionData::collect($products),
            'locations' => OptionData::collect($locations),
            'filters' => $request->input('filter', []),
        ]);
    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web\Labeling;

use App\Domain\Labeling\Actions\GenerateCycleLabelsAction;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Data\DluRuleData;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Data\LabelData;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\DluRule;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Data\CycleData;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Data\CycleItemData;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Enums\CycleStatus;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\Cycle;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\CycleItem;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Labeling\GenerateCycleLabelsRequest;
use App\Support\Data\OptionData;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;

/**
 * The "label sheet" for a cycle: one row per load item, each with its label
 * once generated (CLAUDE.md invariant #2 — only for a released+compliant
 * cycle, enforced by GenerateCycleLabelsAction itself, not re-checked here).
 */
class CycleLabelController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Cycle $cycle, Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $cycle);

        $cycle->loadMissing(['device']);
        $items = $cycle->items()->orderBy('sequence_in_cycle')->get();
        $labels = Label::whereIn('cycle_item_id', $items->pluck('id'))->get();

        $dluRules = DluRule::orderBy('packaging_type')->orderBy('storage_condition')->get();

        return Inertia::render('sterilization/cycles/labels', [
            'cycle' => CycleData::fromModel($cycle),
            'device' => new OptionData($cycle->device->id, $cycle->device->name),
            'items' => CycleItemData::collect(
                $items->map(fn (CycleItem $item) => CycleItemData::fromModel($item))
            ),
            'labels' => LabelData::collect(
                $labels->map(fn (Label $label) => LabelData::fromModel($label))
            ),
            'dluRules' => DluRuleData::collect($dluRules),
            'canGenerate' => $cycle->status === CycleStatus::Released
                && $request->user()->can('create', Label::class),
        ]);
    }

==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Web/Labeling/LabelController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web\Labeling;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RaiseNonConformityAction;
use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\NonConformity;
use App\Domain\Equipment\Models\Device;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Actions\PrintLabelAction;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Actions\RenderLabelPdfAction;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Data\LabelData;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Data\LabelListEntryData;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Data\LabelPrintData;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Enums\LabelStatus;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Support\LabelCodeRenderer;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Data\CycleData;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Data\CycleItemData;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Data\LabelUsageData;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\LabelUsage;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\Patient;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Labeling\PrintLabelRequest;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Data\OptionData;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Response;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response as InertiaResponse;
use Spatie\LaravelData\CursorPaginatedDataCollection;
use Spatie\LaravelPdf\PdfBuilder;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\AllowedFilter;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\QueryBuilder;

class LabelController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): InertiaResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Label::class);

        $labels = QueryBuilder::for(Label::class)
            ->allowedFilters(
                AllowedFilter::exact('status'),
                AllowedFilter::callback('device_id', function ($query, $value): void {
                    $query->whereHas('cycleItem.cycle', fn ($q) => $q->where('device_id', $value));
                }),
                // Expiry is lazy (ResolveLabelScanAction flips status to
                // Expired only the first time a past-DLU label is scanned)
                // — status can't be trusted here, so this checks use_by_date
                // directly, same predicate UI-30's dashboard card uses.
                AllowedFilter::callback('overdue', function ($query, $value): void {
                    if ($value) {
                        $query->whereIn('status', [LabelStatus::Created, LabelStatus::Printed])
                            ->where('use_by_date', '<', now()->toDateString());
                    }
                }),
            )
            ->allowedSorts('use_by_date', 'created_at')
            ->defaultSort('-created_at')
            ->with(['cycleItem.cycle.device'])
            ->cursorPaginate(perPage: 25)
            ->withQueryString();

        $devices = Device::orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (Device $device) => new OptionData($device->id, $device->name));

        return Inertia::render('sterilization/labels/index', [
            'labels' => LabelListEntryData::collect($labels, CursorPaginatedDataCollection::class),
            'devices' => OptionData::collect($devices),
            'filters' => $request->input('filter', []),
        ]);
    }

    public function show(Label $label, Request $request, RaiseNonConformityAction $raiseNonConformity): InertiaResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $label);

        $label->loadMissing(['cycleItem.cycle.device.site', 'cycleItem.batch']);
        $cycleItem = $label->cycleItem;
        $cycle = $cycleItem->cycle;

        $prints = $label->prints()->orderBy('sequence')->get();
        $printedByUsers = User::whereIn('id', $prints->pluck('printed_by_user_id')->unique())->get()
            ->map(fn (User $user) => new OptionData($user->id, $user->name));

        $usage = $label->usage()->first();
        // withTrashed(): the usage keeps its patient's identity even if
        // the pseudonym was later archived (same as LabelUsage::patient()).
        $patient = $usage ? Patient::withTrashed()->find($usage->patient_id) : null;
        $practitioner = $usage ? User::find($usage->practitioner_id) : null;

        $tenant = Tenant::current();
        $patients = Patient::orderBy('reference')->get()
            ->map(fn (Patient $p) => new OptionData($p->id, $p->reference));
        $practitioners = User::whereHas(
            'tenantUsers',
            fn ($query) => $query->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->where('status', 'active')
        )->orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (User $user) => new OptionData($user->id, $user->name));

        return Inertia::render('sterilization/labels/show', [
            'nonConformityBlastRadius' => $raiseNonConformity->previewBlastRadius($label),
            'canRaiseNonConformity' => $request->user()->can('create', NonConformity::class),
            'label' => LabelData::fromModel($label),
            'cycle' => CycleData::fromModel($cycle),
            'device' => new OptionData($cycle->device->id, $cycle->device->name),
            'site' => new OptionData($cycle->device->site->id, $cycle->device->site->name),
            'item' => CycleItemData::fromModel($cycleItem),
            'prints' => LabelPrintData::collect($prints),
            'printedByUsers' => OptionData::collect($printedByUsers),
            'usage' => $usage ? LabelUsageData::fromModel($usage) : null,
            'patient' => $patient ? new OptionData($patient->id, $patient->reference) : null,
            'practitioner' => $practitioner ? new OptionData($practitioner->id, $practitioner->name) : null,
            'canViewDossier' => $usage ? $request->user()->can('view', $usage) : false,
            'patients' => OptionData::collect($patients),
            'practitioners' => OptionData::collect($practitioners),
            'canRecordUsage' => $request->user()->can('create', LabelUsage::class),
        ]);
    }

    public function print(Label $label, PrintLabelRequest $request, PrintLabelAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('print', $label);

        $isReprint = $label->status === LabelStatus::Printed;

        $action->execute($label, $request->user(), $request->string('reason')->toString() ?: null);

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => $isReprint ? 'Label reprinted.' : 'Label printed.']);

        return back();
    }

    public function pdf(Label $label, RenderLabelPdfAction $action): PdfBuilder
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $label);

        return $action->execute($label);
    }

    public function qrCode(Label $label): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $label);

        return response(LabelCodeRenderer::qrSvg($label->urn()), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'image/svg+xml']);
    }

    public function dataMatrix(Label $label): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $label);

        return response(LabelCodeRenderer::dataMatrixSvg($label->urn()), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'image/svg+xml']);
    }
}

/**

 * (Api\V1\Purchasing\PurchaseOrderController) — this is a second, web-only
 * presentation of the identical query, not new domain logic.

class PurchaseOrderController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', PurchaseOrder::class);

        $orders = PurchaseOrder::with('lines')
            ->orderByDesc('created_at')
            ->cursorPaginate(perPage: 25)
            ->withQueryString();

        $suppliers = Supplier::orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (Supplier $supplier) => new OptionData($supplier->id, $supplier->name));

        return Inertia::render('purchasing/purchase-orders/index', [
            'purchaseOrders' => PurchaseOrderData::collect($orders, CursorPaginatedDataCollection::class),
            'suppliers' => OptionData::collect($suppliers),
            'canCreate' => $request->user()->can('create', PurchaseOrder::class),
        ]);
    }

    public function create(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('create', PurchaseOrder::class);

        $suppliers = Supplier::orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (Supplier $supplier) => new OptionData($supplier->id, $supplier->name));
        $products = Product::orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (Product $product) => new OptionData($product->id, $product->name));

        return Inertia::render('purchasing/purchase-orders/create', [
            'suppliers' => OptionData::collect($suppliers),
            'products' => OptionData::collect($products),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(CreatePurchaseOrderRequest $request, CreatePurchaseOrderAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {

        $supplier = Supplier::findOrFail($request->string('supplier_id')->toString());

        $purchaseOrder = $action->execute(Tenant::current(), $supplier, $request->user(), $request->input('lines'));

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => 'Purchase order created.']);

        return redirect()->route('purchase-orders.show', $purchaseOrder);

    public function show(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder, Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $purchaseOrder);

        $purchaseOrder->loadMissing(['lines', 'supplier']);

        $products = Product::orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (Product $product) => new OptionData($product->id, $product->name));

        $locations = StorageLocation::orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (StorageLocation $location) => new OptionData($location->id, $location->name));

        $goodsReceipts = $purchaseOrder->goodsReceipts()->with('lines')->orderByDesc('received_at')->get()
            ->map(fn (GoodsReceipt $receipt) => GoodsReceiptData::fromModel($receipt));

            'goodsReceipts' => GoodsReceiptData::collect($goodsReceipts),
            'canManage' => $request->user()->can('update', $purchaseOrder),
        ]);
    }

    {

        return back();
    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web\Reporting;

use App\Domain\Reporting\Actions\GenerateDataExportDownloadUrlAction;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Actions\RequestDataExportAction;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Data\DataExportRequestData;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Enums\DataExportStatus;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Models\DataExportRequest;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;
use Spatie\LaravelData\CursorPaginatedDataCollection;

/**
 * UI-29: the single most sensitive artifact the product can emit — every
 * table, every attached file for the whole practice — gated on its own
 * data_exports.manage permission (owner/admin only, see
 * SeedTenantRolesAction), never on the more general exports.manage used by
 * the S4 evidence dossier. The download URL is never part of this
 * controller's Inertia props or JSON payload except from the dedicated
 * download() action, which mints it fresh and audits the click — see
 * GenerateDataExportDownloadUrlAction's docblock.
 */
class DataExportRequestController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', DataExportRequest::class);

        $tenant = Tenant::current();

        $exports = DataExportRequest::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
            ->orderByDesc('created_at')
            ->cursorPaginate(20)
            ->withQueryString();

        $hasRunningExport = DataExportRequest::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
            ->whereIn('status', [DataExportStatus::Pending, DataExportStatus::Processing])
            ->exists();

        return Inertia::render('reporting/data-exports/index', [
            'exports' => DataExportRequestData::collect($exports, CursorPaginatedDataCollection::class),
            'hasRunningExport' => $hasRunningExport,
            'weeklyLimit' => RequestDataExportAction::WEEKLY_LIMIT,
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request, RequestDataExportAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', DataExportRequest::class);

        $action->execute(Tenant::current(), $request->user());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => "Export requested. We've emailed the practice owners, and this page will update once it's ready."]);

        return back();
    }

    public function download(DataExportRequest $dataExportRequest, Request $request, GenerateDataExportDownloadUrlAction $action): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('download', $dataExportRequest);

        $url = $action->execute(Tenant::current(), $dataExportRequest, $request->user());

        return response()->json([
            'download_url' => $url,
            'url_expires_at' => now()->addMinutes(GenerateDataExportDownloadUrlAction::URL_TTL_MINUTES)->toIso8601String(),
        ]);
    }
}


==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Web/Sterilization/ControlTestController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web\Sterilization;

use App\Domain\Equipment\Models\Device;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Data\ControlTestLogEntryData;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\ControlTest;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\Cycle;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Support\Data\OptionData;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;
use Spatie\LaravelData\CursorPaginatedDataCollection;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\AllowedFilter;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\QueryBuilder;

/**
 * The tenant-wide control-test logbook (CLAUDE.md: "a compliant control-test
 * logbook ... with reminder alerts"). This screen covers the logbook and
 * recording a test (CycleControlTestController::store); it deliberately does
 * NOT compute "missing/overdue" — see OQ-7 in docs/open-questions.md, which
 * already flags that determining "missing" needs a per-tenant test
 * frequency rule that doesn't exist yet. Building that here would mean
 * inventing a regulatory rule, which the per-task contract forbids.
 */
class ControlTestController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Cycle::class);

        $tests = QueryBuilder::for(ControlTest::class)
            ->allowedFilters(
                AllowedFilter::exact('type'),
                AllowedFilter::exact('result'),
                AllowedFilter::callback('device_id', function ($query, $value): void {
                    $query->whereHas('cycle', fn ($q) => $q->where('device_id', $value));
                }),
                AllowedFilter::callback('from', function ($query, $value): void {
                    $query->where('performed_at', '>=', $value);
                }),
                AllowedFilter::callback('to', function ($query, $value): void {
                    $query->where('performed_at', '<=', $value);
                }),
            )
            ->allowedSorts('performed_at')
            ->defaultSort('-performed_at')
            // Placed after every spatie-QueryBuilder-only call (allowedFilters,
            // allowedSorts, defaultSort) — with() is forwarded straight to the
            // underlying Eloquent builder, and Larastan's Eloquent-aware return
            // type resolver narrows the chain to a concrete Builder from this
            // point on, which has no allowedFilters()/allowedSorts() of its own.
            ->with(['cycle.device'])
            ->cursorPaginate(perPage: 25)
            ->withQueryString();

        $devices = Device::orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (Device $device) => new OptionData($device->id, $device->name));

        return Inertia::render('sterilization/control-tests/index', [
            'tests' => ControlTestLogEntryData::collect($tests, CursorPaginatedDataCollection::class),
            'devices' => OptionData::collect($devices),
            'filters' => $request->input('filter', []),
        ]);
    }
}

        $action->execute($cycle, $media, $request->user());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => 'Attachment removed.']);

        return back();
    }

use App\Domain\Equipment\Models\Device;
use App\Domain\Equipment\Models\DeviceProgram;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Actions\CompleteCycleAction;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Actions\CreateCycleAction;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Actions\ReleaseCycleAction;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Actions\StartCycleAction;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Actions\SubmitCycleForReleaseAction;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Data\ControlTestData;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Data\CycleAttachmentData;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Data\CycleData;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Data\CycleItemData;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Data\CycleReleaseData;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Enums\CycleReleaseDecision;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\ControlTest;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\Cycle;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\CycleItem;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Sterilization\CreateCycleRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Sterilization\ReleaseCycleRequest;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Data\OptionData;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;
use Spatie\LaravelData\CursorPaginatedDataCollection;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\AllowedFilter;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\QueryBuilder;

/**
 * Same Cycle model and CycleData DTO the mobile API uses
 * (Api\V1\Sterilization\CycleController) — this is a second, web-only
 * presentation of the identical query, not new domain logic. The extra
 * filters below (operator_id, q, from/to) are additive QueryBuilder
 * configuration only; the frozen API contract (device_id/status only) is
 * untouched.
 */
class CycleController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Cycle::class);

        $tenant = Tenant::current();

        $cycles = QueryBuilder::for(Cycle::class)
            ->allowedFilters(
                AllowedFilter::exact('device_id'),
                AllowedFilter::exact('status'),
                AllowedFilter::exact('operator_id'),
                AllowedFilter::callback('q', function ($query, $value): void {
                    $query->whereRaw('cycle_number::text like ?', ['%'.$value.'%']);
                }),
                AllowedFilter::callback('from', function ($query, $value): void {
                    $query->where('started_at', '>=', $value);
                }),
                AllowedFilter::callback('to', function ($query, $value): void {
                    $query->where('started_at', '<=', $value);
                }),
                // UI-30's dashboard card and this list share this exact
                // predicate — whichever changes, the other must too.
                AllowedFilter::callback('missing_non_conformity', function ($query, $value): void {
                    if ($value) {
                        $query->whereDoesntHave('nonConformities');
                    }
                }),
            )
            ->allowedSorts('cycle_number', 'created_at')
            ->defaultSort('-created_at')
            ->cursorPaginate(perPage: 25)
            ->withQueryString();

        $devices = Device::orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (Device $device) => new OptionData($device->id, $device->name));

        $operators = User::whereHas(
            'tenantUsers',
            fn ($query) => $query->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->where('status', 'active')
        )->orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (User $user) => new OptionData($user->id, $user->name));

        // For the "new cycle" dialog's device -> program cascading picker.
        // DeviceProgramData already exists (Api\V1\Equipment) — reused as-is.
        $devicePrograms = DeviceProgram::where('is_active', true)->orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (DeviceProgram $program) => DeviceProgramData::fromModel($program));

        return Inertia::render('sterilization/cycles/index', [
            'cycles' => CycleData::collect($cycles, CursorPaginatedDataCollection::class),
            'devices' => OptionData::collect($devices),
            'devicePrograms' => DeviceProgramData::collect($devicePrograms),
            'operators' => OptionData::collect($operators),
            'canCreate' => $request->user()->can('create', Cycle::class),
            // spatie/laravel-query-builder itself reads filter[...] straight
            // off the request; this is purely to hand the current values
            // back to the page for the filter bar's controlled inputs.
            'filters' => $request->input('filter', []),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(CreateCycleRequest $request, CreateCycleAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', Cycle::class);

        $device = Device::findOrFail($request->string('device_id')->toString());

        $cycle = $action->execute(Tenant::current(), $device, $request->user(), $request->safe()->except('device_id'));

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => "Cycle #{$cycle->cycle_number} created."]);

        return redirect()->route('cycles.show', $cycle);
    }

    public function start(Cycle $cycle, Request $request, StartCycleAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $cycle);

        $action->execute($cycle, $request->user());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => 'Cycle started.']);

        return back();
    }

    public function complete(Cycle $cycle, Request $request, CompleteCycleAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $cycle);

        $action->execute($cycle, $request->user());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => 'Cycle completed.']);

        return back();
    }

    public function submitForRelease(Cycle $cycle, Request $request, SubmitCycleForReleaseAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $cycle);

        $action->execute($cycle, $request->user());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => 'Submitted for release.']);

        return back();
    }

    public function release(Cycle $cycle, ReleaseCycleRequest $request, ReleaseCycleAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('release', $cycle);

        $decision = CycleReleaseDecision::from($request->string('decision')->toString());
        $reason = $request->string('reason')->toString() ?: null;

        $action->execute($cycle, $request->user(), $decision, $reason);

        Inertia::flash('toast', [
            'type' => $decision === CycleReleaseDecision::Compliant ? 'success' : 'error',
            'message' => $decision === CycleReleaseDecision::Compliant
                ? "Cycle #{$cycle->cycle_number} released as compliant."
                : "Cycle #{$cycle->cycle_number} rejected.",
        ]);

        return back();
    }

    /**
     * One page assembling everything the mobile API exposes as separate
     * endpoints (items, control-tests, attachments, release) — a web
     * detail view has no reason to make the browser round-trip four
     * times for one screen the way a mobile client's own navigation does.
     */
    public function show(Cycle $cycle, RaiseNonConformityAction $raiseNonConformity): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $cycle);

        $cycle->loadMissing(['device', 'deviceProgram', 'operator']);

        $release = $cycle->release()->first();
        $releasedBy = $release ? User::find($release->released_by_user_id) : null;

        return Inertia::render('sterilization/cycles/show', [
            'nonConformityBlastRadius' => $raiseNonConformity->previewBlastRadius($cycle),
            'cycle' => CycleData::fromModel($cycle),
            'device' => new OptionData($cycle->device->id, $cycle->device->name),
            'program' => $cycle->deviceProgram ? new OptionData($cycle->deviceProgram->id, $cycle->deviceProgram->name) : null,
            'operator' => new OptionData($cycle->operator->id, $cycle->operator->name),
            'items' => CycleItemData::collect(
                $cycle->items()->orderBy('sequence_in_cycle')->get()
                    ->map(fn (CycleItem $item) => CycleItemData::fromModel($item))
            ),
            'controlTests' => ControlTestData::collect(
                $cycle->controlTests()->orderBy('performed_at')->get()
                    ->map(fn (ControlTest $test) => ControlTestData::fromModel($test))
            ),
            'attachments' => CycleAttachmentData::collect(
                $cycle->getMedia('attachments')->map(fn (Media $media) => CycleAttachmentData::fromModel($media))
            ),
            'release' => $release ? CycleReleaseData::fromModel($release) : null,
            'releasedBy' => $releasedBy ? new OptionData($releasedBy->id, $releasedBy->name) : null,
        ]);
    }
}

/**
 * One page, four sections (UI-28) — not four routes. Owner/admin
 * (practice_settings.manage) can reach every section; only owner
 * (evidence_settings.manage) can actually save label format or DLU rule
 * changes — deliberately a NEW, separate permission from labels.manage
 * (which the mobile API's DluRuleController still uses unchanged for
 * stock_manager/owner/admin) rather than tightening that existing,
 * independently-established capability. Hiding a control is UX; every
 * write below still checks the real permission itself.
 */
class PracticeSettingsController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        abort_unless($request->user()->can('practice_settings.manage'), 403);

        $tenant = Tenant::current();
        $dluRules = DluRule::orderBy('packaging_type')->orderBy('storage_condition')->get();
        $currentFormat = UpdateLabelFormatAction::current($tenant);

        $subscriptionsByRole = DigestSubscription::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->get()->keyBy('role');
        $digestSubscriptions = collect(TenantRole::cases())->map(
            fn (TenantRole $role) => $subscriptionsByRole->get($role->value) ?? new DigestSubscription([
                'role' => $role->value,
                'frequency' => 'daily',
                'enabled' => false,
            ])
        );

        return Inertia::render('tenancy/practice-settings/index', [
            'identity' => PracticeIdentityData::fromModel($tenant),
            'dluRules' => DluRuleData::collect($dluRules),
            'labelFormat' => $currentFormat ? LabelFormatVersionData::fromModel($currentFormat) : null,
            'alertSettings' => AlertSettingsData::fromModel(AlertSettings::forTenant($tenant)),
            'digestSubscriptions' => DigestSubscriptionData::collect($digestSubscriptions),
            'canManageEvidence' => $request->user()->can('evidence_settings.manage'),
        ]);
    }

            $request->user(),
            $request->safe()->except('reason'),
            $request->validated('reason'),

        return back();
    }

    public function updateLogo(UpdatePracticeLogoRequest $request, UpdatePracticeLogoAction $action): RedirectResponse

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => 'Logo updated.']);

        return back();

    public function updateLabelFormat(UpdateLabelFormatRequest $request, UpdateLabelFormatAction $action): RedirectResponse
