==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Web/Tenancy/SiteController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web\Tenancy;

use App\Domain\Equipment\Models\Device;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\StockLevel;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Actions\ArchiveSiteAction;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Actions\CreateSiteAction;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Actions\UpdateSiteAction;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Data\RoomData;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Data\SiteData;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Data\StorageLocationData;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Site;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Tenancy\ArchiveSiteRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Tenancy\CreateSiteRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Tenancy\UpdateSiteRequest;
use App\Support\Data\OptionData;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;

/**
 * The tenant -> sites -> rooms -> storage_locations hierarchy every other
 * domain hangs off (devices attach to a site, products/batches/movements
 * to a storage location). Admin/owner only (sites.manage) for every
 * mutation; sites.view (granted to every role) still gates read access,
 * unchanged from the existing mobile-facing SitesController.
 */
class SiteController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Site::class);

        $sites = Site::withCount(['rooms', 'storageLocations'])->orderBy('name')->get();

        // devices_count isn't a relation on Site — one grouped query instead
        // of an N+1, matched onto each site afterwards.
        $deviceCounts = Device::selectRaw('site_id, count(*) as aggregate')
            ->whereIn('site_id', $sites->pluck('id'))
            ->groupBy('site_id')
            ->pluck('aggregate', 'site_id');

        $sites->each(fn (Site $site) => $site->setAttribute('devices_count', $deviceCounts->get($site->id, 0)));

        return Inertia::render('tenancy/sites/index', [
            'sites' => SiteData::collect($sites),
            'canManage' => $request->user()->can('create', Site::class),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(CreateSiteRequest $request, CreateSiteAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', Site::class);

        $site = $action->execute(Tenant::current(), $request->user(), $request->validated());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => "Site \"{$site->name}\" created."]);

        return redirect()->route('sites.show', $site);
    }

    public function show(Site $site, Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $site);

        $rooms = $site->rooms()->withCount('storageLocations')->orderBy('name')->get();
        $locations = $site->storageLocations()->orderBy('name')->get();
        $devicesCount = Device::where('site_id', $site->id)->count();

        $unitsOnHand = StockLevel::whereIn('location_id', $locations->pluck('id'))
            ->groupBy('location_id')
            ->selectRaw('location_id, sum(quantity) as total')
            ->pluck('total', 'location_id');

        $locations->each(fn ($location) => $location->setAttribute('units_on_hand', (int) $unitsOnHand->get($location->id, 0)));

        $activeBatchesCount = StockLevel::whereIn('location_id', $locations->pluck('id'))
            ->where('quantity', '>', 0)
            ->distinct('batch_id')
            ->count('batch_id');

        $site->setAttribute('rooms_count', $rooms->count());
        $site->setAttribute('storage_locations_count', $locations->count());
        $site->setAttribute('devices_count', $devicesCount);

        return Inertia::render('tenancy/sites/show', [
            'site' => SiteData::fromModel($site),
            'rooms' => RoomData::collect($rooms),
            'storageLocations' => StorageLocationData::collect($locations),
            // site.rooms_count/storage_locations_count double as the archive
            // confirmation's blast radius (UI-23's pattern) — archiving
            // cascades to exactly these; devices aren't cascaded but are
            // shown for visibility.
            'devicesCount' => $devicesCount,
            'activeBatchesCount' => $activeBatchesCount,
            // For the "move this room to another site" picker — every
            // tenant site, not just this one.
            'allSites' => OptionData::collect(
                Site::orderBy('name')->get()->map(fn (Site $s) => new OptionData($s->id, $s->name))
            ),
            'canManage' => $request->user()->can('update', $site),
        ]);
    }

    public function update(Site $site, UpdateSiteRequest $request, UpdateSiteAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $site);

        $action->execute($site, $request->user(), $request->validated());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => 'Site updated.']);

        return back();
    }

    public function archive(Site $site, ArchiveSiteRequest $request, ArchiveSiteAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $site);

        $action->execute($site, $request->user(), $request->string('reason')->toString());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => "Site \"{$site->name}\" archived."]);

        return redirect()->route('sites.index');
    }
}

==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Web/Tenancy/SwitchSiteController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web\Tenancy;

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Site;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * Which site is "in view" for screens that filter by site — a display
 * preference stored in the session, not a security boundary (every query
 * is still scoped to the tenant by RLS/TenantScope regardless of this
 * value; a site the request doesn't actually have access to just never
 * validates, since the allowed list below is already tenant-scoped).
 */
class SwitchSiteController extends Controller
{
    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $siteIds = Site::query()->pluck('id');

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'site_id' => ['nullable', 'uuid', Rule::in($siteIds)],
        ]);

        if ($validated['site_id'] ?? null) {
            $request->session()->put('current_site_id', $validated['site_id']);
        } else {
            $request->session()->forget('current_site_id');
        }

        return redirect()->back();
    }
}


==================== ./app/Http/Controllers/Web/Tenancy/SwitchTenantController.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web\Tenancy;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

/**
 * A member of more than one practice picks which one is "active" for this
 * browser session — there's no mid-request tenant switch (CLAUDE.md's
 * tenancy invariant: the tenant never comes from a client-supplied
 * parameter, only the session), so this just rewrites the session value
 * that Web\SetCurrentTenant reads on the next request, after validating
 * the target tenant is one this user actually has active access to.
 */
class SwitchTenantController extends Controller
{
    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $activeTenantIds = $request->user()->tenantUsers()->where('status', 'active')->pluck('tenant_id');

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'tenant_id' => ['required', 'uuid', Rule::in($activeTenantIds)],
        ]);

        $request->session()->put('current_tenant_id', $validated['tenant_id']);
        $request->session()->forget('current_site_id');

        return redirect()->route('dashboard');
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web\Traceability;

use App\Domain\Equipment\Models\Device;

/**
 * Same SearchEvidenceAction and EvidenceSearchResultData the mobile API's
 * EvidenceSearchController uses (Api\V1\Traceability) — this is a second,
 * web-only presentation of the identical query (REC-09: complete result
 * < 2s at pilot volume, via the btree indexes SearchEvidenceAction's own
 * docblock already covers), not new domain logic.

class EvidenceSearchController extends Controller

    public function index(EvidenceSearchRequest $request, SearchEvidenceAction $action): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', LabelUsage::class);

        $results = $action->execute($request->validated(), 25);

        $tenant = Tenant::current();

            ->map(fn (Device $device) => new OptionData($device->id, $device->name));
        $operators = User::whereHas(
            'tenantUsers',
            fn ($query) => $query->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->where('status', 'active')
        )->orderBy('name')->get()
            ->map(fn (User $user) => new OptionData($user->id, $user->name));

            'operators' => OptionData::collect($operators),
            'filters' => $request->validated(),
            'canExport' => $request->user()->can('export', LabelUsage::class),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Same EvidenceExportController the mobile API uses (Api\V1\Reporting)
     * — a bulk export is more sensitive than viewing one record at a time,
     * gated on its own exports.manage permission (LabelUsagePolicy::export),
     * not usages.view.
     */
    public function export(ExportEvidenceRequest $request): BinaryFileResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('export', LabelUsage::class);

        $format = $request->string('format', 'xlsx')->toString();
        $writerType = $format === 'csv' ? ExcelFormat::CSV : ExcelFormat::XLSX;

        return Excel::download(
            new EvidenceExport($request->safe()->except('format')),
            "evidence-export.{$format}",
            $writerType,
        );
    }
}

    {

        abort_if($usage === null, 404);

        $this->authorize('view', $usage);

        return $action->execute($usage);
    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Web\Traceability;

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Actions\ArchivePatientAction;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Actions\CreatePatientAction;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Data\PatientData;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Data\PatientUsageEntryData;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\LabelUsage;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\Patient;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;
use Spatie\LaravelData\CursorPaginatedDataCollection;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\AllowedFilter;
use Spatie\QueryBuilder\QueryBuilder;

/**
 * Same Patient model and PatientData DTO the mobile API uses
 * (Api\V1\Traceability\PatientController) — this is a second, web-only
 * presentation of the identical query, not new domain logic.
 * CreatePatientAction takes no input at all (a pseudonym's reference is
 * generated, never client-supplied), so "New patient" is a zero-field
 * confirm, not a form.
 */
class PatientController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('viewAny', Patient::class);

        $patients = QueryBuilder::for(Patient::class)
            ->allowedFilters(AllowedFilter::partial('reference'))
            ->allowedSorts('reference', 'created_at')
            ->defaultSort('-created_at')
            ->cursorPaginate(perPage: 25)
            ->withQueryString();

        return Inertia::render('traceability/patients/index', [
            'patients' => PatientData::collect($patients, CursorPaginatedDataCollection::class),
            'canCreate' => $request->user()->can('create', Patient::class),
            'filters' => $request->input('filter', []),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request, CreatePatientAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('create', Patient::class);

        $patient = $action->execute(Tenant::current(), $request->user());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => "Patient \"{$patient->reference}\" created."]);

        return redirect()->route('patients.show', $patient);
    }

    public function show(Patient $patient, Request $request): Response
    {
        $this->authorize('view', $patient);

        $usages = LabelUsage::where('patient_id', $patient->id)
            ->with('practitioner')
            ->orderByDesc('used_at')
            ->get();

        return Inertia::render('traceability/patients/show', [
            'patient' => PatientData::fromModel($patient),
            'usages' => PatientUsageEntryData::collect($usages),
            'canManage' => $request->user()->can('delete', $patient),
        ]);
    }

    public function destroy(Patient $patient, Request $request, ArchivePatientAction $action): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $patient);

        $action->execute($patient, $request->user());

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => "Patient \"{$patient->reference}\" archived."]);

        return redirect()->route('patients.index');
    }
}


==================== ./app/Http/Middleware/Api/AssignRequestId.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware\Api;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/**
 * Every API request gets a request_id: echoed back on X-Request-Id, and
 * included in every error envelope's `request_id` field so a client-reported
 * issue can be traced straight to a log line.
 */
class AssignRequestId
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $requestId = $request->header('X-Request-Id') ?: (string) Str::uuid7();

        $request->attributes->set('request_id', $requestId);

        $response = $next($request);
        $response->headers->set('X-Request-Id', $requestId);

        return $response;
    }
}


==================== ./app/Http/Middleware/Api/EnsureIdempotency.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware\Api;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/**
 * Idempotency is mandatory on every mutation (CLAUDE.md API conventions):
 * the client sends `Idempotency-Key`, the server stores key + request hash +
 * response for 24h and replays it verbatim on repeat, so a retried request
 * (dropped connection, doubled tap) can never double-apply. Cache store is
 * whatever CACHE_STORE resolves to — Redis in dev/staging/prod, array in
 * tests — the key/hash/replay contract is identical either way.
 */
class EnsureIdempotency
{
    private const TTL_SECONDS = 86400;

    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $key = $request->header('Idempotency-Key');

        if (! $key) {
            throw new ApiException(
                errorCode: 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED',
                message: 'This request must include an Idempotency-Key header.',
                status: 400,
            );
        }

        $requestHash = hash('sha256', $request->method().'|'.$request->path().'|'.$request->getContent());
        $cacheKey = $this->cacheKey($request, $key);

        $stored = Cache::get($cacheKey);

        if ($stored !== null) {
            if ($stored['hash'] !== $requestHash) {
                throw new ApiException(
                    errorCode: 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED',
                    message: 'This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request.',
                    status: 409,
                );
            }

            return response()->json($stored['body'], $stored['status']);
        }

        $response = $next($request);

        Cache::put($cacheKey, [
            'hash' => $requestHash,
            'status' => $response->getStatusCode(),
            'body' => json_decode($response->getContent(), true),
        ], self::TTL_SECONDS);

        return $response;
    }

    private function cacheKey(Request $request, string $idempotencyKey): string
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $scope = $user instanceof User ? $user->id : 'guest';

        return "steriqore:idem:{$scope}:{$idempotencyKey}";
    }
}


==================== ./app/Http/Middleware/Api/SetCurrentTenant.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware\Api;

use App\Domain\Identity\Models\PersonalAccessToken;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/**
 * Binds the request's tenant — read from the Sanctum token, never a
 * client-supplied parameter (CLAUDE.md's tenancy invariant) — as:
 *   - the "current tenant" (spatie/laravel-multitenancy)
 *   - the Postgres RLS session variable app.tenant_id
 *     (App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope / .../add_row_level_security_to_tenant_tables.php)
 *   - the spatie/laravel-permission "team id" (config/permission.php teams
 *     mode), so a role check is scoped to this practice, not any practice
 *     the user happens to hold a role in
 *
 * `SET LOCAL`/`set_config(..., true)` only lasts for the current
 * transaction, and Octane/FrankenPHP keeps the DB connection alive across
 * requests — so the whole request has to run inside one transaction, or the
 * setting would either vanish immediately (autocommit) or leak into the
 * next request on the same worker (a plain, non-local SET). Runs after
 * auth:sanctum, so $request->user() is already resolved.
 */
class SetCurrentTenant
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $token = $request->user()?->currentAccessToken();

        abort_if(! $token instanceof PersonalAccessToken, 401);

        $tenant = Tenant::find($token->tenant_id);

        abort_if($tenant === null, 401);

        return TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => $next($request));
    }
}

class HandleAppearance
{
    /**
     * Handle an incoming request.
     *
     * @param  Closure(Request): (Response)  $next
     */
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        View::share('appearance', $request->cookie('appearance') ?? 'system');

==================== ./app/Http/Middleware/HandleInertiaRequests.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Data\SiteData;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Data\TenantData;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Site;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Middleware;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

class HandleInertiaRequests extends Middleware
{
    /**
     * The root template that's loaded on the first page visit.
     *
     * @see https://inertiajs.com/server-side-setup#root-template
     *
     * @var string
     */
    protected $rootView = 'app';

    /**
     * Determines the current asset version.
     *
     * @see https://inertiajs.com/asset-versioning
     */
    public function version(Request $request): ?string
    {
        return parent::version($request);
    }

    /**
     * Define the props that are shared by default.
     *
     * Tenant/site/permission data is resolved directly from the session
     * here rather than trusting that Web\SetCurrentTenant has already run
     * and bound Tenant::current() — this middleware is registered globally
     * on the 'web' group while Web\SetCurrentTenant is only attached to
     * specific route groups, and Laravel's middleware priority sorting
     * doesn't guarantee one runs before the other just because both are
     * present on the same request. Resolving independently here means the
     * shared props are correct regardless of that ordering; the actual
     * request handling (RLS binding for the controller's own queries)
     * still goes through Web\SetCurrentTenant as normal.
     *
     * @see https://inertiajs.com/shared-data
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function share(Request $request): array
    {
        // Scramble's /docs/api UI is a Blade page on the `web` middleware
        // group, so this middleware still runs — but it is not an Inertia
        // page and must not resolve tenant-scoped Spatie permissions here.
        // Those queries hit RLS-protected permission tables without
        // Web\SetCurrentTenant having bound app.tenant_id, which crashes
        // the docs UI for logged-in users.
        if ($request->routeIs('scramble.*')) {
            return [
                ...parent::share($request),
                'name' => config('app.name'),
                'auth' => [
                    'user' => null,
                    'permissions' => [],
                    'role' => null,
                ],
                'tenant' => null,
                'tenants' => [],
                'sites' => [],
                'currentSiteId' => null,
                'sidebarOpen' => ! $request->hasCookie('sidebar_state') || $request->cookie('sidebar_state') === 'true',
            ];
        }

        $user = $request->user();

        $tenant = null;
        $tenants = [];
        $permissions = [];
        $role = null;
        $sites = [];

        if ($user !== null) {
            $tenants = TenantData::collect(
                $user->tenants()->wherePivot('status', 'active')->orderBy('name')->get()
            );

            $tenantId = $request->session()->get('current_tenant_id');
            $tenant = is_string($tenantId) ? Tenant::find($tenantId) : null;

            if ($tenant !== null) {
                app(PermissionRegistrar::class)->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
                $permissions = $user->getAllPermissions()->pluck('name')->values()->all();
                $role = $user->getRoleNames()->first();

                $sites = SiteData::collect(
                    Site::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)
                        ->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
                        ->orderBy('name')
                        ->get()
                );
            }
        }

        return [
            ...parent::share($request),
            'name' => config('app.name'),
            'auth' => [
                // A plain snapshot, not the live $user object: calling
                // getAllPermissions()/getRoleNames() above lazy-loads and
                // caches the roles/permissions relations onto $user, and
                // anything later in the request (a Policy check, for
                // instance) can reload them again before the response is
                // actually serialized — unsetting the relation here
                // wouldn't survive that. A plain array can't accidentally
                // pick up Spatie's internal pivot rows the same way.
                'user' => $user !== null ? [
                    'id' => $user->id,
                    'name' => $user->name,
                    'email' => $user->email,
                    'email_verified_at' => $user->email_verified_at?->toIso8601String(),
                    'created_at' => $user->created_at?->toIso8601String(),
                    'updated_at' => $user->updated_at?->toIso8601String(),
                ] : null,
                'permissions' => $permissions,
                'role' => $role,
            ],
            'tenant' => $tenant !== null ? TenantData::fromModel($tenant) : null,
            'tenants' => $tenants,
            'sites' => $sites,
            'currentSiteId' => $request->session()->get('current_site_id'),
            'sidebarOpen' => ! $request->hasCookie('sidebar_state') || $request->cookie('sidebar_state') === 'true',
        ];
    }
}


==================== ./app/Http/Middleware/Web/SetCurrentTenant.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware\Web;

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/**
 * The web equivalent of Api\SetCurrentTenant. A browser session has no
 * per-token tenant_id to read (unlike a mobile Sanctum token, which is
 * minted for exactly one practice at login) — a session authenticates a
 * user, who may hold active membership in more than one tenant, so the
 * tenant is resolved from the session instead: whichever tenant_id was
 * last selected (see Web\SwitchTenantController), defaulting to the
 * user's first active membership the first time. The tenant still never
 * comes from a client-supplied route/query parameter (CLAUDE.md's tenancy
 * invariant) — the session value itself is only ever written server-side,
 * validated against the user's own active memberships on every request.
 */
class SetCurrentTenant
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        abort_if($user === null, 401);

        $activeTenantIds = $user->tenantUsers()->where('status', 'active')->pluck('tenant_id');

        abort_if($activeTenantIds->isEmpty(), 403, 'This account has no active practice access.');

        $tenantId = $request->session()->get('current_tenant_id');

        if (! is_string($tenantId) || ! $activeTenantIds->contains($tenantId)) {
            $tenantId = (string) $activeTenantIds->first();
            $request->session()->put('current_tenant_id', $tenantId);
        }

        $tenant = Tenant::find($tenantId);

        abort_if($tenant === null, 403);

        return TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => $next($request));
    }
}

==================== ./app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/Catalog/CreateProductRequest.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Catalog;

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class CreateProductRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        // Rule::exists runs a raw DB query, not an Eloquent one — it does
        // NOT see BelongsToTenant's global scope. Scoping by tenant_id here
        // explicitly is what stops a category/location id from a different
        // practice validating as "exists".
        $tenantId = Tenant::current()?->id;

        return [
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'reference' => ['required', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'unit' => ['sometimes', 'string', 'max:50'],
            'min_threshold' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:0'],
            'is_sterilizable' => ['sometimes', 'boolean'],
            'barcode' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'category_id' => [
                'nullable', 'uuid',
                Rule::exists('product_categories', 'id')->where('tenant_id', $tenantId),
            ],
            'default_location_id' => [
                'nullable', 'uuid',
                Rule::exists('storage_locations', 'id')->where('tenant_id', $tenantId),
            ],
        ];
    }
}

==================== ./app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/Compliance/ListAuditEventsRequest.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Compliance;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

class ListAuditEventsRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Nested under filter[...] — that's what QueryBuilder::allowedFilters
     * actually reads (its own convention, not this app's usual top-level
     * search params), so the validation has to match that shape or it
     * silently validates fields the request never sends.
     *
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'filter.actor_id' => ['nullable', 'uuid'],
            'filter.action' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'filter.subject_type' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'filter.from' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'filter.to' => ['nullable', 'date', 'after_or_equal:filter.from'],
        ];
    }
}


==================== ./app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/Compliance/RaiseNonConformityRequest.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Compliance;

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class RaiseNonConformityRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $tenantId = Tenant::current()?->id;
        $table = $this->input('subject_type') === 'cycle' ? 'cycles' : 'labels';

        return [
            'subject_type' => ['required', Rule::in(['cycle', 'label'])],
            'subject_id' => ['required', 'uuid', Rule::exists($table, 'id')->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)],
            'description' => ['required', 'string', 'max:2000'],
        ];
    }
}

class AdjustStockRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $tenantId = Tenant::current()?->id;

        return [
            'batch_id' => ['required', 'uuid', Rule::exists('batches', 'id')->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)],
            'location_id' => ['required', 'uuid', Rule::exists('storage_locations', 'id')->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)],

            // Mandatory, unlike issue/transfer: an adjustment is a
            // correction with no other evidence behind it.
            'reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:1000'],
        ];
    }
}

==================== ./app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/Labeling/PrintLabelRequest.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Labeling;

use App\Domain\Labeling\Enums\LabelStatus;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class PrintLabelRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            // Required only on a reprint (the label is already Printed) —
            // CLAUDE.md invariant #4. Route model binding has already
            // resolved {label} by the time this runs.
            'reason' => [
                Rule::requiredIf(fn () => $this->route('label') instanceof Label && $this->route('label')->status === LabelStatus::Printed),
                'nullable', 'string', 'max:2000',
            ],
        ];
    }
}

==================== ./app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/Purchasing/ReceiveGoodsRequest.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Purchasing;

use App\Domain\Purchasing\Models\PurchaseOrder;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;

class ReceiveGoodsRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        $tenantId = Tenant::current()?->id;
        $purchaseOrder = $this->route('purchaseOrder');
        $purchaseOrderId = $purchaseOrder instanceof PurchaseOrder ? $purchaseOrder->id : null;

        return [
            'location_id' => [
                'required', 'uuid',
                Rule::exists('storage_locations', 'id')->where('tenant_id', $tenantId),
            ],
            'lines' => ['required', 'array', 'min:1'],
            'lines.*.purchase_order_line_id' => [
                'required', 'uuid',
                Rule::exists('purchase_order_lines', 'id')
                    ->where('tenant_id', $tenantId)
                    ->where('purchase_order_id', $purchaseOrderId),
            ],
            'lines.*.batch_number' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'lines.*.expiry_date' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'lines.*.qty' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:1'],
            'lines.*.discrepancy_reason' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1000'],
        ];
    }
}

==================== ./app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/Sterilization/AttachCycleFileRequest.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Sterilization;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

/**
 * mimes: is an allowlist, not just a size cap — a cycle attachment is a
 * photo of a printed ticket or a scanned document, never an arbitrary
 * file type (S5-ANA-01). Medialibrary's own denylist (config/media
 * -library.php's disallowed_extensions) is defense-in-depth on top of
 * this, not a substitute for it.
 */
class AttachCycleFileRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'file' => ['required', 'file', 'max:10240', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png,webp,pdf'],
        ];
    }
}

==================== ./app/Models/User.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Models;

// use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\MustVerifyEmail;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Support\Concerns\HasUuidv7;
use Database\Factories\UserFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Fillable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Hidden;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsToMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\User as Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notifiable;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Laravel\Fortify\Contracts\PasskeyUser;
use Laravel\Fortify\PasskeyAuthenticatable;
use Laravel\Fortify\TwoFactorAuthenticatable;
use Laravel\Sanctum\HasApiTokens;
use Spatie\Permission\Traits\HasRoles;

/**
 * @property string $id
 * @property string $name
 * @property string $email
 * @property Carbon|null $email_verified_at
 * @property string $password
 * @property string|null $two_factor_secret
 * @property string|null $two_factor_recovery_codes
 * @property Carbon|null $two_factor_confirmed_at
 * @property Carbon|null $disabled_at
 * @property string|null $remember_token
 * @property Carbon|null $created_at
 * @property Carbon|null $updated_at
 */
#[Fillable(['name', 'email', 'password'])]
#[Hidden(['password', 'two_factor_secret', 'two_factor_recovery_codes', 'remember_token'])]
class User extends Authenticatable implements PasskeyUser
{
    /** @use HasFactory<UserFactory> */
    use HasApiTokens, HasFactory, HasRoles, HasUuidv7, Notifiable, PasskeyAuthenticatable, TwoFactorAuthenticatable;

    /**
     * Get the attributes that should be cast.
     *
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'email_verified_at' => 'datetime',
            'password' => 'hashed',
            'two_factor_confirmed_at' => 'datetime',
            'disabled_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return HasMany<TenantUser, $this>
     */
    public function tenantUsers(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(TenantUser::class);
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsToMany<Tenant, $this, TenantUser>
     */
    public function tenants(): BelongsToMany
    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(Tenant::class, 'tenant_user')
            ->using(TenantUser::class)
            ->withPivot(['status', 'invited_at', 'joined_at', 'disabled_at'])
            ->withTimestamps();
    }
}

==================== ./app/Policies/DataExportRequestPolicy.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Domain\Reporting\Models\DataExportRequest;
use App\Models\User;

/**
 * An account-wide data export (every table, every file) is more sensitive
 * than any single evidence dossier — its own permission, owner/admin only
 * (see SeedTenantRolesAction). No update()/delete(): a request's outcome
 * is written only by GenerateDataExportJob.
 */
class DataExportRequestPolicy
{
    public function viewAny(User $user): bool

==================== ./app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Providers;

use App\Domain\Catalog\Models\Product;
use App\Domain\Catalog\Models\ProductCategory;
use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\AuditEvent;
use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\NonConformity;
use App\Domain\Equipment\Models\Device;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\Invitation;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\PersonalAccessToken;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Alert;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\StockLevel;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\StockMovement;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\DluRule;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Domain\Purchasing\Models\PurchaseOrder;
use App\Domain\Purchasing\Models\Supplier;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Models\DataExportRequest;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\Cycle;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Room;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Site;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\StorageLocation;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\LabelUsage;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\Patient;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Policies\AlertPolicy;
use App\Policies\AuditEventPolicy;
use App\Policies\BatchPolicy;
use App\Policies\CyclePolicy;
use App\Policies\DataExportRequestPolicy;
use App\Policies\DevicePolicy;
use App\Policies\DluRulePolicy;
use App\Policies\InvitationPolicy;
use App\Policies\LabelPolicy;
use App\Policies\LabelUsagePolicy;
use App\Policies\NonConformityPolicy;
use App\Policies\PatientPolicy;
use App\Policies\ProductCategoryPolicy;
use App\Policies\ProductPolicy;
use App\Policies\PurchaseOrderPolicy;
use App\Policies\RoomPolicy;
use App\Policies\SitePolicy;
use App\Policies\StockLevelPolicy;
use App\Policies\StockMovementPolicy;
use App\Policies\StorageLocationPolicy;
use App\Policies\SupplierPolicy;
use App\Policies\TenantUserPolicy;
use App\Support\Api\ScrambleErrorEnvelope;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Dedoc\Scramble\Scramble;
use Illuminate\Cache\RateLimiting\Limit;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Date;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\URL;
use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;
use Laravel\Sanctum\Sanctum;

class AppServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
{
    /**
     * Register any application services.
     */
    public function register(): void
    {
        //
    }

    /**
     * Bootstrap any application services.
     */
    public function boot(): void
    {
        $this->configureDefaults();
        $this->configureRateLimiting();

        Sanctum::usePersonalAccessTokenModel(PersonalAccessToken::class);

        Scramble::afterOpenApiGenerated(ScrambleErrorEnvelope::apply(...));

        // Explicit, not relying on Laravel's App\Policies\{Model}Policy
        // auto-discovery: our models live under App\Domain\..., not
        // App\Models, so the convention-based guess isn't guaranteed.
        Gate::policy(Site::class, SitePolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(Room::class, RoomPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(StorageLocation::class, StorageLocationPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(Invitation::class, InvitationPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(TenantUser::class, TenantUserPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(AuditEvent::class, AuditEventPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(Product::class, ProductPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(ProductCategory::class, ProductCategoryPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(Supplier::class, SupplierPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(PurchaseOrder::class, PurchaseOrderPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(StockMovement::class, StockMovementPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(StockLevel::class, StockLevelPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(Batch::class, BatchPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(Alert::class, AlertPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(Device::class, DevicePolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(Cycle::class, CyclePolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(DluRule::class, DluRulePolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(Label::class, LabelPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(Patient::class, PatientPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(LabelUsage::class, LabelUsagePolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(NonConformity::class, NonConformityPolicy::class);
        Gate::policy(DataExportRequest::class, DataExportRequestPolicy::class);
    }

    /**
     * Configure default behaviors for production-ready applications.
     */
    protected function configureDefaults(): void
    {
        Date::use(CarbonImmutable::class);

        DB::prohibitDestructiveCommands(
            $this->app->isProduction(),
        );

        Password::defaults(fn (): ?Password => $this->app->isProduction()
            ? Password::min(12)
                ->mixedCase()
                ->letters()
                ->numbers()
                ->symbols()
                ->uncompromised()
            : null,
        );

        if ($this->app->isProduction()) {
            URL::forceScheme('https');
        }
    }

    /**
     * S5-ANA-01 (security campaign): the whole /api/v1 surface had no rate
     * limiting at all — Laravel's default 'api' middleware group isn't
     * used here (routes/api.php is wired directly via ->withRouting()),
     * so nothing registered one implicitly. 'public-api' is deliberately
     * stricter than 'api': it covers registration, login, and invitation
     * acceptance — the three endpoints an unauthenticated caller can hit
     * to brute-force credentials or spam tenant/account creation.
     */
    protected function configureRateLimiting(): void
    {
        RateLimiter::for('api', function (Request $request) {
            $user = $request->user();

            return Limit::perMinute(120)->by($user instanceof User ? $user->id : $request->ip());
        });

        RateLimiter::for('public-api', fn (Request $request) => Limit::perMinute(10)->by($request->ip()));
    }
}


==================== ./app/Providers/FortifyServiceProvider.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Providers;

use App\Actions\Fortify\CreateNewUser;
use App\Actions\Fortify\ResetUserPassword;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Cache\RateLimiting\Limit;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter;
use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Laravel\Fortify\Features;
use Laravel\Fortify\Fortify;

class FortifyServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
{
    /**
     * Register any application services.
     */
    public function register(): void
    {
        //
    }

    /**
     * Bootstrap any application services.
     */
    public function boot(): void
    {
        $this->configureActions();
        $this->configureAuthentication();
        $this->configureViews();
        $this->configureRateLimiting();
    }

    /**
     * Configure Fortify actions.
     */
    private function configureActions(): void
    {
        Fortify::resetUserPasswordsUsing(ResetUserPassword::class);
        Fortify::createUsersUsing(CreateNewUser::class);
    }

    /**
     * CLAUDE.md invariant #6: "Users are soft-disabled, never deleted" —
     * a disabled account must still never authenticate, web or mobile
     * (App\Domain\Identity\Actions\AuthenticateUserAction enforces the
     * same thing for the API). Whether the user has an active practice
     * membership is deliberately NOT checked here: that's already
     * enforced on every tenant-scoped page by Web\SetCurrentTenant, and a
     * bare account with no practice yet still needs to be able to log in
     * to reach onboarding rather than being rejected before ever seeing
     * why. A generic `null` return (rather than a specific message)
     * matches Fortify's default "these credentials do not match"
     * response, the same way a mismatched password does.
     */
    private function configureAuthentication(): void
    {
        Fortify::authenticateUsing(function (Request $request) {
            $user = User::where('email', $request->email)->first();

            if (! $user || ! Hash::check($request->password, $user->password)) {
                return null;
            }

            if ($user->disabled_at !== null) {
                return null;
            }

            return $user;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Configure Fortify views.
     */
    private function configureViews(): void
    {
        Fortify::loginView(fn (Request $request) => Inertia::render('auth/login', [
            'canResetPassword' => Features::enabled(Features::resetPasswords()),
            'status' => $request->session()->get('status'),
        ]));

        Fortify::resetPasswordView(fn (Request $request) => Inertia::render('auth/reset-password', [
            'email' => $request->email,
            'token' => $request->route('token'),
            'passwordRules' => Password::defaults()->toPasswordRulesString(),
        ]));

        Fortify::requestPasswordResetLinkView(fn (Request $request) => Inertia::render('auth/forgot-password', [
            'status' => $request->session()->get('status'),
        ]));

        Fortify::verifyEmailView(fn (Request $request) => Inertia::render('auth/verify-email', [
            'status' => $request->session()->get('status'),
        ]));

        Fortify::registerView(fn () => Inertia::render('auth/register', [
            'passwordRules' => Password::defaults()->toPasswordRulesString(),
        ]));

        Fortify::twoFactorChallengeView(fn () => Inertia::render('auth/two-factor-challenge'));

        Fortify::confirmPasswordView(fn () => Inertia::render('auth/confirm-password'));
    }

    /**
     * Configure rate limiting.
     */
    private function configureRateLimiting(): void
    {
        RateLimiter::for('two-factor', function (Request $request) {
            return Limit::perMinute(5)->by($request->session()->get('login.id'));
        });

        RateLimiter::for('login', function (Request $request) {
            $throttleKey = Str::transliterate(Str::lower($request->input(Fortify::username())).'|'.$request->ip());

            // 5/minute is the real security control, verified for real by
            // AuthenticationTest (APP_ENV=testing) — untouched here. Only
            // the `local` Docker dev container is loosened: Playwright E2E
            // specs re-authenticate the same demo account dozens of times
            // per run against that one long-lived container (a real user
            // never does this) and legitimately trip it. Test-loop volume,
            // not an attack to defend against.
            $limit = app()->environment('local') ? 1000 : 5;

            return Limit::perMinute($limit)->by($throttleKey);
        });

        RateLimiter::for('passkeys', function (Request $request) {
            return Limit::perMinute(10)->by(
                ($request->input('credential.id') ?: $request->session()->getId()).'|'.$request->ip(),
            );
        });
    }
}

==================== ./app/Support/Api/ApiException.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Support\Api;

use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Thrown for any business-rule failure that needs the API's stable machine
 * `code` (mobile branches on the code, never the message — see CLAUDE.md's
 * API conventions). Framework exceptions (validation, auth, 404s, ...) are
 * mapped to the same envelope separately in ApiExceptionRenderer.
 */
class ApiException extends RuntimeException
{
    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $details
     */
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $errorCode,
        string $message,
        public readonly int $status = 409,
        public readonly array $details = [],
        ?Throwable $previous = null,
    ) {
        parent::__construct($message, 0, $previous);
    }
}


==================== ./app/Support/Api/ApiExceptionRenderer.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Support\Api;

use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Auth\AuthenticationException;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\ModelNotFoundException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpExceptionInterface;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\TooManyRequestsHttpException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Every /api/* error uses one envelope, per CLAUDE.md's API conventions:
 * {"error":{"code","message","details","request_id"}}. The mobile app
 * branches on `code`, never `message` — so every case below carries a
 * stable, documented code, not just an HTTP status.
 */
class ApiExceptionRenderer
{
    public static function register(Exceptions $exceptions): void
    {
        $exceptions->render(function (Throwable $e, Request $request) {
            if (! $request->is('api/*')) {
                return null;
            }

            return self::toResponse($e, $request);
        });
    }

    public static function toResponse(Throwable $e, Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        [$status, $code, $message, $details] = self::resolve($e);

        $requestId = $request->attributes->get('request_id') ?? (string) Str::uuid7();

        return response()->json([
            'error' => [
                'code' => $code,
                'message' => $message,
                'details' => (object) $details,
                'request_id' => $requestId,
            ],
        ], $status);
    }

    /**
     * @return array{0: int, 1: string, 2: string, 3: array<string, mixed>}
     */
    private static function resolve(Throwable $e): array
    {
        return match (true) {
            $e instanceof ApiException => [$e->status, $e->errorCode, $e->getMessage(), $e->details],
            $e instanceof ValidationException => [422, 'VALIDATION_FAILED', 'The given data was invalid.', $e->errors()],
            $e instanceof AuthenticationException => [401, 'UNAUTHENTICATED', 'Authentication is required.', []],
            $e instanceof AuthorizationException => [403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'This action is unauthorized.', []],
            $e instanceof ModelNotFoundException => [404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'The requested resource was not found.', []],
            $e instanceof TooManyRequestsHttpException => [429, 'TOO_MANY_REQUESTS', 'Too many requests.', []],
            $e instanceof HttpExceptionInterface => [
                $e->getStatusCode(),
                self::genericCodeFor($e->getStatusCode()),
                $e->getMessage() !== '' ? $e->getMessage() : 'An error occurred.',
                [],
            ],
            default => [500, 'INTERNAL_ERROR', config('app.debug') ? $e->getMessage() : 'An unexpected error occurred.', []],
        };
    }

    private static function genericCodeFor(int $status): string
    {
        return match ($status) {
            404 => 'NOT_FOUND',
            405 => 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',
            409 => 'CONFLICT',
            410 => 'GONE',
            default => 'HTTP_'.$status,
        };
    }
}


==================== ./app/Support/Api/ScrambleErrorEnvelope.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Support\Api;

use Dedoc\Scramble\Exceptions\OpenApiReferenceTargetNotFoundException;
use Dedoc\Scramble\Support\Generator\OpenApi;
use Dedoc\Scramble\Support\Generator\Reference;
use Dedoc\Scramble\Support\Generator\Response as OAResponse;
use Dedoc\Scramble\Support\Generator\Schema;
use Dedoc\Scramble\Support\Generator\Types\ObjectType;
use Dedoc\Scramble\Support\Generator\Types\StringType;

/**
 * Scramble infers per-exception response shapes (e.g. Laravel's default
 * {"message","errors"} for a ValidationException) by statically analysing
 * what each controller can throw. That's wrong here: every /api/* error is
 * rewritten by ApiExceptionRenderer into one envelope
 * {"error":{"code","message","details","request_id"}} — see CLAUDE.md's API
 * conventions. Without this transformer, the committed openapi.yaml would
 * silently drift from what the API actually returns. Registered via
 * Scramble::afterOpenApiGenerated() in AppServiceProvider.
 *
 * Note: an operation's response map is keyed by HTTP status at
 * Operation::toArray() time by resolving each entry's `Response::$code`
 * (reading straight through a Reference to its target). So this transformer
 * can't point every error response at one shared named response component —
 * that would collapse every status onto whatever single code the shared
 * component happened to carry. Instead each entry becomes its own inline
 * Response with the correct code, all pointing at the one shared
 * ApiErrorEnvelope *schema* (schemas don't have this keying problem).
 */
class ScrambleErrorEnvelope
{
    public static function apply(OpenApi $openApi): void
    {
        $components = $openApi->components;

        $errorObject = (new ObjectType)
            ->addProperty('code', new StringType)
            ->addProperty('message', new StringType)
            ->addProperty('details', new ObjectType)
            ->addProperty('request_id', new StringType)
            ->setRequired(['code', 'message', 'details', 'request_id']);

        $envelope = (new ObjectType)
            ->addProperty('error', $errorObject)
            ->setRequired(['error']);

        $components->addSchema('ApiErrorEnvelope', Schema::fromType($envelope));

        foreach ($openApi->paths as $path) {
            foreach ($path->operations as $operation) {
                if ($operation->responses === null) {
                    continue;
                }

                foreach ($operation->responses as $index => $entry) {
                    $code = self::resolveCode($entry);

                    if (is_int($code) && $code >= 400) {
                        $operation->responses[$index] = OAResponse::make($code)
                            ->setDescription('SteriQore API error envelope.')
                            ->setContent('application/json', $components->getSchemaReference('ApiErrorEnvelope'));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        self::removeOrphanedResponseComponents($openApi);
    }

    /**
     * Built-in named responses (ValidationException, AuthenticationException,
     * ...) no longer have any references pointing at them once the loop
     * above ran — every operation that used to $ref one now carries its own
     * inline Response instead. Sweep anything components.responses no
     * longer points at, rather than guessing their exact (fully-qualified,
     * backslash-prefixed) component names.
     */
    private static function removeOrphanedResponseComponents(OpenApi $openApi): void
    {
        $components = $openApi->components;
        $usedNames = [];

        foreach ($openApi->paths as $path) {
            foreach ($path->operations as $operation) {
                foreach (($operation->responses ?? []) as $entry) {
                    if ($entry instanceof Reference && $entry->referenceType === 'responses') {
                        $usedNames[$entry->fullName] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        foreach (array_keys($components->responses) as $name) {
            if (! isset($usedNames[$name])) {
                $components->removeResponse($name);
            }
        }
    }

    private static function resolveCode(OAResponse|Reference $entry): int|string|null
    {
        if ($entry instanceof OAResponse) {
            return $entry->code;
        }

        try {
            $resolved = $entry->resolve();
        } catch (OpenApiReferenceTargetNotFoundException) {
            return null;
        }

        return $resolved instanceof OAResponse ? $resolved->code : null;
    }
}


==================== ./app/Support/Concerns/BelongsToTenant.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Support\Concerns;

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;

/**
 * Applies to every tenant-owned model: adds the global scope that filters
 * reads to the current tenant (fails closed, see TenantScope) and
 * auto-fills tenant_id on create so callers never have to pass it — the
 * tenant never comes from client input (CLAUDE.md's tenancy invariant).
 */
trait BelongsToTenant
{
    public static function bootBelongsToTenant(): void
    {
        static::addGlobalScope(new TenantScope);

        static::creating(function (Model $model): void {
            if ($model->getAttribute('tenant_id') === null && $tenant = Tenant::current()) {
                $model->setAttribute('tenant_id', $tenant->getKey());
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * @return BelongsTo<Tenant, $this>
     */
    public function tenant(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Tenant::class);
    }
}


==================== ./app/Support/Concerns/HasUuidv7.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Support\Concerns;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Concerns\HasUuids;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * Primary keys are UUIDv7 (time-ordered) rather than Laravel's default
 * "ordered UUIDv4", so ids sort chronologically and match the DB-level
 * `uuidv7()` default set on every tenant-owned table (see docs/erd.md).
 */
trait HasUuidv7
{
    use HasUuids;

    public function newUniqueId(): string
    {
        return (string) Str::uuid7();
    }
}


==================== ./app/Support/Dashboard/DashboardCache.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Support\Dashboard;

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;

/**
 * UI-30's dashboard rolls up counts across Sterilization/Inventory/
 * Compliance in one request — cached per tenant with a short TTL as the
 * safety net, and explicitly forgotten by every write that could change
 * what it shows (cycle release, non-conformity raise/resolve, stock
 * movement, alert detect/resolve) so the attention queue is never stale on
 * purpose. This is the first cache-invalidation-on-domain-event pattern in
 * the app; kept as a tiny standalone helper (not tied to any one domain)
 * so Sterilization/Inventory/Compliance Actions can depend on it without a
 * dependency back into the Reporting domain that owns the dashboard itself.
 */
class DashboardCache
{
    private const int TTL_SECONDS = 60;

    /**
     * @template TValue of array<string, mixed>
     *
     * @param  Closure(): TValue  $callback
     * @return TValue
     */
    public static function remember(Tenant $tenant, Closure $callback): array
    {
        return Cache::remember(self::key($tenant), self::TTL_SECONDS, $callback);
    }

    public static function forget(Tenant $tenant): void
    {
        Cache::forget(self::key($tenant));
    }

    private static function key(Tenant $tenant): string
    {
        return "dashboard:{$tenant->id}";
    }
}

==================== ./app/Support/Security/SecurityEventRenderer.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Support\Security;

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RecordSecurityEventAction;
use App\Domain\Compliance\Enums\SecurityEventType;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Support\Concerns\BelongsToTenant;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\ModelNotFoundException;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpExceptionInterface;
use Throwable;

/**
 * The dedicated security channel REC-01 promises but never had: every
 * authorization failure, cross-tenant resolution attempt, and RLS policy
 * rejection, recorded to security_events (never audit_events — see that
 * migration's docblock for why). Purely observational — every branch below
 * returns null, so the actual response (403, 404, the normal 500 page) is
 * always decided by ApiExceptionRenderer/ApiExceptionWebRenderer/Laravel's
 * own defaults exactly as before; this only ever adds a side effect.
 *
 * Registered FIRST in bootstrap/app.php, deliberately: Handler::render()
 * calls prepareException() once up front — which is where
 * AuthorizationException becomes AccessDeniedHttpException/HttpException
 * and ModelNotFoundException becomes NotFoundHttpException — so every
 * render() callback, including this one, only ever sees the CONVERTED
 * type; the original is reachable only via ->getPrevious(). Separately,
 * Handler::renderViaCallbacks() stops at the first callback that returns
 * non-null, so unless this one runs before ApiExceptionRenderer/
 * ApiExceptionWebRenderer, it would never even be invoked for most of
 * them.
 *
 * A cross-tenant resolution attempt specifically means: the id in the URL
 * resolves to a REAL row in a DIFFERENT tenant, not just any 404. A wholly
 * made-up id is normal 404 noise, not a security event — recording every
 * ModelNotFoundException indiscriminately would drown the signal the
 * brief asked for ("a rate spike on this channel is the signal that
 * matters") in typos and dead links.
 */
class SecurityEventRenderer
{
    public static function register(Exceptions $exceptions): void
    {
        $exceptions->render(function (Throwable $e, Request $request) {
            self::record($e, $request);

            return null;
        });
    }

    private static function record(Throwable $e, Request $request): void
    {
        try {
            if (self::isAuthorizationFailure($e)) {
                self::recordAuthorizationFailure($request);

                return;
            }

            if ($e instanceof HttpExceptionInterface
                && $e->getStatusCode() === 404
                && $e->getPrevious() instanceof ModelNotFoundException) {
                self::recordCrossTenantAttemptIfReal($e->getPrevious());

                return;
            }

            if (self::isRlsPolicyRejection($e)) {
                app(RecordSecurityEventAction::class)->execute(SecurityEventType::RlsPolicyRejection);
            }
        } catch (Throwable $recordingFailure) {
            // Recording a security event must never itself break the
            // response being rendered for the original exception.
            report($recordingFailure);
        }
    }

    private static function isAuthorizationFailure(Throwable $e): bool
    {
        return $e instanceof AuthorizationException
            || ($e instanceof HttpExceptionInterface && $e->getStatusCode() === 403);
    }

    private static function recordAuthorizationFailure(Request $request): void
    {
        $subject = collect($request->route()?->parameters() ?? [])
            ->first(fn ($value) => $value instanceof Model);

        app(RecordSecurityEventAction::class)->execute(
            type: SecurityEventType::AuthorizationFailure,
            subjectType: $subject?->getMorphClass(),
            subjectId: $subject?->getKey(),
        );
    }

    /**
     * @param  ModelNotFoundException<Model>  $e
     */
    private static function recordCrossTenantAttemptIfReal(ModelNotFoundException $e): void
    {
        $modelClass = $e->getModel();

        if (! is_subclass_of($modelClass, Model::class) || ! self::usesBelongsToTenant($modelClass)) {
            return;
        }

        $tenantClaimed = Tenant::current();

        foreach ($e->getIds() as $id) {
            $record = $modelClass::on('pgsql_admin')
                ->withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)
                ->find($id);

            if (! $record instanceof Model) {
                continue;
            }

            $recordTenantId = $record->getAttribute('tenant_id');

            if ($recordTenantId === null) {
                continue;
            }

            if ($tenantClaimed !== null && $recordTenantId === $tenantClaimed->id) {
                // Genuinely not found within the caller's own tenant
                // (soft-deleted, a different scope excluded it, ...) —
                // not a cross-tenant probe.
                continue;
            }

            $tenantActual = Tenant::find($recordTenantId);

            if (! $tenantActual instanceof Tenant) {
                continue;
            }

            app(RecordSecurityEventAction::class)->execute(
                type: SecurityEventType::CrossTenantResolutionAttempt,
                tenantActual: $tenantActual,
                subjectType: $modelClass,
                subjectId: (string) $id,
            );
        }
    }

    private static function isRlsPolicyRejection(Throwable $e): bool
    {
        return $e instanceof QueryException
            && str_contains($e->getMessage(), 'row-level security policy');
    }

    /**
     * @param  class-string  $modelClass
     */
    private static function usesBelongsToTenant(string $modelClass): bool
    {
        return in_array(BelongsToTenant::class, class_uses_recursive($modelClass), true);
    }
}


==================== ./app/Support/Tenancy/TenantContext.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Support\Tenancy;

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * The exact binding App\Http\Middleware\Api\SetCurrentTenant does for a
 * real request — spatie/multitenancy's "current tenant", the Postgres RLS
 * session variable app.tenant_id, and spatie/permission's team id —
 * extracted so it can also run outside a request, for the two public
 * endpoints that must create tenant-scoped rows (roles, in particular —
 * RLS-protected since S1-ANA-03) before any "current tenant" exists to
 * scope by: tenant registration and invitation acceptance.
 *
 * `set_config(..., true)` only lasts for the current transaction — hence
 * wrapping the callback in one here, same as the middleware.
 */
class TenantContext
{
    public static function run(Tenant $tenant, Closure $callback): mixed
    {
        $tenant->makeCurrent();
        app(PermissionRegistrar::class)->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);

        try {
            return DB::transaction(function () use ($tenant, $callback) {
                DB::select("select set_config('app.tenant_id', ?, true)", [$tenant->id]);

                return $callback();
            });
        } finally {
            Tenant::forgetCurrent();
            app(PermissionRegistrar::class)->setPermissionsTeamId(null);
        }
    }
}


==================== ./app/Support/Tenancy/TenantScope.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Support\Tenancy;

use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Scope;

/**
 * Fails closed: with no current tenant bound (a forgotten middleware, a
 * console context that never called Tenant::current()), this returns zero
 * rows rather than silently falling back to an unscoped, cross-tenant query.
 * Legitimate system contexts opt out explicitly via
 * Model::withoutGlobalScope(self::class), the same way Postgres RLS
 * defaults to denying when app.tenant_id isn't set (see docs/erd.md §4).
 *
 * @implements Scope<Model>
 */
class TenantScope implements Scope
{
    public function apply(Builder $builder, Model $model): void
    {
        $tenant = Tenant::current();

        $column = $model->getTable().'.tenant_id';

        if ($tenant === null) {
            $builder->whereRaw('1 = 0');

            return;
        }

        $builder->where($column, $tenant->getKey());
    }
}


==================== ./app/Support/Web/ApiExceptionWebRenderer.php ====================

<?php

namespace App\Support\Web;

use App\Support\Api\ApiException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;

/**
 * Every domain Action throws ApiException for a business-rule violation
 * (CYCLE_LOAD_EMPTY, CYCLE_INVALID_TRANSITION, ...) — the exact same
 * Actions the web controllers call, not a separate set of rules. But
 * ApiExceptionRenderer only ever registers itself for `/api/*` requests
 * (CLAUDE.md's one-error-envelope convention is an API contract concern),
 * so without this, a business-rule failure on any web write action would
 * fall through to a bare, unbranded error page instead of a normal
 * validation-style "redirected back with a message" experience. This
 * mirrors how a ValidationException already behaves for web requests —
 * just for the domain's own business-rule exception type.
 */
class ApiExceptionWebRenderer
{
    public static function register(Exceptions $exceptions): void
    {
        $exceptions->render(function (ApiException $e, Request $request) {
            if ($request->is('api/*')) {
                return null;
            }

            Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'error', 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);

            return redirect()->back();
        });
    }
}

==================== ./bootstrap/app.php ====================

<?php

use App\Http\Middleware\Api\AssignRequestId;
use App\Http\Middleware\Api\EnsureIdempotency;
use App\Http\Middleware\Api\SetCurrentTenant;
use App\Http\Middleware\HandleAppearance;
use App\Http\Middleware\HandleInertiaRequests;
use App\Http\Middleware\Web\SetCurrentTenant as SetCurrentTenantWeb;
use App\Support\Api\ApiExceptionRenderer;
use App\Support\Security\SecurityEventRenderer;
use App\Support\Web\ApiExceptionWebRenderer;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Middleware;
use Illuminate\Http\Middleware\AddLinkHeadersForPreloadedAssets;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Routing\Middleware\SubstituteBindings;
use Sentry\Laravel\Integration;

return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
    ->withRouting(
        web: __DIR__.'/../routes/web.php',
        api: __DIR__.'/../routes/api.php',
        commands: __DIR__.'/../routes/console.php',
        health: '/up',
    )
    ->withMiddleware(function (Middleware $middleware): void {
        $middleware->encryptCookies(except: ['appearance', 'sidebar_state']);

        $middleware->web(append: [
            HandleAppearance::class,
            HandleInertiaRequests::class,
            AddLinkHeadersForPreloadedAssets::class,
        ]);

        $middleware->api(prepend: [
            AssignRequestId::class,
        ]);

        $middleware->alias([
            'idempotent' => EnsureIdempotency::class,
            'tenant' => SetCurrentTenant::class,
            'tenant.web' => SetCurrentTenantWeb::class,
        ]);

        // Without this, Laravel's default middleware priority runs
        // SubstituteBindings (which resolves route-bound models, e.g.
        // Product $product) before this — so a BelongsToTenant-scoped
        // model's global scope would query with no current tenant bound
        // yet, and every such route would 404 (TenantScope fails closed).
        $middleware->prependToPriorityList(
            before: SubstituteBindings::class,
            prepend: SetCurrentTenant::class,
        );

        $middleware->prependToPriorityList(
            before: SubstituteBindings::class,
            prepend: SetCurrentTenantWeb::class,
        );
    })
    ->withExceptions(function (Exceptions $exceptions): void {
        $exceptions->shouldRenderJsonWhen(
            fn (Request $request) => $request->is('api/*') || $request->expectsJson(),
        );

        // Registered first and deliberately: every render() callback below
        // sees the exception in registration order, and the loop stops at
        // the first one that returns a non-null response
        // (Handler::renderViaCallbacks) — this one always returns null, but
        // if it were registered after ApiExceptionRenderer/
        // ApiExceptionWebRenderer, most exceptions would already have a
        // response by the time it runs and it would simply never fire.
        SecurityEventRenderer::register($exceptions);
        ApiExceptionRenderer::register($exceptions);
        ApiExceptionWebRenderer::register($exceptions);

        // No-op until SENTRY_LARAVEL_DSN is set (S5-ANA-02) — no staging/
        // production Sentry project exists yet, see docs/open-questions.md.
        Integration::handles($exceptions);
    })->create();
