==================== ./e2e/batches.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';

/**
 * Batches have no create route anywhere in the domain — they only ever
 * come into existence as a side effect of receiving a purchase order
 * (UI-14). This spec drives that same real flow, then checks the batch
 * shows up in the tenant-wide batches list (UI-15) with the right
 * on-hand quantity and an "Expiring soon" badge.
 */
test.describe('Batches (UI-15)', () => {
    test('receive a purchase order, then find the resulting batch in the batches list', async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);

        await page.goto('/products');
        const productName = `E2E Batch Product ${Date.now()}`;
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'New product' }).click();
        const productDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await productDialog.getByLabel('Name').fill(productName);
        await productDialog
            .getByLabel('Reference')
            .fill(`E2E-BATCH-SKU-${Date.now()}`);
        await productDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Add product' })
            .click();
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('heading', { name: productName }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await page.goto('/suppliers');
        const supplierName = `E2E Batch Supplier ${Date.now()}`;
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'New supplier' }).click();
        const supplierDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await supplierDialog.getByLabel('Name').fill(supplierName);
        await supplierDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Add supplier' })
            .click();
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('heading', { name: supplierName }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await page.goto('/purchase-orders/create');
        await page.getByLabel('Supplier').click();
        await page
            .getByRole('option', { name: supplierName, exact: true })
            .click();
        await page.getByLabel(/Product for line 1/).click();
        await page
            .getByRole('option', { name: productName, exact: true })
            .click();
        await page.getByLabel(/Quantity for line 1/).fill('10');
        await page
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Create purchase order' })
            .click();
        await expect(
            page.getByText('Purchase order created.'),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Mark as ordered' }).click();
        await expect(
            page.getByText('Purchase order marked as ordered.'),
        ).toBeVisible();

        const batchNumber = `E2E-BATCH-${Date.now()}`;
        const expiry = new Date(Date.now() + 20 * 86_400_000)
            .toISOString()
            .slice(0, 10);

        await expect(page.getByLabel('Storage location')).toBeVisible();
        await page.getByLabel('Storage location').click();
        await page.getByRole('option').first().click();
        await page.getByLabel(/Batch number for/).fill(batchNumber);
        await page.getByLabel(/Expiry date for/).fill(expiry);
        await page.getByLabel(/Quantity received for/).fill('10');
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Record receipt' }).click();
        await expect(page.getByText('Goods received.')).toBeVisible();

        await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Batches' }).click();
        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/batches$/);
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Batches' }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await page
            .getByRole('combobox')
            .filter({ hasText: 'All products' })
            .click();
        await page
            .getByRole('option', { name: productName, exact: true })
            .click();

        const row = page.getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: batchNumber });
        await expect(row).toBeVisible();
        await expect(row.getByText(productName)).toBeVisible();
        await expect(row.getByText('10', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
        await expect(row.getByText('Expiring soon')).toBeVisible();
        await expect(row.getByText('Active', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    });

==================== ./e2e/control-tests.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';
import {
    addDemoCycleItem,
    completeDemoCycle,
    createDemoCycle,
    createDemoDevice,
    mintDemoApiToken,
} from './support/demo';

test.describe('Control tests (UI-04)', () => {
    test('record a test from the cycle detail page, then find it in the logbook', async ({
        page,
        request,
    }) => {
        const token = await mintDemoApiToken(request);
        const deviceId = await createDemoDevice(request, token);
        const cycleId = await createDemoCycle(request, token, deviceId);
        await addDemoCycleItem(request, token, cycleId, 'Scaler kit, pouch 1');
        await completeDemoCycle(request, token, cycleId);

        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);
        await page.goto(`/cycles/${cycleId}`);

        await expect(
            page.getByText('No control tests recorded for this cycle yet.'),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await page.getByLabel('Type').click();
        await page.getByRole('option', { name: 'Helix' }).click();
        await page.getByLabel('Result').click();
        await page.getByRole('option', { name: 'Pass' }).click();
        await page.getByLabel('Control test notes').fill('Ran clean.');
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Record test' }).click();

        await expect(page.getByText('Control test recorded.')).toBeVisible();
        await expect(page.getByRole('cell', { name: 'Helix' })).toBeVisible();

        // The logbook is a second, tenant-wide view of the same row.
        await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Control tests' }).click();
        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/control-tests$/);

        // The demo tenant is a persistent, shared fixture — prior runs of
        // this same spec leave their own "Helix" rows behind, so this
        // filter can match several. Sorted newest-first, the row this test
        // just created is always the first match.
        const row = page.getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: 'Helix' }).first();
        await expect(row).toBeVisible();
        await expect(row.getByText('Pass')).toBeVisible();

        // Filtering to a result with no matches proves the filter reaches
        // the server, not just a client-side illusion.
        await page
            .getByRole('combobox')
            .filter({ hasText: 'All results' })
            .click();
        await page.getByRole('option', { name: 'Fail' }).click();
        await expect(
            page.getByText('No control tests match these filters.'),
        ).toBeVisible();
    });
});

==================== ./e2e/cycle-release.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Cycle release (UI-05)', () => {
    test('release a cycle as compliant', async ({ page, request }) => {
        const token = await mintDemoApiToken(request);
        const deviceId = await createDemoDevice(request, token);
        const cycleId = await createDemoCycle(request, token, deviceId);
        await addDemoCycleItem(request, token, cycleId, 'Scaler kit, pouch 1');
        await completeDemoCycle(request, token, cycleId);

            page.getByText(`Cycle #1 released as compliant.`),

            page.getByText('Compliant', { exact: true }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        // A released cycle is terminal — no more decision to make.
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Release as compliant' }),
        ).toHaveCount(0);
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reject cycle' }),
        ).toHaveCount(0);
    });

    test('reject a cycle with a required reason', async ({
        page,
        request,
    }) => {
        const token = await mintDemoApiToken(request);
        const deviceId = await createDemoDevice(request, token);
        const cycleId = await createDemoCycle(request, token, deviceId);
        await addDemoCycleItem(request, token, cycleId, 'Scaler kit, pouch 1');
        await completeDemoCycle(request, token, cycleId);
        await submitDemoCycleForRelease(request, token, cycleId);

        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);
        await page.goto(`/cycles/${cycleId}`);

        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reject cycle' }).click();

        // The dialog's own submit button is disabled until a reason is typed.
        const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        const submitButton = dialog.getByRole('button', {
            name: 'Reject cycle',
        });
        await expect(submitButton).toBeDisabled();

        await page
            .getByLabel('Reason')
            .fill('Bowie-Dick control test failed.');
        await expect(submitButton).toBeEnabled();
        await submitButton.click();

        await expect(page.getByText(`Cycle #1 rejected.`)).toBeVisible();
        // "Rejected" also appears inside the timeline's terminal station
        // label ("Released / Rejected") — the release decision Card's own
        // badge is the last match in DOM order, since the timeline renders
        // above it.
        await expect(page.getByText('Rejected').last()).toBeVisible();
        await expect(
            page.getByText('Bowie-Dick control test failed.', {
                exact: false,
            }),
        ).toBeVisible();
    });
});


==================== ./e2e/cycle-workflow.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';
import { createDemoDevice, mintDemoApiToken } from './support/demo';

test.describe('Cycle workflow (UI-03)', () => {
    test('create a cycle, build the load, and run it through to awaiting release', async ({
        page,
        request,
    }) => {
        const token = await mintDemoApiToken(request);
        await createDemoDevice(request, token);

        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);
        await page.goto('/cycles');

        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'New cycle' }).click();
        await page.getByLabel('Device').click();
        await page
            .getByRole('option', { name: /E2E Autoclave/ })
            .first()
            .click();
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create cycle' }).click();

        // Redirected to the new cycle's detail page, in draft. "Draft" also
        // labels a station on the timeline further down the page — the
        // status badge (the first match, right next to the heading) is
        // what's actually under test here.
        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/cycles\/[0-9a-f-]+$/);
        await expect(
            page.getByText('Draft', { exact: true }).first(),
        ).toBeVisible();

        // Starting an empty load is blocked, with a real reason shown.
        const startButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Start cycle' });
        await expect(startButton).toBeDisabled();

        // Build the load.
        await page
            .getByLabel('New item description')
            .fill('Scaler kit, pouch 1');
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add item' }).click();
        await expect(page.getByText('Scaler kit, pouch 1')).toBeVisible();

        // Now the load is non-empty, so start is enabled.
        await expect(startButton).toBeEnabled();
        await startButton.click();
        await expect(
            page.getByText('Running', { exact: true }).first(),
        ).toBeVisible();
        await expect(
            page.getByText('Locked once the cycle is running.'),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await page
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Complete cycle — record result' })
            .click();
        await expect(
            page.getByText('Completed', { exact: true }).first(),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit for release' }).click();
        await expect(
            page.getByText('Pending release', { exact: true }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        // No further operator action once awaiting release — that's UI-05's territory.
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Start cycle' }),
        ).toHaveCount(0);
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit for release' }),
        ).toHaveCount(0);
    });
});


==================== ./e2e/cycles.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';
import {
    createDemoCycle,
    createDemoDevice,
    mintDemoApiToken,
} from './support/demo';

test.describe('Cycles list (UI-01)', () => {
    test('shows a seeded cycle with its status, and a status filter narrows the list', async ({
        page,
        request,
    }) => {
        // Fixture data via the real API — there's no browser-based "start a
        // cycle" screen yet (UI-03), so this is the only honest way to get
        // a real cycle in front of the list under test.
        const token = await mintDemoApiToken(request);
        const deviceId = await createDemoDevice(request, token);
        await createDemoCycle(request, token, deviceId);

        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);
        // Pre-scoped to this test's own freshly-created device via the URL
        // (which only ever has one draft cycle) — the demo tenant is a
        // persistent, shared fixture that has accumulated dozens of "E2E
        // Autoclave" devices and even rejected cycles from other spec runs
        // (e.g. UI-05's release flow), so "no cycles match" can no longer be
        // assumed tenant-wide. The status combobox below is still driven
        // through the real UI — that's the actual feature under test.
        await page.goto(`/cycles?filter%5Bdevice_id%5D=${deviceId}`);

        await expect(
            page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Cycles' }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        const row = page.getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: 'Draft' }).first();
        await expect(row).toBeVisible();
        await expect(row.getByText('Draft')).toBeVisible();

        // Filtering to a status with no matches (within this device) proves
        // the filter really reaches the server (spatie/laravel-query-
        // builder's filter[...] bucket), not just a client-side illusion.
        await page
            .getByRole('combobox')
            .filter({ hasText: 'All statuses' })
            .click();
        await page.getByRole('option', { name: 'Rejected' }).click();
        await expect(page).toHaveURL(
            /filter%5Bstatus%5D=rejected|filter\[status\]=rejected/,
        );
        await expect(
            page.getByText('No cycles match these filters.'),
        ).toBeVisible();

        // Switching back to the status our seeded cycle actually has.
        await page
            .getByRole('combobox')
            .filter({ hasText: 'Rejected' })
            .click();
        await page.getByRole('option', { name: 'Draft' }).click();
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: 'Draft' }).first(),
        ).toBeVisible();
    });

    test('a nav item without permission is never rendered, but the Cycles link works', async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);

        await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Cycles' })).toBeVisible();
        await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Cycles' }).click();
        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/cycles$/);
    });
});

==================== ./e2e/data-exports.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';

/**
 * Data export (UI-29) — the most sensitive artifact the product can emit.
 * The demo tenant is shared and persistent across runs, and requests are
 * rate-limited (one in flight, a weekly cap) — this spec only requests a
 * fresh export when none is already running, same tolerance-for-prior-runs
 * approach as other specs against this shared fixture.
 */
test.describe('Data export (UI-29)', () => {
    test('an owner requests an export, watches it complete, and inspects its contents', async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);
        await page.goto('/data-exports');
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Data export' }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        const requestButton = page.getByRole('button', {
            name: 'Request export',
        });

        if (await requestButton.isEnabled()) {
            await requestButton.click();
            const confirmDialog = page.getByRole('alertdialog');
            await expect(
                confirmDialog.getByText('Request a full data export?'),
            ).toBeVisible();
            await confirmDialog
                .getByRole('button', { name: 'Request export' })
                .click();
            await expect(
                page.getByText(/Export requested\./),
            ).toBeVisible();
        }

        // The real Horizon worker in this environment actually processes
        // the job — poll for it to reach Ready like a real user would.
        const readyRow = page
            .getByRole('row')
            .filter({ has: page.getByText('Ready') })
            .first();
        await expect(readyRow).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 });

        await readyRow.getByRole('button', { name: 'View contents' }).click();
        const manifestDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await expect(
            manifestDialog.getByText("What's inside this export"),
        ).toBeVisible();
        await expect(manifestDialog.getByText('Total size')).toBeVisible();
        await expect(
            manifestDialog.getByRole('row').nth(1),
        ).toBeVisible();
        await page.keyboard.press('Escape');

        const [downloadResponse] = await Promise.all([
            page.waitForResponse(
                (response) =>
                    response.url().includes('/download') &&
                    response.request().method() === 'POST',
            ),
            readyRow.getByRole('button', { name: 'Download' }).click(),
        ]);
        expect(downloadResponse.ok()).toBeTruthy();
        const body = await downloadResponse.json();
        expect(body.download_url).toContain('data-exports/');
        expect(body.url_expires_at).toBeTruthy();
    });
});


==================== ./e2e/device-maintenance.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';

test.describe('Device maintenance (UI-10)', () => {
    test('record maintenance with a past next-due date, and see it surfaced as overdue', async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);
        await page.goto('/devices');

        const deviceName = `E2E Maintenance Device ${Date.now()}`;
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'New device' }).click();
        const newDeviceDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await newDeviceDialog.getByLabel('Site').click();
        await page.getByRole('option').first().click();
        await newDeviceDialog.getByLabel('Name').fill(deviceName);
        await newDeviceDialog
            .getByLabel('Serial number')
            .fill(`E2E-MAINT-${Date.now()}`);
        await newDeviceDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Add device' })
            .click();
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('heading', { name: deviceName }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await expect(
            page.getByText('No maintenance has been recorded for this device yet.'),
        ).toBeVisible();

        // Performed 60 days ago, was due for a follow-up 1 day ago but
        // hasn't happened yet — the device header should surface this as
        // overdue immediately after recording. next_due_at must be after
        // performed_at (a real validation rule), so both are backdated.
        const performedAt = new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
            .toISOString()
            .slice(0, 16);
        const pastDue = new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
            .toISOString()
            .slice(0, 16);

        await page.getByLabel('Technician').fill('Jane Tech');
        await page.getByLabel('Performed at').fill(performedAt);
        await page.getByLabel('Next due (optional)').fill(pastDue);
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Record maintenance' }).click();

        await expect(page.getByText('Maintenance recorded.')).toBeVisible();
        // Scoped to the history row — the record form's own Kind select
        // still shows "Preventive" as its default value, which would
        // otherwise collide with a bare page-wide getByText.
        const row = page.getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: 'Jane Tech' });
        await expect(row).toBeVisible();
        await expect(row.getByText('Preventive')).toBeVisible();
        await expect(page.getByText(/Overdue since/)).toBeVisible();
    });
});

==================== ./e2e/evidence-dossier.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';
import {
    addDemoCycleItem,
    completeDemoCycle,
    createDemoCycle,
    createDemoDevice,
    createDemoDluRule,
    generateDemoLabels,
    mintDemoApiToken,
    printDemoLabel,
    releaseDemoCycleAsCompliant,
    submitDemoCycleForRelease,
} from './support/demo';

/**
 * Evidence dossier + exports (UI-22). The dossier PDF is inline (same
 * pattern as the label PDF, UI-06/07) — one link is both the preview and
 * the download. Exports reuse the exact same EvidenceExport the mobile
 * API downloads.
 */
test.describe('Evidence dossier + exports (UI-22)', () => {
    test('a printed but unused label has no dossier link; after linking a procedure, the dossier opens', async ({
        page,
        request,
    }) => {
        const token = await mintDemoApiToken(request);
        const deviceId = await createDemoDevice(request, token);
        const cycleId = await createDemoCycle(request, token, deviceId);
        await addDemoCycleItem(request, token, cycleId, 'Scaler kit, pouch 1');
        await completeDemoCycle(request, token, cycleId);
        await submitDemoCycleForRelease(request, token, cycleId);
        await releaseDemoCycleAsCompliant(request, token, cycleId);
        await createDemoDluRule(request, token, 'Sachet', 'Armoire', 180);
        const [labelId] = await generateDemoLabels(
            request,
            token,
            cycleId,
            'Sachet',
            'Armoire',
        );
        await printDemoLabel(request, token, labelId);

        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);

        await page.goto(`/labels/${labelId}`);
        await expect(
            page.getByText('Point-of-care usage'),
        ).toBeVisible();
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Evidence dossier' }),
        ).not.toBeVisible();

        const patientCreate = await request.post('/api/v1/patients', {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
            },
            data: {},
        });
        const patient = await patientCreate.json();

        await page.getByLabel('Patient', { exact: true }).click();
        await page.keyboard.type(patient.reference);
        await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
        await page.getByLabel('Practitioner', { exact: true }).click();
        await page.keyboard.type('Admin');
        await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
        await page.getByLabel('Procedure').fill('Détartrage');
        await page
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Link label to procedure' })
            .click();
        await expect(page.getByText('Label linked to procedure.')).toBeVisible();

        const dossierLink = page.getByRole('link', {
            name: 'Evidence dossier',
        });
        await expect(dossierLink).toBeVisible();
        const dossierHref = await dossierLink.getAttribute('href');
        expect(dossierHref).toContain(`/labels/${labelId}/usage/dossier`);

        // Headless Chromium's PDF viewer isn't reliably introspectable as
        // a popup page — verify the link actually resolves instead.
        const dossierResponse = await page.request.get(dossierHref!);
        expect(dossierResponse.ok()).toBeTruthy();
        expect(dossierResponse.headers()['content-type']).toContain(
            'application/pdf',
        );
    });

    test('evidence search exports CSV and XLSX for a user with exports.manage', async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);
        await page.goto('/evidence-search');
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Evidence search' }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        const [csvDownload] = await Promise.all([
            page.waitForEvent('download'),
            page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Export CSV' }).click(),
        ]);
        expect(csvDownload.suggestedFilename()).toBe('evidence-export.csv');

        const [xlsxDownload] = await Promise.all([
            page.waitForEvent('download'),
            page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Export XLSX' }).click(),
        ]);
        expect(xlsxDownload.suggestedFilename()).toBe('evidence-export.xlsx');
    });
});


==================== ./e2e/evidence-search.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';
import {
    addDemoCycleItem,
    completeDemoCycle,
    createDemoCycle,
    createDemoDevice,
    createDemoDluRule,
    generateDemoLabels,
    mintDemoApiToken,
    printDemoLabel,
    releaseDemoCycleAsCompliant,
    submitDemoCycleForRelease,
} from './support/demo';

/**
 * Evidence search (UI-21, REC-09) — reuses SearchEvidenceAction exactly
 * as the mobile API does. Builds a full pouch -> cycle -> device ->
 * practitioner -> procedure -> patient chain via the API, then finds it
 * by each filter dimension on the web: patient, cycle, batch, device,
 * operator, period.
 */
test.describe('Evidence search (UI-21)', () => {
    test('find a full evidence chain by patient reference, then narrow by cycle and operator', async ({
        page,
        request,
    }) => {
        const token = await mintDemoApiToken(request);
        const deviceId = await createDemoDevice(request, token);
        const cycleId = await createDemoCycle(request, token, deviceId);
        await addDemoCycleItem(request, token, cycleId, 'Scaler kit, pouch 1');
        await completeDemoCycle(request, token, cycleId);
        await submitDemoCycleForRelease(request, token, cycleId);
        await releaseDemoCycleAsCompliant(request, token, cycleId);
        await createDemoDluRule(request, token, 'Sachet', 'Armoire', 180);
        const [labelId] = await generateDemoLabels(
            request,
            token,
            cycleId,
            'Sachet',
            'Armoire',
        );
        await printDemoLabel(request, token, labelId);
        // The scan resolution endpoint — transitions printed -> used.
        await request.get(`/api/v1/labels/${labelId}`, {
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        });

        const me = await request.get('/api/v1/me', {
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        });
        const operatorId = (await me.json()).user.id as string;

        const patientCreate = await request.post('/api/v1/patients', {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
            },
            data: {},
        });
        const patient = await patientCreate.json();

        const procedure = `E2E Evidence Procedure ${Date.now()}`;
        await request.post(`/api/v1/labels/${labelId}/usage`, {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
            },
            data: {
                patient_id: patient.id,
                practitioner_id: operatorId,
                procedure,
            },
        });

        const cycleResponse = await request.get(
            `/api/v1/cycles/${cycleId}`,
            { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } },
        );
        const cycleNumber = (await cycleResponse.json()).cycle_number as number;

        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);

        // The nav item used to be a disabled "Soon" stub.
        await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Evidence search' }).click();
        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/evidence-search$/);
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Evidence search' }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await page
            .getByLabel('Patient reference')
            .fill(patient.reference);
        const row = page.getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: procedure });
        await expect(row).toBeVisible();
        await expect(row.getByText(patient.reference)).toBeVisible();
        await expect(row.getByText(`#${cycleNumber}`)).toBeVisible();

        // Narrowing further, by cycle number, still finds it.
        await page.getByLabel('Patient reference').fill('');
        await page.getByLabel('Cycle number').fill(String(cycleNumber));
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: procedure }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        // A cycle number with no match returns the honest empty state.
        await page.getByLabel('Cycle number').fill('999999');
        await expect(
            page.getByText('No evidence matches these filters.'),
        ).toBeVisible();
    });
});

/**

==================== ./e2e/label-usages.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';
import {
    addDemoCycleItem,
    completeDemoCycle,
    createDemoCycle,
    createDemoDevice,
    createDemoDluRule,
    generateDemoLabels,
    mintDemoApiToken,
    printDemoLabel,
    releaseDemoCycleAsCompliant,
    submitDemoCycleForRelease,
} from './support/demo';

/**
 * The web fallback for the mobile scan (UI-20) — a desk without a camera
 * links a PRINTED (not yet scanned) label straight from its detail page.
 * Submitting the form performs the scan resolution itself (same
 * ResolveLabelScanAction a real scan runs), so the label goes
 * printed -> used in the same request that records the usage.
 */
test.describe('Label usages — web fallback for the scan (UI-20)', () => {
    test('link a printed label to a patient and procedure directly from its detail page', async ({
        page,
        request,
    }) => {
        const token = await mintDemoApiToken(request);
        const deviceId = await createDemoDevice(request, token);
        const cycleId = await createDemoCycle(request, token, deviceId);
        await addDemoCycleItem(request, token, cycleId, 'Scaler kit, pouch 1');
        await completeDemoCycle(request, token, cycleId);
        await submitDemoCycleForRelease(request, token, cycleId);
        await releaseDemoCycleAsCompliant(request, token, cycleId);
        await createDemoDluRule(request, token, 'Sachet', 'Armoire', 180);
        const [labelId] = await generateDemoLabels(
            request,
            token,
            cycleId,
            'Sachet',
            'Armoire',
        );
        await printDemoLabel(request, token, labelId);
        // Created explicitly rather than relying on another spec having
        // left one behind — this spec must be able to run standalone
        // against a genuinely fresh demo tenant.
        const patientCreate = await request.post('/api/v1/patients', {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
            },
            data: {},
        });
        const patientReference = (await patientCreate.json())
            .reference as string;

        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);

        await page.goto(`/labels/${labelId}`);
        await expect(
            page.getByText('Point-of-care usage'),
        ).toBeVisible();

        // Radix's built-in typeahead jumps to the matching option — more
        // reliable than clicking a specific option in a long, possibly
        // off-screen list.
        await page.getByLabel('Patient', { exact: true }).click();
        await page.keyboard.type(patientReference);
        await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
        await page.getByLabel('Practitioner', { exact: true }).click();
        await page.keyboard.type('Admin');
        await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
        const procedure = `E2E Procedure ${Date.now()}`;
        await page.getByLabel('Procedure').fill(procedure);
        await page
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Link label to procedure' })
            .click();

        await expect(page.getByText('Label linked to procedure.')).toBeVisible();
        await expect(page.getByText(procedure)).toBeVisible();
        await expect(page.getByText('Used', { exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible();
    });
});

==================== ./e2e/non-conformities.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';
import {
    addDemoCycleItem,
    completeDemoCycle,
    createDemoCycle,
    createDemoDevice,
    createDemoDluRule,
    generateDemoLabels,
    mintDemoApiToken,
    printDemoLabel,
    releaseDemoCycleAsCompliant,
    submitDemoCycleForRelease,
} from './support/demo';

/**
 * Non-conformities + recall (UI-23) — the confirm dialog must show the
 * blast radius (how many labels/batches) BEFORE the user confirms,
 * computed by the same RaiseNonConformityAction the confirm button then
 * executes, so it can never overstate or understate what actually happens.
 */
test.describe('Non-conformities + recall (UI-23)', () => {
    test('recalling a cycle shows the blast radius, then recalls its label and quarantines its batch', async ({
        page,
        request,
    }) => {
        const token = await mintDemoApiToken(request);
        const deviceId = await createDemoDevice(request, token);
        const cycleId = await createDemoCycle(request, token, deviceId);
        await addDemoCycleItem(request, token, cycleId, 'Scaler kit, pouch 1');
        await completeDemoCycle(request, token, cycleId);
        await submitDemoCycleForRelease(request, token, cycleId);
        await releaseDemoCycleAsCompliant(request, token, cycleId);
        await createDemoDluRule(request, token, 'Sachet', 'Armoire', 180);
        const [labelId] = await generateDemoLabels(
            request,
            token,
            cycleId,
            'Sachet',
            'Armoire',
        );
        await printDemoLabel(request, token, labelId);

        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);

        await page.goto(`/cycles/${cycleId}`);
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Recall cycle' }).click();

        // The demo cycle item has no batch attached, so only the label
        // count is non-zero here.
        const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await expect(dialog.getByText('1 label').first()).toBeVisible();
        await expect(dialog.getByText('0 batches').first()).toBeVisible();

        await dialog
            .getByLabel('Reason')
            .fill('Discovered a mis-calibrated sensor after the fact.');
        await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Recall 1 label' }).click();

        await expect(page.getByText('Non-conformity raised.')).toBeVisible();

        // The label is now recalled — the label detail page reflects it.
        await page.goto(`/labels/${labelId}`);
        await expect(page.getByText('Recalled', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

        // The non-conformity is logged, tenant-wide.
        await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Non-conformities' }).click();
        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/non-conformities$/);
        // The demo tenant is a persistent, shared fixture — prior runs of
        // this same spec leave their own rows behind, sorted newest-first,
        // so the row this test just created is always the first match.
        const row = page
            .getByRole('row')
            .filter({ hasText: 'Discovered a mis-calibrated sensor' })
            .first();
        await expect(row).toBeVisible();
        await expect(row.getByText('Open', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

        // Resolving it closes the record without un-recalling anything.
        await row.getByRole('button', { name: 'Resolve' }).click();
        const resolveDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await resolveDialog
            .getByLabel('Resolution')
            .fill('Re-tested the device; sensor now reads correctly.');
        await resolveDialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Resolve' }).click();
        await expect(page.getByText('Non-conformity resolved.')).toBeVisible();
        await expect(row.getByText('Resolved', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    });
});


==================== ./e2e/patients.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';
import {
    addDemoCycleItem,
    completeDemoCycle,
    createDemoCycle,
    createDemoDevice,
    createDemoDluRule,
    generateDemoLabels,
    mintDemoApiToken,
    printDemoLabel,
    releaseDemoCycleAsCompliant,
    submitDemoCycleForRelease,
} from './support/demo';

/**
 * Patients are pseudonymous references only (CLAUDE.md) — CreatePatientAction
 * takes no input at all, so "New patient" is a one-click confirm, not a
 * form. Linking a label to a procedure (UI-20) has no web UI yet, so the
 * usage fixture here is built the same way a real practitioner's phone
 * would after scanning: run a cycle through to released+compliant, print
 * a label, scan it (GET, the resolution endpoint transitions
 * printed -> used), then record the usage — all via the mobile API.
 */
test.describe('Patients (UI-19)', () => {
    test('create a patient, then see a linked procedure in its history, then archive it', async ({
        page,
        request,
    }) => {
        const token = await mintDemoApiToken(request);
        const deviceId = await createDemoDevice(request, token);
        const cycleId = await createDemoCycle(request, token, deviceId);
        await addDemoCycleItem(request, token, cycleId, 'Scaler kit, pouch 1');
        await completeDemoCycle(request, token, cycleId);
        await submitDemoCycleForRelease(request, token, cycleId);
        await releaseDemoCycleAsCompliant(request, token, cycleId);

        const packagingType = 'Sachet';
        const storageCondition = 'Armoire';
        await createDemoDluRule(request, token, packagingType, storageCondition, 180);
        const [labelId] = await generateDemoLabels(
            request,
            token,
            cycleId,
            packagingType,
            storageCondition,
        );
        await printDemoLabel(request, token, labelId);
        // The scan resolution endpoint — transitions printed -> used.
        await request.get(`/api/v1/labels/${labelId}`, {
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        });

        const me = await request.get('/api/v1/me', {
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        });
        const practitionerId = (await me.json()).user.id as string;

        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);

        // The nav item used to be a disabled "Soon" stub.
        await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Patients' }).click();
        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/patients$/);
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Patients' }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'New patient' }).click();
        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/patients\/[0-9a-f-]+$/);
        await expect(
            page.getByText('No procedures recorded yet', { exact: false }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        const patientId = page.url().split('/').pop() as string;

        const procedure = `E2E Procedure ${Date.now()}`;
        await request.post(`/api/v1/labels/${labelId}/usage`, {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
            },
            data: {
                patient_id: patientId,
                practitioner_id: practitionerId,
                procedure,
            },
        });

        await page.reload();
        await expect(page.getByText(procedure)).toBeVisible();
        await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: 'View label' })).toBeVisible();

        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Archive patient' }).click();
        await page
            .getByRole('alertdialog')
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Archive patient' })
            .click();
        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/patients$/);
        await expect(page.getByText('archived', { exact: false })).toBeVisible();
    });
});


==================== ./e2e/practice-settings.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';

/**
 * Practice settings (UI-28) — one page, four sections. Owner-only sections
 * (label format, DLU rule table) are evidence-affecting and versioned;
 * identity and alerts are plain audited updates. Everything here is
 * driven through the UI itself — there's no API to pre-seed fixtures
 * with for most of this (practice identity/label format/alerts are
 * web-only settings).
 */
test.describe('Practice settings (UI-28)', () => {
    test('an owner updates identity, label format, a DLU rule, and alert settings', async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);
        await page.goto('/practice-settings');

        // Identity section.
        await page.getByLabel('Legal name (optional)').fill('Cabinet Demo SARL');
        await page.getByLabel('City').fill('Lyon');
        await page
            .getByLabel('Reason', { exact: true })
            .first()
            .fill('Correcting the legal name.');
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save identity' }).click();
        await expect(
            page.getByText('Practice identity updated.'),
        ).toBeVisible();

        // Label format section — confirm dialog shows the consequence and
        // requires its own reason. The demo tenant is shared across runs,
        // so pick whichever option isn't already selected rather than a
        // fixed one, or the "Save changes" button never becomes enabled.
        await page.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Label format' }).click();
        const primaryCodeField = page.getByLabel('Primary code');
        const currentPrimaryCode = await primaryCodeField.textContent();
        const nextPrimaryCode = currentPrimaryCode?.trim() === 'QR' ? 'DataMatrix' : 'QR';
        await primaryCodeField.click();
        await page.getByRole('option', { name: nextPrimaryCode }).click();
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }).click();
        const formatDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await expect(
            formatDialog.getByText('Save the new label format?'),
        ).toBeVisible();
        await formatDialog
            .getByLabel('Reason')
            .fill('Practice prefers QR as primary.');
        await formatDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Save label format' })
            .click();
        await expect(
            page.getByText(
                'Label format updated. Applies to labels printed from now on.',
            ),
        ).toBeVisible();

        // DLU rule table section — add then edit a rule, both requiring a
        // reason, and the edit dialog states the never-retroactive rule.
        await page.getByRole('tab', { name: 'DLU rule table' }).click();
        const packagingType = `E2E Pouch ${Date.now()}`;
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add rule' }).click();
        const addRuleDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await addRuleDialog
            .getByLabel('Packaging type')
            .fill(packagingType);
        await addRuleDialog
            .getByLabel('Storage condition')
            .fill('Armoire fermée');
        await addRuleDialog.getByLabel('Shelf life (days)').fill('180');
        await addRuleDialog
            .getByLabel('Reason')
            .fill('EN 868 starting point for pouches.');
        await addRuleDialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add rule' }).click();

        const ruleRow = page.getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: packagingType });
        await expect(ruleRow).toBeVisible();
        await expect(ruleRow.getByText('180 days')).toBeVisible();

        await ruleRow.getByRole('button', { name: /^Edit/ }).click();
        const editRuleDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await expect(
            editRuleDialog.getByText('No labels have used this rule yet.'),
        ).toBeVisible();
        await editRuleDialog.getByLabel('Shelf life (days)').fill('365');
        await editRuleDialog
            .getByLabel('Reason')
            .fill('Extended after review.');
        await editRuleDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' })
            .click();
        await expect(ruleRow.getByText('365 days')).toBeVisible();

        // Alerts & notifications section.
        await page.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Alerts & notifications' }).click();
        await page.getByLabel('Near-expiry window (days)').fill('45');
        await page
            .getByLabel('Reason', { exact: true })
            .first()
            .fill('Practice wants more lead time.');
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save thresholds' }).click();
        await expect(page.getByText('Alert settings updated.')).toBeVisible();
    });
});

test.describe('Products (UI-11)', () => {
    test('the Products nav link works; add a category, add a product, view it, edit it, then delete it', async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);

        // The nav item used to be a disabled "Soon" stub — this proves it
        // now links to a real, working screen.
        await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Products' }).click();
        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/products$/);

        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'New category' }).click();
        const categoryDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await categoryDialog.getByLabel('Name').fill(categoryName);
        await categoryDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Add category' })
            .click();
        await expect(
            page.getByText(`Category "${categoryName}" created.`),
        ).toBeVisible();

        const productName = `E2E Product ${Date.now()}`;
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'New product' }).click();
        const productDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await productDialog.getByLabel('Name').fill(productName);
        await productDialog
            .getByLabel('Reference')
            .fill(`E2E-SKU-${Date.now()}`);
        await productDialog.getByLabel('Category').click();

            .getByRole('option', { name: categoryName, exact: true })
            .click();
        await productDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Add product' })
            .click();

        await expect(
            page.getByText(`Product "${productName}" created.`),
        ).toBeVisible();
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('heading', { name: productName }),
        ).toBeVisible();
        // exact: true — an earlier "Category ... created." toast may still
        // be lingering on screen and also contains this substring.
        await expect(
            page.getByText(categoryName, { exact: true }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit' }).click();
        const editDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await editDialog.getByLabel('Unit').fill('box');
        await editDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' })
            .click();
        await expect(page.getByText('Product updated.')).toBeVisible();
        await expect(editDialog).not.toBeVisible();
        await expect(page.getByText('box', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete' }).click();
        const deleteDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await deleteDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete product' })
            .click();

            .getByRole('option', { name: supplierName, exact: true })

            .getByRole('option', { name: productName, exact: true })
            .click();
        await page.getByLabel(/Quantity for line 1/).fill('50');
        await page.getByLabel(/Unit price for line 1/).fill('12.50');
        await page
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Create purchase order' })
            .click();

        await expect(

        ).toBeVisible();

            page.getByRole('heading', { name: supplierName }),

==================== ./e2e/quarantine.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';
import {
    completeDemoCycle,
    createDemoCycle,
    createDemoDevice,
    createDemoDluRule,
    generateDemoLabels,
    mintDemoApiToken,
    printDemoLabel,
    releaseDemoCycleAsCompliant,
    submitDemoCycleForRelease,
} from './support/demo';

/**
 * Quarantine (UI-24) — read-only. The only writer is
 * RaiseNonConformityAction (UI-23's recall flow), so this fixture goes
 * through the real web recall flow rather than setting Batch::status
 * directly. A batch only gets quarantined as a side effect of recalling
 * a label that actually references it, so this builds a full
 * receive -> cycle item (with that batch) -> release -> label chain,
 * not just a bare cycle item.
 */
test.describe('Quarantine (UI-24)', () => {
    test('recalling a cycle with a batch surfaces it in the quarantine list with who, why, and when', async ({
        page,
        request,
    }) => {
        const token = await mintDemoApiToken(request);
        const deviceId = await createDemoDevice(request, token);
        const cycleId = await createDemoCycle(request, token, deviceId);

        const existingLevels = await request.get('/api/v1/stock-levels', {
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        });
        const locationId = (await existingLevels.json()).data[0]
            .location_id as string;
        const productName = `E2E Quarantine Product ${Date.now()}`;
        const productCreate = await request.post('/api/v1/products', {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
            },
            data: { name: productName, reference: `E2E-QRT-${Date.now()}` },
        });
        const productId = (await productCreate.json()).id as string;
        const supplierCreate = await request.post('/api/v1/suppliers', {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
            },
            data: { name: `E2E Quarantine Supplier ${Date.now()}` },
        });
        const supplierId = (await supplierCreate.json()).id as string;
        const poCreate = await request.post('/api/v1/purchase-orders', {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
            },
            data: {
                supplier_id: supplierId,
                lines: [{ product_id: productId, qty_ordered: 5 }],
            },
        });
        const po = await poCreate.json();
        await request.post(`/api/v1/purchase-orders/${po.id}/order`, {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
            },
            data: {},
        });
        const batchNumber = `E2E-QRT-BATCH-${Date.now()}`;
        const receiptCreate = await request.post(
            `/api/v1/purchase-orders/${po.id}/receipts`,
            {
                headers: {
                    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                    'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
                },
                data: {
                    location_id: locationId,
                    lines: [
                        {
                            purchase_order_line_id: po.lines[0].id,
                            batch_number: batchNumber,
                            qty: 5,
                        },
                    ],
                },
            },
        );
        const batchId = (await receiptCreate.json()).lines[0]
            .batch_id as string;

        await request.post(`/api/v1/cycles/${cycleId}/items`, {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
            },
            data: { description: 'Kit with batch', batch_id: batchId },
        });

        await completeDemoCycle(request, token, cycleId);
        await submitDemoCycleForRelease(request, token, cycleId);
        await releaseDemoCycleAsCompliant(request, token, cycleId);
        await createDemoDluRule(request, token, 'Sachet', 'Armoire', 180);
        const [labelId] = await generateDemoLabels(
            request,
            token,
            cycleId,
            'Sachet',
            'Armoire',
        );
        await printDemoLabel(request, token, labelId);

        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);

        const reason = `E2E recall reason ${Date.now()}`;
        await page.goto(`/cycles/${cycleId}`);
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Recall cycle' }).click();
        const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await dialog.getByLabel('Reason').fill(reason);
        await dialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: /Recall \d|Raise non-conformity/ })
            .click();
        await expect(page.getByText('Non-conformity raised.')).toBeVisible();

        await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Quarantine' }).click();
        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/quarantine$/);
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Quarantine' }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        const row = page.getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: batchNumber });
        await expect(row).toBeVisible();
        await expect(row.getByText(productName)).toBeVisible();
        await expect(row.getByText(reason)).toBeVisible();
        await expect(row.getByText('Admin', { exact: false })).toBeVisible();
    });
});


==================== ./e2e/sites.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';

/**
 * Sites, rooms, storage locations (UI-27) — the tenant -> sites -> rooms ->
 * storage_locations hierarchy every other domain hangs off. Everything is
 * driven through the UI itself (unlike most other specs, there's no mobile
 * API to pre-seed fixtures with — Sites has no API create route at all,
 * by design: it's an admin-only web settings screen).
 */
test.describe('Sites, rooms, storage locations (UI-27)', () => {
    test('create a site, add a room and a location, then archive the location and the room', async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);

        const siteName = `E2E Site ${Date.now()}`;
        await page.goto('/sites');
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'New site' }).click();
        const newSiteDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await newSiteDialog.getByLabel('Name').fill(siteName);
        await newSiteDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Add site' })
            .click();

        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/sites\/[0-9a-f-]+$/);
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('heading', { name: siteName }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add room' }).click();
        const newRoomDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await newRoomDialog.getByLabel('Name').fill('Sterilization room');
        await newRoomDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Add room' })
            .click();

        const roomSection = page.getByRole('region', {
            name: 'Room: Sterilization room',
        });
        await expect(roomSection).toBeVisible();

        await roomSection.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add location' }).click();
        const newLocationDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await newLocationDialog.getByLabel('Name').fill('Cupboard A');
        await newLocationDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Add and add another' })
            .click();
        // The dialog stays open (for adding several in a row) and hides
        // the rest of the page from the accessibility tree while it's up.
        await expect(
            newLocationDialog.getByRole('button', {
                name: 'Add and add another',
            }),
        ).toBeDisabled();
        await newLocationDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Finish' })
            .click();

        const locationItem = page.getByRole('listitem', {
            name: 'Storage location: Cupboard A',
        });
        await expect(locationItem).toBeVisible();

        // Rename the location.
        await locationItem
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit Cupboard A' })
            .click();
        const editLocationDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await editLocationDialog.getByLabel('Name').fill('Cupboard B');
        await editLocationDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' })
            .click();

        const renamedLocationItem = page.getByRole('listitem', {
            name: 'Storage location: Cupboard B',
        });
        await expect(renamedLocationItem).toBeVisible();

        // Archiving requires a reason and states the consequence.
        await renamedLocationItem
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Archive Cupboard B' })
            .click();
        const archiveLocationDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await expect(
            archiveLocationDialog.getByText('Archive Cupboard B?'),
        ).toBeVisible();
        await archiveLocationDialog
            .getByLabel('Reason')
            .fill('No longer used.');
        await archiveLocationDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Archive location' })
            .click();

        await expect(renamedLocationItem).toHaveCount(0);
        await expect(
            roomSection.getByText('No storage locations in this room yet.'),
        ).toBeVisible();

        // Archiving the room states the (now zero) cascade count.
        await roomSection
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Archive Sterilization room' })
            .click();
        const archiveRoomDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await expect(
            archiveRoomDialog.getByText(
                'This room has no storage locations under it.',
            ),
        ).toBeVisible();
        await archiveRoomDialog.getByLabel('Reason').fill('Room repurposed.');
        await archiveRoomDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Archive room' })
            .click();

        await expect(roomSection).toHaveCount(0);
        await expect(
            page.getByText(
                'No rooms yet — add one to start placing storage locations.',
            ),
        ).toBeVisible();

        // Back on the index, the site is still there (archiving a room
        // doesn't archive the site itself).
        await page.goto('/sites');
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: siteName }),
        ).toBeVisible();
    });
});


==================== ./e2e/stock.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';
import { mintDemoApiToken } from './support/demo';

/**
 * Stock levels + the movement ledger (UI-16) are both read-only — there's
 * no web form to issue/transfer/adjust stock (mobile-only for now), so
 * this fixture is built the same way a real receipt + issue would happen:
 * through the mobile API, exactly like a real client would call it.
 * There's no API to create a storage location either (same gap UI-14/15
 * already flagged), so this reuses whichever location the demo tenant's
 * prior stock already sits at.
 */
test.describe('Stock levels + movement ledger (UI-16)', () => {
    test('receive stock, then issue some of it, and see both reflected on the web', async ({
        page,
        request,
    }) => {
        const token = await mintDemoApiToken(request);

        const existingLevels = await request.get('/api/v1/stock-levels', {
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        });
        const locationId = (await existingLevels.json()).data[0]
            .location_id as string;

        const productName = `E2E Stock Product ${Date.now()}`;
        const productCreate = await request.post('/api/v1/products', {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
            },
            data: { name: productName, reference: `E2E-STOCK-${Date.now()}` },
        });
        const productId = (await productCreate.json()).id as string;

        const supplierCreate = await request.post('/api/v1/suppliers', {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
            },
            data: { name: `E2E Stock Supplier ${Date.now()}` },
        });
        const supplierId = (await supplierCreate.json()).id as string;

        const poCreate = await request.post('/api/v1/purchase-orders', {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
            },
            data: {
                supplier_id: supplierId,
                lines: [{ product_id: productId, qty_ordered: 20 }],
            },
        });
        const po = await poCreate.json();
        const purchaseOrderId = po.id as string;
        const lineId = po.lines[0].id as string;

        await request.post(
            `/api/v1/purchase-orders/${purchaseOrderId}/order`,
            {
                headers: {
                    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                    'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
                },
                data: {},
            },
        );

        const batchNumber = `E2E-STOCK-BATCH-${Date.now()}`;
        const receiptCreate = await request.post(
            `/api/v1/purchase-orders/${purchaseOrderId}/receipts`,
            {
                headers: {
                    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                    'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
                },
                data: {
                    location_id: locationId,
                    lines: [
                        {
                            purchase_order_line_id: lineId,
                            batch_number: batchNumber,
                            qty: 20,
                        },
                    ],
                },
            },
        );
        const batchId = (await receiptCreate.json()).lines[0]
            .batch_id as string;

        const issueReason = `E2E issued at ${Date.now()}.`;
        await request.post('/api/v1/stock-movements/issue', {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
            },
            data: {
                batch_id: batchId,
                location_id: locationId,
                qty: 8,
                reason: issueReason,
            },
        });

        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);

        // The nav item used to be a disabled "Soon" stub.
        await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Stock' }).click();
        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/stock$/);
        await expect(
            page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Stock' }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await page
            .getByRole('combobox')
            .filter({ hasText: 'All products' })
            .click();
        await page
            .getByRole('option', { name: productName, exact: true })
            .click();

        const levelRow = page
            .getByRole('row')
            .filter({ hasText: batchNumber });
        await expect(levelRow).toBeVisible();
        await expect(
            levelRow.getByText('12', { exact: true }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Movement ledger' }).click();
        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/stock\/movements$/);
        await expect(
            page.getByText(
                'Append-only — every row here is permanent.',
                { exact: false },
            ),
        ).toBeVisible();

        const receiptRow = page
            .getByRole('row')
            .filter({ hasText: batchNumber })
            .filter({ hasText: 'Receipt' });
        await expect(receiptRow).toBeVisible();
        await expect(
            receiptRow.getByText('+20', { exact: true }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        const issueRow = page
            .getByRole('row')
            .filter({ hasText: issueReason });
        await expect(issueRow).toBeVisible();
        await expect(issueRow.getByText('-8', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
        await expect(
            issueRow.getByText('Issue', { exact: true }),
        ).toBeVisible();
    });
});

==================== ./e2e/support/auth.ts ====================

import type { Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { DEMO_EMAIL, DEMO_PASSWORD } from './demo';

export async function loginAsDemoOwner(page: Page): Promise<void> {
    await page.goto('/login');
    await page.locator('#email').fill(DEMO_EMAIL);
    await page.locator('#password').fill(DEMO_PASSWORD);
    await page.locator('[data-test="login-button"]').click();
    await page.waitForURL('**/dashboard');
}


==================== ./e2e/support/demo.ts ====================

import type { APIRequestContext } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * The demo practice (database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php) — a real owner
 * of a real practice, not a bare login. E2E specs build their own
 * fixture data on top of it via the mobile API (there's no browser-based
 * "create a device"/"start a cycle" screen yet), then drive the actual
 * screen under test through the browser.
 */
export const DEMO_TENANT_SLUG = 'demo';
export const DEMO_EMAIL = 'admin@steriqore.local';
export const DEMO_PASSWORD = 'password';

export async function mintDemoApiToken(
    request: APIRequestContext,
): Promise<string> {
    const response = await request.post('/api/v1/auth/login', {
        headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID() },
        data: {
            tenant_slug: DEMO_TENANT_SLUG,
            email: DEMO_EMAIL,
            password: DEMO_PASSWORD,
        },
    });

    if (!response.ok()) {
        throw new Error(
            `Demo login failed: ${response.status()} ${await response.text()}`,
        );
    }

    const body = (await response.json()) as { token: string };

    return body.token;
}

export async function createDemoDevice(
    request: APIRequestContext,
    token: string,
): Promise<string> {
    const sites = await request.get('/api/v1/sites', {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    });
    const siteId = (await sites.json()).data[0].id as string;

    const response = await request.post('/api/v1/devices', {
        headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
            'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
        },
        data: {
            site_id: siteId,
            name: `E2E Autoclave ${Date.now()}`,
            serial_number: `E2E-${Date.now()}`,
            kind: 'autoclave',
        },
    });

    if (!response.ok()) {
        throw new Error(
            `Device creation failed: ${response.status()} ${await response.text()}`,
        );
    }

    return (await response.json()).id as string;
}

}

/** Advances draft -> running -> completed, the only state a control test can
 * be recorded from (CYCLE_NOT_READY_FOR_TESTS otherwise). */
export async function completeDemoCycle(
    request: APIRequestContext,
    token: string,
    cycleId: string,
): Promise<void> {
    for (const action of ['start', 'complete']) {
        const response = await request.post(
            `/api/v1/cycles/${cycleId}/${action}`,
            {
                headers: {
                    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
                    'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
                },
                data: {},
            },
        );

        if (!response.ok()) {
            throw new Error(
                `Cycle ${action} failed: ${response.status()} ${await response.text()}`,
            );
        }
    }
}

/** Releases a submitted cycle as compliant (the demo owner has cycles.release). */

/**
 * DLU rules aren't seeded — labels can't be generated without at least one.
 * A rule is practice-wide configuration a real practice sets up once, not
 * per-cycle, so — unlike devices/cycles — this is meant to be reused across
 * spec runs against the persistent demo tenant. DLU_RULE_ALREADY_EXISTS (409)
 * from an earlier run is exactly as good as creating it fresh.
 */
export async function createDemoDluRule(
    request: APIRequestContext,
    token: string,
    packagingType: string,
    storageCondition: string,
    shelfLifeDays: number,
): Promise<void> {
    const response = await request.post('/api/v1/dlu-rules', {
        headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
            'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
        },
        data: {
            packaging_type: packagingType,
            storage_condition: storageCondition,
            shelf_life_days: shelfLifeDays,
            reason: 'E2E fixture setup.',
        },
    });

    if (!response.ok() && response.status() !== 409) {
        throw new Error(
            `DLU rule creation failed: ${response.status()} ${await response.text()}`,
        );
    }
}

/** Requires a matching DLU rule (createDemoDluRule) and a released+compliant cycle. */
export async function generateDemoLabels(
    request: APIRequestContext,
    token: string,
    cycleId: string,
    packagingType: string,
    storageCondition: string,
): Promise<string[]> {
    const response = await request.post(`/api/v1/cycles/${cycleId}/labels`, {
        headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
            'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
        },
        data: {
            packaging_type: packagingType,
            storage_condition: storageCondition,
        },
    });

    if (!response.ok()) {
        throw new Error(
            `Label generation failed: ${response.status()} ${await response.text()}`,
        );
    }

    const body = (await response.json()) as Array<{ id: string }>;

    return body.map((label) => label.id);
}

export async function printDemoLabel(

        data: {},
    });

    if (!response.ok()) {
        throw new Error(
            `Label print failed: ${response.status()} ${await response.text()}`,
        );
    }
}

==================== ./e2e/team.spec.ts ====================

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAsDemoOwner } from './support/auth';
import { DEMO_EMAIL } from './support/demo';

/**
 * Team (UI-26) — users, invitations, role assignment, disable (never
 * delete). The demo owner is a real, persistent member of the shared demo
 * tenant, so this spec exercises the invite/revoke lifecycle rather than
 * disabling a member (there's no in-browser way to accept an invitation
 * and create a second real member without email delivery); the disable
 * mutation itself is covered by tests/Feature/Web/TeamTest.php.
 */
test.describe('Team (UI-26)', () => {
    test('inviting and then revoking a member updates the team page', async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        await loginAsDemoOwner(page);
        await page.goto('/team');

        // The demo owner is listed as an active member, and can't disable
        // their own access (self-lockout guard).
        const ownerRow = page.getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: DEMO_EMAIL });
        await expect(ownerRow).toBeVisible();
        await expect(ownerRow.getByText('Active', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
        await expect(
            ownerRow.getByRole('button', { name: 'Disable access' }),
        ).toHaveCount(0);

        const email = `e2e-invite-${Date.now()}@example.com`;
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Invite member' }).click();
        const inviteDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');
        await inviteDialog.getByLabel('Email').fill(email);
        await inviteDialog.getByLabel('Role').click();
        await page.getByRole('option', { name: 'Practitioner' }).click();
        await inviteDialog
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Send invitation' })
            .click();

        await expect(page.getByText('Invitation sent.')).toBeVisible();

        const invitationRow = page.getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: email });
        await expect(invitationRow).toBeVisible();
        await expect(
            invitationRow.getByText('Practitioner', { exact: true }),
        ).toBeVisible();
        await expect(
            invitationRow.getByText('Pending', { exact: true }),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await invitationRow.getByRole('button', { name: 'Revoke' }).click();
        await page
            .getByRole('alertdialog')
            .getByRole('button', { name: 'Revoke invitation' })
            .click();

        await expect(page.getByText('Invitation revoked.')).toBeVisible();
        await expect(
            invitationRow.getByText('Revoked', { exact: true }),
        ).toBeVisible();
        await expect(
            invitationRow.getByRole('button', { name: 'Revoke' }),
        ).toHaveCount(0);
    });
});

==================== ./playwright.config.ts ====================

import { defineConfig, devices } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * Runs against the real running Docker container (steriqore.sh up), not a
 * dev server Playwright spins up itself — this is the same container the
 * app actually deploys as, FrankenPHP/Octane included, not a stand-in.
 */
export default defineConfig({
    testDir: './e2e',
    fullyParallel: false,
    forbidOnly: !!process.env.CI,
    retries: process.env.CI ? 1 : 0,
    workers: 1,
    reporter: [['list']],
    use: {
        baseURL: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:8010',
        trace: 'retain-on-failure',
        screenshot: 'only-on-failure',
    },
    projects: [
        {
            name: 'chromium',
            use: { ...devices['Desktop Chrome'] },
            testIgnore: '**/acceptance/**',
        },
        // UI-31 — the full §10 demo-journey acceptance suite. Kept out of
        // the default `chromium` project (and out of `npm run e2e`'s
        // day-to-day loop) since it registers its own fresh tenant, sends
        // real mail through Mailpit, and is slow by design; run it
        // explicitly via `npm run e2e:acceptance`. NO retries, ever — a
        // flaky acceptance test is a failing one, never papered over.
        {
            name: 'acceptance',
            testDir: './e2e/acceptance',
            retries: 0,
            use: { ...devices['Desktop Chrome'], video: 'retain-on-failure' },
        },
    ],
});

<?php

use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

// Determine if the application is in maintenance mode...
