    require $maintenance;
}

// Register the Composer autoloader...
require __DIR__.'/../vendor/autoload.php';

// Bootstrap Laravel and handle the request...
/** @var Application $app */
$app = require_once __DIR__.'/../bootstrap/app.php';

$app->handleRequest(Request::capture());


==================== ./README.md ====================

# SteriQore

Sterilization traceability and inventory for dental practices, modelled
on Sterily.fr. Multi-tenant SaaS: PHP 8.4, Laravel 13 (Octane +
FrankenPHP), Inertia 3 + React 19, PostgreSQL 18 with Row-Level Security,
Redis 8, S3-compatible storage (MinIO locally). A separate Flutter app
consumes the same `/api/v1` REST surface via Sanctum tokens.

Core loop: receive stock (batch + expiry) → prepare a load → run a
sterilization cycle → record control tests → an authorized user releases
the cycle (compliant/rejected) → print one unique 2D-coded label per
pouch → scan at the chair before use → link pouch → cycle → device →
practitioner → procedure → pseudonymized patient → one click produces the
inspection-ready evidence dossier PDF.

See `CLAUDE.md` for the full product brief, invariants, and build order;
`docs/erd.md` for the data model; `docs/backlog.md` for the sprint plan.

## Quick start (local development)

Requires Docker and Docker Compose V2. Everything else (PHP, Node,
Postgres, Redis, MinIO) runs in containers — nothing needs installing on
the host except Docker itself.

```bash
git clone <repo> && cd steriqore
cp .env.example .env
echo "APP_KEY=base64:$(openssl rand -base64 32)" >> .env
./steriqore.sh up            # build and start in the background
```

`.env` is gitignored and not copied into the image (`.dockerignore`) —
`docker-compose.yml` injects it via `env_file`, so `APP_KEY` has to exist
on the host's `.env` *before* the container starts, not generated inside
it afterward.

This brings up the app plus Postgres 18, Redis 8, MinIO, and Mailpit.
Once healthy, switch to `./steriqore.sh watch` (foreground) for day-to-day
work — it syncs PHP/config changes into the container automatically.

| Service | URL |
|---|---|
| App / API | http://localhost:8010 |
| Horizon (queues) | http://localhost:8010/horizon |
| Mailpit (catches all local mail) | http://localhost:8035 |
| MinIO console | http://localhost:9024 (`minioadmin` / `minioadmin`) |
| Postgres | `localhost:5455` (`steriqore` / `secret`) |
| Redis | `localhost:6395` |

`./steriqore.sh help` lists every helper command (`art` for artisan,
`shell`, `logs`, `assets`, `rebuild`, ...). See its header comment or run
it directly.

### Running tests

The test suite runs on the **host** (not in the container) against the
same dockerized Postgres, using PHP directly — requires PHP 8.4 on the
host (e.g. via [Laravel Herd](https://herd.laravel.com) or your own
toolchain) plus Composer:

```bash
composer install
./vendor/bin/pest --testsuite=Feature
./vendor/bin/pint          # code style (auto-fixes)
./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=1G   # static analysis
```

`phpunit.xml` points the test suite at a separate `steriqore_test`
database on the same Postgres instance, using the elevated migrations
role (see the comment there for why — it's a deliberate, documented
choice, not an oversight).

### Regenerating the API contract

`docs/openapi.yaml` is generated, never hand-edited, and a contract test
(`tests/Feature/Api/V1/OpenApiContractTest.php`) fails on any route
change until it's regenerated:

```bash
php artisan scramble:clear
php artisan scramble:export --path=storage/app/openapi.json
php -r '
require "vendor/autoload.php";
$json = json_decode(file_get_contents("storage/app/openapi.json"), true);
file_put_contents("docs/openapi.yaml", Symfony\Component\Yaml\Yaml::dump(
    $json, 20, 2, Symfony\Component\Yaml\Yaml::DUMP_MULTI_LINE_LITERAL_BLOCK
));
'
rm storage/app/openapi.json
```

## Documentation

- [`docs/erd.md`](docs/erd.md) — data model and tenancy design
- [`docs/openapi.yaml`](docs/openapi.yaml) — the full API contract (OpenAPI 3.1)
- [`docs/open-questions.md`](docs/open-questions.md) — decisions flagged rather than guessed
- [`docs/performance.md`](docs/performance.md) — pilot-volume performance results
- [`docs/deployment.md`](docs/deployment.md) — building/deploying the Docker image, staging, environment variables
- [`docs/operations.md`](docs/operations.md) — backups/restore, scheduled jobs, monitoring, troubleshooting

## Architecture at a glance

```
app/Domain/<Context>/{Models,Actions,Data,Enums}
```

One folder per bounded context (Tenancy, Identity, Catalog, Purchasing,
Inventory, Equipment, Sterilization, Labeling, Traceability, Reporting,
Compliance). Controllers validate → authorize → delegate to a
single-purpose Action → respond; no business logic lives in controllers,
models, or the React frontend.

Every tenant-owned table carries a `tenant_id`, scoped twice: an Eloquent
global scope (`App\Support\Concerns\BelongsToTenant`) and PostgreSQL
Row-Level Security as a second, independent line of defense — enforced
even against a raw query or a forgotten scope. The tenant is only ever
resolved from the session (web) or the Sanctum token (API), never from a
request parameter.

Proprietary — internal project.

/*
 * Motion: only state transitions and skeletons, never ambient animation —
 * and even those respect a user's reduced-motion preference. A blanket
 * rule here means every future screen gets this for free instead of each
 * one having to remember to guard its own animate-* utility.
 */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
        transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        scroll-behavior: auto !important;
    }
}

/*
 * Print: inspectors print these. The dark theme must never follow a
 * screen onto paper, and app chrome (sidebar, header, filters, pagination)
 * has no business on a printed page — only the evidence does. Elements
 * marked .no-print (nav, filter bars, action buttons) are hidden;
 * everything else keeps its normal light-mode colors regardless of which
 * theme was active on screen.

==================== ./resources/js/app.tsx ====================

import { createInertiaApp } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { Toaster } from '@/components/ui/sonner';
import { TooltipProvider } from '@/components/ui/tooltip';
import { initializeTheme } from '@/hooks/use-appearance';
import AppLayout from '@/layouts/app-layout';
import AuthLayout from '@/layouts/auth-layout';
import SettingsLayout from '@/layouts/settings/layout';

const appName = import.meta.env.VITE_APP_NAME || 'Laravel';

createInertiaApp({
    title: (title) => (title ? `${title} - ${appName}` : appName),
    layout: (name) => {
        switch (true) {
            case name === 'welcome':
                return null;
            case name.startsWith('auth/'):
                return AuthLayout;
            case name.startsWith('settings/'):
                return [AppLayout, SettingsLayout];
            default:
                return AppLayout;
        }
    },
    strictMode: true,
    withApp(app) {
        return (
            <TooltipProvider delayDuration={0}>
                {app}
                <Toaster />
            </TooltipProvider>
        );
    },
    progress: {
        color: '#4B5563',
    },
});

// This will set light / dark mode on load...
initializeTheme();


==================== ./resources/js/components/alert-error.tsx ====================

import { AlertCircleIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert';

export default function AlertError({
    errors,
    title,
}: {
    errors: string[];
    title?: string;
}) {
    return (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertCircleIcon />
            <AlertTitle>{title || 'Something went wrong.'}</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>
                <ul className="list-inside list-disc text-sm">
                    {Array.from(new Set(errors)).map((error, index) => (
                        <li key={index}>{error}</li>
                    ))}
                </ul>
            </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
    );
}


==================== ./resources/js/components/app-content.tsx ====================

import * as React from 'react';
import { SidebarInset } from '@/components/ui/sidebar';
import type { AppVariant } from '@/types';

type Props = React.ComponentProps<'main'> & {
    variant?: AppVariant;
};

export function AppContent({ variant = 'sidebar', children, ...props }: Props) {
    if (variant === 'sidebar') {
        return <SidebarInset {...props}>{children}</SidebarInset>;
    }

    return (
        <main
            className="mx-auto flex h-full w-full max-w-7xl flex-1 flex-col gap-4 rounded-xl"
            {...props}
        >
            {children}
        </main>
    );
}

                                                ),

                                            )}
                                        >
                                            {item.icon && (
                                                <item.icon className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                                            )}
                                            {item.title}
                                        </Link>
                                        {isCurrentUrl(item.href) && (
                                            <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-0.5 w-full translate-y-px bg-black dark:bg-white"></div>
                                        )}
                                    </NavigationMenuItem>
                                ))}
                            </NavigationMenuList>
                        </NavigationMenu>
                    </div>

                    <div className="ml-auto flex items-center space-x-2">
                        <div className="relative flex items-center space-x-1">
                            <Button
                                variant="ghost"
                                size="icon"
                                className="group h-9 w-9 cursor-pointer"
                            >
                                <Search className="!size-5 opacity-80 group-hover:opacity-100" />
                            </Button>
                            <div className="ml-1 hidden gap-1 lg:flex">
                                {rightNavItems.map((item) => (
                                    <Tooltip key={item.title}>
                                        <TooltipTrigger>
                                            <a
                                                href={toUrl(item.href)}
                                                target="_blank"
                                                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                                className="group inline-flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-transparent p-0 text-sm font-medium text-accent-foreground ring-offset-background transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-none disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50"
                                            >
                                                <span className="sr-only">
                                                    {item.title}
                                                </span>
                                                {item.icon && (
                                                    <item.icon className="size-5 opacity-80 group-hover:opacity-100" />
                                                )}
                                            </a>
                                        </TooltipTrigger>
                                        <TooltipContent>
                                            <p>{item.title}</p>
                                        </TooltipContent>
                                    </Tooltip>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <DropdownMenu>
                            <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                                <Button
                                    variant="ghost"
                                    className="size-10 rounded-full p-1"
                                >
                                    <Avatar className="size-8 overflow-hidden rounded-full">
                                        <AvatarImage
                                            src={auth.user?.avatar}
                                            alt={auth.user?.name}
                                        />
                                        <AvatarFallback className="rounded-lg bg-neutral-200 text-black dark:bg-neutral-700 dark:text-white">
                                            {getInitials(auth.user?.name ?? '')}
                                        </AvatarFallback>
                                    </Avatar>
                                </Button>
                            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                            <DropdownMenuContent className="w-56" align="end">
                                {auth.user && (
                                    <UserMenuContent user={auth.user} />
                                )}
                            </DropdownMenuContent>
                        </DropdownMenu>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            {breadcrumbs.length > 1 && (
                <div className="flex w-full border-b border-sidebar-border/70">
                    <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-start px-4 text-neutral-500 md:max-w-7xl">
                        <Breadcrumbs breadcrumbs={breadcrumbs} />
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </>
    );
}

==================== ./resources/js/components/app-shell.tsx ====================

import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/react';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { SidebarProvider } from '@/components/ui/sidebar';
import type { AppVariant } from '@/types';

type Props = {
    children: ReactNode;
    variant?: AppVariant;
};

export function AppShell({ children, variant = 'sidebar' }: Props) {
    const isOpen = usePage().props.sidebarOpen;

    if (variant === 'header') {
        return (
            <div className="flex min-h-screen w-full flex-col">{children}</div>
        );
    }

    return <SidebarProvider defaultOpen={isOpen}>{children}</SidebarProvider>;
}

==================== ./resources/js/components/appearance-tabs.tsx ====================

import type { LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import { Monitor, Moon, Sun } from 'lucide-react';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import type { Appearance } from '@/hooks/use-appearance';
import { useAppearance } from '@/hooks/use-appearance';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function AppearanceToggleTab({
    className = '',
    ...props
}: HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) {
    const { appearance, updateAppearance } = useAppearance();

    const tabs: { value: Appearance; icon: LucideIcon; label: string }[] = [
        { value: 'light', icon: Sun, label: 'Light' },
        { value: 'dark', icon: Moon, label: 'Dark' },
        { value: 'system', icon: Monitor, label: 'System' },
    ];

    return (
        <div
            className={cn(
                'inline-flex gap-1 rounded-lg bg-neutral-100 p-1 dark:bg-neutral-800',
                className,
            )}
            {...props}
        >
            {tabs.map(({ value, icon: Icon, label }) => (
                <button
                    key={value}
                    onClick={() => updateAppearance(value)}
                    className={cn(
                        'flex items-center rounded-md px-3.5 py-1.5 transition-colors',
                        appearance === value
                            ? 'bg-white shadow-xs dark:bg-neutral-700 dark:text-neutral-100'
                            : 'text-neutral-500 hover:bg-neutral-200/60 hover:text-black dark:text-neutral-400 dark:hover:bg-neutral-700/60',
                    )}
                >
                    <Icon className="-ml-1 h-4 w-4" />
                    <span className="ml-1.5 text-sm">{label}</span>
                </button>
            ))}
        </div>
    );
}


==================== ./resources/js/components/breadcrumbs.tsx ====================

import { Link } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { Fragment } from 'react';
import {
    Breadcrumb,
    BreadcrumbItem,
    BreadcrumbLink,
    BreadcrumbList,
    BreadcrumbPage,
    BreadcrumbSeparator,
} from '@/components/ui/breadcrumb';
import type { BreadcrumbItem as BreadcrumbItemType } from '@/types';

export function Breadcrumbs({
    breadcrumbs,
}: {
    breadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItemType[];
}) {
    return (
        <>
            {breadcrumbs.length > 0 && (
                <Breadcrumb>
                    <BreadcrumbList>
                        {breadcrumbs.map((item, index) => {
                            const isLast = index === breadcrumbs.length - 1;

                            return (
                                <Fragment key={index}>
                                    <BreadcrumbItem>
                                        {isLast ? (
                                            <BreadcrumbPage>
                                                {item.title}
                                            </BreadcrumbPage>
                                        ) : (
                                            <BreadcrumbLink asChild>
                                                <Link href={item.href}>
                                                    {item.title}
                                                </Link>
                                            </BreadcrumbLink>
                                        )}
                                    </BreadcrumbItem>
                                    {!isLast && <BreadcrumbSeparator />}
                                </Fragment>
                            );
                        })}
                    </BreadcrumbList>
                </Breadcrumb>
            )}
        </>
    );
}


==================== ./resources/js/components/cycle-timeline.tsx ====================

import { Check, CircleDashed, PlayCircle, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

type Station =
    'draft' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'awaiting_release' | 'terminal';

const STATIONS: { key: Station; label: string }[] = [
    { key: 'draft', label: 'Draft' },
    { key: 'running', label: 'Running' },
    { key: 'completed', label: 'Completed' },
    { key: 'awaiting_release', label: 'Awaiting release' },
    { key: 'terminal', label: 'Released / Rejected' },
];

const STATUS_TO_INDEX: Record<string, number> = {
    draft: 0,
    running: 1,
    completed: 2,
    awaiting_release: 3,
    released: 4,
    rejected: 4,
};

/**
 * The signature element (S7 design direction): the one place to spend
 * visual effort, kept quiet everywhere else. A horizontal state track —
 * draft -> running -> completed -> awaiting_release -> released/rejected —
 * with the terminal station taking on the compliance outcome's tone once
 * reached, never before (an undecided cycle shows a neutral placeholder,
 * not a color that would wrongly imply a decision was made).
 */
export function CycleTimeline({ status }: { status: string }) {
    const currentIndex = STATUS_TO_INDEX[status] ?? 0;
    const isRejected = status === 'rejected';
    const isReleased = status === 'released';

    return (
        <ol className="flex items-start" aria-label="Cycle progress">
            {STATIONS.map((station, index) => {
                const isTerminal = station.key === 'terminal';
                const reached = index <= currentIndex;
                const isCurrent = index === currentIndex;

                let circleClasses =
                    'border-border bg-background text-muted-foreground';
                let Icon = CircleDashed;

                if (isTerminal && reached) {
                    if (isRejected) {
                        circleClasses =
                            'border-status-danger-fg bg-status-danger-bg text-status-danger-fg';
                        Icon = X;
                    } else if (isReleased) {
                        circleClasses =
                            'border-status-success-fg bg-status-success-bg text-status-success-fg';
                        Icon = Check;
                    }
                } else if (reached && isCurrent) {
                    circleClasses = 'border-primary bg-primary/10 text-primary';
                    Icon = PlayCircle;
                } else if (reached) {
                    circleClasses =
                        'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground';
                    Icon = Check;
                }

                return (
                    <li
                        key={station.key}
                        className="flex flex-1 flex-col items-center last:flex-none"
                    >
                        <div className="flex w-full items-center">
                            {index > 0 && (
                                <div
                                    className={cn(
                                        'h-0.5 flex-1',
                                        index <= currentIndex
                                            ? 'bg-primary'
                                            : 'bg-border',
                                    )}
                                    aria-hidden="true"
                                />
                            )}
                            <div
                                className={cn(
                                    'flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2',
                                    circleClasses,
                                )}
                                aria-current={isCurrent ? 'step' : undefined}
                            >
                                <Icon className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <span
                            className={cn(
                                'mt-2 max-w-24 text-center text-xs',
                                reached
                                    ? 'font-medium text-foreground'
                                    : 'text-muted-foreground',
                            )}
                        >
                            {station.label}
                        </span>
                    </li>
                );
            })}
        </ol>
    );
}


==================== ./resources/js/components/dashboard/attention-queue.tsx ====================

import { Link } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { CheckCircle2, TriangleAlert } from 'lucide-react';
import type { LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import { TONE_CLASSES } from '@/components/status-badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import type { StatusTone } from '@/lib/status';
import alertRoutes from '@/routes/alerts';
import cycles from '@/routes/cycles';
import labels from '@/routes/labels';
import nonConformityRoutes from '@/routes/non-conformities';
import type { AttentionCard } from '@/types';

/**
 * Zero is a success state (CLAUDE.md/UI-30) — every card renders a check
 * and a plain sentence, not a grey box with "0" in it. `tone` only applies
 * once there's actually something to act on; severity is always icon + text
 * + color together, never color alone.
 */
const CARD_META: Record<
    string,
    { zeroLabel: string; tone: StatusTone; href: () => string }
> = {
    cycles_awaiting_release: {
        zeroLabel: 'Nothing awaiting release',
        tone: 'pending',
        href: () =>
            cycles.index({ query: { filter: { status: 'awaiting_release' } } })
                .url,
    },
    cycles_rejected_no_non_conformity: {
        zeroLabel: 'No rejected cycles missing a non-conformity',
        tone: 'danger',
        href: () =>
            cycles.index({
                query: {
                    filter: { status: 'rejected', missing_non_conformity: true },
                },
            }).url,
    },
    open_non_conformities: {
        zeroLabel: 'No open non-conformities or recalls',
        tone: 'contained',
        href: () =>
            nonConformityRoutes.index({ query: { filter: { resolved: false } } })
                .url,
    },
    batches_expired_in_stock: {
        zeroLabel: 'No expired batches still in stock',
        tone: 'danger',
        href: () =>
            alertRoutes.index({
                query: { filter: { type: 'expired', state: 'open' } },
            }).url,
    },
    batches_near_expiry: {
        zeroLabel: 'Nothing expiring soon',
        tone: 'pending',
        href: () =>
            alertRoutes.index({
                query: { filter: { type: 'near_expiry', state: 'open' } },
            }).url,
    },
    products_low_stock: {
        zeroLabel: 'No products below threshold',
        tone: 'pending',
        href: () =>
            alertRoutes.index({
                query: { filter: { type: 'low_stock', state: 'open' } },
            }).url,
    },
    labels_past_dlu_unused: {
        zeroLabel: 'No unused labels past their use-by date',
        tone: 'expired',
        href: () => labels.index({ query: { filter: { overdue: true } } }).url,
    },
};

const DEFAULT_ORDER = [
    'cycles_awaiting_release',
    'cycles_rejected_no_non_conformity',
    'open_non_conformities',
    'batches_expired_in_stock',
    'batches_near_expiry',
    'products_low_stock',
    'labels_past_dlu_unused',
];

/** A releaser leads with release work; a stock_manager leads with stock and expiry (UI-30 role composition). */
const LEAD_KEYS_BY_ROLE: Record<string, string[]> = {
    releaser: ['cycles_awaiting_release'],
    stock_manager: [
        'products_low_stock',
        'batches_expired_in_stock',
        'batches_near_expiry',
    ],
};

function orderCards(
    cards: AttentionCard[],
    role: string | null,
): AttentionCard[] {
    const byKey = new Map(cards.map((card) => [card.key, card]));
    const leadKeys = role ? (LEAD_KEYS_BY_ROLE[role] ?? []) : [];
    const order = [
        ...leadKeys,
        ...DEFAULT_ORDER.filter((key) => !leadKeys.includes(key)),
    ];

    return order
        .map((key) => byKey.get(key))
        .filter((card): card is AttentionCard => card !== undefined);
}

function CardIcon({ tone, icon: Icon }: { tone: StatusTone; icon: LucideIcon }) {
    return (
        <span
            className={`inline-flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${TONE_CLASSES[tone]}`}
        >
            <Icon className="size-4.5" aria-hidden="true" />
        </span>
    );
}

function AttentionCardTile({ card }: { card: AttentionCard }) {
    const meta = CARD_META[card.key];

    if (!meta) {
        return null;
    }

    if (card.error) {
        return (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border p-4">
                <CardIcon tone="danger" icon={TriangleAlert} />
                <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium">Couldn't load this</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {card.label}
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }

    if (card.count === 0) {
        return (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border p-4">
                <CardIcon tone="success" icon={CheckCircle2} />
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">{meta.zeroLabel}</p>
            </div>
        );
    }

    return (
        <div
            data-testid={`attention-card-${card.key}`}
            className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border p-4"
        >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <CardIcon tone={meta.tone} icon={TriangleAlert} />
                <div>
                    <p className="text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums">
                        {card.count}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        {card.label}
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>
            {/* A generic "View" name, not the card's own label — the label
                text always contains a domain noun (Cycles, Products, ...)
                that collides with getByRole('link', { name }) lookups for
                the sidebar nav item of the same name on this same page. */}
            <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm">
                <Link href={meta.href()}>View</Link>
            </Button>
        </div>
    );
}

export function AttentionQueueSkeleton() {
    return (
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
            {Array.from({ length: 7 }).map((_, i) => (
                <Skeleton key={i} className="h-[68px] rounded-lg" />
            ))}
        </div>
    );
}

export function AttentionQueue({
    cards,
    role,
}: {
    cards: AttentionCard[];
    role: string | null;
}) {
    const ordered = orderCards(cards, role);

    return (
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
            {ordered.map((card) => (
                <AttentionCardTile key={card.key} card={card} />
            ))}
        </div>
    );
}


==================== ./resources/js/components/dashboard/onboarding-checklist.tsx ====================

import { Link } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { Circle, CircleCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import cycles from '@/routes/cycles';
import devices from '@/routes/devices';
import siteRoutes from '@/routes/sites';
import type { OnboardingStep } from '@/types';

const HREF_BY_KEY: Record<string, () => string> = {
    add_site: () => siteRoutes.index().url,
    add_autoclave: () => devices.index().url,
    add_program: () => devices.index().url,
    run_first_cycle: () => cycles.index().url,
};

export function OnboardingChecklistSkeleton() {
    return <Skeleton className="h-64 rounded-lg" />;
}

/**
 * Shown instead of the attention queue for a tenant with no devices and no
 * cycles yet (UI-30) — eight empty attention cards would read as a broken
 * product to a trial user's first visit.
 */
export function OnboardingChecklist({ steps }: { steps: OnboardingStep[] }) {
    return (
        <div className="rounded-lg border p-6">
            <h2 className="text-base font-semibold">
                Get your practice set up
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                A few steps before your first sterilization cycle.
            </p>

            <ul className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-2">
                {steps.map((step) => {
                    const href = HREF_BY_KEY[step.key]?.();
                    const Icon = step.done ? CircleCheck : Circle;

                    return (
                        <li
                            key={step.key}
                            className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-md border p-3"
                        >
                            <Icon
                                className={
                                    step.done
                                        ? 'size-5 shrink-0 text-status-success-fg'
                                        : 'size-5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground'
                                }
                                aria-hidden="true"
                            />
                            {step.done || !step.can_act || !href ? (
                                <span
                                    className={
                                        step.done
                                            ? 'text-sm line-through opacity-70'
                                            : 'text-sm'
                                    }
                                >
                                    {step.label}
                                </span>
                            ) : (
                                <Link
                                    href={href}
                                    className="text-sm font-medium underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
                                >
                                    {step.label}
                                </Link>
                            )}
                        </li>
                    );
                })}
            </ul>
        </div>
    );
}


==================== ./resources/js/components/dashboard/recent-procedures.tsx ====================

import { Link } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { TriangleAlert } from 'lucide-react';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/format';
import labels from '@/routes/labels';
import type { RecentProcedure } from '@/types';

export function RecentProceduresSkeleton() {
    return <Skeleton className="h-32 rounded-lg" />;
}

/** A practitioner's own recent procedures (UI-30 role composition) — never anyone else's. */
export function RecentProcedures({
    procedures,
    error,
}: {
    procedures: RecentProcedure[];
    error: boolean;
}) {
    if (error) {
        return (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border p-4">
                <TriangleAlert className="size-5 shrink-0 text-status-danger-fg" />
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    Couldn't load your recent procedures.
                </p>
            </div>
        );
    }

    if (procedures.length === 0) {
        return (
            <p className="rounded-lg border p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                No procedures recorded yet.
            </p>
        );
    }

    return (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            {procedures.map((procedure) => (
                <li
                    key={procedure.label_id}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-3"
                >
                    <Link
                        href={labels.show(procedure.label_id).url}
                        className="text-sm font-medium underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
                    >
                        {procedure.procedure}
                    </Link>
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {formatDateTime(procedure.used_at)}
                    </span>
                </li>
            ))}
        </ul>
    );
}

                                <StatusBadge status={cycleStatus[row.status]} />
                            </TableCell>

                                        —
                                    </span>
                                )}
                            </TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                    ))}
                </TableBody>
            </Table>
        </div>
    );
}

==================== ./resources/js/components/global-search.tsx ====================

import { router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
    CommandDialog,
    CommandEmpty,
    CommandGroup,
    CommandInput,
    CommandItem,
    CommandList,
} from '@/components/ui/command';
import cycles from '@/routes/cycles';

/**
 * A single, honest entry point today: cycle number lookup, since Cycles
 * is the only screen that exists yet. The full multi-criteria evidence
 * search (patient ref / cycle / batch / device / period / operator) is
 * its own dedicated screen later in the build order (S7 item 5) — this
 * isn't a preview of that, just the header search this milestone can
 * actually back with a real query.
 */
export function GlobalSearch() {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [query, setQuery] = useState('');

    useEffect(() => {
        function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
            if (event.key === 'k' && (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)) {
                event.preventDefault();
                setOpen((value) => !value);
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);

        return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    }, []);

    function runSearch() {
        if (!query.trim()) {
            return;
        }

        setOpen(false);
        router.visit(
            cycles.index({ query: { filter: { q: query.trim() } } }).url,
        );
    }

    return (
        <>
            <Button
                variant="outline"
                className="h-8 w-full max-w-64 justify-start gap-2 px-3 font-normal text-muted-foreground sm:w-56"
                onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
            >
                <Search className="size-4" />
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">Search cycle number…</span>
                <span className="ml-auto hidden text-xs sm:inline">⌘K</span>
            </Button>
            <CommandDialog
                open={open}
                onOpenChange={setOpen}
                title="Search"
                description="Search by cycle number"
            >
                <CommandInput
                    placeholder="Cycle number…"
                    value={query}
                    onValueChange={setQuery}
                />
                <CommandList>
                    <CommandEmpty>
                        Type a cycle number, then press Enter.
                    </CommandEmpty>
                    {query.trim() && (
                        <CommandGroup heading="Cycles">
                            <CommandItem onSelect={runSearch}>
                                <Search />
                                Search cycles for &ldquo;{query.trim()}&rdquo;
                            </CommandItem>
                        </CommandGroup>
                    )}
                </CommandList>
            </CommandDialog>
        </>
    );
}

==================== ./resources/js/components/manage-passkeys.tsx ====================

import { router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { KeyRound } from 'lucide-react';
import { destroy } from '@/actions/Laravel/Passkeys/Http/Controllers/PasskeyRegistrationController';
import Heading from '@/components/heading';
import PasskeyItem from '@/components/passkey-item';
import PasskeyRegistration from '@/components/passkey-register';
import type { Passkey } from '@/types/auth';

export type Props = {
    canManagePasskeys?: boolean;
    passkeys?: Passkey[];
};

const EmptyState = () => {
    return (
        <div className="p-8 text-center">
            <div className="mx-auto mb-4 flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-muted">
                <KeyRound className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground" />
            </div>
            <p className="font-medium">No passkeys yet</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Add a passkey to sign in without a password
            </p>
        </div>
    );
};

export default function ManagePasskeys(props: Props) {
    const passkeys = props.passkeys ?? [];

    const handleDelete = (id: number, onError: () => void) => {
        router.delete(destroy.url(id), {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onError,
        });
    };

    const handleRegisterSuccess = () => {
        router.reload();
    };

    if (!(props.canManagePasskeys ?? false)) {
        return null;
    }

    return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
            <Heading
                variant="small"
                title="Passkeys"
                description="Manage your passkeys for passwordless sign-in"
            />

            <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border">
                {passkeys.length > 0 ? (
                    passkeys.map((passkey) => (
                        <PasskeyItem
                            key={passkey.id}
                            passkey={passkey}
                            onDelete={handleDelete}
                        />
                    ))
                ) : (
                    <EmptyState />
                )}
            </div>

            <PasskeyRegistration onSuccess={handleRegisterSuccess} />
        </div>
    );
}


==================== ./resources/js/components/manage-two-factor.tsx ====================

import { Form } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Heading from '@/components/heading';
import TwoFactorRecoveryCodes from '@/components/two-factor-recovery-codes';
import TwoFactorSetupModal from '@/components/two-factor-setup-modal';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { useTwoFactorAuth } from '@/hooks/use-two-factor-auth';
import { disable, enable } from '@/routes/two-factor';

export type Props = {
    canManageTwoFactor?: boolean;
    requiresConfirmation?: boolean;
    twoFactorEnabled?: boolean;
};

export default function ManageTwoFactor(props: Props) {
    const requiresConfirmation = props.requiresConfirmation ?? false;
    const twoFactorEnabled = props.twoFactorEnabled ?? false;

    const {
        qrCodeSvg,
        hasSetupData,
        manualSetupKey,
        clearSetupData,
        clearTwoFactorAuthData,
        fetchSetupData,
        recoveryCodesList,
        fetchRecoveryCodes,
        errors,
    } = useTwoFactorAuth();
    const [showSetupModal, setShowSetupModal] = useState<boolean>(false);
    const prevTwoFactorEnabled = useRef(twoFactorEnabled);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (prevTwoFactorEnabled.current && !twoFactorEnabled) {
            clearTwoFactorAuthData();
        }

        prevTwoFactorEnabled.current = twoFactorEnabled;
    }, [twoFactorEnabled, clearTwoFactorAuthData]);

    if (!(props.canManageTwoFactor ?? false)) {
        return null;
    }

    return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
            <Heading
                variant="small"
                title="Two-factor authentication"
                description="Manage your two-factor authentication settings"
            />
            {twoFactorEnabled ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-start justify-start space-y-4">
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        You will be prompted for a secure, random pin during
                        login, which you can retrieve from the TOTP-supported
                        application on your phone.
                    </p>

                    <div className="relative inline">
                        <Form {...disable.form()}>
                            {({ processing }) => (
                                <Button
                                    variant="destructive"
                                    type="submit"
                                    disabled={processing}
                                >
                                    Disable 2FA
                                </Button>
                            )}
                        </Form>
                    </div>

                    <TwoFactorRecoveryCodes
                        recoveryCodesList={recoveryCodesList}
                        fetchRecoveryCodes={fetchRecoveryCodes}
                        errors={errors}
                    />
                </div>
            ) : (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-start justify-start space-y-4">
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        When you enable two-factor authentication, you will be
                        prompted for a secure pin during login. This pin can be
                        retrieved from a TOTP-supported application on your
                        phone.
                    </p>

                    <div>
                        {hasSetupData ? (
                            <Button onClick={() => setShowSetupModal(true)}>
                                <ShieldCheck />
                                Continue setup
                            </Button>
                        ) : (
                            <Form
                                {...enable.form()}
                                onSuccess={() => setShowSetupModal(true)}
                            >
                                {({ processing }) => (
                                    <Button type="submit" disabled={processing}>
                                        Enable 2FA
                                    </Button>
                                )}
                            </Form>
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}

            <TwoFactorSetupModal
                isOpen={showSetupModal}
                onClose={() => setShowSetupModal(false)}
                requiresConfirmation={requiresConfirmation}
                twoFactorEnabled={twoFactorEnabled}
                qrCodeSvg={qrCodeSvg}
                manualSetupKey={manualSetupKey}
                clearSetupData={clearSetupData}
                fetchSetupData={fetchSetupData}
                errors={errors}
            />
        </div>
    );
}

==================== ./resources/js/components/nav-main.tsx ====================

import { Link, usePage } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import {
    SidebarGroup,
    SidebarGroupLabel,
    SidebarMenu,
    SidebarMenuButton,
    SidebarMenuItem,
} from '@/components/ui/sidebar';
import { useCurrentUrl } from '@/hooks/use-current-url';
import type { NavGroup } from '@/types';

/**
 * Permission-aware: an item the user can't access is not rendered at all
 * (hiding is UX only — every page's own Policy is still the real
 * authorization). A group with no visible items renders nothing.
 */
export function NavMain({ groups }: { groups: NavGroup[] }) {
    const { isCurrentUrl } = useCurrentUrl();
    const { auth } = usePage().props;
    const permissions = auth.permissions;

    return (
        <>
            {groups.map((group) => {
                const visibleItems = group.items.filter(
                    (item) =>
                        !item.permission ||
                        permissions.includes(item.permission),
                );

                if (visibleItems.length === 0) {
                    return null;
                }

                return (
                    <SidebarGroup key={group.label} className="px-2 py-0">
                        <SidebarGroupLabel>{group.label}</SidebarGroupLabel>
                        <SidebarMenu>
                            {visibleItems.map((item) =>
                                item.comingSoon ? (
                                    <SidebarMenuItem key={item.title}>
                                        <SidebarMenuButton
                                            disabled
                                            tooltip={{
                                                children: `${item.title} — coming soon`,
                                            }}
                                        >
                                            {item.icon && <item.icon />}
                                            <span>{item.title}</span>
                                            <Badge
                                                variant="outline"
                                                className="ml-auto text-[10px] font-normal opacity-60"
                                            >
                                                Soon
                                            </Badge>
                                        </SidebarMenuButton>
                                    </SidebarMenuItem>
                                ) : (
                                    <SidebarMenuItem key={item.title}>
                                        <SidebarMenuButton
                                            asChild
                                            isActive={isCurrentUrl(item.href)}
                                            tooltip={{ children: item.title }}
                                        >
                                            <Link href={item.href} prefetch>
                                                {item.icon && <item.icon />}
                                                <span>{item.title}</span>
                                            </Link>
                                        </SidebarMenuButton>
                                    </SidebarMenuItem>
                                ),
                            )}
                        </SidebarMenu>
                    </SidebarGroup>
                );
            })}
        </>
    );
}

==================== ./resources/js/components/new-category-dialog.tsx ====================

import { useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { FolderPlus } from 'lucide-react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
    Dialog,
    DialogContent,
    DialogDescription,
    DialogFooter,
    DialogHeader,
    DialogTitle,
    DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import productCategories from '@/routes/product-categories';
import type { ProductCategory } from '@/types';

export function NewCategoryDialog({
    categories,
}: {
    categories: ProductCategory[];
}) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const form = useForm({ name: '', parent_category_id: '' });

    function submit() {
        form.post(productCategories.store().url, {
            onSuccess: () => {
                setOpen(false);
                form.reset();
            },
        });
    }

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
                setOpen(next);

                if (!next) {
                    form.reset();
                    form.clearErrors();
                }
            }}
        >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                    <FolderPlus className="size-4" />
                    New category
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Add a category</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        Categories group products for filtering — optionally
                        nested under a parent.
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="grid gap-4">
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <Label htmlFor="category-name">Name</Label>
                        <Input
                            id="category-name"
                            value={form.data.name}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('name', e.target.value)
                            }
                            placeholder="e.g. Sterilization pouches"
                        />
                        {form.errors.name && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.name}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <Label htmlFor="category-parent">
                            Parent category (optional)
                        </Label>
                        <Select
                            value={form.data.parent_category_id}
                            onValueChange={(value) =>
                                form.setData('parent_category_id', value)
                            }
                        >
                            <SelectTrigger id="category-parent" className="w-full">
                                <SelectValue placeholder="None" />
                            </SelectTrigger>
                            <SelectContent>
                                {categories.map((category) => (
                                    <SelectItem
                                        key={category.id}
                                        value={category.id}
                                    >
                                        {category.name}
                                    </SelectItem>
                                ))}
                            </SelectContent>
                        </Select>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        onClick={submit}
                        disabled={form.processing || !form.data.name.trim()}
                    >
                        Add category
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

import { useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';

import {

    DialogTitle,
    DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import cycles from '@/routes/cycles';
import type { DeviceProgram, Option } from '@/types';

export function NewCycleDialog({
    devices,
    devicePrograms,
}: {
    devices: Option[];
    devicePrograms: DeviceProgram[];
}) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const form = useForm({
        device_id: '',
        device_program_id: '',
        notes: '',
    });

    const programsForDevice = devicePrograms.filter(
        (program) => program.device_id === form.data.device_id,
    );

    function submit() {
        form.post(cycles.store().url, {
            onSuccess: () => {
                setOpen(false);
                form.reset();
            },
        });
    }

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
                setOpen(next);

                if (!next) {
                    form.reset();
                    form.clearErrors();
                }
            }}
        >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm">
                    <Plus className="size-4" />
                    New cycle
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Start a new cycle</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        Pick the autoclave running this load. You'll add the
                        load items next.
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="grid gap-4">
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <Label htmlFor="device_id">Device</Label>
                        <Select
                            value={form.data.device_id}
                            onValueChange={(value) => {
                                form.setData('device_id', value);
                                form.setData('device_program_id', '');
                            }}
                        >
                            <SelectTrigger id="device_id" className="w-full">
                                <SelectValue placeholder="Select a device…" />
                            </SelectTrigger>
                            <SelectContent>
                                {devices.map((device) => (
                                    <SelectItem
                                        key={device.id}
                                        value={device.id}
                                    >
                                        {device.label}
                                    </SelectItem>
                                ))}
                            </SelectContent>
                        </Select>
                        {form.errors.device_id && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.device_id}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    {form.data.device_id && programsForDevice.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <Label htmlFor="device_program_id">
                                Program (optional)
                            </Label>
                            <Select
                                value={form.data.device_program_id}
                                onValueChange={(value) =>
                                    form.setData('device_program_id', value)
                                }
                            >
                                <SelectTrigger
                                    id="device_program_id"
                                    className="w-full"
                                >
                                    <SelectValue placeholder="No specific program" />
                                </SelectTrigger>
                                <SelectContent>
                                    {programsForDevice.map((program) => (
                                        <SelectItem
                                            key={program.id}
                                            value={program.id}
                                        >
                                            {program.name} (
                                            {program.target_temperature_celsius}
                                            °C, {program.plateau_minutes} min)
                                        </SelectItem>
                                    ))}
                                </SelectContent>
                            </Select>
                        </div>
                    )}

                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <Label htmlFor="notes">Notes (optional)</Label>
                        <Textarea
                            id="notes"
                            value={form.data.notes}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('notes', e.target.value)
                            }
                            placeholder="Anything worth noting about this run…"
                        />
                        {form.errors.notes && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.notes}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        onClick={submit}
                        disabled={form.processing || !form.data.device_id}
                    >
                        Create cycle
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

                                {form.errors.name}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>

                            }
                            placeholder="e.g. SKU or catalog code"
                        />
                        {form.errors.reference && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.reference}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <Label htmlFor="product-category">
                            Category (optional)
                        </Label>
                        <Select
                            value={form.data.category_id}
                            onValueChange={(value) =>
                                form.setData('category_id', value)

                                id="product-category"

                                        key={category.id}

                        </div>
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <Label htmlFor="product-min-threshold">

                            </Label>
                            <Input
                                id="product-min-threshold"
                                type="number"
                                min={0}
                                value={form.data.min_threshold}
                                onChange={(e) =>

                            />
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <Label htmlFor="product-barcode">
                            Barcode (optional)
                        </Label>
                        <Input
                            id="product-barcode"
                            value={form.data.barcode}

                            }
                        />
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Checkbox
                            id="product-sterilizable"
                            checked={form.data.is_sterilizable}
                            onCheckedChange={(checked) =>
                                form.setData(
                                    'is_sterilizable',
                                    checked === true,
                                )
                            }
                        />
                        <Label
                            htmlFor="product-sterilizable"
                            className="font-normal"
                        >
                            This product is sterilizable
                        </Label>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        onClick={submit}
                        disabled={
                            form.processing ||
                            !form.data.name.trim() ||
                            !form.data.reference.trim()
                        }
                    >
                        Add product
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

==================== ./resources/js/components/passkey-item.tsx ====================

import { KeyRound, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
    Dialog,
    DialogClose,
    DialogContent,
    DialogDescription,
    DialogFooter,
    DialogTitle,
    DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import type { Passkey } from '@/types/auth';

type Props = {
    passkey: Passkey;
    onDelete: (id: number, onError: () => void) => void;
};

export default function PasskeyItem({ passkey, onDelete }: Props) {
    const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false);

    const handleDelete = () => {
        setIsDeleting(true);
        onDelete(passkey.id, () => setIsDeleting(false));
    };

    return (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b p-4 last:border-b-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-muted">
                    <KeyRound className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground" />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        <p className="font-medium tracking-tight">
                            {passkey.name}
                        </p>
                        {passkey.authenticator && (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase ring-1 ring-border ring-inset">
                                {passkey.authenticator}
                            </span>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        Added {passkey.created_at_diff}
                        {passkey.last_used_at_diff && (
                            <>
                                <span className="mx-1 text-muted-foreground/50">
                                    /
                                </span>
                                Last used {passkey.last_used_at_diff}
                            </>
                        )}
                    </p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <Dialog>
                <DialogTrigger asChild>
                    <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        className="text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive"
                    >
                        <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                        <span className="sr-only">Remove</span>
                    </Button>
                </DialogTrigger>
                <DialogContent>
                    <DialogTitle>Remove passkey</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        Are you sure you want to remove the "{passkey.name}"
                        passkey? You will no longer be able to use it to sign
                        in.
                    </DialogDescription>
                    <DialogFooter className="gap-2">
                        <DialogClose asChild>
                            <Button variant="secondary">Cancel</Button>
                        </DialogClose>
                        <Button
                            variant="destructive"
                            onClick={handleDelete}
                            disabled={isDeleting}
                        >
                            {isDeleting ? 'Removing...' : 'Remove passkey'}
                        </Button>
                    </DialogFooter>
                </DialogContent>
            </Dialog>
        </div>
    );
}


==================== ./resources/js/components/passkey-register.tsx ====================

import { usePasskeyRegister } from '@laravel/passkeys/react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import InputError from '@/components/input-error';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';

type Props = {
    onSuccess: () => void;
};

export default function PasskeyRegistration({ onSuccess }: Props) {
    const [name, setName] = useState(() => {
        const ua = navigator.userAgent;

        const browser = [
            { pattern: /Edg|Edge/, name: 'Edge' },
            { pattern: /OPR|Opera|OPiOS/, name: 'Opera' },
            { pattern: /Firefox|FxiOS/, name: 'Firefox' },
            { pattern: /Chrome|CriOS/, name: 'Chrome' },
            { pattern: /Safari/, name: 'Safari' },
        ].find(({ pattern }) => pattern.test(ua))?.name;

        const os = [
            { pattern: /iPhone/, name: 'iPhone' },
            { pattern: /iPad|Macintosh(?=.*Mobile)/, name: 'iPad' },
            { pattern: /Android/, name: 'Android' },
            { pattern: /Mac/, name: 'Mac' },
            { pattern: /Windows/, name: 'Windows' },
        ].find(({ pattern }) => pattern.test(ua))?.name;

        return [browser, os].filter(Boolean).join(' on ') || '';
    });

    const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
    const { register, isLoading, error, isSupported } = usePasskeyRegister({
        onSuccess: () => {
            setName('');
            setShowForm(false);
            onSuccess();
        },
    });

    const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
        e.preventDefault();

        if (!name.trim()) {
            return;
        }

        await register(name);
    };

    const handleCancel = () => {
        setShowForm(false);
        setName('');
    };

    if (!isSupported) {
        return (
            <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Passkeys are not supported in this browser.
            </div>
        );
    }

    if (!showForm) {
        return (
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setShowForm(true)}>
                Add passkey
            </Button>
        );
    }

    return (
        <form
            onSubmit={handleSubmit}
            className="space-y-4 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/50 p-4"
        >
            <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Label htmlFor="passkey-name">Passkey name</Label>
                <Input
                    id="passkey-name"
                    type="text"
                    value={name}
                    onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g., MacBook Pro, iPhone"
                    className="mt-1 block w-full border-foreground/20"
                    autoFocus
                />
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    A name helps you identify this passkey later.
                </p>
            </div>

            {error && <InputError message={error} />}

            <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Button type="submit" disabled={isLoading || !name.trim()}>
                    {isLoading ? 'Registering...' : 'Register passkey'}
                </Button>
                <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={handleCancel}>
                    Cancel
                </Button>
            </div>
        </form>
    );
}


==================== ./resources/js/components/passkey-verify.tsx ====================

import type { UrlMethodPair } from '@inertiajs/core';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { usePasskeyVerify } from '@laravel/passkeys/react';
import { KeyRound } from 'lucide-react';
import InputError from '@/components/input-error';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Separator } from '@/components/ui/separator';
import { Spinner } from '@/components/ui/spinner';

type Props = {
    routes?: {
        options: UrlMethodPair;
        submit: UrlMethodPair;
    };
    label?: string;
    loadingLabel?: string;
    separator?: string;
};

export default function PasskeyVerify({
    routes,
    label,
    loadingLabel,
    separator,
}: Props = {}) {
    const { verify, isLoading, error, isSupported } = usePasskeyVerify({
        ...(routes && {
            routes: {
                options: routes.options.url,
                submit: routes.submit.url,
            },
        }),
        onSuccess: (response) => {
            router.visit(response.redirect ?? '/dashboard');
        },
    });

    if (!isSupported) {
        return null;
    }

    return (
        <>
            <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="outline"
                    className="w-full"
                    onClick={verify}
                    disabled={isLoading}
                >
                    {isLoading ? <Spinner /> : <KeyRound className="h-4 w-4" />}
                    {isLoading
                        ? (loadingLabel ?? 'Authenticating...')
                        : (label ?? 'Sign in with a passkey')}
                </Button>
                {error && (
                    <InputError message={error} className="text-center" />
                )}
            </div>

            <div className="relative my-6">
                <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center">
                    <Separator className="w-full" />
                </div>
                <div className="relative flex justify-center text-xs uppercase">
                    <span className="bg-background px-2 text-muted-foreground">
                        {separator ?? 'Or continue with email'}
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

==================== ./resources/js/components/recall-dialog.tsx ====================

import { useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
    Dialog,
    DialogContent,
    DialogDescription,
    DialogFooter,
    DialogHeader,
    DialogTitle,
    DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Label as FieldLabel } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import nonConformities from '@/routes/non-conformities';
import type { NonConformityBlastRadius } from '@/types';

/**
 * The recall flow's confirmation step (UI-23) — shows the blast radius
 * BEFORE confirming, computed server-side by the exact same
 * RaiseNonConformityAction the confirm button then executes
 * (previewBlastRadius), so the numbers here can never drift from what
 * actually happens on submit.
 */
export function RecallDialog({
    subjectType,
    subjectId,
    subjectLabel,
    blastRadius,
}: {
    subjectType: 'cycle' | 'label';
    subjectId: string;
    subjectLabel: string;
    blastRadius: NonConformityBlastRadius;
}) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const form = useForm({
        subject_type: subjectType,
        subject_id: subjectId,
        description: '',
    });

    function submit() {
        form.post(nonConformities.store().url, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                setOpen(false);
                form.reset();
            },
        });
    }

    const labelCount = blastRadius.labels_to_recall;
    const batchCount = blastRadius.batches_to_quarantine;
    const consequence =
        labelCount === 0
            ? 'Raise non-conformity'
            : `Recall ${labelCount} label${labelCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
                setOpen(next);

                if (!next) {
                    form.reset();
                    form.clearErrors();
                }
            }}
        >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm" variant="destructive">
                    Recall {subjectType}
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Recall {subjectLabel}?</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        {labelCount === 0 ? (
                            <>
                                No labels will be recalled — this{' '}
                                {subjectType} has none outstanding. This
                                still raises a permanent, audited
                                non-conformity record.
                            </>
                        ) : (
                            <>
                                This will recall{' '}
                                <strong>
                                    {labelCount} label
                                    {labelCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                                </strong>{' '}
                                and quarantine{' '}
                                <strong>
                                    {batchCount} batch
                                    {batchCount === 1 ? '' : 'es'}
                                </strong>
                                . This is permanent — corrected afterwards
                                only by resolving the non-conformity with a
                                note, never by editing history.
                            </>
                        )}
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="grid gap-2">
                    <FieldLabel htmlFor="nc-description">Reason</FieldLabel>
                    <Textarea
                        id="nc-description"
                        value={form.data.description}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                            form.setData('description', e.target.value)
                        }
                        placeholder="What went wrong?"
                    />
                    {form.errors.description && (
                        <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                            {form.errors.description}
                        </p>
                    )}
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="destructive"
                        onClick={submit}
                        disabled={
                            form.processing || !form.data.description.trim()
                        }
                    >
                        {consequence}
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}
