import { Head, Link, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { AlertCircle, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { NewCategoryDialog } from '@/components/new-category-dialog';
import { NewProductDialog } from '@/components/new-product-dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import products from '@/routes/products';
import type {
    CursorPaginated,
    Product,
    ProductCategory,
    ProductFilters,
} from '@/types';

export default function ProductsIndex({
    products: productsPage,
    categories,
    canCreate,
    filters,
}: {
    products: CursorPaginated<Product>;
    categories: ProductCategory[];
    canCreate: boolean;
    filters: ProductFilters;
}) {
    const [q, setQ] = useState(filters.name ?? '');
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
    const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        const removeStart = router.on('start', () => setIsLoading(true));
        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        const handle = setTimeout(() => {
            if (q !== (filters.name ?? '')) {
                applyFilters({ name: q || undefined });
            }
        }, 300);

        return () => clearTimeout(handle);
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, [q]);

    function applyFilters(next: Partial<ProductFilters>) {
        const merged: Record<string, string> = {
            ...filters,
            ...next,
        } as Record<string, string>;

        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(merged)) {
            if (!value || value === 'all') {
                delete merged[key];
            }
        }

        router.get(
            products.index().url,
            { filter: merged },
            {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                replace: true,
                only: ['products', 'filters'],
                onError: () => setLoadError(true),
                onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
            },
        );
    }

    function goTo(url: string | null) {
        if (!url) {
            return;
        }

        router.visit(url, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            only: ['products', 'filters'],
            onError: () => setLoadError(true),
            onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
        });
    }

    function retry() {
        setLoadError(false);
        router.reload({ only: ['products', 'filters'] });
    }

    const hasFilters = Object.keys(filters).length > 0;

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Products" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                            Products
                        </h1>
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            Everything stocked and tracked in inventory.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    {canCreate && (
                        <div className="no-print flex gap-2">
                            <NewCategoryDialog categories={categories} />
                            <NewProductDialog categories={categories} />
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>

                {loadError && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-md border border-status-danger-fg/30 bg-status-danger-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-status-danger-fg">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <AlertCircle className="size-4" />
                            Couldn&apos;t load products — the request failed.
                            Your filters weren&apos;t lost.
                        </span>
                        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={retry}>
                            Retry
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                )}

                <div className="no-print flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Input
                        value={q}
                        onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Search by name…"
                        className="h-8 w-48"
                        aria-label="Search by name"
                    />

                    <Select
                        value={filters.category_id ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ category_id: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-44">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Category" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All categories</SelectItem>
                            {categories.map((category) => (
                                <SelectItem
                                    key={category.id}
                                    value={category.id}
                                >
                                    {category.name}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <Select
                        value={filters.is_sterilizable ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ is_sterilizable: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-44">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Sterilizable" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All products</SelectItem>
                            <SelectItem value="1">Sterilizable</SelectItem>
                            <SelectItem value="0">
                                Not sterilizable
                            </SelectItem>
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    {hasFilters && (
                        <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8"
                            onClick={() => {
                                setQ('');
                                router.get(
                                    products.index().url,
                                    {},
                                    {
                                        preserveState: true,
                                        preserveScroll: true,
                                        replace: true,
                                        only: ['products', 'filters'],
                                    },
                                );
                            }}
                        >
                            <X className="size-3.5" />
                            Clear filters
                        </Button>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead>Name</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Reference</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Category</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-24">Unit</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-32">
                                    Sterilizable
                                </TableHead>
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {isLoading &&
                                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={`skeleton-${i}`}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map(
                                            (__, j) => (
                                                <TableCell key={j}>
                                                    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full max-w-32" />
                                                </TableCell>
                                            ),
                                        )}
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                !loadError &&
                                productsPage.data.length === 0 && (
                                    <TableRow>
                                        <TableCell
                                            colSpan={5}
                                            className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground"
                                        >
                                            {hasFilters
                                                ? 'No products match these filters.'
                                                : canCreate
                                                    ? 'No products have been added yet — add one to get started.'
                                                    : 'No products have been added yet.'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                )}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                productsPage.data.map((product) => {
                                    const category = categories.find(
                                        (c) => c.id === product.category_id,
                                    );

                                    return (
                                        <TableRow
                                            key={product.id}
                                            className="h-10 cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/40"
                                            onClick={() =>
                                                router.visit(
                                                    products.show(product.id)
                                                        .url,
                                                )
                                            }
                                        >
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Link
                                                    href={
                                                        products.show(
                                                            product.id,
                                                        ).url
                                                    }
                                                    className="hover:underline"
                                                    onClick={(e) =>
                                                        e.stopPropagation()
                                                    }
                                                >
                                                    {product.name}
                                                </Link>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                                {product.reference}
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                {category?.name ?? '—'}
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                {product.unit}
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                {product.is_sterilizable
                                                    ? 'Yes'
                                                    : 'No'}
                                            </TableCell>
                                        </TableRow>
                                    );
                                })}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!productsPage.prev_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(productsPage.prev_page_url)}
                    >
                        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
                        Previous
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!productsPage.next_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(productsPage.next_page_url)}
                    >
                        Next
                        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

ProductsIndex.layout = {
    breadcrumbs: [
        { title: 'Dashboard', href: dashboard() },
        { title: 'Products', href: products.index() },
    ],
};


==================== ./resources/js/pages/catalog/products/show.tsx ====================

import { Head, Link, router, useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Mono } from '@/components/mono';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import {
    Dialog,
    DialogContent,
    DialogDescription,
    DialogFooter,
    DialogHeader,
    DialogTitle,
    DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import products from '@/routes/products';
import type { Option, Product } from '@/types';

function EditProductDialog({ product }: { product: Product }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const form = useForm({
        name: product.name,
        reference: product.reference,
        unit: product.unit,
        min_threshold: product.min_threshold,
        is_sterilizable: product.is_sterilizable,
        barcode: product.barcode ?? '',
    });

    function submit() {
        form.patch(products.update(product.id).url, {
            onSuccess: () => setOpen(false),
        });
    }

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
                setOpen(next);

                if (!next) {
                    form.clearErrors();
                }
            }}
        >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                    Edit
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Edit {product.name}</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        Update this product&apos;s details.
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="grid gap-4">
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <Label htmlFor="edit-product-name">Name</Label>
                        <Input
                            id="edit-product-name"
                            value={form.data.name}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('name', e.target.value)
                            }
                        />
                        {form.errors.name && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.name}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <Label htmlFor="edit-product-reference">
                            Reference
                        </Label>
                        <Input
                            id="edit-product-reference"
                            value={form.data.reference}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('reference', e.target.value)
                            }
                        />
                        {form.errors.reference && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.reference}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <Label htmlFor="edit-product-unit">Unit</Label>
                            <Input
                                id="edit-product-unit"
                                value={form.data.unit}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                    form.setData('unit', e.target.value)
                                }
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <Label htmlFor="edit-product-min-threshold">
                                Low-stock threshold
                            </Label>
                            <Input
                                id="edit-product-min-threshold"
                                type="number"
                                min={0}
                                value={form.data.min_threshold}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                    form.setData(
                                        'min_threshold',
                                        Number(e.target.value),
                                    )
                                }
                            />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <Label htmlFor="edit-product-barcode">Barcode</Label>
                        <Input
                            id="edit-product-barcode"
                            value={form.data.barcode}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('barcode', e.target.value)
                            }
                        />
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Checkbox
                            id="edit-product-sterilizable"
                            checked={form.data.is_sterilizable}
                            onCheckedChange={(checked) =>
                                form.setData(
                                    'is_sterilizable',
                                    checked === true,
                                )
                            }
                        />
                        <Label
                            htmlFor="edit-product-sterilizable"
                            className="font-normal"
                        >
                            This product is sterilizable
                        </Label>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button onClick={submit} disabled={form.processing}>
                        Save changes
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

function DeleteProductDialog({ product }: { product: Product }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

    function confirmDelete() {
        router.delete(products.destroy(product.id).url);
    }

    return (
        <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm" variant="destructive">
                    Delete
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Delete {product.name}?</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        This removes it from the active catalog. Past stock
                        movements and cycle references keep pointing to it —
                        nothing else is affected.
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>
                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="destructive" onClick={confirmDelete}>
                        Delete product
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

    );

==================== ./resources/js/pages/compliance/audit-log/index.tsx ====================

import { Head, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Mono } from '@/components/mono';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
    Dialog,
    DialogContent,
    DialogHeader,
    DialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/format';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import auditLog from '@/routes/audit-log';
import type {
    AuditEvent,
    AuditEventFilters,
    CursorPaginated,
    Option,
} from '@/types';

function formatValue(value: unknown): string {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) {
        return '—';
    }

    if (typeof value === 'object') {
        return JSON.stringify(value);
    }

    return String(value);
}

/** Every key present in either side, old -> new, changed ones highlighted. */
function ValueDiff({ event }: { event: AuditEvent }) {
    const { old_values: oldValues, new_values: newValues } = event;

    if (!oldValues && !newValues) {
        return (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                No field values were recorded for this event.
            </p>
        );
    }

    const keys = Array.from(
        new Set([
            ...Object.keys(oldValues ?? {}),
            ...Object.keys(newValues ?? {}),
        ]),
    );

    return (
        <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
            <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                    <TableRow>
                        <TableHead>Field</TableHead>
                        {oldValues && <TableHead>Before</TableHead>}
                        <TableHead>{oldValues ? 'After' : 'Recorded'}</TableHead>
                    </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                    {keys.map((key) => {
                        const oldVal = oldValues?.[key];
                        const newVal = newValues?.[key];
                        const changed =
                            oldValues &&
                            newValues &&
                            JSON.stringify(oldVal) !== JSON.stringify(newVal);

                        return (
                            <TableRow key={key}>
                                <TableCell className="font-medium">
                                    {key}
                                </TableCell>
                                {oldValues && (
                                    <TableCell
                                        className={
                                            changed
                                                ? 'text-status-danger-fg line-through'
                                                : 'text-muted-foreground'
                                        }
                                    >
                                        <Mono className="text-xs">
                                            {formatValue(oldVal)}
                                        </Mono>
                                    </TableCell>
                                )}
                                <TableCell
                                    className={
                                        changed
                                            ? 'font-medium text-status-success-fg'
                                            : undefined
                                    }
                                >
                                    <Mono className="text-xs">
                                        {formatValue(newVal ?? oldVal)}
                                    </Mono>
                                </TableCell>
                            </TableRow>
                        );
                    })}
                </TableBody>
            </Table>
        </div>
    );
}

function AuditEventDetailsDialog({ event }: { event: AuditEvent }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

    return (
        <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
                Details
            </Button>
            <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg">
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>{event.action}</DialogTitle>
                </DialogHeader>

                <dl className="grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-sm">
                    <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Actor</dt>
                    <dd>{event.actor_label_snapshot ?? '—'}</dd>
                    <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Subject</dt>
                    <dd>
                        <Mono className="text-xs">
                            {event.subject_type.split('\\').pop()} ·{' '}
                            {event.subject_id}
                        </Mono>
                    </dd>
                    <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Occurred</dt>
                    <dd>
                        <Mono>{formatDateTime(event.occurred_at)}</Mono>
                    </dd>
                    {event.reason && (
                        <>
                            <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Reason</dt>
                            <dd>{event.reason}</dd>
                        </>
                    )}
                </dl>

                <ValueDiff event={event} />
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

export default function AuditLogIndex({
    events: eventsPage,
    actors,
    actions,
    subjectTypes,
    filters,
}: {
    events: CursorPaginated<AuditEvent>;
    actors: Option[];
    actions: string[];
    subjectTypes: Option[];
    filters: AuditEventFilters;
}) {
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        const removeStart = router.on('start', () => setIsLoading(true));
        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };
    }, []);

    function applyFilters(next: Partial<AuditEventFilters>) {
        const merged: Record<string, string> = {
            ...filters,
            ...next,
        } as Record<string, string>;

        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(merged)) {
            if (!value || value === 'all') {
                delete merged[key];
            }
        }

        router.get(
            auditLog.index().url,
            { filter: merged },
            {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                replace: true,
                only: ['events', 'filters'],
            },
        );
    }

    function goTo(url: string | null) {
        if (!url) {
            return;
        }

        router.visit(url, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            only: ['events', 'filters'],
        });
    }

    const hasFilters = Object.keys(filters).length > 0;

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Audit log" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div>
                    <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                        Audit log
                    </h1>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        Every sensitive action, append-only — who, what,
                        and the exact field values before and after.
                    </p>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Select
                        value={filters.actor_id ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ actor_id: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-40">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Actor" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All actors</SelectItem>
                            {actors.map((actor) => (
                                <SelectItem key={actor.id} value={actor.id}>
                                    {actor.label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <Select
                        value={filters.action ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ action: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-44">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Action" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All actions</SelectItem>
                            {actions.map((action) => (
                                <SelectItem key={action} value={action}>
                                    {action}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <Select
                        value={filters.subject_type ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ subject_type: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-40">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Subject" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">
                                All subjects
                            </SelectItem>
                            {subjectTypes.map((type) => (
                                <SelectItem key={type.id} value={type.id}>
                                    {type.label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Input
                            type="date"
                            value={filters.from ?? ''}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                applyFilters({
                                    from: e.target.value || undefined,
                                })
                            }
                            className="h-8 w-36"
                            aria-label="Occurred from"
                        />
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            to
                        </span>
                        <Input
                            type="date"
                            value={filters.to ?? ''}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                applyFilters({
                                    to: e.target.value || undefined,
                                })
                            }
                            className="h-8 w-36"
                            aria-label="Occurred to"
                        />
                    </div>

                    {hasFilters && (
                        <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8"
                            onClick={() =>
                                router.get(
                                    auditLog.index().url,
                                    {},
                                    {
                                        preserveState: true,
                                        preserveScroll: true,
                                        replace: true,
                                        only: ['events', 'filters'],
                                    },
                                )
                            }
                        >
                            <X className="size-3.5" />
                            Clear filters
                        </Button>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead className="w-44">
                                    Occurred
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Actor</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Action</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Subject</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-24" />
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {isLoading &&
                                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={`skeleton-${i}`}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map(
                                            (__, j) => (
                                                <TableCell key={j}>
                                                    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full max-w-32" />
                                                </TableCell>
                                            ),
                                        )}
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                            {!isLoading && eventsPage.data.length === 0 && (
                                <TableRow>
                                    <TableCell
                                        colSpan={5}
                                        className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground"
                                    >
                                        {hasFilters
                                            ? 'No audit events match these filters.'
                                            : 'No audit events recorded yet.'}
                                    </TableCell>
                                </TableRow>
                            )}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                eventsPage.data.map((event) => (
                                    <TableRow key={event.id} className="h-10">
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Mono className="text-xs">
                                                {formatDateTime(
                                                    event.occurred_at,
                                                )}
                                            </Mono>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            {event.actor_label_snapshot ??
                                                '—'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Mono className="text-xs">
                                                {event.action}
                                            </Mono>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                            {event.subject_type
                                                .split('\\')
                                                .pop()}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <AuditEventDetailsDialog
                                                event={event}
                                            />
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!eventsPage.prev_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(eventsPage.prev_page_url)}
                    >
                        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
                        Previous
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!eventsPage.next_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(eventsPage.next_page_url)}
                    >
                        Next
                        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

==================== ./resources/js/pages/compliance/non-conformities/index.tsx ====================

import { Head, Link, router, useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Mono } from '@/components/mono';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/status-badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
    Dialog,
    DialogContent,
    DialogDescription,
    DialogFooter,
    DialogHeader,
    DialogTitle,
    DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Label as FieldLabel } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/format';
import { nonConformityState } from '@/lib/status';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import cycles from '@/routes/cycles';
import labels from '@/routes/labels';
import nonConformities from '@/routes/non-conformities';
import type {
    CursorPaginated,
    NonConformity,
    NonConformityFilters,
} from '@/types';

const SUBJECT_TYPE_OPTIONS = ['Cycle', 'Label'];

function ResolveDialog({ nonConformity }: { nonConformity: NonConformity }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const form = useForm({ resolution: '' });

    function submit() {
        form.post(nonConformities.resolve(nonConformity.id).url, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                setOpen(false);
                form.reset();
            },
        });
    }

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
                setOpen(next);

                if (!next) {
                    form.reset();
                    form.clearErrors();
                }
            }}
        >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                    Resolve
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Resolve this non-conformity</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        This closes the record with a note — it does not
                        un-recall any label or un-quarantine any batch.
                        That needs its own deliberate follow-up once
                        someone has actually verified it&apos;s safe.
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="grid gap-2">
                    <FieldLabel htmlFor="resolution">Resolution</FieldLabel>
                    <Textarea
                        id="resolution"
                        value={form.data.resolution}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                            form.setData('resolution', e.target.value)
                        }
                        placeholder="What was done to address this?"
                    />
                    {form.errors.resolution && (
                        <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                            {form.errors.resolution}
                        </p>
                    )}
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        onClick={submit}
                        disabled={
                            form.processing || !form.data.resolution.trim()
                        }
                    >
                        Resolve
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

function subjectHref(nonConformity: NonConformity): string {
    return nonConformity.subject_type === 'Cycle'
        ? cycles.show(nonConformity.subject_id).url
        : labels.show(nonConformity.subject_id).url;
}

export default function NonConformitiesIndex({
    nonConformities: nonConformitiesPage,
    canManage,
    filters,
}: {
    nonConformities: CursorPaginated<NonConformity>;
    canManage: boolean;
    filters: NonConformityFilters;
}) {
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        const removeStart = router.on('start', () => setIsLoading(true));
        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };
    }, []);

    function applyFilters(next: Partial<NonConformityFilters>) {
        const merged: Record<string, string> = {
            ...filters,
            ...next,
        } as Record<string, string>;

        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(merged)) {
            if (!value || value === 'all') {
                delete merged[key];
            }
        }

        router.get(
            nonConformities.index().url,
            { filter: merged },
            {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                replace: true,
                only: ['nonConformities', 'filters'],
            },
        );
    }

    function goTo(url: string | null) {
        if (!url) {
            return;
        }

        router.visit(url, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            only: ['nonConformities', 'filters'],
        });
    }

    const hasFilters = Object.keys(filters).length > 0;

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Non-conformities" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div>
                    <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                        Non-conformities
                    </h1>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        Every recall and quarantine, with why — corrections
                        here are audited records, never silent edits.
                    </p>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Select
                        value={filters.subject_type ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ subject_type: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-36">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Subject" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All subjects</SelectItem>
                            {SUBJECT_TYPE_OPTIONS.map((type) => (
                                <SelectItem key={type} value={type}>
                                    {type}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead className="w-24">
                                    Subject
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Description</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-44">
                                    Raised
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-32">
                                    Status
                                </TableHead>
                                {canManage && (
                                    <TableHead className="w-24" />
                                )}
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {isLoading &&
                                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={`skeleton-${i}`}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        {Array.from({
                                            length: canManage ? 5 : 4,
                                        }).map((__, j) => (
                                            <TableCell key={j}>
                                                <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full max-w-32" />
                                            </TableCell>
                                        ))}
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                nonConformitiesPage.data.length === 0 && (
                                    <TableRow>
                                        <TableCell
                                            colSpan={canManage ? 5 : 4}
                                            className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground"
                                        >
                                            {hasFilters
                                                ? 'No non-conformities match this filter.'
                                                : 'No non-conformities have been raised — good sign.'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                )}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                nonConformitiesPage.data.map((nc) => {
                                    const resolved = nc.resolved_at !== null;
                                    const status = resolved
                                        ? nonConformityState.resolved
                                        : nonConformityState.open;

                                    return (
                                        <TableRow
                                            key={nc.id}
                                            className="h-10"

                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Link

                                                    className="hover:underline"
                                                >
                                                    {nc.subject_type}
                                                </Link>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <div>
                                                    {nc.description}

                                                            Resolved:{' '}
                                                            {nc.resolution}
                                                        </p>
                                                    )}
                                                </div>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Mono className="text-xs">
                                                    {formatDateTime(
                                                        nc.raised_at,
                                                    )}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <StatusBadge
                                                    status={status}
                                                />
                                            </TableCell>
                                            {canManage && (
                                                <TableCell>
                                                    {!resolved && (
                                                        <ResolveDialog
                                                            nonConformity={
                                                                nc
                                                            }
                                                        />
                                                    )}
                                                </TableCell>
                                            )}
                                        </TableRow>
                                    );
                                })}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!nonConformitiesPage.prev_page_url}
                        onClick={() =>
                            goTo(nonConformitiesPage.prev_page_url)
                        }
                    >
                        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
                        Previous
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!nonConformitiesPage.next_page_url}
                        onClick={() =>
                            goTo(nonConformitiesPage.next_page_url)
                        }
                    >
                        Next
                        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />

}

==================== ./resources/js/pages/dashboard.tsx ====================

import { Head, router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
    AttentionQueue,
    AttentionQueueSkeleton,
} from '@/components/dashboard/attention-queue';
import {
    OnboardingChecklist,
    OnboardingChecklistSkeleton,
} from '@/components/dashboard/onboarding-checklist';
import {
    RecentProcedures,
    RecentProceduresSkeleton,
} from '@/components/dashboard/recent-procedures';
import {
    TodayGlance,
    TodayGlanceSkeleton,
} from '@/components/dashboard/today-glance';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import type { DashboardData } from '@/types';

/**
 * UI-30: "what needs me today," not an analytics page — replaces the
 * starter-kit placeholder cards. The Refresh button is the one client-
 * triggered reload this page has (no filters to drive one otherwise); it
 * also lets someone see past BuildDashboardAction's 60s cache TTL sooner
 * after acting on something. Each section shows its own skeleton while a
 * reload is in flight and its own error state if its data failed to load
 * server-side (see BuildDashboardAction) — one broken query never blanks
 * the rest of the page.
 */
export default function Dashboard({
    dashboard: data,
}: {
    dashboard: DashboardData;
}) {
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
    const { auth } = usePage().props;

    useEffect(() => {
        const removeStart = router.on('start', () => setIsLoading(true));
        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };
    }, []);

    const showRecentProcedures =
        auth.role === 'practitioner' || data.my_recent_procedures.length > 0;

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Dashboard" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-6 p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                            Dashboard
                        </h1>
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            What needs you today.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={() => router.reload()}
                        disabled={isLoading}
                    >
                        <RefreshCw
                            className={
                                isLoading ? 'size-3.5 animate-spin' : 'size-3.5'
                            }
                        />
                        Refresh
                    </Button>
                </div>

                {data.is_new_practice ? (
                    isLoading ? (
                        <OnboardingChecklistSkeleton />
                    ) : (
                        <OnboardingChecklist steps={data.onboarding_steps} />
                    )
                ) : (
                    <>
                        <section className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                            <h2 className="sr-only">Attention queue</h2>
                            {isLoading ? (
                                <AttentionQueueSkeleton />
                            ) : (
                                <AttentionQueue
                                    cards={data.attention_cards}
                                    role={auth.role}
                                />
                            )}
                        </section>

                        <section className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                                Today at a glance
                            </h2>
                            {isLoading ? (
                                <TodayGlanceSkeleton />
                            ) : (
                                <TodayGlance
                                    rows={data.today_cycles}
                                    error={data.today_cycles_error}
                                />
                            )}
                        </section>

                        {showRecentProcedures && (
                            <section className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                                <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                                    Your recent procedures
                                </h2>
                                {isLoading ? (
                                    <RecentProceduresSkeleton />
                                ) : (
                                    <RecentProcedures
                                        procedures={data.my_recent_procedures}
                                        error={data.my_recent_procedures_error}
                                    />
                                )}
                            </section>
                        )}
                    </>
                )}
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

Dashboard.layout = {
    breadcrumbs: [{ title: 'Dashboard', href: dashboard() }],
};


==================== ./resources/js/pages/equipment/devices/index.tsx ====================

import { Head, Link, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { AlertCircle, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { NewDeviceDialog } from '@/components/new-device-dialog';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/status-badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { deviceKindLabel, deviceStatus } from '@/lib/status';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import devices from '@/routes/devices';
import type { CursorPaginated, Device, DeviceFilters, Option } from '@/types';

const STATUS_OPTIONS = Object.keys(deviceStatus);
const KIND_OPTIONS = Object.keys(deviceKindLabel);

export default function DevicesIndex({
    devices: devicesPage,
    sites,
    canCreate,
    filters,
}: {
    devices: CursorPaginated<Device>;
    sites: Option[];
    canCreate: boolean;
    filters: DeviceFilters;
}) {
    const [q, setQ] = useState(filters.name ?? '');
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
    const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        const removeStart = router.on('start', () => setIsLoading(true));
        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        const handle = setTimeout(() => {
            if (q !== (filters.name ?? '')) {
                applyFilters({ name: q || undefined });
            }
        }, 300);

        return () => clearTimeout(handle);
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, [q]);

    function applyFilters(next: Partial<DeviceFilters>) {
        const merged: Record<string, string> = {
            ...filters,
            ...next,
        } as Record<string, string>;

        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(merged)) {
            if (!value || value === 'all') {
                delete merged[key];
            }
        }

        router.get(
            devices.index().url,
            { filter: merged },
            {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                replace: true,
                only: ['devices', 'filters'],
                onError: () => setLoadError(true),
                onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
            },
        );
    }

    function goTo(url: string | null) {
        if (!url) {
            return;
        }

        router.visit(url, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            only: ['devices', 'filters'],
            onError: () => setLoadError(true),
            onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
        });
    }

    function retry() {
        setLoadError(false);
        router.reload({ only: ['devices', 'filters'] });
    }

    const hasFilters = Object.keys(filters).length > 0;

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Devices" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                            Devices
                        </h1>
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            Every autoclave, washer-disinfector, sealer and
                            other piece of sterilization equipment.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    {canCreate && (
                        <div className="no-print">
                            <NewDeviceDialog sites={sites} />
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>

                {loadError && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-md border border-status-danger-fg/30 bg-status-danger-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-status-danger-fg">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <AlertCircle className="size-4" />
                            Couldn&apos;t load devices — the request failed.
                            Your filters weren&apos;t lost.
                        </span>
                        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={retry}>
                            Retry
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                )}

                <div className="no-print flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Input
                        value={q}
                        onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Search by name…"
                        className="h-8 w-48"
                        aria-label="Search by name"
                    />

                    <Select
                        value={filters.status ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ status: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-40">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Status" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All statuses</SelectItem>
                            {STATUS_OPTIONS.map((status) => (
                                <SelectItem key={status} value={status}>
                                    {deviceStatus[status].label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <Select
                        value={filters.kind ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ kind: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-44">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Kind" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All kinds</SelectItem>
                            {KIND_OPTIONS.map((kind) => (
                                <SelectItem key={kind} value={kind}>
                                    {deviceKindLabel[kind]}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <Select
                        value={filters.site_id ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ site_id: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-44">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Site" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All sites</SelectItem>
                            {sites.map((site) => (
                                <SelectItem key={site.id} value={site.id}>
                                    {site.label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    {hasFilters && (
                        <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8"
                            onClick={() => {
                                setQ('');
                                router.get(
                                    devices.index().url,
                                    {},
                                    {
                                        preserveState: true,
                                        preserveScroll: true,
                                        replace: true,
                                        only: ['devices', 'filters'],
                                    },
                                );
                            }}
                        >
                            <X className="size-3.5" />
                            Clear filters
                        </Button>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead>Name</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Site</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Kind</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-32">Status</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Serial number</TableHead>
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {isLoading &&
                                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={`skeleton-${i}`}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map(
                                            (__, j) => (
                                                <TableCell key={j}>
                                                    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full max-w-32" />
                                                </TableCell>
                                            ),
                                        )}
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                !loadError &&
                                devicesPage.data.length === 0 && (
                                    <TableRow>
                                        <TableCell
                                            colSpan={5}
                                            className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground"
                                        >
                                            {hasFilters
                                                ? 'No devices match these filters.'
                                                : canCreate
                                                    ? 'No devices have been registered yet — add one to get started.'
                                                    : 'No devices have been registered yet.'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                )}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                devicesPage.data.map((device) => {
                                    const site = sites.find(
                                        (s) => s.id === device.site_id,
                                    );
                                    const status =
                                        deviceStatus[device.status] ??
                                        deviceStatus.active;

                                    return (
                                        <TableRow
                                            key={device.id}
                                            className="h-10 cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/40"
                                            onClick={() =>
                                                router.visit(
                                                    devices.show(device.id)
                                                        .url,
                                                )
                                            }
                                        >
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Link
                                                    href={
                                                        devices.show(
                                                            device.id,
                                                        ).url
                                                    }
                                                    className="hover:underline"
                                                    onClick={(e) =>
                                                        e.stopPropagation()
                                                    }
                                                >
                                                    {device.name}
                                                </Link>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                {site?.label ?? '—'}
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                {deviceKindLabel[
                                                    device.kind
                                                ] ?? device.kind}
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <StatusBadge status={status} />
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                                {device.serial_number}
                                            </TableCell>
                                        </TableRow>
                                    );
                                })}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!devicesPage.prev_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(devicesPage.prev_page_url)}
                    >
                        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
                        Previous
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!devicesPage.next_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(devicesPage.next_page_url)}
                    >
                        Next
                        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

    ],
};
