const MAINTENANCE_KINDS = Object.keys(maintenanceKindLabel);

function defaultDateTimeLocal(): string {
    const now = new Date();
    now.setMinutes(now.getMinutes() - now.getTimezoneOffset());

    return now.toISOString().slice(0, 16);
}

/**
 * The most recent record that actually set a next-due date — not
 * necessarily the single latest record, since e.g. a corrective repair
 * visit might not reset the scheduled date a preventive visit set earlier.
 */
function nextDueStatus(records: MaintenanceRecord[]) {
    const nextDueAt = records.find((r) => r.next_due_at)?.next_due_at;

    if (!nextDueAt) {
        return null;
    }

    const isOverdue = new Date(nextDueAt) < new Date();
    const date = nextDueAt.slice(0, 10);

    return isOverdue
        ? { tone: 'danger' as const, label: `Overdue since ${date}`, icon: XCircle }
        : { tone: 'pending' as const, label: `Next due ${date}`, icon: Clock };
}

function RecordMaintenanceForm({ device }: { device: Device }) {
    const form = useForm({
        kind: 'preventive',
        technician: '',
        performed_at: defaultDateTimeLocal(),
        next_due_at: '',
        description: '',
    });

    function submit(e: FormEvent) {
        e.preventDefault();
        form.post(deviceMaintenanceRecords.store(device.id).url, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () =>
                form.setData({
                    kind: 'preventive',
                    technician: '',
                    performed_at: defaultDateTimeLocal(),
                    next_due_at: '',
                    description: '',
                }),
        });
    }

    return (
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-2 border-t pt-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2">
                <div>
                    <Label
                        htmlFor="maintenance-kind"
                        className="mb-1 block text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                    >
                        Kind
                    </Label>
                    <Select
                        value={form.data.kind}
                        onValueChange={(value) => form.setData('kind', value)}
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger id="maintenance-kind" className="h-8 w-36">
                            <SelectValue />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            {MAINTENANCE_KINDS.map((kind) => (
                                <SelectItem key={kind} value={kind}>
                                    {maintenanceKindLabel[kind]}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <Label
                        htmlFor="maintenance-technician"
                        className="mb-1 block text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                    >
                        Technician
                    </Label>
                    <Input
                        id="maintenance-technician"
                        value={form.data.technician}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                            form.setData('technician', e.target.value)
                        }
                        className="h-8 w-40"
                    />
                </div>
                <div>
                    <Label
                        htmlFor="maintenance-performed-at"
                        className="mb-1 block text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                    >
                        Performed at
                    </Label>
                    <Input
                        id="maintenance-performed-at"
                        type="datetime-local"
                        value={form.data.performed_at}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                            form.setData('performed_at', e.target.value)
                        }
                        className="h-8"
                    />
                </div>
                <div>
                    <Label
                        htmlFor="maintenance-next-due"
                        className="mb-1 block text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                    >
                        Next due (optional)
                    </Label>
                    <Input
                        id="maintenance-next-due"
                        type="datetime-local"
                        value={form.data.next_due_at}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                            form.setData('next_due_at', e.target.value)
                        }
                        className="h-8"
                    />
                </div>
                <Button
                    type="submit"
                    size="sm"
                    disabled={form.processing}
                >
                    Record maintenance
                </Button>
            </div>
            <Textarea
                value={form.data.description}
                onChange={(e) => form.setData('description', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Notes (optional)"
                aria-label="Maintenance notes"
                className="min-h-16"
            />
            {form.errors.next_due_at && (
                <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                    {form.errors.next_due_at}
                </p>
            )}
        </form>
    );
}

export default function DeviceShow({
    device,
    site,
    programs,
    maintenanceRecords,
    canManage,
}: {
    device: Device;
    site: Option;
    programs: DeviceProgram[];
    maintenanceRecords: MaintenanceRecord[];
    canManage: boolean;
}) {
    const status = deviceStatus[device.status] ?? deviceStatus.active;
    const dueStatus = nextDueStatus(maintenanceRecords);

    return (
        <>
            <Head title={device.name} />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div>
                    <Link
                        href={devices.index().url}
                        className="mb-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                    >
                        <ArrowLeft className="size-3.5" />
                        Back to devices
                    </Link>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                                {device.name}
                            </h1>
                            <StatusBadge status={status} />
                            {dueStatus && <StatusBadge status={dueStatus} />}
                        </div>
                        {canManage && <EditDeviceDialog device={device} />}
                    </div>
                </div>

                <Card>
                    <CardContent className="py-4">
                        <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-6 gap-y-2 text-sm md:grid-cols-3">
                            <div>
                                <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                    Site
                                </dt>
                                <dd>{site.label}</dd>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                    Kind
                                </dt>
                                <dd>
                                    {deviceKindLabel[device.kind] ??

                                        Notes

                                    <dd>{device.notes}</dd>
                                </div>
                            )}
                        </dl>

                        <CardTitle className="text-sm">Programs</CardTitle>

                            </p>

                                    </TableRow>

                                <TableBody>
                                    {maintenanceRecords.map((record) => (

                                                        : '—'}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                                {record.description ?? '—'}
                                            </TableCell>
                                        </TableRow>

import { Head, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { AlertCircle, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Mono } from '@/components/mono';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/status-badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/format';
import { alertSeverity, alertState, alertTypeLabel } from '@/lib/status';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import alerts from '@/routes/alerts';
import type { Alert, AlertFilters, CursorPaginated } from '@/types';

const TYPE_OPTIONS = Object.keys(alertTypeLabel);
const SEVERITY_OPTIONS = Object.keys(alertSeverity);
const STATE_OPTIONS = Object.keys(alertState);

export default function AlertsIndex({
    alerts: alertsPage,
    canManage,
    filters,
}: {
    alerts: CursorPaginated<Alert>;
    canManage: boolean;
    filters: AlertFilters;
}) {
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
    const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        const removeStart = router.on('start', () => setIsLoading(true));
        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };
    }, []);

    function applyFilters(next: Partial<AlertFilters>) {
        const merged: Record<string, string> = {
            ...filters,
            ...next,
        } as Record<string, string>;

        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(merged)) {
            if (!value || value === 'all') {
                delete merged[key];
            }
        }

        router.get(
            alerts.index().url,
            { filter: merged },
            {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                replace: true,
                only: ['alerts', 'filters'],
                onError: () => setLoadError(true),
                onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
            },
        );
    }

    function goTo(url: string | null) {
        if (!url) {
            return;
        }

        router.visit(url, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            only: ['alerts', 'filters'],
            onError: () => setLoadError(true),
            onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
        });
    }

    function retry() {
        setLoadError(false);
        router.reload({ only: ['alerts', 'filters'] });
    }

    const hasFilters = Object.keys(filters).length > 0;

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Alerts" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div>
                    <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                        Alerts
                    </h1>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        Low stock, near-expiry, expired batches and failed
                        control tests, tenant-wide.
                    </p>
                </div>

                {loadError && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-md border border-status-danger-fg/30 bg-status-danger-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-status-danger-fg">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <AlertCircle className="size-4" />
                            Couldn&apos;t load alerts — the request failed.
                            Your filters weren&apos;t lost.
                        </span>
                        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={retry}>
                            Retry
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                )}

                <div className="no-print flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Select
                        value={filters.type ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ type: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-40">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Type" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All types</SelectItem>
                            {TYPE_OPTIONS.map((type) => (
                                <SelectItem key={type} value={type}>
                                    {alertTypeLabel[type]}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <Select
                        value={filters.severity ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ severity: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-36">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Severity" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">
                                All severities
                            </SelectItem>
                            {SEVERITY_OPTIONS.map((severity) => (
                                <SelectItem key={severity} value={severity}>
                                    {alertSeverity[severity].label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <Select
                        value={filters.state ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ state: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-36">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Status" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All statuses</SelectItem>
                            {STATE_OPTIONS.map((state) => (
                                <SelectItem key={state} value={state}>
                                    {alertState[state].label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    {hasFilters && (
                        <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8"
                            onClick={() =>
                                router.get(
                                    alerts.index().url,
                                    {},
                                    {
                                        preserveState: true,
                                        preserveScroll: true,
                                        replace: true,
                                        only: ['alerts', 'filters'],
                                    },
                                )
                            }
                        >
                            <X className="size-3.5" />
                            Clear filters
                        </Button>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead className="w-32">Type</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-28">
                                    Severity
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Message</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-44">
                                    Raised
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-32">
                                    Status
                                </TableHead>
                                {canManage && (
                                    <TableHead className="w-28" />
                                )}
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {isLoading &&
                                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={`skeleton-${i}`}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        {Array.from({
                                            length: canManage ? 6 : 5,
                                        }).map((__, j) => (
                                            <TableCell key={j}>
                                                <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full max-w-32" />
                                            </TableCell>
                                        ))}
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                !loadError &&
                                alertsPage.data.length === 0 && (
                                    <TableRow>
                                        <TableCell
                                            colSpan={canManage ? 6 : 5}
                                            className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground"
                                        >
                                            {hasFilters
                                                ? 'No alerts match these filters.'
                                                : 'No alerts — everything is within range.'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                )}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                alertsPage.data.map((alert) => (
                                    <TableRow key={alert.id} className="h-10">
                                        <TableCell>
                                            {alertTypeLabel[alert.type] ??
                                                alert.type}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <StatusBadge
                                                status={
                                                    alertSeverity[
                                                        alert.severity
                                                    ]
                                                }
                                            />
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>{alert.message}</TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Mono className="text-xs">
                                                {formatDateTime(
                                                    alert.created_at,
                                                )}
                                            </Mono>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                                                <StatusBadge
                                                    status={
                                                        alertState[
                                                            alert.state
                                                        ]
                                                    }
                                                />
                                                {alert.state ===
                                                    'resolved' && (
                                                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                                        {alert.resolved_by_name ??
                                                            'Auto-resolved'}
                                                        {alert.resolved_at &&
                                                            ` · ${formatDateTime(alert.resolved_at)}`}
                                                    </span>
                                                )}
                                            </div>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        {canManage && (
                                            <TableCell>
                                                {alert.state === 'open' && (
                                                    <Button
                                                        variant="outline"
                                                        size="sm"
                                                        onClick={() =>
                                                            router.post(
                                                                alerts.resolve(
                                                                    alert.id,
                                                                ).url,
                                                                {},
                                                                {
                                                                    preserveScroll:
                                                                        true,
                                                                },
                                                            )
                                                        }
                                                    >
                                                        Resolve
                                                    </Button>
                                                )}
                                            </TableCell>
                                        )}
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!alertsPage.prev_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(alertsPage.prev_page_url)}
                    >
                        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
                        Previous
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!alertsPage.next_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(alertsPage.next_page_url)}
                    >
                        Next
                        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

const STATUS_OPTIONS = Object.keys(batchStatus);

/**
 * A batch with a null expiry_date never carries an expiry badge — nothing
 * to warn about. The 30-day near-expiry window mirrors
 * DetectAlertsAction::NEAR_EXPIRY_DAYS exactly (same source of truth the
 * alert engine uses), not a value invented for this screen.
 */
function expiryBadge(expiryDate: string | null): StatusMeta | null {
    if (!expiryDate) {
        return null;
    }

    const days = Math.ceil(
        (new Date(expiryDate).getTime() - Date.now()) / 86_400_000,
    );

    if (days < 0) {
        return { tone: 'expired', label: 'Expired', icon: CalendarOff };
    }

    if (days <= 30) {
        return { tone: 'pending', label: 'Expiring soon', icon: Clock };
    }

    return null;
}

export default function BatchesIndex({

}: {

    filters: BatchFilters;
}) {

        const removeStart = router.on('start', () => setIsLoading(true));
        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };
    }, []);

        const merged: Record<string, string> = {
            ...filters,

        } as Record<string, string>;

    function goTo(url: string | null) {

        }

    }

    const hasFilters = Object.keys(filters).length > 0;

    return (

                        Every received batch and its expiry, across all

                    </p>

                            Your filters weren&apos;t lost.
                        </span>
                        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={retry}>
                            Retry
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                )}

                <div className="no-print flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Select
                        value={filters.product_id ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ product_id: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-44">

                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead>Batch</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Product</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Supplier</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-32 text-right">
                                    On hand
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-36">
                                    Received
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-40">Expiry</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-32">Status</TableHead>
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {isLoading &&
                                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={`skeleton-${i}`}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        {Array.from({ length: 7 }).map(
                                            (__, j) => (
                                                <TableCell key={j}>
                                                    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full max-w-32" />
                                                </TableCell>
                                            ),
                                        )}
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                !loadError &&
                                batchesPage.data.length === 0 && (
                                    <TableRow>
                                        <TableCell
                                            colSpan={7}
                                            className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground"
                                        >
                                            {hasFilters
                                                ? 'No batches match these filters.'
                                                : 'No batches have been received yet — receive a purchase order to see one here.'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                )}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                batchesPage.data.map((batch) => {
                                    const expiry = expiryBadge(
                                        batch.expiry_date,
                                    );

                                    return (
                                        <TableRow
                                            key={batch.id}
                                            className="h-10"
                                        >
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Mono>
                                                    {batch.batch_number}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Link
                                                    href={
                                                        products.show(
                                                            batch.product_id,
                                                        ).url
                                                    }
                                                    className="hover:underline"
                                                >
                                                    {batch.product_name}
                                                </Link>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                {batch.supplier_id &&
                                                batch.supplier_name ? (
                                                    <Link
                                                        href={
                                                            suppliers.show(
                                                                batch.supplier_id,
                                                            ).url
                                                        }
                                                        className="hover:underline"
                                                    >
                                                        {batch.supplier_name}
                                                    </Link>
                                                ) : (
                                                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                                                        —
                                                    </span>
                                                )}
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell className="text-right">
                                                <Mono>
                                                    {batch.qty_on_hand}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                                <Mono className="text-xs">
                                                    {new Date(
                                                        batch.received_at,
                                                    ).toLocaleDateString()}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                                    <Mono className="text-xs">
                                                        {batch.expiry_date
                                                            ? new Date(
                                                                  batch.expiry_date,
                                                              ).toLocaleDateString()
                                                            : '—'}
                                                    </Mono>
                                                    {expiry && (
                                                        <StatusBadge
                                                            status={expiry}
                                                        />
                                                    )}
                                                </div>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <StatusBadge
                                                    status={
                                                        batchStatus[
                                                            batch.status
                                                        ] ??
                                                        batchStatus.active
                                                    }
                                                />
                                            </TableCell>
                                        </TableRow>
                                    );
                                })}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!batchesPage.prev_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(batchesPage.prev_page_url)}
                    >
                        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
                        Previous
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!batchesPage.next_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(batchesPage.next_page_url)}
                    >
                        Next
                        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

BatchesIndex.layout = {

        { title: 'Batches', href: batches.index() },
    ],

==================== ./resources/js/pages/inventory/stock/index.tsx ====================

import { Head, Link, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { AlertCircle, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Mono } from '@/components/mono';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import batches from '@/routes/batches';
import products from '@/routes/products';
import stock from '@/routes/stock';
import type {
    CursorPaginated,
    Option,
    StockLevelEntry,
    StockLevelFilters,
} from '@/types';

export default function StockLevelsIndex({
    levels: levelsPage,
    products: productOptions,
    locations: locationOptions,
    filters,
}: {
    levels: CursorPaginated<StockLevelEntry>;
    products: Option[];
    locations: Option[];
    filters: StockLevelFilters;
}) {
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
    const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        const removeStart = router.on('start', () => setIsLoading(true));
        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };
    }, []);

    function applyFilters(next: Partial<StockLevelFilters>) {
        const merged: Record<string, string> = {
            ...filters,
            ...next,
        } as Record<string, string>;

        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(merged)) {
            if (!value || value === 'all') {
                delete merged[key];
            }
        }

        router.get(
            stock.index().url,
            { filter: merged },
            {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                replace: true,
                only: ['levels', 'filters'],
                onError: () => setLoadError(true),
                onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
            },
        );
    }

    function goTo(url: string | null) {
        if (!url) {
            return;
        }

        router.visit(url, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            only: ['levels', 'filters'],
            onError: () => setLoadError(true),
            onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
        });
    }

    function retry() {
        setLoadError(false);
        router.reload({ only: ['levels', 'filters'] });
    }

    const hasFilters = Object.keys(filters).length > 0;

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Stock" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                            Stock
                        </h1>
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            What&apos;s on hand, by batch and location — a
                            projection derived from the movement ledger,
                            never set directly.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="no-print flex gap-1 rounded-md border p-1">
                        <span className="rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm font-medium bg-muted">
                            Levels
                        </span>
                        <Link
                            href={stock.movements().url}
                            className="rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted"
                        >
                            Movement ledger
                        </Link>
                    </div>
                </div>

                {loadError && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-md border border-status-danger-fg/30 bg-status-danger-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-status-danger-fg">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <AlertCircle className="size-4" />
                            Couldn&apos;t load stock levels — the request
                            failed. Your filters weren&apos;t lost.
                        </span>
                        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={retry}>
                            Retry
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                )}

                <div className="no-print flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Select
                        value={filters.product_id ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ product_id: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-44">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Product" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All products</SelectItem>
                            {productOptions.map((product) => (
                                <SelectItem
                                    key={product.id}
                                    value={product.id}
                                >
                                    {product.label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <Select
                        value={filters.location_id ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ location_id: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-44">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Location" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">
                                All locations
                            </SelectItem>
                            {locationOptions.map((location) => (
                                <SelectItem
                                    key={location.id}
                                    value={location.id}
                                >
                                    {location.label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 px-1 text-sm">
                        <Checkbox
                            checked={filters.in_stock_only === '1'}
                            onCheckedChange={(checked) =>
                                applyFilters({
                                    in_stock_only: checked ? '1' : undefined,
                                })
                            }
                        />
                        <Label className="font-normal">
                            In stock only
                        </Label>
                    </label>

                    {hasFilters && (
                        <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8"
                            onClick={() =>
                                router.get(
                                    stock.index().url,
                                    {},
                                    {
                                        preserveState: true,
                                        preserveScroll: true,
                                        replace: true,
                                        only: ['levels', 'filters'],
                                    },
                                )
                            }
                        >
                            <X className="size-3.5" />
                            Clear filters
                        </Button>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead>Product</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Batch</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Location</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-28 text-right">
                                    Quantity
                                </TableHead>
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {isLoading &&
                                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={`skeleton-${i}`}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        {Array.from({ length: 4 }).map(
                                            (__, j) => (
                                                <TableCell key={j}>
                                                    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full max-w-32" />
                                                </TableCell>
                                            ),
                                        )}
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                !loadError &&
                                levelsPage.data.length === 0 && (
                                    <TableRow>
                                        <TableCell
                                            colSpan={4}
                                            className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground"
                                        >
                                            {hasFilters
                                                ? 'No stock levels match these filters.'
                                                : 'No stock on hand yet — receive a purchase order to see it here.'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                )}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                levelsPage.data.map((level) => (
                                    <TableRow key={level.id} className="h-10">
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Link
                                                href={
                                                    products.show(
                                                        level.product_id,
                                                    ).url
                                                }
                                                className="hover:underline"
                                            >
                                                {level.product_name}
                                            </Link>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Link
                                                href={batches.index().url}
                                                className="hover:underline"
                                            >
                                                <Mono>
                                                    {level.batch_number}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </Link>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            {level.location_name}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell className="text-right">
                                            <Mono>{level.quantity}</Mono>
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!levelsPage.prev_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(levelsPage.prev_page_url)}
                    >
                        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
                        Previous
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!levelsPage.next_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(levelsPage.next_page_url)}
                    >
                        Next
                        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };

    function applyFilters(next: Partial<StockMovementFilters>) {
        const merged: Record<string, string> = {

            ...next,
        } as Record<string, string>;

        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(merged)) {
            if (!value || value === 'all') {
                delete merged[key];
            }

            { filter: merged },
            {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                replace: true,
                only: ['movements', 'filters'],
                onError: () => setLoadError(true),

    function goTo(url: string | null) {

            return;
        }

        router.visit(url, {

            preserveScroll: true,

        setLoadError(false);
        router.reload({ only: ['movements', 'filters'] });

                        <Input
                            type="date"
                            value={filters.from ?? ''}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                applyFilters({
                                    from: e.target.value || undefined,
                                })
                            }
                            className="h-8 w-36"
                            aria-label="Occurred from"
                        />
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            to
                        </span>
                        <Input
                            type="date"
                            value={filters.to ?? ''}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                applyFilters({
                                    to: e.target.value || undefined,
                                })
                            }
                            className="h-8 w-36"
                            aria-label="Occurred to"
                        />
                    </div>

                    {hasFilters && (
                        <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8"
                            onClick={() =>
                                router.get(
                                    stock.movements().url,
                                    {},
                                    {
                                        preserveState: true,
                                        preserveScroll: true,
                                        replace: true,
                                        only: ['movements', 'filters'],
                                    },
                                )
                            }
                        >
                            <X className="size-3.5" />
                            Clear filters
                        </Button>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead className="w-32">Type</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Product</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Batch</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Location</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-24 text-right">
                                    Qty
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-44">
                                    Occurred
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Reason</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Actor</TableHead>
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {isLoading &&
                                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={`skeleton-${i}`}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        {Array.from({ length: 8 }).map(
                                            (__, j) => (
                                                <TableCell key={j}>
                                                    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full max-w-32" />
                                                </TableCell>
                                            ),
                                        )}
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                !loadError &&
                                movementsPage.data.length === 0 && (
                                    <TableRow>
                                        <TableCell
                                            colSpan={8}
                                            className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground"
                                        >
                                            {hasFilters
                                                ? 'No movements match these filters.'
                                                : 'No stock movements have been recorded yet.'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                )}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                movementsPage.data.map((movement) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={movement.id}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        <TableCell>
                                            {stockMovementTypeLabel[
                                                movement.type
                                            ] ?? movement.type}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Link
                                                href={
                                                    products.show(
                                                        movement.product_id,
                                                    ).url
                                                }
                                                className="hover:underline"
                                            >
                                                {movement.product_name}
                                            </Link>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Mono>
                                                {movement.batch_number}
                                            </Mono>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            {movement.location_name}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell className="text-right">
                                            <Mono>
                                                {movement.qty > 0
                                                    ? `+${movement.qty}`
                                                    : movement.qty}
                                            </Mono>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Mono className="text-xs">
                                                {formatDateTime(
                                                    movement.occurred_at,
                                                )}
                                            </Mono>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                            {movement.reason ?? '—'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                            {movement.actor_name ?? '—'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"

                        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />

                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!movementsPage.next_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(movementsPage.next_page_url)}
                    >
                        Next
                        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>

==================== ./resources/js/pages/purchasing/purchase-orders/create.tsx ====================

import { Head, Link, useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { ArrowLeft, Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import type { FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import purchaseOrders from '@/routes/purchase-orders';
import type { Option } from '@/types';

type LineDraft = {
    product_id: string;
    qty_ordered: number;
    unit_price: string;
};

function emptyLine(): LineDraft {
    return { product_id: '', qty_ordered: 1, unit_price: '' };
}

export default function PurchaseOrderCreate({
    suppliers,
    products,
}: {
    suppliers: Option[];
    products: Option[];
}) {
    const form = useForm({
        supplier_id: '',
        lines: [emptyLine()] as LineDraft[],
    });

    function updateLine(index: number, patch: Partial<LineDraft>) {
        const lines = form.data.lines.map((line, i) =>
            i === index ? { ...line, ...patch } : line,
        );
        form.setData('lines', lines);
    }

    function addLine() {
        form.setData('lines', [...form.data.lines, emptyLine()]);
    }

    function removeLine(index: number) {
        form.setData(
            'lines',
            form.data.lines.filter((_, i) => i !== index),
        );
    }

    function submit(e: FormEvent) {
        e.preventDefault();
        form.post(purchaseOrders.store().url);
    }

    const hasValidLines =
        form.data.lines.length > 0 &&
        form.data.lines.every(
            (line) => line.product_id && line.qty_ordered > 0,
        );

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="New purchase order" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div>
                    <Link
                        href={purchaseOrders.index().url}
                        className="mb-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                    >
                        <ArrowLeft className="size-3.5" />
                        Back to purchase orders
                    </Link>
                    <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                        New purchase order
                    </h1>
                </div>

                <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
                    <Card>
                        <CardHeader>
                            <CardTitle className="text-sm">
                                Supplier
                            </CardTitle>
                        </CardHeader>
                        <CardContent>
                            <div className="grid max-w-sm gap-2">
                                <Label htmlFor="supplier_id">Supplier</Label>
                                <Select
                                    value={form.data.supplier_id}
                                    onValueChange={(value) =>
                                        form.setData('supplier_id', value)
                                    }
                                >
                                    <SelectTrigger
                                        id="supplier_id"
                                        className="w-full"
                                    >
                                        <SelectValue placeholder="Select a supplier…" />
                                    </SelectTrigger>
                                    <SelectContent>
                                        {suppliers.map((supplier) => (
                                            <SelectItem
                                                key={supplier.id}
                                                value={supplier.id}
                                            >
                                                {supplier.label}
                                            </SelectItem>
                                        ))}
                                    </SelectContent>
                                </Select>
                                {form.errors.supplier_id && (
                                    <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                        {form.errors.supplier_id}
                                    </p>
                                )}
                            </div>
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>

                    <Card>
                        <CardHeader>
                            <CardTitle className="text-sm">Lines</CardTitle>
                        </CardHeader>
                        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                            <Table>
                                <TableHeader>
                                    <TableRow>
                                        <TableHead>Product</TableHead>
                                        <TableHead className="w-28">
                                            Quantity
                                        </TableHead>
                                        <TableHead className="w-32">
                                            Unit price
                                        </TableHead>
                                        <TableHead className="w-10" />
                                    </TableRow>
                                </TableHeader>
                                <TableBody>
                                    {form.data.lines.map((line, index) => (
                                         
                                        <TableRow key={index}>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Select
                                                    value={line.product_id}
                                                    onValueChange={(value) =>
                                                        updateLine(index, {
                                                            product_id: value,
                                                        })
                                                    }
                                                >
                                                    <SelectTrigger
                                                        className="w-full"
                                                        aria-label={`Product for line ${index + 1}`}
                                                    >
                                                        <SelectValue placeholder="Select a product…" />
                                                    </SelectTrigger>
                                                    <SelectContent>
                                                        {products.map(
                                                            (product) => (
                                                                <SelectItem
                                                                    key={
                                                                        product.id
                                                                    }
                                                                    value={
                                                                        product.id
                                                                    }
                                                                >
                                                                    {
                                                                        product.label
                                                                    }
                                                                </SelectItem>
                                                            ),
                                                        )}
                                                    </SelectContent>
                                                </Select>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Input
                                                    type="number"
                                                    min={1}
                                                    value={line.qty_ordered}
                                                    onChange={(e) =>
                                                        updateLine(index, {
                                                            qty_ordered:
                                                                Number(
                                                                    e.target
                                                                        .value,
                                                                ),
                                                        })
                                                    }
                                                    aria-label={`Quantity for line ${index + 1}`}
                                                />
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Input
                                                    type="number"
                                                    min={0}
                                                    step="0.01"
                                                    value={line.unit_price}
                                                    onChange={(e) =>
                                                        updateLine(index, {
                                                            unit_price:
                                                                e.target
                                                                    .value,
                                                        })
                                                    }
                                                    aria-label={`Unit price for line ${index + 1}`}
                                                />
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Button
                                                    type="button"
                                                    variant="ghost"
                                                    size="icon"
                                                    aria-label={`Remove line ${index + 1}`}
                                                    disabled={
                                                        form.data.lines
                                                            .length === 1
                                                    }
                                                    onClick={() =>
                                                        removeLine(index)
                                                    }
                                                >
                                                    <Trash2 className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                                                </Button>
                                            </TableCell>
                                        </TableRow>
                                    ))}
                                </TableBody>
                            </Table>
                            <Button
                                type="button"
                                variant="outline"
                                size="sm"
                                onClick={addLine}
                            >
                                <Plus className="size-4" />
                                Add line
                            </Button>
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>

                    <div>
                        <Button
                            type="submit"
                            disabled={
                                form.processing ||
                                !form.data.supplier_id ||
                                !hasValidLines
                            }
                        >
                            Create purchase order
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                </form>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

PurchaseOrderCreate.layout = {
