import { Head, Link, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { AlertCircle, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Mono } from '@/components/mono';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/status-badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { purchaseOrderStatus } from '@/lib/status';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import purchaseOrders from '@/routes/purchase-orders';
import type { CursorPaginated, Option, PurchaseOrder } from '@/types';

export default function PurchaseOrdersIndex({
    purchaseOrders: purchaseOrdersPage,
    suppliers,
    canCreate,
}: {
    purchaseOrders: CursorPaginated<PurchaseOrder>;
    suppliers: Option[];
    canCreate: boolean;
}) {
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
    const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        const removeStart = router.on('start', () => setIsLoading(true));
        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };
    }, []);

    function goTo(url: string | null) {
        if (!url) {
            return;
        }

        router.visit(url, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            only: ['purchaseOrders'],
            onError: () => setLoadError(true),
            onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
        });
    }

    function retry() {
        setLoadError(false);
        router.reload({ only: ['purchaseOrders'] });
    }

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Purchase orders" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                            Purchase orders
                        </h1>
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            Orders placed with suppliers, newest first.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    {canCreate && (
                        <div className="no-print">
                            <Link href={purchaseOrders.create().url}>
                                <Button size="sm">
                                    <Plus className="size-4" />
                                    New purchase order
                                </Button>
                            </Link>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>

                {loadError && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-md border border-status-danger-fg/30 bg-status-danger-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-status-danger-fg">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <AlertCircle className="size-4" />
                            Couldn&apos;t load purchase orders — the request
                            failed.
                        </span>
                        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={retry}>
                            Retry
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                )}

                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead>Supplier</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-40">Status</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-20">Lines</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-44">Ordered</TableHead>
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {isLoading &&
                                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={`skeleton-${i}`}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        {Array.from({ length: 4 }).map(
                                            (__, j) => (
                                                <TableCell key={j}>
                                                    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full max-w-32" />
                                                </TableCell>
                                            ),
                                        )}
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                purchaseOrdersPage.data.length === 0 && (
                                    <TableRow>
                                        <TableCell
                                            colSpan={4}
                                            className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground"
                                        >
                                            {canCreate
                                                ? 'No purchase orders have been created yet — create one to get started.'
                                                : 'No purchase orders have been created yet.'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                )}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                purchaseOrdersPage.data.map((order) => {
                                    const supplier = suppliers.find(
                                        (s) => s.id === order.supplier_id,
                                    );
                                    const status =
                                        purchaseOrderStatus[order.status] ??
                                        purchaseOrderStatus.draft;

                                    return (
                                        <TableRow
                                            key={order.id}
                                            className="h-10 cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/40"
                                            onClick={() =>
                                                router.visit(
                                                    purchaseOrders.show(
                                                        order.id,
                                                    ).url,
                                                )
                                            }
                                        >
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Link
                                                    href={
                                                        purchaseOrders.show(
                                                            order.id,
                                                        ).url
                                                    }
                                                    className="hover:underline"
                                                    onClick={(e) =>
                                                        e.stopPropagation()
                                                    }
                                                >
                                                    {supplier?.label ?? '—'}
                                                </Link>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <StatusBadge status={status} />
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Mono>
                                                    {order.lines.length}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Mono className="text-xs">
                                                    {order.ordered_at
                                                        ? new Date(
                                                              order.ordered_at,
                                                          ).toLocaleDateString()
                                                        : '—'}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </TableCell>
                                        </TableRow>
                                    );
                                })}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!purchaseOrdersPage.prev_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(purchaseOrdersPage.prev_page_url)}
                    >
                        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
                        Previous
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!purchaseOrdersPage.next_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(purchaseOrdersPage.next_page_url)}
                    >
                        Next
                        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

==================== ./resources/js/pages/purchasing/purchase-orders/show.tsx ====================

import { Head, Link, router, useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import type { FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Mono } from '@/components/mono';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/status-badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import {
    Dialog,
    DialogContent,
    DialogDescription,
    DialogFooter,
    DialogHeader,
    DialogTitle,
    DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/format';
import { purchaseOrderStatus } from '@/lib/status';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import purchaseOrders from '@/routes/purchase-orders';
import goodsReceipts from '@/routes/purchase-orders/receipts';
import type { GoodsReceipt, Option, PurchaseOrder } from '@/types';

function CancelPurchaseOrderDialog({
    purchaseOrder,
}: {
    purchaseOrder: PurchaseOrder;
}) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const form = useForm({ reason: '' });

    function submit() {
        form.post(purchaseOrders.cancel(purchaseOrder.id).url, {
            onSuccess: () => {
                setOpen(false);
                form.reset();
            },
        });
    }

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
                setOpen(next);

                if (!next) {
                    form.reset();
                    form.clearErrors();
                }
            }}
        >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm" variant="destructive">
                    Cancel purchase order
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Cancel this purchase order?</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        This is permanent — a cancelled order can&apos;t be
                        reopened.
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="grid gap-2">
                    <Label htmlFor="cancel-reason">
                        Reason (optional)
                    </Label>
                    <Textarea
                        id="cancel-reason"
                        value={form.data.reason}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                            form.setData('reason', e.target.value)
                        }
                        placeholder="e.g. Supplier out of stock, ordered elsewhere."
                    />
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Keep order
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="destructive"
                        onClick={submit}
                        disabled={form.processing}
                    >
                        Cancel purchase order
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

type LineReceiptDraft = {
    batch_number: string;
    expiry_date: string;
    qty: number;
    discrepancy_reason: string;
};

function ReceiveGoodsForm({
    purchaseOrder,
    products,
    locations,
}: {
    purchaseOrder: PurchaseOrder;
    products: Option[];
    locations: Option[];
}) {
    const remainingLines = purchaseOrder.lines.filter(
        (line) => line.qty_received < line.qty_ordered,
    );

    const [locationId, setLocationId] = useState('');
    const [drafts, setDrafts] = useState<Record<string, LineReceiptDraft>>(
        () =>
            Object.fromEntries(
                remainingLines.map((line) => [
                    line.id,
                    {
                        batch_number: '',
                        expiry_date: '',
                        qty: line.qty_ordered - line.qty_received,
                        discrepancy_reason: '',
                    },
                ]),
            ),
    );
    const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
    const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

    function updateDraft(lineId: string, patch: Partial<LineReceiptDraft>) {
        setDrafts((prev) => ({ ...prev, [lineId]: { ...prev[lineId], ...patch } }));
    }

    function submit(e: FormEvent) {
        e.preventDefault();

        const lines = remainingLines
            .filter((line) => drafts[line.id]?.batch_number.trim())
            .map((line) => {
                const draft = drafts[line.id];

                return {
                    purchase_order_line_id: line.id,
                    batch_number: draft.batch_number,
                    expiry_date: draft.expiry_date || null,
                    qty: draft.qty,
                    discrepancy_reason: draft.discrepancy_reason || null,
                };
            });

        setProcessing(true);
        router.post(
            goodsReceipts.store(purchaseOrder.id).url,
            { location_id: locationId, lines },
            {
                preserveScroll: true,
                onError: (formErrors) =>
                    setErrors(formErrors as Record<string, string>),
                onFinish: () => setProcessing(false),
            },
        );
    }

    if (locations.length === 0) {
        return (
            <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle className="text-sm">Receive goods</CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        No storage locations are configured for this practice
                        yet, so there&apos;s nowhere to receive stock into.
                        Ask an admin to set one up before goods can be
                        received.
                    </p>
                </CardContent>
            </Card>
        );
    }

    const hasAnyBatch = remainingLines.some((line) =>
        drafts[line.id]?.batch_number.trim(),
    );

    return (
        <Card>
            <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="text-sm">Receive goods</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
                <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
                    <div className="grid max-w-sm gap-2">
                        <Label htmlFor="receipt-location">
                            Storage location
                        </Label>
                        <Select
                            value={locationId}
                            onValueChange={setLocationId}
                        >
                            <SelectTrigger
                                id="receipt-location"
                                className="w-full"
                            >
                                <SelectValue placeholder="Select a location…" />
                            </SelectTrigger>
                            <SelectContent>
                                {locations.map((location) => (
                                    <SelectItem
                                        key={location.id}
                                        value={location.id}
                                    >
                                        {location.label}
                                    </SelectItem>
                                ))}
                            </SelectContent>
                        </Select>
                        {errors.location_id && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {errors.location_id}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader>
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead>Product</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-24">
                                    Remaining
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-36">
                                    Batch number
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-36">
                                    Expiry date
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-24">
                                    Qty received
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Discrepancy reason</TableHead>
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {remainingLines.map((line) => {
                                const product = products.find(
                                    (p) => p.id === line.product_id,
                                );
                                const remaining =
                                    line.qty_ordered - line.qty_received;
                                const draft = drafts[line.id];

                                return (
                                    <TableRow key={line.id}>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            {product?.label ?? '—'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Mono>{remaining}</Mono>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Input
                                                value={draft.batch_number}
                                                onChange={(e) =>
                                                    updateDraft(line.id, {
                                                        batch_number:
                                                            e.target.value,
                                                    })
                                                }
                                                aria-label={`Batch number for ${product?.label ?? 'line'}`}
                                            />
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Input
                                                type="date"
                                                value={draft.expiry_date}
                                                onChange={(e) =>
                                                    updateDraft(line.id, {
                                                        expiry_date:
                                                            e.target.value,
                                                    })
                                                }
                                                aria-label={`Expiry date for ${product?.label ?? 'line'}`}
                                            />
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Input
                                                type="number"
                                                min={1}
                                                max={remaining}
                                                value={draft.qty}
                                                onChange={(e) =>
                                                    updateDraft(line.id, {
                                                        qty: Number(
                                                            e.target.value,
                                                        ),
                                                    })
                                                }
                                                aria-label={`Quantity received for ${product?.label ?? 'line'}`}
                                            />
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Input
                                                value={
                                                    draft.discrepancy_reason
                                                }
                                                onChange={(e) =>
                                                    updateDraft(line.id, {
                                                        discrepancy_reason:
                                                            e.target.value,
                                                    })
                                                }
                                                placeholder="e.g. 2 units damaged in transit"
                                                aria-label={`Discrepancy reason for ${product?.label ?? 'line'}`}
                                            />
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                );
                            })}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>

                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        Leave a line&apos;s batch number blank to skip it on
                        this receipt — a purchase order can be received
                        across several partial deliveries.
                    </p>

                    <Button
                        type="submit"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={processing || !locationId || !hasAnyBatch}
                    >
                        Record receipt
                    </Button>
                </form>
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
}

function GoodsReceiptHistory({
    goodsReceipts,
    products,
}: {
    goodsReceipts: GoodsReceipt[];
    products: Option[];
}) {
    if (goodsReceipts.length === 0) {
        return null;
    }

    return (
        <Card>
            <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="text-sm">Receipt history</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                {goodsReceipts.map((receipt) => (
                    <div key={receipt.id} className="space-y-2">
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            <Mono>{formatDateTime(receipt.received_at)}</Mono>
                        </p>
                        <Table>
                            <TableHeader>
                                <TableRow>
                                    <TableHead>Product</TableHead>
                                    <TableHead>Qty</TableHead>
                                    <TableHead>Discrepancy</TableHead>
                                </TableRow>
                            </TableHeader>
                            <TableBody>
                                {receipt.lines.map((line) => {
                                    const product = products.find(
                                        (p) => p.id === line.product_id,
                                    );

                                    return (
                                        <TableRow key={line.id}>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                {product?.label ?? '—'}
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Mono>{line.qty}</Mono>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                                {line.discrepancy_reason ??
                                                    '—'}
                                            </TableCell>
                                        </TableRow>
                                    );
                                })}
                            </TableBody>
                        </Table>
                    </div>
                ))}
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
}

export default function PurchaseOrderShow({
    purchaseOrder,
    supplier,
    products,
    locations,
    goodsReceipts: receipts,
    canManage,
}: {
    purchaseOrder: PurchaseOrder;
    supplier: Option;
    products: Option[];
    locations: Option[];
    goodsReceipts: GoodsReceipt[];
    canManage: boolean;
}) {
    const status =
        purchaseOrderStatus[purchaseOrder.status] ?? purchaseOrderStatus.draft;

    return (
        <>
            <Head title={`Purchase order — ${supplier.label}`} />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div>
                    <Link
                        href={purchaseOrders.index().url}
                        className="mb-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                    >
                        <ArrowLeft className="size-3.5" />
                        Back to purchase orders
                    </Link>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                                {supplier.label}
                            </h1>
                            <StatusBadge status={status} />
                        </div>
                        {canManage && (
                            <div className="flex gap-2">
                                {purchaseOrder.status === 'draft' && (
                                    <Button
                                        size="sm"
                                        onClick={() =>
                                            router.post(
                                                purchaseOrders.order(
                                                    purchaseOrder.id,
                                                ).url,
                                                {},
                                                { preserveScroll: true },
                                            )
                                        }
                                    >
                                        Mark as ordered
                                    </Button>
                                )}
                                {(purchaseOrder.status === 'draft' ||
                                    purchaseOrder.status === 'ordered') && (
                                    <CancelPurchaseOrderDialog
                                        purchaseOrder={purchaseOrder}
                                    />
                                )}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>

                <Card>
                    <CardHeader>
                        <CardTitle className="text-sm">Lines</CardTitle>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                        <Table>
                            <TableHeader>
                                <TableRow>
                                    <TableHead>Product</TableHead>
                                    <TableHead>Ordered</TableHead>
                                    <TableHead>Received</TableHead>
                                    <TableHead>Unit price</TableHead>
                                </TableRow>
                            </TableHeader>
                            <TableBody>
                                {purchaseOrder.lines.map((line) => {
                                    const product = products.find(
                                        (p) => p.id === line.product_id,
                                    );

                                    return (
                                        <TableRow key={line.id}>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                {product?.label ?? '—'}
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Mono>
                                                    {line.qty_ordered}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Mono>
                                                    {line.qty_received}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                {line.unit_price ?? '—'}
                                            </TableCell>
                                        </TableRow>
                                    );
                                })}
                            </TableBody>
                        </Table>
                    </CardContent>
                </Card>

                {canManage &&
                    (purchaseOrder.status === 'ordered' ||
                        purchaseOrder.status === 'partially_received') && (
                        <ReceiveGoodsForm
                            purchaseOrder={purchaseOrder}
                            products={products}
                            locations={locations}
                        />
                    )}

                <GoodsReceiptHistory
                    goodsReceipts={receipts}
                    products={products}
                />
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

==================== ./resources/js/pages/purchasing/suppliers/index.tsx ====================

import { Head, Link, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { AlertCircle, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { NewSupplierDialog } from '@/components/new-supplier-dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import suppliers from '@/routes/suppliers';
import type { CursorPaginated, Supplier, SupplierFilters } from '@/types';

export default function SuppliersIndex({
    suppliers: suppliersPage,
    canCreate,
    filters,
}: {
    suppliers: CursorPaginated<Supplier>;
    canCreate: boolean;
    filters: SupplierFilters;
}) {
    const [q, setQ] = useState(filters.name ?? '');
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
    const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        const removeStart = router.on('start', () => setIsLoading(true));
        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };
    }, []);

    function applyFilters(next: Partial<SupplierFilters>) {
        const merged: Record<string, string> = {
            ...filters,
            ...next,
        } as Record<string, string>;

        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(merged)) {
            if (!value) {
                delete merged[key];
            }
        }

        router.get(
            suppliers.index().url,
            { filter: merged },
            {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                replace: true,
                only: ['suppliers', 'filters'],
                onError: () => setLoadError(true),
                onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
            },
        );
    }

    useEffect(() => {
        const handle = setTimeout(() => {
            if (q !== (filters.name ?? '')) {
                applyFilters({ name: q || undefined });
            }
        }, 300);

        return () => clearTimeout(handle);
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, [q]);

    function goTo(url: string | null) {
        if (!url) {
            return;
        }

        router.visit(url, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            only: ['suppliers', 'filters'],
            onError: () => setLoadError(true),
            onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
        });
    }

    function retry() {
        setLoadError(false);
        router.reload({ only: ['suppliers', 'filters'] });
    }

    const hasFilters = Object.keys(filters).length > 0;

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Suppliers" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                            Suppliers
                        </h1>
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            Vendors and their product references.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    {canCreate && (
                        <div className="no-print">
                            <NewSupplierDialog />
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>

                {loadError && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-md border border-status-danger-fg/30 bg-status-danger-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-status-danger-fg">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <AlertCircle className="size-4" />
                            Couldn&apos;t load suppliers — the request
                            failed. Your filters weren&apos;t lost.
                        </span>
                        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={retry}>
                            Retry
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                )}

                <div className="no-print flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Input
                        value={q}
                        onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Search by name…"
                        className="h-8 w-48"
                        aria-label="Search by name"
                    />

                    {hasFilters && (
                        <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8"
                            onClick={() => {
                                setQ('');
                                router.get(
                                    suppliers.index().url,
                                    {},
                                    {
                                        preserveState: true,
                                        preserveScroll: true,
                                        replace: true,
                                        only: ['suppliers', 'filters'],
                                    },
                                );
                            }}
                        >
                            <X className="size-3.5" />
                            Clear filters
                        </Button>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead>Name</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Email</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Phone</TableHead>
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {isLoading &&
                                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={`skeleton-${i}`}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map(
                                            (__, j) => (
                                                <TableCell key={j}>
                                                    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full max-w-32" />
                                                </TableCell>
                                            ),
                                        )}
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                !loadError &&
                                suppliersPage.data.length === 0 && (
                                    <TableRow>
                                        <TableCell
                                            colSpan={3}
                                            className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground"
                                        >
                                            {hasFilters
                                                ? 'No suppliers match these filters.'
                                                : canCreate
                                                    ? 'No suppliers have been added yet — add one to get started.'
                                                    : 'No suppliers have been added yet.'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                )}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                suppliersPage.data.map((supplier) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={supplier.id}
                                        className="h-10 cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/40"
                                        onClick={() =>
                                            router.visit(
                                                suppliers.show(supplier.id)
                                                    .url,
                                            )
                                        }
                                    >
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Link
                                                href={
                                                    suppliers.show(
                                                        supplier.id,
                                                    ).url
                                                }
                                                className="hover:underline"
                                                onClick={(e) =>
                                                    e.stopPropagation()
                                                }
                                            >
                                                {supplier.name}
                                            </Link>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                            {supplier.email ?? '—'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                            {supplier.phone ?? '—'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!suppliersPage.prev_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(suppliersPage.prev_page_url)}
                    >
                        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
                        Previous
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!suppliersPage.next_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(suppliersPage.next_page_url)}
                    >
                        Next
                        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

SuppliersIndex.layout = {
    breadcrumbs: [
        { title: 'Dashboard', href: dashboard() },
        { title: 'Suppliers', href: suppliers.index() },
    ],
};


==================== ./resources/js/pages/purchasing/suppliers/show.tsx ====================

import { Head, Link, router, useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import type { FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Mono } from '@/components/mono';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import {
    Dialog,
    DialogContent,
    DialogDescription,
    DialogFooter,
    DialogHeader,
    DialogTitle,
    DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import suppliers from '@/routes/suppliers';
import supplierProducts from '@/routes/suppliers/products';
import type { Option, Supplier, SupplierProduct } from '@/types';

function EditSupplierDialog({ supplier }: { supplier: Supplier }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const form = useForm({
        name: supplier.name,
        email: supplier.email ?? '',
        phone: supplier.phone ?? '',
        address: supplier.address ?? '',
    });

    function submit() {
        form.patch(suppliers.update(supplier.id).url, {
            onSuccess: () => setOpen(false),
        });
    }

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
                setOpen(next);

                if (!next) {
                    form.clearErrors();
                }
            }}
        >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                    Edit
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Edit {supplier.name}</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        Update this supplier&apos;s details.
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="grid gap-4">
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <Label htmlFor="edit-supplier-name">Name</Label>
                        <Input
                            id="edit-supplier-name"
                            value={form.data.name}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('name', e.target.value)
                            }
                        />
                        {form.errors.name && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.name}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <Label htmlFor="edit-supplier-email">Email</Label>
                            <Input
                                id="edit-supplier-email"
                                type="email"
                                value={form.data.email}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                    form.setData('email', e.target.value)
                                }
                            />
                            {form.errors.email && (
                                <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                    {form.errors.email}
                                </p>
                            )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <Label htmlFor="edit-supplier-phone">Phone</Label>
                            <Input
                                id="edit-supplier-phone"
                                value={form.data.phone}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                    form.setData('phone', e.target.value)
                                }
                            />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <Label htmlFor="edit-supplier-address">Address</Label>
                        <Textarea
                            id="edit-supplier-address"
                            value={form.data.address}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('address', e.target.value)
                            }
                        />
                    </div>
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button onClick={submit} disabled={form.processing}>
                        Save changes
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

function DeleteSupplierDialog({ supplier }: { supplier: Supplier }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

    function confirmDelete() {
        router.delete(suppliers.destroy(supplier.id).url);
    }

    return (
        <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm" variant="destructive">
                    Delete
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Delete {supplier.name}?</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        This removes it from the active supplier list. Past
                        purchase orders and stock movements keep pointing to
                        it — nothing else is affected.
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>
                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="destructive" onClick={confirmDelete}>
                        Delete supplier
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

function LinkProductForm({
    supplier,
    products,
}: {
    supplier: Supplier;
    products: Option[];
}) {
    const form = useForm({
        product_id: '',
        supplier_reference: '',
        pack_size: 1,
        price: '',
    });

    function submit(e: FormEvent) {
        e.preventDefault();
        form.post(supplierProducts.store(supplier.id).url, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => form.reset(),
        });
    }

    return (
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2">
            <div>
                <Label
                    htmlFor="link-product"
                    className="mb-1 block text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                >
                    Product
                </Label>
                <Select
                    value={form.data.product_id}
                    onValueChange={(value) =>
                        form.setData('product_id', value)
                    }
                >
                    <SelectTrigger id="link-product" className="h-8 w-52">
                        <SelectValue placeholder="Select a product…" />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                        {products.map((product) => (
                            <SelectItem key={product.id} value={product.id}>
                                {product.label}
                            </SelectItem>
                        ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                </Select>
            </div>
            <div>
                <Label
                    htmlFor="link-reference"
                    className="mb-1 block text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                >
                    Supplier reference
                </Label>
                <Input
                    id="link-reference"
                    value={form.data.supplier_reference}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                        form.setData('supplier_reference', e.target.value)
                    }
                    className="h-8 w-36"
                />
            </div>
            <div>
                <Label
                    htmlFor="link-pack-size"
                    className="mb-1 block text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                >
                    Pack size
                </Label>
                <Input
                    id="link-pack-size"
                    type="number"
                    min={1}
                    value={form.data.pack_size}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                        form.setData('pack_size', Number(e.target.value))
                    }
                    className="h-8 w-20"
                />
            </div>
            <div>
                <Label
                    htmlFor="link-price"
                    className="mb-1 block text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                >
                    Price
                </Label>
                <Input
                    id="link-price"
                    type="number"
                    min={0}
                    step="0.01"
                    value={form.data.price}
                    onChange={(e) => form.setData('price', e.target.value)}
                    className="h-8 w-24"
                />
            </div>
            <Button
                type="submit"
                size="sm"
                disabled={form.processing || !form.data.product_id}
            >
                Link product
            </Button>
        </form>
    );
}

==================== ./resources/js/pages/reporting/data-exports/index.tsx ====================

import { Head, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { Download, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/status-badge';
import {
    AlertDialog,
    AlertDialogAction,
    AlertDialogCancel,
    AlertDialogContent,
    AlertDialogDescription,
    AlertDialogFooter,
    AlertDialogHeader,
    AlertDialogTitle,
    AlertDialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import {
    Dialog,
    DialogContent,
    DialogHeader,
    DialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { formatBytes, formatDateTime } from '@/lib/format';
import { dataExportStatus } from '@/lib/status';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import dataExports from '@/routes/data-exports';
import type { CursorPaginated, DataExportRequest } from '@/types';

const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 4000;

function csrfToken(): string {
    return decodeURIComponent(
        document.cookie
            .split('; ')
            .find((row) => row.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))
            ?.split('=')[1] ?? '',
    );
}

function ManifestDialog({ request }: { request: DataExportRequest }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const manifest = Object.entries(request.table_manifest ?? {}).sort(
        ([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b),
    );

    return (
        <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
                View contents
            </Button>
            <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>What&apos;s inside this export</DialogTitle>
                </DialogHeader>

                <dl className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto] gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-sm">
                    <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Attached files</dt>
                    <dd className="text-right tabular-nums">
                        {request.file_count ?? 0}
                    </dd>
                    <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Total size</dt>
                    <dd className="text-right tabular-nums">
                        {formatBytes(request.size_bytes)}
                    </dd>
                </dl>

                <div className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead>Table</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="text-right">
                                    Rows
                                </TableHead>
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {manifest.map(([table, count]) => (
                                <TableRow key={table}>
                                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">
                                        {table}
                                    </TableCell>
                                    <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                                        {count}
                                    </TableCell>
                                </TableRow>
                            ))}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

function DownloadButton({ request }: { request: DataExportRequest }) {
    const [isDownloading, setIsDownloading] = useState(false);

    async function handleDownload() {
        setIsDownloading(true);

        try {
            const response = await fetch(
                dataExports.download(request.id).url,
                {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        Accept: 'application/json',
                        'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                        'X-XSRF-TOKEN': csrfToken(),
                    },
                },
            );

            if (!response.ok) {
                return;
            }

            const data: { download_url: string } = await response.json();
            window.open(data.download_url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
        } finally {
            setIsDownloading(false);
        }
    }

    return (
        <Button size="sm" onClick={handleDownload} disabled={isDownloading}>
            <Download className="size-3.5" />
            Download
        </Button>
    );
}

function RequestExportDialog({
    disabledReason,
}: {
    disabledReason: string | null;
}) {
    function submit() {
        router.post(dataExports.store().url, {}, { preserveScroll: true });
    }

    return (
        <AlertDialog>
            <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button disabled={disabledReason !== null}>
                    Request export
                </Button>
            </AlertDialogTrigger>
            <AlertDialogContent>
                <AlertDialogHeader>
                    <AlertDialogTitle>
                        Request a full data export?
                    </AlertDialogTitle>
                    <AlertDialogDescription>
                        This generates a complete copy of every record and
                        attached file for this practice, including
                        pseudonymized patient references. Every owner will be
                        emailed when this export is requested, and the
                        download link expires 30 minutes after you generate
                        it.
                    </AlertDialogDescription>
                </AlertDialogHeader>
                <AlertDialogFooter>
                    <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
                    <AlertDialogAction onClick={submit}>
                        Request export
                    </AlertDialogAction>
                </AlertDialogFooter>
            </AlertDialogContent>
        </AlertDialog>
    );
}

export default function DataExportsIndex({
    exports: exportsPage,
    hasRunningExport,
    weeklyLimit,
}: {
    exports: CursorPaginated<DataExportRequest>;
    hasRunningExport: boolean;
    weeklyLimit: number;
}) {
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!hasRunningExport) {
            return;
        }

        const interval = setInterval(() => {
            router.reload({ only: ['exports', 'hasRunningExport'] });
        }, POLL_INTERVAL_MS);

        return () => clearInterval(interval);
    }, [hasRunningExport]);

    const disabledReason = hasRunningExport
        ? 'An export is already in progress. Wait for it to finish before requesting another.'
        : null;

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Data export" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div>
                    <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                        Data export
                    </h1>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        Export every record and attached file this practice
                        has stored — for GDPR data portability, or if you're
                        leaving SteriQore. Up to {weeklyLimit} requests per
                        week.
                    </p>
                </div>

                <Card>
                    <CardHeader>
                        <CardTitle>Request an export</CardTitle>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            The archive contains every table this practice
                            owns and every attached file, in readable
                            formats (JSON records, original files), zipped
                            into a single download. Generating it usually
                            takes a few minutes depending on how much data
                            there is.
                        </p>
                        <div>
                            <RequestExportDialog
                                disabledReason={disabledReason}
                            />
                            {disabledReason && (
                                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                    {disabledReason}
                                </p>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </CardContent>
                </Card>

                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead>Requested</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Requested by</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Size</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Expires</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-56" />
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {exportsPage.data.length === 0 && (
                                <TableRow>
                                    <TableCell
                                        colSpan={6}
                                        className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground"
                                    >
                                        No exports requested yet.
                                    </TableCell>
                                </TableRow>
                            )}
                            {exportsPage.data.map((request) => {
                                const status =
                                    dataExportStatus[request.status];

                                return (
                                    <TableRow key={request.id} className="h-12">
                                        <TableCell>
                                            {formatDateTime(
                                                request.requested_at,
                                            )}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            {request.requested_by_name}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <StatusBadge status={status} />
                                            {request.status === 'failed' &&
                                                request.error && (
                                                    <p className="mt-1 max-w-xs text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                                        {request.error}
                                                    </p>
                                                )}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell className="tabular-nums">
                                            {formatBytes(request.size_bytes)}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            {formatDateTime(
                                                request.expires_at,
                                            )}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                                                {request.status ===
                                                    'completed' && (
                                                    <>
                                                        <ManifestDialog
                                                            request={request}
                                                        />
                                                        <DownloadButton
                                                            request={request}
                                                        />
                                                    </>
                                                )}
                                                {request.status ===
                                                    'failed' && (
                                                    <Button
                                                        size="sm"
                                                        variant="outline"
                                                        disabled={
                                                            hasRunningExport
                                                        }
                                                        onClick={() =>
                                                            router.post(
                                                                dataExports.store()
                                                                    .url,
                                                                {},
                                                                {
                                                                    preserveScroll:
                                                                        true,
                                                                },
                                                            )
                                                        }
                                                    >
                                                        <RotateCcw className="size-3.5" />
                                                        Request again
                                                    </Button>
                                                )}
                                            </div>
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                );
                            })}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>

                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    Download links are generated on demand and are valid for
                    30 minutes. The archive contains pseudonymous patient
                    references — treat it as sensitive.
                </p>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

DataExportsIndex.layout = {

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { edit } from '@/routes/security';

type Props = {
    passwordRules: string;
} & ManagePasskeysProps &
    ManageTwoFactorProps;

export default function Security(props: Props) {
    const passwordInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    const currentPasswordInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Security settings" />

            <h1 className="sr-only">Security settings</h1>

                    options={{

                    }}
                    resetOnError={[
                        'password',
                        'password_confirmation',
                        'current_password',
                    ]}
                    resetOnSuccess
                    onError={(errors) => {
                        if (errors.password) {

                                    className="mt-1 block w-full"
                                    autoComplete="current-password"
                                    placeholder="Current password"
                                />

                                <InputError message={errors.current_password} />
                            </div>

                            <div className="grid gap-2">
                                <Label htmlFor="password">New password</Label>

                                <PasswordInput
                                    id="password"
                                    ref={passwordInput}
                                    name="password"
                                    className="mt-1 block w-full"
                                    autoComplete="new-password"
                                    placeholder="New password"
                                    passwordrules={props.passwordRules}
                                />

                                <InputError message={errors.password} />
                            </div>

                            <div className="grid gap-2">
                                <Label htmlFor="password_confirmation">
                                    Confirm password
                                </Label>

                                <PasswordInput
                                    id="password_confirmation"
                                    name="password_confirmation"
                                    className="mt-1 block w-full"
                                    autoComplete="new-password"
                                    placeholder="Confirm password"
                                    passwordrules={props.passwordRules}
                                />

                                <InputError
                                    message={errors.password_confirmation}
                                />
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                                <Button
                                    disabled={processing}
                                    data-test="update-password-button"
                                >
                                    Save
                                </Button>
                            </div>
                        </>
                    )}
                </Form>
            </div>

            <ManageTwoFactor
                canManageTwoFactor={props.canManageTwoFactor}
                requiresConfirmation={props.requiresConfirmation}
                twoFactorEnabled={props.twoFactorEnabled}
            />

            <ManagePasskeys
                canManagePasskeys={props.canManagePasskeys}
                passkeys={props.passkeys}
            />
        </>
    );
}
