    tests: CursorPaginated<ControlTestLogEntry>;
    devices: Option[];
    filters: ControlTestFilters;
}) {
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
    const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        const removeStart = router.on('start', () => setIsLoading(true));
        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };
    }, []);

    function applyFilters(next: Partial<ControlTestFilters>) {
        const merged: Record<string, string> = {
            ...filters,
            ...next,
        } as Record<string, string>;

        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(merged)) {
            if (!value || value === 'all') {
                delete merged[key];
            }
        }

        router.get(
            controlTests.index().url,
            { filter: merged },
            {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                replace: true,
                only: ['tests', 'filters'],
                onError: () => setLoadError(true),
                onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
            },
        );
    }

    function goTo(url: string | null) {
        if (!url) {
            return;
        }

        router.visit(url, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            only: ['tests', 'filters'],
            onError: () => setLoadError(true),
            onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
        });
    }

    function retry() {
        setLoadError(false);
        router.reload({ only: ['tests', 'filters'] });
    }

    const hasFilters = Object.keys(filters).length > 0;

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Control tests" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div>
                    <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                        Control tests
                    </h1>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        Every vacuum, Bowie-Dick, Helix and biological test
                        recorded, newest first.
                    </p>
                </div>

                {loadError && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-md border border-status-danger-fg/30 bg-status-danger-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-status-danger-fg">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <AlertCircle className="size-4" />
                            Couldn&apos;t load the logbook — the request
                            failed. Your filters weren&apos;t lost.
                        </span>
                        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={retry}>
                            Retry
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                )}

                <div className="no-print flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Select
                        value={filters.type ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) => applyFilters({ type: value })}
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-40">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Type" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All types</SelectItem>
                            {TYPE_OPTIONS.map((type) => (
                                <SelectItem key={type} value={type}>
                                    {controlTestTypeLabel[type]}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <Select
                        value={filters.result ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ result: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-36">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Result" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All results</SelectItem>
                            {RESULT_OPTIONS.map((result) => (
                                <SelectItem key={result} value={result}>
                                    {controlTestResult[result].label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <Select
                        value={filters.device_id ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ device_id: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-44">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Device" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All devices</SelectItem>
                            {devices.map((device) => (
                                <SelectItem key={device.id} value={device.id}>
                                    {device.label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Input
                            type="date"
                            value={filters.from ?? ''}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                applyFilters({
                                    from: e.target.value || undefined,
                                })
                            }
                            className="h-8 w-36"
                            aria-label="Performed from"
                        />
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            to
                        </span>
                        <Input
                            type="date"
                            value={filters.to ?? ''}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                applyFilters({
                                    to: e.target.value || undefined,
                                })
                            }
                            className="h-8 w-36"
                            aria-label="Performed to"
                        />
                    </div>

                    {hasFilters && (
                        <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8"
                            onClick={() =>
                                router.get(
                                    controlTests.index().url,
                                    {},
                                    {
                                        preserveState: true,
                                        preserveScroll: true,
                                        replace: true,
                                        only: ['tests', 'filters'],
                                    },
                                )
                            }
                        >
                            <X className="size-3.5" />
                            Clear filters
                        </Button>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead className="w-28">Cycle</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Device</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Type</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-28">Result</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-44">
                                    Performed
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Notes</TableHead>
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {isLoading &&
                                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={`skeleton-${i}`}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map(
                                            (__, j) => (
                                                <TableCell key={j}>
                                                    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full max-w-32" />
                                                </TableCell>
                                            ),
                                        )}
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                !loadError &&

                                        <TableCell

                                        >
                                            {hasFilters
                                                ? 'No control tests match these filters.'
                                                : 'No control tests have been recorded yet — record one from a completed cycle to see it here.'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                )}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                testsPage.data.map((test) => (
                                    <TableRow key={test.id} className="h-10">

                                            <Link
                                                href={
                                                    cycles.show(test.cycle_id)
                                                        .url
                                                }
                                                className="hover:underline"

                                                <Mono>
                                                    #{test.cycle_number}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </Link>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            {test.device_name}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            {controlTestTypeLabel[
                                                test.type
                                            ] ?? test.type}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <StatusBadge
                                                status={
                                                    controlTestResult[
                                                        test.result
                                                    ] ?? controlTestResult.fail
                                                }
                                            />
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Mono className="text-xs">
                                                {formatDateTime(
                                                    test.performed_at,
                                                )}
                                            </Mono>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                            {test.notes ?? '—'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex items-center justify-end gap-2">

                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!testsPage.prev_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(testsPage.prev_page_url)}

                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!testsPage.next_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(testsPage.next_page_url)}
                    >
                        Next
                        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />

                </div>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

    Select,

    SelectValue,

    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/format';
import { cycleStatus } from '@/lib/status';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import cycles from '@/routes/cycles';
import type {
    CursorPaginated,
    Cycle,
    CycleFilters,
    DeviceProgram,
    Option,
} from '@/types';

const STATUS_OPTIONS = Object.keys(cycleStatus);

export default function CyclesIndex({
    cycles: cyclesPage,
    devices,
    devicePrograms,
    operators,
    canCreate,
    filters,
}: {
    cycles: CursorPaginated<Cycle>;
    devices: Option[];
    devicePrograms: DeviceProgram[];
    operators: Option[];
    canCreate: boolean;
    filters: CycleFilters;
}) {
    const [q, setQ] = useState(filters.q ?? '');
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
    const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false);

    // Inertia's global top progress bar covers full page navigation, but a
    // filtered/paginated reload of just this table benefits from a more
    // localized signal — the rows themselves go quiet rather than the whole
    // page appearing to hang.
    useEffect(() => {
        const removeStart = router.on('start', () => setIsLoading(true));
        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };
    }, []);

    // Debounced free-text search — every other filter below applies
    // immediately on change, since a select/date change is already a
    // single deliberate action.
    useEffect(() => {
        const handle = setTimeout(() => {
            if (q !== (filters.q ?? '')) {
                applyFilters({ q: q || undefined });
            }
        }, 300);

        return () => clearTimeout(handle);
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, [q]);

    function applyFilters(next: Partial<CycleFilters>) {
        const merged: Record<string, string> = {
            ...filters,
            ...next,
        } as Record<string, string>;

        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(merged)) {
            if (!value || value === 'all') {
                delete merged[key];
            }
        }

        // spatie/laravel-query-builder reads filters from a nested
        // `filter[...]` query bucket, not bare top-level params — the same
        // convention every existing endpoint in this app already uses.
        router.get(
            cycles.index().url,
            { filter: merged },
            {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                replace: true,
                only: ['cycles', 'filters'],
                onError: () => setLoadError(true),
                onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
            },
        );
    }

    function goTo(url: string | null) {
        if (!url) {
            return;
        }

        router.visit(url, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            only: ['cycles', 'filters'],
            onError: () => setLoadError(true),
            onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
        });
    }

    function retry() {
        setLoadError(false);
        router.reload({ only: ['cycles', 'filters'] });
    }

    const hasFilters = Object.keys(filters).length > 0;

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Cycles" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                            Cycles
                        </h1>
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            Every sterilization run, newest first.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    {canCreate && (
                        <div className="no-print">
                            <NewCycleDialog
                                devices={devices}
                                devicePrograms={devicePrograms}
                            />
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>

                {loadError && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-md border border-status-danger-fg/30 bg-status-danger-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-status-danger-fg">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <AlertCircle className="size-4" />
                            Couldn&apos;t load cycles — the request failed. Your
                            filters weren&apos;t lost.
                        </span>
                        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={retry}>
                            Retry
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                )}

                <div className="no-print flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Input
                        value={q}
                        onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Cycle number…"
                        className="h-8 w-40"
                        aria-label="Search by cycle number"
                    />

                    <Select
                        value={filters.status ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ status: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-40">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Status" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All statuses</SelectItem>
                            {STATUS_OPTIONS.map((status) => (
                                <SelectItem key={status} value={status}>
                                    {cycleStatus[status].label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <Select
                        value={filters.device_id ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ device_id: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-44">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Device" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All devices</SelectItem>
                            {devices.map((device) => (
                                <SelectItem key={device.id} value={device.id}>
                                    {device.label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <Select
                        value={filters.operator_id ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ operator_id: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-44">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Operator" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All operators</SelectItem>
                            {operators.map((operator) => (
                                <SelectItem
                                    key={operator.id}
                                    value={operator.id}
                                >
                                    {operator.label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Input
                            type="date"
                            value={filters.from ?? ''}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                applyFilters({
                                    from: e.target.value || undefined,
                                })
                            }
                            className="h-8 w-36"
                            aria-label="Started from"
                        />
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            to
                        </span>
                        <Input
                            type="date"
                            value={filters.to ?? ''}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                applyFilters({
                                    to: e.target.value || undefined,
                                })
                            }
                            className="h-8 w-36"
                            aria-label="Started to"
                        />
                    </div>

                    {hasFilters && (
                        <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8"
                            onClick={() => {
                                setQ('');
                                router.get(
                                    cycles.index().url,
                                    {},
                                    {
                                        preserveState: true,
                                        preserveScroll: true,
                                        replace: true,
                                        only: ['cycles', 'filters'],
                                    },
                                );
                            }}
                        >
                            <X className="size-3.5" />
                            Clear filters
                        </Button>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead className="w-28">Cycle</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Device</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Operator</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-40">Status</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-44">Started</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-44">
                                    Completed
                                </TableHead>
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {isLoading &&
                                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={`skeleton-${i}`}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map(
                                            (__, j) => (
                                                <TableCell key={j}>
                                                    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full max-w-32" />
                                                </TableCell>
                                            ),
                                        )}
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                !loadError &&

                                                <Link
                                                    href={
                                                        cycles.show(cycle.id)
                                                            .url
                                                    }
                                                    className="hover:underline"

                                                    }

==================== ./resources/js/pages/sterilization/cycles/labels.tsx ====================

import { Head, Link, router, useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import type { FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Mono } from '@/components/mono';
import { ReprintLabelDialog } from '@/components/reprint-label-dialog';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/status-badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Label as FieldLabel } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/format';
import { labelStatus } from '@/lib/status';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import cycles from '@/routes/cycles';
import cycleLabels from '@/routes/cycles/labels';
import labels from '@/routes/labels';
import type {
    Cycle,
    CycleItem,
    DluRule,
    Label as LabelType,
    Option,
} from '@/types';

function GenerateLabelsForm({
    cycle,
    dluRules,
}: {
    cycle: Cycle;
    dluRules: DluRule[];
}) {
    const form = useForm({ packaging_type: '', storage_condition: '' });

    const rule = dluRules.find(
        (r) =>
            r.packaging_type === form.data.packaging_type &&
            r.storage_condition === form.data.storage_condition,
    );

    function submit(e: FormEvent) {
        e.preventDefault();
        form.post(cycleLabels.store(cycle.id).url);
    }

    if (dluRules.length === 0) {
        return (
            <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle className="text-sm">Generate labels</CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        No packaging/storage rules are configured for this
                        practice yet, so a use-by date can&apos;t be
                        calculated. Ask an admin to set one up before labels
                        can be generated.
                    </p>
                </CardContent>
            </Card>
        );
    }

    const packagingTypes = [...new Set(dluRules.map((r) => r.packaging_type))];
    // Deduplicated by storage_condition — a practice can end up with more
    // than one rule row sharing the same packaging/storage pair (e.g. a
    // correction), which would otherwise render duplicate, identical
    // options with clashing React keys.
    const storageConditionsForPackaging = [
        ...new Map(
            dluRules
                .filter((r) => r.packaging_type === form.data.packaging_type)
                .map((r) => [r.storage_condition, r]),
        ).values(),
    ];

    return (
        <Card>
            <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="text-sm">Generate labels</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
                <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2">
                    <div>
                        <FieldLabel
                            htmlFor="packaging_type"
                            className="mb-1 block text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                        >
                            Packaging
                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Select
                            value={form.data.packaging_type}
                            onValueChange={(value) => {
                                form.setData('packaging_type', value);
                                form.setData('storage_condition', '');
                            }}
                        >
                            <SelectTrigger id="packaging_type" className="h-8 w-44">
                                <SelectValue placeholder="Select…" />
                            </SelectTrigger>
                            <SelectContent>
                                {packagingTypes.map((type) => (
                                    <SelectItem key={type} value={type}>
                                        {type}
                                    </SelectItem>
                                ))}
                            </SelectContent>
                        </Select>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <FieldLabel
                            htmlFor="storage_condition"
                            className="mb-1 block text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                        >
                            Storage
                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Select
                            value={form.data.storage_condition}
                            onValueChange={(value) =>
                                form.setData('storage_condition', value)
                            }
                            disabled={!form.data.packaging_type}
                        >
                            <SelectTrigger id="storage_condition" className="h-8 w-44">
                                <SelectValue placeholder="Select…" />
                            </SelectTrigger>
                            <SelectContent>
                                {storageConditionsForPackaging.map((r) => (
                                    <SelectItem
                                        key={r.storage_condition}
                                        value={r.storage_condition}
                                    >
                                        {r.storage_condition}
                                    </SelectItem>
                                ))}
                            </SelectContent>
                        </Select>
                    </div>
                    <Button
                        type="submit"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={form.processing || !rule}
                    >
                        Generate labels
                    </Button>
                    {rule && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            Use-by = sterilization date + {rule.shelf_life_days}{' '}
                            days.
                        </p>
                    )}
                </form>
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
}

function LabelCard({ label, item }: { label: LabelType; item?: CycleItem }) {
    const status = labelStatus[label.status] ?? labelStatus.created;

    return (
        <Card className="break-inside-avoid">
            <CardContent className="flex gap-4 py-4">
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
                    <img
                        src={labels.qrCode(label.id).url}
                        alt="QR code"
                        className="size-20"
                    />
                    <img
                        src={labels.datamatrix(label.id).url}
                        alt="DataMatrix code"
                        className="h-10 w-20"
                    />
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1 space-y-1 text-sm">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <Link
                            href={labels.show(label.id).url}
                            className="font-medium hover:underline"
                        >
                            #{item?.sequence_in_cycle ?? '—'}{' '}
                            {item?.description}
                        </Link>
                        <StatusBadge status={status} />
                    </div>
                    <dl className="grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        <dt>Sterilized</dt>
                        <dd>
                            <Mono>{formatDateTime(label.sterilized_at)}</Mono>
                        </dd>
                        <dt>Use by</dt>
                        <dd>
                            <Mono>{label.use_by_date}</Mono>
                        </dd>
                        <dt>Prints</dt>
                        <dd>
                            <Mono>{label.print_counter}</Mono>
                        </dd>
                    </dl>
                    <div className="no-print flex gap-2 pt-1">
                        <a
                            href={labels.pdf(label.id).url}
                            target="_blank"
                            rel="noreferrer"
                        >
                            <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                                Download PDF
                            </Button>
                        </a>
                        {label.print_counter === 0 ? (
                            <Button
                                size="sm"
                                onClick={() =>
                                    router.post(
                                        labels.print(label.id).url,
                                        {},
                                        { preserveScroll: true },
                                    )
                                }
                            >
                                Print
                            </Button>
                        ) : (
                            <ReprintLabelDialog label={label} />
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
}

                        </p>

                        <Button
                            variant="outline"
                            size="sm"
                            className="no-print"
                            onClick={() => window.print()}
                        >
                            Print sheet
                        </Button>
                    )}
                </div>

                {cycleLabelsList.length === 0 && (
                    <>
                        {canGenerate ? (
                            <div className="no-print">
                                <GenerateLabelsForm
                                    cycle={cycle}
                                    dluRules={dluRules}
                                />
                            </div>
                        ) : (
                            <Card>
                                <CardContent className="py-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                                    {cycle.status === 'released' ? (
                                        <>
                                            No labels have been generated for
                                            this cycle yet.
                                        </>
                                    ) : (
                                        <>
                                            Labels can only be generated once
                                            this cycle has been released as
                                            compliant.{' '}
                                            <Link
                                                href={cycles.show(cycle.id).url}
                                                className="text-primary hover:underline"
                                            >
                                                Back to cycle #
                                                {cycle.cycle_number}
                                            </Link>
                                        </>
                                    )}
                                </CardContent>
                            </Card>
                        )}
                    </>
                )}

                {cycleLabelsList.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="columns-1 gap-4 space-y-4 md:columns-2">
                        {cycleLabelsList.map((label) => (
                            <LabelCard
                                key={label.id}
                                label={label}
                                item={itemsById.get(label.cycle_item_id)}
                            />
                        ))}
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

function CycleActions({
    cycle,
    canManage,
    itemCount,
}: {
    cycle: Cycle;
    canManage: boolean;
    itemCount: number;
}) {
    if (!canManage) {
        return null;
    }

    if (cycle.status === 'draft') {
        const button = (
            <Button
                size="sm"
                disabled={itemCount === 0}
                onClick={() =>
                    router.post(
                        cycles.start(cycle.id).url,
                        {},
                        { preserveScroll: true },
                    )
                }
            >
                Start cycle
            </Button>
        );

        if (itemCount === 0) {
            return (
                <Tooltip>
                    <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                        {/* A disabled native button doesn't fire hover events for the tooltip — the wrapper does. */}
                        <span>{button}</span>
                    </TooltipTrigger>
                    <TooltipContent>
                        Add at least one item to the load before starting.
                    </TooltipContent>
                </Tooltip>
            );
        }

        return button;
    }

    if (cycle.status === 'running') {
        return (
            <Button
                size="sm"
                onClick={() =>
                    router.post(
                        cycles.complete(cycle.id).url,
                        {},
                        { preserveScroll: true },
                    )
                }
            >
                Complete cycle — record result
            </Button>
        );
    }

    if (cycle.status === 'completed') {
        return (
            <Button
                size="sm"
                onClick={() =>
                    router.post(
                        cycles.submitForRelease(cycle.id).url,
                        {},
                        { preserveScroll: true },
                    )
                }
            >
                Submit for release
            </Button>
        );
    }

    return null;
}

function RejectCycleDialog({ cycle }: { cycle: Cycle }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const form = useForm({ decision: 'rejected', reason: '' });

    function submit() {
        form.post(cycles.release(cycle.id).url, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                setOpen(false);
                form.reset();
            },
        });
    }

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
                setOpen(next);

                if (!next) {
                    form.reset();
                    form.clearErrors();
                }
            }}
        >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm" variant="destructive">
                    Reject cycle
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Reject cycle #{cycle.cycle_number}</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        This is permanent evidence — a rejection can&apos;t be
                        edited or undone afterwards, only explained.
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="grid gap-2">
                    <Label htmlFor="reject-reason">Reason</Label>
                    <Textarea
                        id="reject-reason"
                        value={form.data.reason}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                            form.setData('reason', e.target.value)
                        }
                        placeholder="What made this cycle non-compliant?"
                    />
                    {form.errors.reason && (
                        <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                            {form.errors.reason}
                        </p>
                    )}
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="destructive"
                        onClick={submit}
                        disabled={form.processing || !form.data.reason.trim()}
                    >
                        Reject cycle
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

function ReleaseDecisionForm({ cycle }: { cycle: Cycle }) {
    function releaseAsCompliant() {
        router.post(
            cycles.release(cycle.id).url,
            { decision: 'compliant' },
            { preserveScroll: true },
        );
    }

    return (
        <Card>
            <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="text-sm">Release decision</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <p className="mr-auto text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    This cycle is awaiting release. Both outcomes are
                    permanent evidence.
                </p>
                <RejectCycleDialog cycle={cycle} />
                <Button size="sm" onClick={releaseAsCompliant}>
                    Release as compliant
                </Button>
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
}

function AddItemForm({ cycle }: { cycle: Cycle }) {

    return (
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex items-start gap-2">

                />
                {form.errors.description && (

        </form>
    );
}

const CONTROL_TEST_TYPES = Object.keys(controlTestTypeLabel);

function defaultPerformedAt(): string {
    const now = new Date();
    now.setMinutes(now.getMinutes() - now.getTimezoneOffset());

    return now.toISOString().slice(0, 16);
}

function AttachmentUploadForm({ cycle }: { cycle: Cycle }) {
    const form = useForm<{ file: File | null }>({ file: null });

    function submit(e: FormEvent) {
        e.preventDefault();

        if (!form.data.file) {
            return;
        }

        form.post(cycleAttachments.store(cycle.id).url, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            forceFormData: true,
            onSuccess: () => form.reset(),
        });
    }

    return (
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex items-start gap-2">
            <div className="flex-1">
                <Input
                    type="file"
                    accept=".jpg,.jpeg,.png,.webp,.pdf"
                    onChange={(e) =>
                        form.setData('file', e.target.files?.[0] ?? null)
                    }
                    aria-label="Attach a ticket or photo"
                />
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF, up to 10&nbsp;MB.
                </p>
                {form.errors.file && (
                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-destructive">
                        {form.errors.file}
                    </p>
                )}
            </div>
            <Button
                type="submit"
                size="sm"
                disabled={form.processing || !form.data.file}
            >
                Upload
            </Button>
        </form>
    );
}

export default function CycleShow({
    cycle,
    device,
    program,
    operator,
    items,
    controlTests,
    attachments,
    release,
    releasedBy,
    nonConformityBlastRadius,
}: {

    program: Option | null;
    operator: Option;
    items: CycleItem[];
    controlTests: ControlTest[];
    attachments: CycleAttachment[];
    release: CycleRelease | null;

}) {

    const canManage = auth.permissions.includes('cycles.manage');
    const canRelease = auth.permissions.includes('cycles.release');

        'non_conformities.manage',
    );

                            </h1>

                            {cycle.status === 'released' && (

                                    blastRadius={nonConformityBlastRadius}
                                />
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <dl className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-x-6 gap-y-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        <div className="flex gap-1">
                            <dt className="font-medium">Device:</dt>
                            <dd>{device.label}</dd>
                        </div>
                        {program && (
                            <div className="flex gap-1">
                                <dt className="font-medium">Program:</dt>
                                <dd>{program.label}</dd>
                            </div>
                        )}
                        <div className="flex gap-1">
                            <dt className="font-medium">Operator:</dt>
                            <dd>{operator.label}</dd>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex gap-1">
                            <dt className="font-medium">Started:</dt>
                            <dd>
                                <Mono>{formatDateTime(cycle.started_at)}</Mono>
                            </dd>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex gap-1">
                            <dt className="font-medium">Completed:</dt>
                            <dd>
                                <Mono>
                                    {formatDateTime(cycle.completed_at)}
                                </Mono>
                            </dd>
                        </div>
                    </dl>
                </div>

                <Card>
                    <CardContent className="overflow-x-auto py-2">
                        <CycleTimeline status={cycle.status} />
                    </CardContent>
                </Card>

                {release && (
                    <Card>
                        <CardHeader>
                            <CardTitle className="text-sm">
                                Release decision
                            </CardTitle>
                        </CardHeader>
                        <CardContent className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-1 text-sm">

                                                <TableCell>
                                                    <Mono>
                                                        {item.sequence_in_cycle}
                                                    </Mono>
                                                </TableCell>
                                                <TableCell>
                                                    {item.description}
                                                </TableCell>
                                                <TableCell>
                                                    {item.batch_id ? (
                                                        <Mono className="text-xs">
                                                            {item.batch_id}
                                                        </Mono>
                                                    ) : (
                                                        '—'
                                                    )}
                                                </TableCell>
                                                {!loadLocked && canManage && (
                                                    <TableCell>
                                                        <Button
                                                            variant="ghost"
                                                            size="icon"
                                                            aria-label={`Remove item ${item.sequence_in_cycle}`}
                                                            onClick={() =>
                                                                router.delete(
                                                                    cycleItems.destroy(
                                                                        {
                                                                            cycle: cycle.id,
                                                                            item: item.id,
                                                                        },
                                                                    ).url,
                                                                    {
                                                                        preserveScroll: true,
                                                                    },
                                                                )
                                                            }
                                                        >
                                                            <Trash2 className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                                                        </Button>
                                                    </TableCell>
                                                )}
                                            </TableRow>
                                        ))}
                                    </TableBody>
                                </Table>
                            )}
                            {!loadLocked && canManage && (
                                <AddItemForm cycle={cycle} />
                            )}
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>

                    <Card>
                        <CardHeader>
                            <CardTitle className="text-sm">
                                Control tests
                            </CardTitle>
                        </CardHeader>
                        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                            {controlTests.length === 0 ? (
                                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                                    No control tests recorded for this cycle
                                    yet.
                                </p>
                            ) : (
                                <Table>
                                    <TableHeader>
                                        <TableRow>
                                            <TableHead>Type</TableHead>
                                            <TableHead>Result</TableHead>
                                            <TableHead>Performed</TableHead>
                                        </TableRow>
                                    </TableHeader>
                                    <TableBody>
                                        {controlTests.map((test) => (
                                            <TableRow key={test.id}>
                                                <TableCell>
                                                    {controlTestTypeLabel[
                                                        test.type
                                                    ] ?? test.type}
                                                </TableCell>
                                                <TableCell>
                                                    <StatusBadge
                                                        status={
                                                            controlTestResult[
                                                                test.result
                                                            ] ??
                                                            controlTestResult.fail
                                                        }
                                                    />
                                                </TableCell>
                                                <TableCell>
                                                    <Mono className="text-xs">
                                                        {formatDateTime(
                                                            test.performed_at,
                                                        )}
                                                    </Mono>
                                                </TableCell>
                                            </TableRow>
                                        ))}
                                    </TableBody>
                                </Table>
                            )}
                            {canManage &&
                                (cycle.status === 'completed' ||
                                    cycle.status === 'awaiting_release') && (
                                    <RecordControlTestForm cycle={cycle} />
                                )}
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                </div>

                <Card>
                    <CardHeader>
                        <CardTitle className="text-sm">Attachments</CardTitle>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                        {attachments.length === 0 ? (
                            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                                No tickets or photos have been attached to this
                                cycle yet.
                            </p>
                        ) : (
                            <ul className="divide-y">
                                {attachments.map((attachment) => (
                                    <li
                                        key={attachment.id}
                                        className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 py-2 text-sm"
                                    >
                                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                            <Paperclip className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                                            <a
                                                href={attachment.url}
                                                target="_blank"
                                                rel="noreferrer"
                                                className="text-primary hover:underline"
                                            >
                                                {attachment.file_name}
                                            </a>
                                        </span>
                                        <span className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                            <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                                                <Mono className="text-xs">
                                                    {formatDateTime(
                                                        attachment.created_at,
                                                    )}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </span>
                                            {canManage && (
                                                <Button
                                                    variant="ghost"
                                                    size="icon"
                                                    className="no-print"
                                                    aria-label={`Remove ${attachment.file_name}`}
                                                    onClick={() =>
                                                        router.delete(
                                                            cycleAttachments.destroy(
                                                                {
                                                                    cycle: cycle.id,
                                                                    media: attachment.id,
                                                                },
                                                            ).url,
                                                            {
                                                                preserveScroll: true,
                                                            },
                                                        )
                                                    }
                                                >
                                                    <Trash2 className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                                                </Button>
                                            )}
                                        </span>
                                    </li>
                                ))}
                            </ul>
                        )}
                        {canManage && <AttachmentUploadForm cycle={cycle} />}
                    </CardContent>
                </Card>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

CycleShow.layout = (props: { cycle: Cycle }) => ({
    breadcrumbs: [
        { title: 'Dashboard', href: dashboard() },
        { title: 'Cycles', href: cycles.index() },
        {

            href: cycles.show(props.cycle.id),
        },

});


==================== ./resources/js/pages/sterilization/labels/index.tsx ====================

import { Head, Link, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { AlertCircle, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Mono } from '@/components/mono';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/status-badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { labelStatus } from '@/lib/status';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import labels from '@/routes/labels';
import type { CursorPaginated, LabelFilters, LabelListEntry, Option } from '@/types';

const STATUS_OPTIONS = Object.keys(labelStatus);

export default function LabelsIndex({
    labels: labelsPage,
    devices,
    filters,
}: {
    labels: CursorPaginated<LabelListEntry>;
    devices: Option[];
    filters: LabelFilters;
}) {
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
    const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        const removeStart = router.on('start', () => setIsLoading(true));
        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };
    }, []);

    function applyFilters(next: Partial<LabelFilters>) {
        const merged: Record<string, string> = {
            ...filters,
            ...next,
        } as Record<string, string>;

        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(merged)) {
            if (!value || value === 'all') {
                delete merged[key];
            }
        }

        router.get(
            labels.index().url,
            { filter: merged },
            {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                replace: true,
                only: ['labels', 'filters'],
                onError: () => setLoadError(true),
                onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
            },
        );
    }

    function goTo(url: string | null) {
        if (!url) {
            return;
        }

        router.visit(url, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            only: ['labels', 'filters'],
            onError: () => setLoadError(true),
            onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
        });
    }

    function retry() {
        setLoadError(false);
        router.reload({ only: ['labels', 'filters'] });
    }

    const hasFilters = Object.keys(filters).length > 0;

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Labels" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div>
                    <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                        Labels
                    </h1>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        Every pouch label printed across every cycle, newest
                        first.
                    </p>
                </div>

                {loadError && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-md border border-status-danger-fg/30 bg-status-danger-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-status-danger-fg">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <AlertCircle className="size-4" />
                            Couldn&apos;t load labels — the request failed.
                            Your filters weren&apos;t lost.
                        </span>
                        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={retry}>
                            Retry
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                )}

                <div className="no-print flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Select
                        value={filters.status ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ status: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-40">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Status" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All statuses</SelectItem>
                            {STATUS_OPTIONS.map((status) => (
                                <SelectItem key={status} value={status}>
                                    {labelStatus[status].label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <Select
                        value={filters.device_id ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ device_id: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-44">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Device" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All devices</SelectItem>
                            {devices.map((device) => (
                                <SelectItem key={device.id} value={device.id}>
                                    {device.label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    {hasFilters && (
                        <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8"
                            onClick={() =>
                                router.get(
                                    labels.index().url,
                                    {},
                                    {
                                        preserveState: true,
                                        preserveScroll: true,
                                        replace: true,
                                        only: ['labels', 'filters'],
                                    },
                                )
                            }
                        >
                            <X className="size-3.5" />
                            Clear filters
                        </Button>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead className="w-28">Cycle</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Device</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Contents</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-32">Status</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-32">Use by</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-20">Prints</TableHead>
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {isLoading &&
                                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={`skeleton-${i}`}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map(
                                            (__, j) => (
                                                <TableCell key={j}>
                                                    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full max-w-32" />
                                                </TableCell>
                                            ),
                                        )}
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                !loadError &&
                                labelsPage.data.length === 0 && (
                                    <TableRow>
                                        <TableCell
                                            colSpan={6}
                                            className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground"
                                        >
                                            {hasFilters
                                                ? 'No labels match these filters.'
                                                : 'No labels have been generated yet — generate a sheet from a released cycle to see them here.'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                )}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                labelsPage.data.map((label) => {
                                    const status =
                                        labelStatus[label.status] ??
                                        labelStatus.created;

                                    return (
                                        <TableRow
                                            key={label.id}
                                            className="h-10 cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/40"
                                            onClick={() =>
                                                router.visit(
                                                    labels.show(label.id).url,
                                                )
                                            }
                                        >
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Link
                                                    href={
                                                        labels.show(label.id)
                                                            .url
                                                    }
                                                    className="hover:underline"
                                                    onClick={(e) =>
                                                        e.stopPropagation()
                                                    }
                                                >
                                                    <Mono>
                                                        #{label.cycle_number}
                                                    </Mono>
                                                </Link>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                {label.device_name}
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                {label.description}
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <StatusBadge status={status} />
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Mono className="text-xs">
                                                    {label.use_by_date}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Mono>
                                                    {label.print_counter}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </TableCell>
                                        </TableRow>
                                    );
                                })}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!labelsPage.prev_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(labelsPage.prev_page_url)}
                    >
                        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
                        Previous
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!labelsPage.next_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(labelsPage.next_page_url)}
                    >
                        Next
                        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

LabelsIndex.layout = {
    breadcrumbs: [
        { title: 'Dashboard', href: dashboard() },
        { title: 'Labels', href: labels.index() },
    ],
};

import { Head, Link, router, useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { Mono } from '@/components/mono';
import { RecallDialog } from '@/components/recall-dialog';
import { ReprintLabelDialog } from '@/components/reprint-label-dialog';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/status-badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label as FormLabel } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/format';
import { labelStatus } from '@/lib/status';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import cycles from '@/routes/cycles';
import labels from '@/routes/labels';
import labelUsage from '@/routes/labels/usage';
import patients from '@/routes/patients';
import type {
    Cycle,
    CycleItem,
    Label as LabelType,
    LabelPrint,
    LabelUsage,
    NonConformityBlastRadius,
    Option,
} from '@/types';

const UNUSABLE_STATUSES = ['recalled', 'voided', 'expired'];

function RecordUsageForm({
    label,
    patients: patientOptions,
    practitioners,
}: {
    label: LabelType;
    patients: Option[];
    practitioners: Option[];
}) {
    const form = useForm({
        patient_id: '',
        practitioner_id: '',
        procedure: '',
        notes: '',
    });

    function submit() {
        form.post(labelUsage.store(label.id).url, {
            preserveScroll: true,
        });
    }

    return (
        <div className="grid gap-4">
            <div className="grid gap-2">
                <FormLabel htmlFor="usage-patient">Patient</FormLabel>
                <Select
                    value={form.data.patient_id}
                    onValueChange={(value) =>
                        form.setData('patient_id', value)
                    }
                >
                    <SelectTrigger id="usage-patient" className="w-full">
                        <SelectValue placeholder="Select a patient" />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                        {patientOptions.map((p) => (
                            <SelectItem key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                                {p.label}
                            </SelectItem>
                        ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                </Select>
                {form.errors.patient_id && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                        {form.errors.patient_id}
                    </p>
                )}
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    Don&apos;t see the right patient?{' '}
                    <Link
                        href={patients.index().url}
                        className="underline"
                    >
                        Create one
                    </Link>
                    , then come back here.
                </p>
            </div>

            <div className="grid gap-2">
                <FormLabel htmlFor="usage-practitioner">
                    Practitioner
                </FormLabel>
                <Select
                    value={form.data.practitioner_id}
                    onValueChange={(value) =>
                        form.setData('practitioner_id', value)
                    }
                >
                    <SelectTrigger
                        id="usage-practitioner"
                        className="w-full"
                    >
                        <SelectValue placeholder="Select a practitioner" />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                        {practitioners.map((p) => (
                            <SelectItem key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                                {p.label}
                            </SelectItem>
                        ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                </Select>
                {form.errors.practitioner_id && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                        {form.errors.practitioner_id}
                    </p>
                )}
            </div>

            <div className="grid gap-2">
                <FormLabel htmlFor="usage-procedure">Procedure</FormLabel>
                <Input
                    id="usage-procedure"
                    value={form.data.procedure}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                        form.setData('procedure', e.target.value)
                    }
                    placeholder="e.g. Détartrage"
                />
                {form.errors.procedure && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                        {form.errors.procedure}
                    </p>
                )}
            </div>

            <div className="grid gap-2">
                <FormLabel htmlFor="usage-notes">
                    Notes (optional)
                </FormLabel>
                <Textarea
                    id="usage-notes"
                    value={form.data.notes}
                    onChange={(e) => form.setData('notes', e.target.value)}
                />
            </div>

            <div>
                <Button
                    onClick={submit}
                    disabled={
                        form.processing ||
                        !form.data.patient_id ||
                        !form.data.practitioner_id ||
                        !form.data.procedure.trim()
                    }
                >
                    Link label to procedure
                </Button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}
