                                <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                    Practice/site
                                </dt>
                                <dd>{site.label}</dd>
                                <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                    Device
                                </dt>
                                <dd>{device.label}</dd>
                                <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                    Cycle
                                </dt>
                                <dd>
                                    <Link
                                        href={cycles.show(cycle.id).url}
                                        className="hover:underline"
                                    >
                                        <Mono>#{cycle.cycle_number}</Mono>
                                    </Link>
                                </dd>
                                <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                    Sequence
                                </dt>

                                    <Mono>
                                        {item.sequence_in_cycle}
                                    </Mono>
                                </dd>
                                <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                    Batch
                                </dt>
                                <dd>
                                    {item.batch_id ? (
                                        <Mono className="text-xs">
                                            {item.batch_id}

                                        '—'

                                </dd>

                                    Storage

                                <dd>{label.storage_condition}</dd>
                            </dl>
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                </div>

                <Card>
                    <CardHeader>
                        <CardTitle className="text-sm">
                            Print history
                        </CardTitle>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                        {prints.length === 0 ? (
                            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                                This label hasn&apos;t been printed yet.
                            </p>
                        ) : (
                            <Table>
                                <TableHeader>
                                    <TableRow>
                                        <TableHead className="w-16">
                                            #
                                        </TableHead>
                                        <TableHead>Printed by</TableHead>
                                        <TableHead>Reason</TableHead>
                                        <TableHead>Printed at</TableHead>
                                    </TableRow>
                                </TableHeader>
                                <TableBody>
                                    {prints.map((print) => (
                                        <TableRow key={print.id}>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Mono>{print.sequence}</Mono>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                {printedByName(
                                                    print.printed_by_user_id,
                                                )}
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                                {print.reason ?? '—'}
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Mono className="text-xs">
                                                    {formatDateTime(
                                                        print.printed_at,
                                                    )}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </TableCell>
                                        </TableRow>
                                    ))}
                                </TableBody>
                            </Table>
                        )}
                    </CardContent>
                </Card>

                <Card>
                    <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
                        <CardTitle className="text-sm">
                            Point-of-care usage
                        </CardTitle>
                        {usage && canViewDossier && (
                            <a
                                href={labelUsage.dossier(label.id).url}
                                target="_blank"
                                rel="noreferrer"
                            >
                                <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                                    Evidence dossier
                                </Button>
                            </a>
                        )}
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                        {usage ? (
                            <dl className="grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-sm">
                                <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                    Patient
                                </dt>
                                <dd>
                                    <Mono>
                                        {patient?.label ?? '—'}
                                    </Mono>
                                </dd>
                                <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                    Practitioner
                                </dt>
                                <dd>{practitioner?.label ?? '—'}</dd>
                                <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                    Procedure
                                </dt>
                                <dd>{usage.procedure}</dd>
                                <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                    Used at
                                </dt>
                                <dd>
                                    <Mono>
                                        {formatDateTime(usage.used_at)}
                                    </Mono>
                                </dd>
                                {usage.notes && (
                                    <>
                                        <dt className="text-muted-foreground">
                                            Notes
                                        </dt>
                                        <dd>{usage.notes}</dd>
                                    </>
                                )}
                            </dl>
                        ) : UNUSABLE_STATUSES.includes(label.status) ? (
                            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                                This label is {label.status} and can no
                                longer be linked to a procedure.
                            </p>
                        ) : canRecordUsage ? (
                            <RecordUsageForm
                                label={label}
                                patients={patientOptions}
                                practitioners={practitioners}
                            />
                        ) : (
                            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                                Not yet scanned at the point of care — this
                                pouch hasn&apos;t been used on a patient yet.
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </CardContent>
                </Card>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

function invitationState(invitation: Invitation): keyof typeof invitationStatus {
    if (invitation.revoked_at) {
        return 'revoked';
    }

    if (invitation.accepted_at) {
        return 'accepted';
    }

    if (new Date(invitation.expires_at) < new Date()) {
        return 'expired';
    }

    return 'pending';
}

function InviteMemberDialog() {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const form = useForm({ email: '', role: '' });

    function submit() {
        form.post(teamInvitations.store().url, {
            onSuccess: () => {
                setOpen(false);
                form.reset();
            },
        });
    }

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
                setOpen(next);

                if (!next) {
                    form.reset();
                    form.clearErrors();
                }
            }}
        >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm">
                    <Plus className="size-4" />
                    Invite member
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Invite a team member</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        Sends an email with a link to set up their account.
                        The invitation expires after 7 days.
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="grid gap-4">
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <Label htmlFor="invite-email">Email</Label>
                        <Input
                            id="invite-email"
                            type="email"
                            value={form.data.email}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('email', e.target.value)
                            }
                        />
                        {form.errors.email && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.email}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <Label htmlFor="invite-role">Role</Label>
                        <Select
                            value={form.data.role}
                            onValueChange={(value) =>
                                form.setData('role', value)
                            }
                        >
                            <SelectTrigger id="invite-role" className="w-full">
                                <SelectValue placeholder="Select a role" />
                            </SelectTrigger>
                            <SelectContent>
                                {ROLE_OPTIONS.map((role) => (
                                    <SelectItem key={role} value={role}>
                                        {tenantRoleLabel[role]}
                                    </SelectItem>
                                ))}
                            </SelectContent>
                        </Select>
                        {form.errors.role && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.role}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        onClick={submit}
                        disabled={
                            form.processing ||
                            !form.data.email.trim() ||
                            !form.data.role
                        }
                    >
                        Send invitation
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

import { useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label as FieldLabel } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';

import { tenantRoleLabel } from '@/lib/status';
import practiceSettings from '@/routes/practice-settings';
import type { AlertSettings, DigestSubscription } from '@/types';

function NearExpiryPreview({ days }: { days: string }) {
    const [impact, setImpact] = useState<{
        appearing: number;
        disappearing: number;
    } | null>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        const value = Number(days);

        const handle = setTimeout(() => {
            if (!value || value < 1) {
                setImpact(null);

                return;
            }

            fetch(practiceSettings.alerts.previewNearExpiry().url, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    Accept: 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                    'X-XSRF-TOKEN': decodeURIComponent(
                        document.cookie
                            .split('; ')
                            .find((row) => row.startsWith('XSRF-TOKEN='))
                            ?.split('=')[1] ?? '',
                    ),
                },
                body: JSON.stringify({ near_expiry_days: value }),
            })
                .then((response) => (response.ok ? response.json() : null))
                .then(setImpact)
                .catch(() => setImpact(null));
        }, 400);

        return () => clearTimeout(handle);
    }, [days]);

    if (!impact || (impact.appearing === 0 && impact.disappearing === 0)) {
        return null;
    }

    return (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            At this window: {impact.appearing} new near-expiry alert
            {impact.appearing === 1 ? '' : 's'} would appear,{' '}
            {impact.disappearing} would disappear. Resolved alerts stay
            untouched either way.
        </p>
    );
}

export function AlertsSection({
    alertSettings,
    digestSubscriptions,
}: {
    alertSettings: AlertSettings;
    digestSubscriptions: DigestSubscription[];
}) {
    const form = useForm({
        near_expiry_days: String(alertSettings.near_expiry_days),
        default_low_stock_threshold: String(
            alertSettings.default_low_stock_threshold,
        ),
        control_test_frequency_days:
            alertSettings.control_test_frequency_days === null
                ? ''
                : String(alertSettings.control_test_frequency_days),
        control_test_overdue_tolerance_days:
            alertSettings.control_test_overdue_tolerance_days === null
                ? ''
                : String(alertSettings.control_test_overdue_tolerance_days),
        failed_cycle_escalation_hours: String(
            alertSettings.failed_cycle_escalation_hours,
        ),
        digests_enabled: alertSettings.digests_enabled,
        reason: '',
    });

    const digestForm = useForm<{
        subscriptions: DigestSubscription[];
        reason: string;
    }>({
        subscriptions: digestSubscriptions,
        reason: '',
    });

    function submit() {
        form.patch(practiceSettings.alerts.update().url, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => form.setData('reason', ''),
        });
    }

    function submitDigests() {
        digestForm.put(practiceSettings.digestSubscriptions.update().url, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => digestForm.setData('reason', ''),
        });
    }

    function updateSubscription(
        role: string,
        patch: Partial<DigestSubscription>,
    ) {
        digestForm.setData(
            'subscriptions',
            digestForm.data.subscriptions.map((subscription) =>
                subscription.role === role
                    ? { ...subscription, ...patch }
                    : subscription,
            ),
        );
    }

    return (
        <div className="grid gap-4">
            <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle className="text-sm">
                        Alert thresholds
                    </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent className="grid gap-4">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <FieldLabel htmlFor="near-expiry-days">
                                Near-expiry window (days)
                            </FieldLabel>
                            <Input
                                id="near-expiry-days"
                                type="number"
                                min={1}
                                value={form.data.near_expiry_days}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                    form.setData(
                                        'near_expiry_days',
                                        e.target.value,
                                    )
                                }
                            />
                            <NearExpiryPreview
                                days={form.data.near_expiry_days}
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <FieldLabel htmlFor="default-low-stock">
                                Default low-stock threshold
                            </FieldLabel>
                            <Input
                                id="default-low-stock"
                                type="number"
                                min={0}
                                value={form.data.default_low_stock_threshold}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                    form.setData(
                                        'default_low_stock_threshold',
                                        e.target.value,
                                    )
                                }
                            />
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                Applies to new products only — each
                                product's own threshold can still be set
                                individually.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <FieldLabel htmlFor="control-test-frequency">
                                Control test frequency (days)
                            </FieldLabel>
                            <Input
                                id="control-test-frequency"
                                type="number"
                                min={1}
                                value={form.data.control_test_frequency_days}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                    form.setData(
                                        'control_test_frequency_days',
                                        e.target.value,
                                    )
                                }
                                placeholder="Not set"
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <FieldLabel htmlFor="control-test-tolerance">
                                Overdue tolerance (days)
                            </FieldLabel>
                            <Input
                                id="control-test-tolerance"
                                type="number"
                                min={0}
                                value={
                                    form.data
                                        .control_test_overdue_tolerance_days
                                }
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                    form.setData(
                                        'control_test_overdue_tolerance_days',
                                        e.target.value,
                                    )
                                }
                                placeholder="Not set"
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <FieldLabel htmlFor="failed-cycle-escalation">
                                Failed-cycle escalation (hours)
                            </FieldLabel>
                            <Input
                                id="failed-cycle-escalation"
                                type="number"
                                min={1}
                                value={
                                    form.data.failed_cycle_escalation_hours
                                }
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                    form.setData(
                                        'failed_cycle_escalation_hours',
                                        e.target.value,
                                    )
                                }
                            />
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                        <Checkbox
                            checked={form.data.digests_enabled}
                            onCheckedChange={(checked) =>
                                form.setData(
                                    'digests_enabled',
                                    checked === true,
                                )
                            }

                        Send email digests
                    </label>

                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <FieldLabel htmlFor="alert-settings-reason">
                            Reason
                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Textarea
                            id="alert-settings-reason"
                            value={form.data.reason}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('reason', e.target.value)
                            }
                            placeholder="Why are these thresholds changing?"
                        />
                        {form.errors.reason && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.reason}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <Button
                            onClick={submit}
                            disabled={
                                form.processing || !form.data.reason.trim()
                            }
                        >
                            Save thresholds
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle className="text-sm">
                        Digest subscriptions
                    </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent className="grid gap-4">
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                        Sent via Resend to every active user currently
                        holding the role, not a stored address list — it
                        stays correct as the team changes. Turned off
                        entirely above disables every digest for this
                        practice regardless of these subscriptions.
                    </p>

                    <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                        <Table>
                            <TableHeader>
                                <TableRow>
                                    <TableHead>Role</TableHead>
                                    <TableHead>Frequency</TableHead>
                                    <TableHead>Enabled</TableHead>
                                    <TableHead>Last sent</TableHead>
                                </TableRow>
                            </TableHeader>
                            <TableBody>
                                {digestForm.data.subscriptions.map(
                                    (subscription) => (
                                        <TableRow
                                            key={subscription.role}
                                            className="h-10"
                                        >
                                            <TableCell>
                                                {tenantRoleLabel[
                                                    subscription.role
                                                ] ?? subscription.role}
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Select
                                                    value={
                                                        subscription.frequency
                                                    }
                                                    onValueChange={(value) =>
                                                        updateSubscription(
                                                            subscription.role,
                                                            {
                                                                frequency:
                                                                    value as DigestSubscription['frequency'],
                                                            },
                                                        )
                                                    }
                                                >
                                                    <SelectTrigger className="h-8 w-32">
                                                        <SelectValue />
                                                    </SelectTrigger>
                                                    <SelectContent>
                                                        <SelectItem value="daily">
                                                            Daily
                                                        </SelectItem>
                                                        <SelectItem value="weekly">
                                                            Weekly
                                                        </SelectItem>
                                                    </SelectContent>
                                                </Select>
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell>
                                                <Checkbox
                                                    checked={
                                                        subscription.enabled
                                                    }
                                                    onCheckedChange={(
                                                        checked,
                                                    ) =>
                                                        updateSubscription(
                                                            subscription.role,
                                                            {
                                                                enabled:
                                                                    checked ===
                                                                    true,
                                                            },
                                                        )
                                                    }
                                                    aria-label={`${subscription.role} digest enabled`}
                                                />
                                            </TableCell>
                                            <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                                {subscription.last_sent_at
                                                    ? new Date(
                                                          subscription.last_sent_at,
                                                      ).toLocaleString()
                                                    : 'Never'}
                                            </TableCell>
                                        </TableRow>
                                    ),
                                )}
                            </TableBody>
                        </Table>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <FieldLabel htmlFor="digest-subscriptions-reason">
                            Reason
                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Textarea
                            id="digest-subscriptions-reason"
                            value={digestForm.data.reason}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                digestForm.setData('reason', e.target.value)
                            }
                        />
                        {digestForm.errors.reason && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {digestForm.errors.reason}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <Button
                            onClick={submitDigests}
                            disabled={
                                digestForm.processing ||
                                !digestForm.data.reason.trim()
                            }
                        >
                            Save digest subscriptions
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                </CardContent>
            </Card>
        </div>
    );
}


==================== ./resources/js/pages/tenancy/practice-settings/dlu-rule-section.tsx ====================

import { useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { AlertTriangle, Pencil, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import {
    Dialog,
    DialogContent,
    DialogDescription,
    DialogFooter,
    DialogHeader,
    DialogTitle,
    DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label as FieldLabel } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import practiceSettings from '@/routes/practice-settings';
import type { DluRule } from '@/types';

function AddRuleDialog({ canManage }: { canManage: boolean }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const form = useForm({
        packaging_type: '',
        storage_condition: '',
        shelf_life_days: '',
        reason: '',
    });

    function submit() {
        form.post(practiceSettings.dluRules.store().url, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                setOpen(false);
                form.reset();
            },
        });
    }

    if (!canManage) {
        return null;
    }

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
                setOpen(next);

                if (!next) {
                    form.reset();
                    form.clearErrors();
                }
            }}
        >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm">
                    <Plus className="size-4" />
                    Add rule
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Add a DLU rule</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        Computes the use-by date for labels generated with
                        this packaging and storage combination.
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="grid gap-4">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <FieldLabel htmlFor="new-rule-packaging">
                                Packaging type
                            </FieldLabel>
                            <Input
                                id="new-rule-packaging"
                                value={form.data.packaging_type}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                    form.setData(
                                        'packaging_type',
                                        e.target.value,
                                    )
                                }
                            />
                            {form.errors.packaging_type && (
                                <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                    {form.errors.packaging_type}
                                </p>
                            )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <FieldLabel htmlFor="new-rule-storage">
                                Storage condition
                            </FieldLabel>
                            <Input
                                id="new-rule-storage"
                                value={form.data.storage_condition}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                    form.setData(
                                        'storage_condition',
                                        e.target.value,
                                    )
                                }
                            />
                            {form.errors.storage_condition && (
                                <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                    {form.errors.storage_condition}
                                </p>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <FieldLabel htmlFor="new-rule-shelf-life">
                            Shelf life (days)
                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Input
                            id="new-rule-shelf-life"
                            type="number"
                            min={1}
                            value={form.data.shelf_life_days}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData(
                                    'shelf_life_days',
                                    e.target.value,
                                )
                            }
                        />
                        {form.errors.shelf_life_days && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.shelf_life_days}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <FieldLabel htmlFor="new-rule-reason">
                            Reason
                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Textarea
                            id="new-rule-reason"
                            value={form.data.reason}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('reason', e.target.value)
                            }
                            placeholder="Source for this shelf-life value?"
                        />
                        {form.errors.reason && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.reason}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        onClick={submit}
                        disabled={
                            form.processing ||
                            !form.data.packaging_type.trim() ||
                            !form.data.storage_condition.trim() ||
                            !form.data.shelf_life_days ||
                            !form.data.reason.trim()
                        }
                    >
                        Add rule
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

function EditRuleDialog({ rule }: { rule: DluRule }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const form = useForm({
        shelf_life_days: String(rule.shelf_life_days),
        reason: '',
    });

    function submit() {
        form.patch(practiceSettings.dluRules.update(rule.id).url, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                setOpen(false);
                form.reset();
            },
        });
    }

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
                setOpen(next);

                if (!next) {
                    form.clearErrors();
                }
            }}
        >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="size-7">
                    <Pencil className="size-3.5" />
                    <span className="sr-only">
                        Edit {rule.packaging_type} / {rule.storage_condition}
                    </span>
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>
                        Edit {rule.packaging_type} / {rule.storage_condition}
                    </DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        New use-by rules apply to labels printed from now
                        on.{' '}
                        {rule.existing_labels_count > 0 ? (
                            <>
                                <strong>
                                    {rule.existing_labels_count} existing
                                    label
                                    {rule.existing_labels_count === 1
                                        ? ''
                                        : 's'}
                                </strong>{' '}
                                keep their current use-by dates — this
                                change is never applied retroactively.
                            </>
                        ) : (
                            'No labels have used this rule yet.'
                        )}
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="grid gap-4">
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <FieldLabel htmlFor={`edit-rule-shelf-life-${rule.id}`}>
                            Shelf life (days)
                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Input
                            id={`edit-rule-shelf-life-${rule.id}`}
                            type="number"
                            min={1}
                            value={form.data.shelf_life_days}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData(
                                    'shelf_life_days',
                                    e.target.value,
                                )
                            }
                        />
                        {form.errors.shelf_life_days && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.shelf_life_days}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <FieldLabel htmlFor={`edit-rule-reason-${rule.id}`}>
                            Reason
                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Textarea
                            id={`edit-rule-reason-${rule.id}`}
                            value={form.data.reason}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('reason', e.target.value)
                            }
                        />
                        {form.errors.reason && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.reason}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        onClick={submit}
                        disabled={
                            form.processing ||
                            !form.data.shelf_life_days ||
                            !form.data.reason.trim()
                        }
                    >
                        Save changes
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

                    <AlertDescription>
                        No EN 868 defaults are pre-filled — inventing

                        compliance figure. Every value below was entered by
                        this practice and has not been signed off by a

                        rule never changes an existing label's use-by date.

                {!canManage && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground italic">

                                    Shelf life
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="text-right">
                                    Labels using it
                                </TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Last updated</TableHead>
                                {canManage && (
                                    <TableHead className="no-print w-10" />
                                )}
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {dluRules.length === 0 && (

                                        className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground"

                                        No DLU rules yet.
                                    </TableCell>
                                </TableRow>
                            )}
                            {dluRules.map((rule) => (

                                    <TableCell>
                                        {rule.packaging_type}
                                    </TableCell>
                                    <TableCell>
                                        {rule.storage_condition}
                                    </TableCell>
                                    <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                                        {rule.shelf_life_days} days
                                    </TableCell>
                                    <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                                        {rule.existing_labels_count}
                                    </TableCell>
                                    <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                        {rule.last_updated_at
                                            ? new Date(
                                                  rule.last_updated_at,
                                              ).toLocaleDateString()
                                            : '—'}
                                        {rule.last_updated_by &&
                                            ` (${rule.last_updated_by})`}
                                    </TableCell>
                                    {canManage && (
                                        <TableCell className="no-print">
                                            <EditRuleDialog rule={rule} />
                                        </TableCell>
                                    )}
                                </TableRow>
                            ))}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
}

export function IdentitySection({ identity }: { identity: PracticeIdentity }) {
    const form = useForm({
        name: identity.name,
        legal_name: identity.legal_name ?? '',
        address_line1: identity.address_line1 ?? '',
        address_line2: identity.address_line2 ?? '',
        postal_code: identity.postal_code ?? '',
        city: identity.city ?? '',
        country_code: identity.country_code ?? '',
        contact_email: identity.contact_email ?? '',
        contact_phone: identity.contact_phone ?? '',

                                id="settings-name"
                                value={form.data.name}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                    form.setData('name', e.target.value)
                                }

                                Timezone
                            </FieldLabel>
                            <Input
                                id="settings-timezone"
                                value={form.data.timezone}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                    form.setData('timezone', e.target.value)
                                }
                                placeholder="Europe/Paris"
                            />
                            {form.errors.timezone && (
                                <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                    {form.errors.timezone}
                                </p>
                            )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <FieldLabel htmlFor="settings-locale">
                                Locale
                            </FieldLabel>
                            <Input
                                id="settings-locale"
                                value={form.data.locale}

                                    form.setData('locale', e.target.value)
                                }
                                placeholder="fr"
                            />
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <FieldLabel htmlFor="settings-identity-reason">
                            Reason
                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Textarea
                            id="settings-identity-reason"
                            value={form.data.reason}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('reason', e.target.value)
                            }
                            placeholder="Why is this changing?"
                        />
                        {form.errors.reason && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">

                            }}
                        />

                        </p>
                    )}

                        <FieldLabel htmlFor="settings-logo-reason">

                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Textarea
                            id="settings-logo-reason"
                            value={logoForm.data.reason}

                                logoForm.setData('reason', e.target.value)
                            }
                        />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <Button
                            onClick={submitLogo}
                            disabled={
                                logoForm.processing ||
                                !logoForm.data.logo ||
                                !logoForm.data.reason.trim()
                            }
                        >
                            Save logo
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                </CardContent>
            </Card>
        </div>
    );
}

==================== ./resources/js/pages/tenancy/practice-settings/label-format-section.tsx ====================

import { useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { Printer } from 'lucide-react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import {
    Dialog,
    DialogContent,
    DialogDescription,
    DialogFooter,
    DialogHeader,
    DialogTitle,
    DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Label as FieldLabel } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { sheetLayoutLabel } from '@/lib/status';
import practiceSettings from '@/routes/practice-settings';
import type { LabelFormatVersion } from '@/types';

const DEFAULTS: Pick<
    LabelFormatVersion,
    'primary_code' | 'sheet_layout' | 'show_batch_number' | 'show_product_name'
> = {
    primary_code: 'datamatrix',
    sheet_layout: 'a4_24',
    show_batch_number: false,
    show_product_name: false,
};

export function LabelFormatSection({
    labelFormat,
    canManage,
}: {
    labelFormat: LabelFormatVersion | null;
    canManage: boolean;
}) {
    const current = labelFormat ?? DEFAULTS;
    const form = useForm({
        primary_code: current.primary_code,
        sheet_layout: current.sheet_layout,
        show_batch_number: current.show_batch_number,
        show_product_name: current.show_product_name,
        reason: '',
    });
    const [confirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false);

    function testPrint() {
        const params = new URLSearchParams({
            primary_code: form.data.primary_code,
            sheet_layout: form.data.sheet_layout,
            show_batch_number: form.data.show_batch_number ? '1' : '0',
            show_product_name: form.data.show_product_name ? '1' : '0',
        });
        window.open(
            `${practiceSettings.labelFormat.sample().url}?${params.toString()}`,
            '_blank',
        );
    }

    function submit() {
        form.post(practiceSettings.labelFormat.update().url, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                setConfirmOpen(false);
                form.setData('reason', '');
            },
        });
    }

    const hasChanges =
        form.data.primary_code !== current.primary_code ||
        form.data.sheet_layout !== current.sheet_layout ||
        form.data.show_batch_number !== current.show_batch_number ||
        form.data.show_product_name !== current.show_product_name;

    return (
        <Card>
            <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="text-sm">Label format</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="grid gap-4">
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    QR and DataMatrix always both print on every label —
                    this only controls which is visually larger, the sheet
                    layout, and which optional fields also appear. Changing
                    it applies to labels printed{' '}
                    <strong>from now on only</strong>; every already-printed
                    label keeps the payload and appearance it was printed
                    with.
                </p>

                {!canManage && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground italic">
                        Only the practice owner can change the label
                        format.
                    </p>
                )}

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <FieldLabel htmlFor="label-format-primary-code">
                            Primary code
                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Select
                            value={form.data.primary_code}
                            onValueChange={(value) =>
                                form.setData(
                                    'primary_code',
                                    value as LabelFormatVersion['primary_code'],
                                )
                            }
                            disabled={!canManage}
                        >
                            <SelectTrigger
                                id="label-format-primary-code"
                                className="w-full"
                            >
                                <SelectValue />
                            </SelectTrigger>
                            <SelectContent>
                                <SelectItem value="datamatrix">
                                    DataMatrix
                                </SelectItem>
                                <SelectItem value="qr">QR</SelectItem>
                            </SelectContent>
                        </Select>
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <FieldLabel htmlFor="label-format-sheet-layout">
                            Sheet layout
                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Select
                            value={form.data.sheet_layout}
                            onValueChange={(value) =>
                                form.setData(
                                    'sheet_layout',
                                    value as LabelFormatVersion['sheet_layout'],
                                )
                            }
                            disabled={!canManage}
                        >
                            <SelectTrigger
                                id="label-format-sheet-layout"
                                className="w-full"
                            >
                                <SelectValue />
                            </SelectTrigger>
                            <SelectContent>
                                {Object.entries(sheetLayoutLabel).map(
                                    ([value, label]) => (
                                        <SelectItem key={value} value={value}>
                                            {label}
                                        </SelectItem>
                                    ),
                                )}
                            </SelectContent>
                        </Select>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                        <Checkbox
                            checked={form.data.show_batch_number}
                            onCheckedChange={(checked) =>
                                form.setData(
                                    'show_batch_number',
                                    checked === true,
                                )
                            }
                            disabled={!canManage}
                        />
                        Show batch number (in addition to the mandatory
                        fields)
                    </label>
                    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                        <Checkbox
                            checked={form.data.show_product_name}
                            onCheckedChange={(checked) =>
                                form.setData(
                                    'show_product_name',
                                    checked === true,
                                )
                            }
                            disabled={!canManage}
                        />
                        Show product name (in addition to the mandatory
                        fields)
                    </label>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={testPrint}>
                        <Printer className="size-4" />
                        Test print a sample sheet
                    </Button>

                    {canManage && (
                        <Dialog
                            open={confirmOpen}
                            onOpenChange={setConfirmOpen}
                        >
                            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                                <Button disabled={!hasChanges}>
                                    Save changes
                                </Button>
                            </DialogTrigger>
                            <DialogContent>
                                <DialogHeader>
                                    <DialogTitle>
                                        Save the new label format?
                                    </DialogTitle>
                                    <DialogDescription>
                                        New labels printed from now on use
                                        this format. Every label printed
                                        before today keeps the exact
                                        appearance it was printed with —
                                        nothing is re-rendered.
                                    </DialogDescription>
                                </DialogHeader>

                                <div className="grid gap-2">
                                    <FieldLabel htmlFor="label-format-reason">
                                        Reason
                                    </FieldLabel>
                                    <Textarea
                                        id="label-format-reason"
                                        value={form.data.reason}
                                        onChange={(e) =>
                                            form.setData(
                                                'reason',
                                                e.target.value,
                                            )
                                        }
                                        placeholder="Why is the format changing?"
                                    />
                                    {form.errors.reason && (
                                        <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                            {form.errors.reason}
                                        </p>
                                    )}
                                </div>

                                <DialogFooter>
                                    <Button
                                        variant="outline"
                                        onClick={() => setConfirmOpen(false)}
                                    >
                                        Cancel
                                    </Button>
                                    <Button
                                        onClick={submit}
                                        disabled={
                                            form.processing ||
                                            !form.data.reason.trim()
                                        }
                                    >
                                        Save label format
                                    </Button>
                                </DialogFooter>
                            </DialogContent>
                        </Dialog>
                    )}
                </div>

                {labelFormat && (
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        Last changed{' '}
                        {new Date(labelFormat.effective_from).toLocaleString()}
                        {labelFormat.updated_by &&
                            ` by ${labelFormat.updated_by}`}
                        {' — '}
                        {labelFormat.reason}
                    </p>
                )}
            </CardContent>
        </Card>
    );
}

import { Head, useForm } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { Archive, Boxes, Pencil, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';

import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';

    Dialog,
    DialogContent,
    DialogDescription,
    DialogFooter,
    DialogHeader,
    DialogTitle,
    DialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label as FieldLabel } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,

    SelectValue,

function EditSiteDialog({ site }: { site: Site }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const form = useForm({
        name: site.name,
        address_line1: site.address_line1 ?? '',
        city: site.city ?? '',
        postal_code: site.postal_code ?? '',
        timezone: site.timezone,
        is_primary: site.is_primary,
    });

    function submit() {
        form.patch(sites.update(site.id).url, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => setOpen(false),
        });
    }

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
                setOpen(next);

                if (!next) {
                    form.clearErrors();
                }
            }}
        >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                    <Pencil className="size-4" />
                    Edit
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Edit site</DialogTitle>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="grid gap-4">
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <FieldLabel htmlFor="edit-site-name">
                            Name
                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Input
                            id="edit-site-name"
                            value={form.data.name}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('name', e.target.value)
                            }
                        />
                        {form.errors.name && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.name}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <FieldLabel htmlFor="edit-site-address">
                            Address
                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Input
                            id="edit-site-address"
                            value={form.data.address_line1}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('address_line1', e.target.value)
                            }
                        />
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <FieldLabel htmlFor="edit-site-city">
                                City
                            </FieldLabel>
                            <Input
                                id="edit-site-city"
                                value={form.data.city}
                                onChange={(e) =>
                                    form.setData('city', e.target.value)
                                }
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div className="grid gap-2">
                            <FieldLabel htmlFor="edit-site-postal-code">
                                Postal code
                            </FieldLabel>
                            <Input
                                id="edit-site-postal-code"
                                value={form.data.postal_code}

                                    form.setData('postal_code', e.target.value)
                                }
                            />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                        <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            checked={form.data.is_primary}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('is_primary', e.target.checked)
                            }
                        />
                        Primary site
                    </label>
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        onClick={submit}
                        disabled={form.processing || !form.data.name.trim()}
                    >
                        Save changes
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

function ArchiveSiteDialog({
    site,
    roomsCount,
    locationsCount,
    devicesCount,
}: {
    site: Site;
    roomsCount: number;
    locationsCount: number;
    devicesCount: number;
}) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const form = useForm({ reason: '' });

    function submit() {
        form.delete(sites.archive(site.id).url, {
            onSuccess: () => setOpen(false),
        });
    }

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
                setOpen(next);

                if (!next) {
                    form.reset();
                    form.clearErrors();
                }
            }}
        >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm" variant="destructive">
                    Archive site
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Archive {site.name}?</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        {roomsCount === 0 && locationsCount === 0 ? (
                            <>
                                This site has no rooms or storage locations
                                under it.
                            </>
                        ) : (
                            <>
                                This will also archive{' '}
                                <strong>
                                    {roomsCount} room
                                    {roomsCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                                </strong>{' '}
                                and{' '}
                                <strong>
                                    {locationsCount} storage location
                                    {locationsCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                                </strong>
                                .
                            </>
                        )}{' '}
                        {devicesCount > 0 && (
                            <>
                                {devicesCount} device
                                {devicesCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} still
                                reference this site and will keep doing so.{' '}
                            </>
                        )}
                        Nothing is deleted — past evidence keeps resolving
                        this site by identity, it's just hidden from pickers
                        from now on.
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="grid gap-2">
                    <FieldLabel htmlFor="archive-site-reason">
                        Reason
                    </FieldLabel>
                    <Textarea
                        id="archive-site-reason"
                        value={form.data.reason}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                            form.setData('reason', e.target.value)
                        }
                        placeholder="Why is this site being archived?"
                    />
                    {form.errors.reason && (
                        <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                            {form.errors.reason}
                        </p>
                    )}
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="destructive"
                        onClick={submit}
                        disabled={form.processing || !form.data.reason.trim()}
                    >
                        Archive site
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}
