                            </SelectTrigger>
                            <SelectContent>
                                {allSites.map((option) => (
                                    <SelectItem
                                        key={option.id}
                                        value={option.id}
                                    >
                                        {option.label}
                                    </SelectItem>
                                ))}
                            </SelectContent>
                        </Select>
                        {form.errors.site_id && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.site_id}
                            </p>
                        )}
                        {form.data.site_id !== room.site_id && (
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                Moving to a different site is refused if any
                                of this room's storage locations has ever
                                recorded a stock movement.
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        onClick={submit}
                        disabled={form.processing || !form.data.name.trim()}
                    >
                        Save changes
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

function ArchiveRoomDialog({ room }: { room: Room }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const form = useForm({ reason: '' });
    const locationsCount = room.storage_locations_count ?? 0;

    function submit() {
        form.delete(rooms.archive(room.id).url, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => setOpen(false),
        });
    }

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
                setOpen(next);

                if (!next) {
                    form.reset();
                    form.clearErrors();
                }
            }}
        >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="size-7">
                    <Archive className="size-3.5" />
                    <span className="sr-only">Archive {room.name}</span>
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Archive {room.name}?</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        {locationsCount === 0 ? (
                            <>This room has no storage locations under it.</>
                        ) : (
                            <>
                                This will also archive{' '}
                                <strong>
                                    {locationsCount} storage location
                                    {locationsCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                                </strong>
                                .
                            </>
                        )}{' '}
                        Nothing is deleted — past evidence keeps resolving
                        this room by identity.
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="grid gap-2">
                    <FieldLabel htmlFor={`archive-room-reason-${room.id}`}>
                        Reason
                    </FieldLabel>
                    <Textarea
                        id={`archive-room-reason-${room.id}`}
                        value={form.data.reason}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                            form.setData('reason', e.target.value)
                        }
                    />
                    {form.errors.reason && (
                        <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                            {form.errors.reason}
                        </p>
                    )}
                </div>

                <DialogFooter>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="destructive"
                        onClick={submit}
                        disabled={form.processing || !form.data.reason.trim()}
                    >
                        Archive room
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

function AddLocationDialog({ roomId }: { roomId: string }) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const form = useForm({ name: '', kind: '' });

    function submit(again: boolean) {
        form.post(rooms.storageLocations.store(roomId).url, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                if (again) {
                    form.setData('name', '');
                    form.setData('kind', '');
                } else {
                    setOpen(false);
                    form.reset();
                }
            },
        });
    }

    return (
        <Dialog
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(next) => {
                setOpen(next);

                if (!next) {
                    form.reset();
                    form.clearErrors();
                }
            }}
        >
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-7 text-xs">
                    <Plus className="size-3.5" />
                    Add location
                </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
                <DialogHeader>
                    <DialogTitle>Add a storage location</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription>
                        e.g. cupboard, drawer, fridge, shelf.
                    </DialogDescription>
                </DialogHeader>

                <div className="grid gap-4">
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <FieldLabel htmlFor="new-location-name">
                            Name
                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Input
                            id="new-location-name"
                            value={form.data.name}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('name', e.target.value)
                            }
                            autoFocus
                        />
                        {form.errors.name && (
                            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                                {form.errors.name}
                            </p>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid gap-2">
                        <FieldLabel htmlFor="new-location-kind">
                            Kind (optional)
                        </FieldLabel>
                        <Input
                            id="new-location-kind"
                            value={form.data.kind}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                form.setData('kind', e.target.value)
                            }
                        />
                    </div>
                </div>

                <DialogFooter className="sm:justify-between">
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                        Finish
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        onClick={() => submit(true)}
                        disabled={form.processing || !form.data.name.trim()}
                    >
                        Add and add another
                    </Button>
                </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
    );
}

function ArchiveLocationDialog({ location }: { location: StorageLocation }) {

export default function SiteShow({
    site,
    rooms: roomList,
    storageLocations: locationList,
    devicesCount,
    activeBatchesCount,
    allSites,
    canManage,
}: {
    site: Site;
    rooms: Room[];
    storageLocations: StorageLocation[];
    devicesCount: number;
    activeBatchesCount: number;
    allSites: Option[];
    canManage: boolean;
}) {
    const locationsByRoom = new Map<string, StorageLocation[]>();

    for (const location of locationList) {
        if (!location.room_id) {
            continue;
        }

        const list = locationsByRoom.get(location.room_id) ?? [];
        list.push(location);
        locationsByRoom.set(location.room_id, list);
    }

    const roomOptions: Option[] = roomList.map((room) => ({
        id: room.id,
        label: room.name,
    }));

    return (
        <>
            <Head title={site.name} />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                                {site.name}
                            </h1>
                            {site.is_primary && (
                                <Badge variant="secondary">Primary</Badge>
                            )}
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            {[
                                site.address_line1,
                                site.city,
                                site.postal_code,
                            ]
                                .filter(Boolean)
                                .join(', ') || 'No address on file'}
                            {' · '}
                            {site.timezone}
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    {canManage && (
                        <div className="no-print flex gap-2">
                            <EditSiteDialog site={site} />
                            <ArchiveSiteDialog
                                site={site}
                                roomsCount={site.rooms_count ?? 0}
                                locationsCount={
                                    site.storage_locations_count ?? 0
                                }
                                devicesCount={devicesCount}
                            />
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
                    <Card>
                        <CardContent className="p-4">
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                Rooms
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums">
                                {site.rooms_count ?? 0}
                            </p>
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                    <Card>
                        <CardContent className="p-4">
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                Storage locations
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums">
                                {site.storage_locations_count ?? 0}
                            </p>
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                    <Card>
                        <CardContent className="p-4">
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                Devices
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums">
                                {devicesCount}
                            </p>
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                    <Card>
                        <CardContent className="p-4">
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                Active batches
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums">
                                {activeBatchesCount}
                            </p>
                        </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                </div>

                <Card>
                    <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
                        <CardTitle className="text-sm">
                            Rooms &amp; storage locations
                        </CardTitle>
                        {canManage && <AddRoomDialog siteId={site.id} />}
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                        {roomList.length === 0 ? (
                            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                                {canManage
                                    ? 'No rooms yet — add one to start placing storage locations.'
                                    : 'No rooms have been added yet.'}
                            </p>
                        ) : (
                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                                {roomList.map((room) => {
                                    const locations =
                                        locationsByRoom.get(room.id) ?? [];

                                    return (
                                        <section
                                            key={room.id}
                                            aria-label={`Room: ${room.name}`}
                                            className="rounded-md border"
                                        >
                                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b bg-muted/30 px-3 py-2">
                                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium">
                                                    {room.name}
                                                    {room.kind && (
                                                        <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">
                                                            {room.kind}
                                                        </span>
                                                    )}
                                                </div>
                                                {canManage && (
                                                    <div className="no-print flex items-center gap-1">
                                                        <AddLocationDialog
                                                            roomId={room.id}
                                                        />
                                                        <EditRoomDialog
                                                            room={room}
                                                            allSites={
                                                                allSites
                                                            }
                                                        />
                                                        <ArchiveRoomDialog
                                                            room={room}
                                                        />
                                                    </div>
                                                )}
                                            </div>
                                            {locations.length === 0 ? (
                                                <p className="px-3 py-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                                                    No storage locations in
                                                    this room yet.
                                                </p>
                                            ) : (
                                                <ul className="divide-y">
                                                    {locations.map(
                                                        (location) => (
                                                            <li
                                                                key={
                                                                    location.id
                                                                }
                                                                aria-label={`Storage location: ${location.name}`}
                                                                className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 pl-8 text-sm"
                                                            >
                                                                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                                                    <Boxes className="size-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                                                                    {
                                                                        location.name
                                                                    }
                                                                    {location.kind && (
                                                                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                                                            (
                                                                            {
                                                                                location.kind
                                                                            }

                                                                            )
                                                                        </span>
                                                                    )}
                                                                    {location.units_on_hand >
                                                                        0 && (
                                                                        <span className="tabular-nums text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                                                            {
                                                                                location.units_on_hand
                                                                            }{' '}
                                                                            units
                                                                        </span>
                                                                    )}
                                                                </span>
                                                                {canManage && (
                                                                    <div className="no-print flex items-center gap-1">
                                                                        <EditLocationDialog
                                                                            location={
                                                                                location
                                                                            }
                                                                            roomOptions={
                                                                                roomOptions
                                                                            }
                                                                        />
                                                                        <ArchiveLocationDialog
                                                                            location={
                                                                                location
                                                                            }
                                                                        />
                                                                    </div>
                                                                )}
                                                            </li>
                                                        ),
                                                    )}
                                                </ul>
                                            )}
                                        </section>
                                    );
                                })}
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </CardContent>
                </Card>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

==================== ./resources/js/pages/traceability/evidence-search/index.tsx ====================

import { Head, Link, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { AlertCircle, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Mono } from '@/components/mono';
import { StatusBadge } from '@/components/status-badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import {
    Select,
    SelectContent,
    SelectItem,
    SelectTrigger,
    SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/format';
import { labelStatus } from '@/lib/status';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import evidenceSearch from '@/routes/evidence-search';
import labels from '@/routes/labels';
import type {
    CursorPaginated,
    EvidenceSearchFilters,
    EvidenceSearchResult,
    Option,
} from '@/types';

export default function EvidenceSearchIndex({
    results: resultsPage,
    devices,
    operators,
    filters,
    canExport,
}: {
    results: CursorPaginated<EvidenceSearchResult>;
    devices: Option[];
    operators: Option[];
    filters: EvidenceSearchFilters;
    canExport: boolean;
}) {
    const [patientReference, setPatientReference] = useState(
        filters.patient_reference ?? '',
    );
    const [cycleNumber, setCycleNumber] = useState(
        filters.cycle_number?.toString() ?? '',
    );
    const [batchNumber, setBatchNumber] = useState(filters.batch_number ?? '');
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
    const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        const removeStart = router.on('start', () => setIsLoading(true));
        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };
    }, []);

    function applyFilters(
        next: Record<string, string | number | undefined>,
    ) {
        const merged: Record<string, string> = {
            ...filters,
            ...next,
        } as Record<string, string>;

        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(merged)) {
            if (!value || value === 'all') {
                delete merged[key];
            }
        }

        router.get(evidenceSearch.index().url, merged, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            replace: true,
            only: ['results', 'filters'],
            onError: () => setLoadError(true),
            onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
        });
    }

    useEffect(() => {
        const handle = setTimeout(() => {
            if (patientReference !== (filters.patient_reference ?? '')) {
                applyFilters({
                    patient_reference: patientReference || undefined,
                });
            }
        }, 300);

        return () => clearTimeout(handle);
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, [patientReference]);

    useEffect(() => {
        const handle = setTimeout(() => {
            if (cycleNumber !== (filters.cycle_number?.toString() ?? '')) {
                applyFilters({
                    cycle_number: cycleNumber
                        ? Number(cycleNumber)
                        : undefined,
                });
            }
        }, 300);

        return () => clearTimeout(handle);
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, [cycleNumber]);

    useEffect(() => {
        const handle = setTimeout(() => {
            if (batchNumber !== (filters.batch_number ?? '')) {
                applyFilters({ batch_number: batchNumber || undefined });
            }
        }, 300);

        return () => clearTimeout(handle);
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, [batchNumber]);

    function retry() {
        setLoadError(false);
        router.reload({ only: ['results', 'filters'] });
    }

    function goTo(url: string | null) {
        if (!url) {
            return;
        }

        router.visit(url, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            only: ['results', 'filters'],
            onError: () => setLoadError(true),
            onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
        });
    }

    function clearAll() {
        setPatientReference('');
        setCycleNumber('');
        setBatchNumber('');
        router.get(
            evidenceSearch.index().url,
            {},
            {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                replace: true,
                only: ['results', 'filters'],
            },
        );
    }

    const hasFilters = Object.keys(filters).length > 0;

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Evidence search" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                            Evidence search
                        </h1>
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            Every pouch traced end to end — patient, cycle,
                            batch, device, operator and period.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    {canExport && (
                        <div className="no-print flex gap-2">
                            <a
                                href={
                                    evidenceSearch.export({
                                        query: { ...filters, format: 'csv' },
                                    }).url
                                }
                            >
                                <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                                    Export CSV
                                </Button>
                            </a>
                            <a
                                href={
                                    evidenceSearch.export({
                                        query: { ...filters, format: 'xlsx' },
                                    }).url
                                }
                            >
                                <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                                    Export XLSX
                                </Button>
                            </a>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>

                {loadError && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-md border border-status-danger-fg/30 bg-status-danger-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-status-danger-fg">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <AlertCircle className="size-4" />
                            Couldn&apos;t search — the request failed. Your
                            filters weren&apos;t lost.
                        </span>
                        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={retry}>
                            Retry
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                )}

                <div className="no-print flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Input
                        value={patientReference}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                            setPatientReference(e.target.value)
                        }
                        placeholder="Patient reference…"
                        className="h-8 w-44"
                        aria-label="Patient reference"
                    />
                    <Input
                        value={cycleNumber}
                        onChange={(e) => setCycleNumber(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Cycle #"
                        type="number"
                        className="h-8 w-28"
                        aria-label="Cycle number"
                    />
                    <Input
                        value={batchNumber}
                        onChange={(e) => setBatchNumber(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Batch number…"
                        className="h-8 w-40"
                        aria-label="Batch number"
                    />

                    <Select
                        value={filters.device_id ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ device_id: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-40">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Device" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">All devices</SelectItem>
                            {devices.map((device) => (
                                <SelectItem key={device.id} value={device.id}>
                                    {device.label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <Select
                        value={filters.operator_id ?? 'all'}
                        onValueChange={(value) =>
                            applyFilters({ operator_id: value })
                        }
                    >
                        <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="h-8 w-40">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Operator" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                            <SelectItem value="all">
                                All operators
                            </SelectItem>
                            {operators.map((operator) => (
                                <SelectItem
                                    key={operator.id}
                                    value={operator.id}
                                >
                                    {operator.label}
                                </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                    </Select>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Input
                            type="date"
                            value={filters.from ?? ''}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                applyFilters({
                                    from: e.target.value || undefined,
                                })
                            }
                            className="h-8 w-36"
                            aria-label="Used from"
                        />
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            to
                        </span>
                        <Input
                            type="date"
                            value={filters.to ?? ''}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                                applyFilters({
                                    to: e.target.value || undefined,
                                })
                            }
                            className="h-8 w-36"
                            aria-label="Used to"
                        />
                    </div>

                    {hasFilters && (
                        <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8"
                            onClick={clearAll}
                        >
                            <X className="size-3.5" />
                            Clear filters
                        </Button>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead className="w-28">Cycle</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Device</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Operator</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Batch</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Patient</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Practitioner</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>Procedure</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-44">Used</TableHead>
                                <TableHead className="w-28">Label</TableHead>
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {isLoading &&
                                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={`skeleton-${i}`}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        {Array.from({ length: 9 }).map(
                                            (__, j) => (
                                                <TableCell key={j}>
                                                    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full max-w-24" />
                                                </TableCell>
                                            ),
                                        )}
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                !loadError &&
                                resultsPage.data.length === 0 && (
                                    <TableRow>
                                        <TableCell
                                            colSpan={9}
                                            className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground"
                                        >
                                            {hasFilters
                                                ? 'No evidence matches these filters.'
                                                : 'No pouch has been used on a patient yet.'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                )}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                resultsPage.data.map((result) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={result.label_id}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Mono>
                                                #{result.cycle_number}
                                            </Mono>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            {result.device_name}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            {result.operator_name}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Mono>
                                                {result.batch_number ?? '—'}
                                            </Mono>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Mono>
                                                {result.patient_reference}
                                            </Mono>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            {result.practitioner_name}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            {result.procedure}
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Mono className="text-xs">
                                                {formatDateTime(
                                                    result.used_at,
                                                )}
                                            </Mono>
                                        </TableCell>
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Link
                                                href={
                                                    labels.show(
                                                        result.label_id,
                                                    ).url
                                                }
                                                className="hover:underline"
                                            >
                                                <StatusBadge
                                                    status={
                                                        labelStatus[
                                                            result
                                                                .label_status
                                                        ] ??
                                                        labelStatus.used
                                                    }
                                                />
                                            </Link>
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!resultsPage.prev_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(resultsPage.prev_page_url)}
                    >
                        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
                        Previous
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!resultsPage.next_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(resultsPage.next_page_url)}
                    >
                        Next
                        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

==================== ./resources/js/pages/traceability/patients/index.tsx ====================

import { Head, Link, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { AlertCircle, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Mono } from '@/components/mono';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import patients from '@/routes/patients';
import type { CursorPaginated, Patient, PatientFilters } from '@/types';

export default function PatientsIndex({
    patients: patientsPage,
    canCreate,
    filters,
}: {
    patients: CursorPaginated<Patient>;
    canCreate: boolean;
    filters: PatientFilters;
}) {
    const [q, setQ] = useState(filters.reference ?? '');
    const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
    const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        const removeStart = router.on('start', () => setIsLoading(true));
        const removeFinish = router.on('finish', () => setIsLoading(false));

        return () => {
            removeStart();
            removeFinish();
        };
    }, []);

    function applyFilters(next: Partial<PatientFilters>) {
        const merged: Record<string, string> = {
            ...filters,
            ...next,
        } as Record<string, string>;

        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(merged)) {
            if (!value) {
                delete merged[key];
            }
        }

        router.get(
            patients.index().url,
            { filter: merged },
            {
                preserveState: true,
                preserveScroll: true,
                replace: true,
                only: ['patients', 'filters'],
                onError: () => setLoadError(true),
                onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
            },
        );
    }

    useEffect(() => {
        const handle = setTimeout(() => {
            if (q !== (filters.reference ?? '')) {
                applyFilters({ reference: q || undefined });
            }
        }, 300);

        return () => clearTimeout(handle);
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, [q]);

    function goTo(url: string | null) {
        if (!url) {
            return;
        }

        router.visit(url, {
            preserveState: true,
            preserveScroll: true,
            only: ['patients', 'filters'],
            onError: () => setLoadError(true),
            onSuccess: () => setLoadError(false),
        });
    }

    function retry() {
        setLoadError(false);
        router.reload({ only: ['patients', 'filters'] });
    }

    const hasFilters = Object.keys(filters).length > 0;

    return (
        <>
            <Head title="Patients" />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                            Patients
                        </h1>
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            Pseudonymous references only — no real patient
                            data is ever stored here.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    {canCreate && (
                        <div className="no-print">
                            <Button
                                size="sm"
                                onClick={() =>
                                    router.post(
                                        patients.store().url,
                                        {},
                                        { preserveScroll: true },
                                    )
                                }
                            >
                                New patient
                            </Button>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>

                {loadError && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-md border border-status-danger-fg/30 bg-status-danger-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-status-danger-fg">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <AlertCircle className="size-4" />
                            Couldn&apos;t load patients — the request
                            failed. Your filters weren&apos;t lost.
                        </span>
                        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={retry}>
                            Retry
                        </Button>
                    </div>
                )}

                <div className="no-print flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Input
                        value={q}
                        onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Search by reference…"
                        className="h-8 w-52"
                        aria-label="Search by reference"
                    />

                    {hasFilters && (
                        <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8"
                            onClick={() => {
                                setQ('');
                                router.get(
                                    patients.index().url,
                                    {},
                                    {
                                        preserveState: true,
                                        preserveScroll: true,
                                        replace: true,
                                        only: ['patients', 'filters'],
                                    },
                                );
                            }}
                        >
                            <X className="size-3.5" />
                            Clear filters
                        </Button>
                    )}
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                    <Table>
                        <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted/40">
                            <TableRow>
                                <TableHead>Reference</TableHead>
                            </TableRow>
                        </TableHeader>
                        <TableBody>
                            {isLoading &&
                                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={`skeleton-${i}`}
                                        className="h-10"
                                    >
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full max-w-32" />
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                !loadError &&
                                patientsPage.data.length === 0 && (
                                    <TableRow>
                                        <TableCell className="h-24 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                                            {hasFilters
                                                ? 'No patients match this search.'
                                                : canCreate
                                                    ? 'No patients yet — create one to start linking labels to procedures.'
                                                    : 'No patients yet.'}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                )}
                            {!isLoading &&
                                patientsPage.data.map((patient) => (
                                    <TableRow
                                        key={patient.id}
                                        className="h-10 cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/40"
                                        onClick={() =>
                                            router.visit(
                                                patients.show(patient.id)
                                                    .url,
                                            )
                                        }
                                    >
                                        <TableCell>
                                            <Link
                                                href={
                                                    patients.show(patient.id)
                                                        .url
                                                }
                                                className="hover:underline"
                                                onClick={(e) =>
                                                    e.stopPropagation()
                                                }
                                            >
                                                <Mono>
                                                    {patient.reference}
                                                </Mono>
                                            </Link>
                                        </TableCell>
                                    </TableRow>
                                ))}
                        </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                </div>

                <div className="no-print flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!patientsPage.prev_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(patientsPage.prev_page_url)}
                    >
                        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
                        Previous
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={!patientsPage.next_page_url}
                        onClick={() => goTo(patientsPage.next_page_url)}
                    >
                        Next
                        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

PatientsIndex.layout = {
    breadcrumbs: [
        { title: 'Dashboard', href: dashboard() },
        { title: 'Patients', href: patients.index() },
    ],
};

import { Head, Link, router } from '@inertiajs/react';
import { ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import {
    AlertDialog,
    AlertDialogAction,
    AlertDialogCancel,
    AlertDialogContent,
    AlertDialogDescription,
    AlertDialogFooter,
    AlertDialogHeader,
    AlertDialogTitle,
    AlertDialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import {
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableHead,
    TableHeader,
    TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { formatDateTime } from '@/lib/format';
import { dashboard } from '@/routes';
import labels from '@/routes/labels';
import patients from '@/routes/patients';
import type { Patient, PatientUsageEntry } from '@/types';

function ArchivePatientDialog({ patient }: { patient: Patient }) {
    return (
        <AlertDialog>
            <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button size="sm" variant="destructive">
                    Archive patient
                </Button>
            </AlertDialogTrigger>
            <AlertDialogContent>
                <AlertDialogHeader>
                    <AlertDialogTitle>
                        Archive {patient.reference}?
                    </AlertDialogTitle>
                    <AlertDialogDescription>
                        This pseudonym will no longer appear when linking a
                        new label to a procedure. Its past procedure history
                        stays exactly as recorded — nothing here is ever
                        deleted.
                    </AlertDialogDescription>
                </AlertDialogHeader>
                <AlertDialogFooter>
                    <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
                    <AlertDialogAction
                        onClick={() =>
                            router.delete(patients.destroy(patient.id).url)
                        }
                    >
                        Archive patient
                    </AlertDialogAction>
                </AlertDialogFooter>
            </AlertDialogContent>
        </AlertDialog>
    );
}

export default function PatientShow({
    patient,
    usages,
    canManage,
}: {
    patient: Patient;
    usages: PatientUsageEntry[];
    canManage: boolean;
}) {
    return (
        <>
            <Head title={patient.reference} />

            <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 p-4">
                <div>
                    <Link
                        href={patients.index().url}
                        className="mb-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                    >
                        <ArrowLeft className="size-3.5" />
                        Back to patients
                    </Link>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">
                            {patient.reference}
                        </h1>
                        {canManage && (
                            <ArchivePatientDialog patient={patient} />
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>

                <Card>
                    <CardHeader>
                        <CardTitle className="text-sm">
                            Procedure history
                        </CardTitle>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                        {usages.length === 0 ? (
                            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                                No procedures recorded yet for this patient
                                — link a scanned label to a procedure to see
                                it here.
                            </p>
                        ) : (
                            <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-md border">
                                <Table>
                                    <TableHeader>
                                        <TableRow>
                                            <TableHead>Procedure</TableHead>
                                            <TableHead>
                                                Practitioner
                                            </TableHead>
                                            <TableHead className="w-44">
                                                Used
                                            </TableHead>
                                            <TableHead>Notes</TableHead>
                                            <TableHead className="w-24" />
                                        </TableRow>
                                    </TableHeader>
                                    <TableBody>
                                        {usages.map((usage) => (
                                            <TableRow
                                                key={usage.id}
                                                className="h-10"
                                            >
                                                <TableCell>
                                                    {usage.procedure}
                                                </TableCell>
                                                <TableCell>
                                                    {usage.practitioner_name}
                                                </TableCell>
                                                <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                                    {formatDateTime(
                                                        usage.used_at,
                                                    )}
                                                </TableCell>
                                                <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                                                    {usage.notes ?? '—'}
                                                </TableCell>
                                                <TableCell>
                                                    <Link
                                                        href={
                                                            labels.show(
                                                                usage.label_id,
                                                            ).url
                                                        }
                                                        className="text-sm hover:underline"
                                                    >
                                                        View label
                                                    </Link>
                                                </TableCell>
                                            </TableRow>
                                        ))}
                                    </TableBody>
                                </Table>
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </CardContent>
                </Card>
            </div>
        </>
    );
}

 * app is cursor-paginated (CLAUDE.md API convention), never offset-based. */

    path: string;
    per_page: number;
    next_cursor: string | null;
    next_page_url: string | null;
    prev_cursor: string | null;
    prev_page_url: string | null;
};

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="{{ str_replace('_', '-', app()->getLocale()) }}" @class(['dark' => ($appearance ?? 'system') == 'dark'])>
    <head>
        <meta charset="utf-8">
        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">

        {{-- Inline script to detect system dark mode preference and apply it immediately --}}
        <script>
            (function() {
                const appearance = '{{ $appearance ?? "system" }}';

                if (appearance === 'system') {
                    const prefersDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;

                    if (prefersDark) {
                        document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
                    }
                }
            })();
        </script>

        {{-- Inline style to set the HTML background color based on our theme in app.css --}}
        <style>
            html {
                background-color: oklch(1 0 0);
            }

            html.dark {
                background-color: oklch(0.145 0 0);
            }
        </style>

        <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" sizes="any">
        <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
        <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/apple-touch-icon.png">

        @fonts

==================== ./resources/views/vendor/scramble/docs.blade.php ====================

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="{{ $config->renderer()->get('theme', 'light') }}">
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, shrink-to-fit=no">
    <meta name="color-scheme" content="{{ $config->renderer()->get('theme', 'light') }}">
    <title>{{ $config->get('ui.title') ?? config('app.name') . ' - API Docs' }}</title>

    <script src="https://unpkg.com/@stoplight/elements@8.4.2/web-components.min.js"></script>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/@stoplight/elements@8.4.2/styles.min.css">

    <script>
        const originalFetch = window.fetch;

        // intercept TryIt requests and add the XSRF-TOKEN header,
        // which is necessary for Sanctum cookie-based authentication to work correctly
        window.fetch = (url, options) => {
            const CSRF_TOKEN_COOKIE_KEY = "XSRF-TOKEN";
            const CSRF_TOKEN_HEADER_KEY = "X-XSRF-TOKEN";
            const getCookieValue = (key) => {
                const cookie = document.cookie.split(';').find((cookie) => cookie.trim().startsWith(key));
                return cookie?.split("=")[1];
            };

            const updateFetchHeaders = (
                headers,
                headerKey,
                headerValue,
            ) => {
                if (headers instanceof Headers) {
                    headers.set(headerKey, headerValue);
                } else if (Array.isArray(headers)) {
                    headers.push([headerKey, headerValue]);
                } else if (headers) {
                    headers[headerKey] = headerValue;
                }
            };
            const csrfToken = getCookieValue(CSRF_TOKEN_COOKIE_KEY);
            if (csrfToken) {
                const { headers = new Headers() } = options || {};
                updateFetchHeaders(headers, CSRF_TOKEN_HEADER_KEY, decodeURIComponent(csrfToken));
                return originalFetch(url, {
                    ...options,
                    headers,
                });
            }

            return originalFetch(url, options);
        };
    </script>

    <style>
        html, body { margin:0; height:100%; }
        body { background-color: var(--color-canvas); }
        /* issues about the dark theme of stoplight/mosaic-code-viewer using web component:
         * https://github.com/stoplightio/elements/issues/2188#issuecomment-1485461965
         */
        [data-theme="dark"] .token.property {
            color: rgb(128, 203, 196) !important;
        }
        [data-theme="dark"] .token.operator {
            color: rgb(255, 123, 114) !important;
        }
        [data-theme="dark"] .token.number {
            color: rgb(247, 140, 108) !important;
        }
        [data-theme="dark"] .token.string {
            color: rgb(165, 214, 255) !important;
        }
        [data-theme="dark"] .token.boolean {
            color: rgb(121, 192, 255) !important;
        }
        [data-theme="dark"] .token.punctuation {
            color: #dbdbdb !important;
        }
    </style>
</head>

@if($config->renderer()->get('theme', 'light') === 'system')
    <script>
        var mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');

        function updateTheme(e) {
            if (e.matches) {
                window.document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
                window.document.getElementsByName('color-scheme')[0].setAttribute('content', 'dark');
            } else {
                window.document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
                window.document.getElementsByName('color-scheme')[0].setAttribute('content', 'light');
            }
        }

        mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', updateTheme);
        updateTheme(mediaQuery);
    </script>
@endif
</body>
</html>

    <title>{{ $config->get('ui.title') ?? config('app.name') . ' - API Docs' }}</title>

<div id="app"></div>
<script src="{{ $config->renderer()->get('cdn', 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@scalar/api-reference') }}"></script>

<script>
    const CSRF_TOKEN_COOKIE_KEY = "XSRF-TOKEN";
    const CSRF_TOKEN_HEADER_KEY = "X-XSRF-TOKEN";
    const getCookieValue = (key) => {
        const cookie = document.cookie.split(';').find((cookie) => cookie.trim().startsWith(key));
        return cookie?.split("=")[1];
    };

    Scalar.createApiReference('#app', {
        content: @json($spec),
        ...@json($config->renderer()->all(except: ['cdn', 'credentials'])),
        onBeforeRequest: ({ requestBuilder }) => {
            requestBuilder.headers.set(CSRF_TOKEN_HEADER_KEY, decodeURIComponent(getCookieValue(CSRF_TOKEN_COOKIE_KEY)))
        },
        customFetch: (input, init) => {
            return window.fetch(input, { ...init, credentials: @json($config->renderer()->get('credentials', 'include')) })
        }
    })
</script>
</body>
</html>

==================== ./routes/console.php ====================

<?php

use Illuminate\Foundation\Inspiring;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schedule;

Artisan::command('inspire', function () {
    $this->comment(Inspiring::quote());
})->purpose('Display an inspiring quote');

Schedule::command('horizon:snapshot')->everyFiveMinutes();
Schedule::command('alerts:detect')->hourly();

// UI-28: daily/weekly cadence is decided inside the command itself
// (DigestSubscription.last_sent_at) — running once a day at a fixed time
// is enough to catch both; it just skips a subscription until it's due.
Schedule::command('digests:send')->dailyAt('07:00');

// UI-29: reclaims the S3 object once a completed export passes its
// retention window (GenerateDataExportJob::RETENTION_DAYS).
Schedule::command('data-exports:expire')->dailyAt('04:30');

// REC-10 ("restore PG + S3 backup"): the database dump (spatie/laravel
// -backup) and the media-disk mirror (steriqore:backup-media) are two
// halves of the same nightly backup — both write to the 'backups' disk.
Schedule::command('backup:run --only-db')->dailyAt('02:00');
Schedule::command('steriqore:backup-media')->dailyAt('02:10');
Schedule::command('backup:clean')->dailyAt('03:00');
Schedule::command('backup:monitor')->dailyAt('04:00');

<?php

use App\Http\Controllers\Settings\ProfileController;
use App\Http\Controllers\Settings\SecurityController;
use Illuminate\Auth\Middleware\RequirePassword;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

Route::middleware(['auth'])->group(function () {
    Route::redirect('settings', '/settings/profile');

    Route::get('settings/profile', [ProfileController::class, 'edit'])->name('profile.edit');
    Route::patch('settings/profile', [ProfileController::class, 'update'])->name('profile.update');
});

Route::middleware(['auth', 'verified'])->group(function () {
    Route::delete('settings/profile', [ProfileController::class, 'destroy'])->name('profile.destroy');

    Route::get('settings/security', [SecurityController::class, 'edit'])
        ->middleware(RequirePassword::class)
        ->name('security.edit');

    Route::put('settings/password', [SecurityController::class, 'update'])
        ->middleware('throttle:6,1')
        ->name('user-password.update');

    Route::inertia('settings/appearance', 'settings/appearance')->name('appearance.edit');
});

Route::get('.well-known/passkey-endpoints', function () {
    return response()->json([
        'enroll' => route('security.edit'),
        'manage' => route('security.edit'),
    ]);
})->name('well-known.passkeys');
