==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/AlertTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

function alertTenantWithMember(TenantRole $role = TenantRole::StockManager): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);
    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);
    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole($role->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

function alertTokenFor(Tenant $tenant, User $user): string
{
    return test()->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('token');
}

function alertLocationFor(Tenant $tenant): string
{
    $site = $tenant->sites()->create(['name' => 'Cabinet Principal']);

    return $site->storageLocations()->create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'name' => 'Réserve'])->id;
}

/**
 * Creates a product with the given threshold, receives $qty of it with the
 * given expiry (or none), via the real purchasing flow.
 */
/**
 * @return array{product_id: string, batch_id: string}
 */
function receiveProductWithThreshold(string $token, string $locationId, int $minThreshold, int $qty, ?string $expiryDate = null): array
{
    $supplierId = test()->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/suppliers', [
        'name' => 'Supplier '.Str::random(6),
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $productId = test()->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/products', [
        'name' => 'Product', 'reference' => 'REF-'.Str::random(8), 'min_threshold' => $minThreshold,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $po = test()->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/purchase-orders', [
        'supplier_id' => $supplierId,
        'lines' => [['product_id' => $productId, 'qty_ordered' => $qty]],
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $poId = $po->json('id');
    $lineId = $po->json('lines.0.id');

    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}/order", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $receipt = test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}/receipts", [
        'location_id' => $locationId,
        'lines' => [[
            'purchase_order_line_id' => $lineId,
            'batch_number' => 'B-'.Str::random(6),
            'expiry_date' => $expiryDate,
            'qty' => $qty,
        ]],
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    return ['product_id' => $productId, 'batch_id' => $receipt->json('lines.0.batch_id')];
}

test('detecting alerts opens a low_stock alert when stock is below threshold', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = alertTenantWithMember();
    $token = alertTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $locationId = alertLocationFor($tenant);
    receiveProductWithThreshold($token, $locationId, minThreshold: 50, qty: 10);

    $detect = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/alerts/detect', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $detect->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('low_stock', 1);

    $alerts = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/alerts?filter[type]=low_stock');
    $alerts->assertOk();
    expect($alerts->json('data'))->toHaveCount(1);
    expect($alerts->json('data.0.state'))->toBe('open');
});

test('detecting alerts is idempotent: running it twice does not duplicate the open alert', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = alertTenantWithMember();
    $token = alertTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $locationId = alertLocationFor($tenant);
    receiveProductWithThreshold($token, $locationId, minThreshold: 50, qty: 10);

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/alerts/detect', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/alerts/detect', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $alerts = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/alerts?filter[type]=low_stock');
    expect($alerts->json('data'))->toHaveCount(1);
});

test('restocking above threshold auto-resolves the low_stock alert on the next detection', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = alertTenantWithMember();
    $token = alertTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $locationId = alertLocationFor($tenant);
    $received = receiveProductWithThreshold($token, $locationId, minThreshold: 50, qty: 10);

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/alerts/detect', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/stock-movements/adjust', [
        'batch_id' => $received['batch_id'],
        'location_id' => $locationId,
        'qty' => 100,
        'reason' => 'Restocked',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/alerts/detect', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $alerts = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/alerts?filter[type]=low_stock&filter[state]=open');
    expect($alerts->json('data'))->toBeEmpty();
});

test('a batch past its expiry date opens an expired alert instead of a near_expiry one', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = alertTenantWithMember();
    $token = alertTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $locationId = alertLocationFor($tenant);
    receiveProductWithThreshold($token, $locationId, minThreshold: 0, qty: 10, expiryDate: now()->subDay()->toDateString());

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/alerts/detect', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $expired = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/alerts?filter[type]=expired');
    expect($expired->json('data'))->toHaveCount(1);

    $nearExpiry = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/alerts?filter[type]=near_expiry&filter[state]=open');
    expect($nearExpiry->json('data'))->toBeEmpty();
});

test('a batch expiring soon opens a near_expiry alert, and a batch far from expiry does not', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = alertTenantWithMember();
    $token = alertTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $locationId = alertLocationFor($tenant);
    receiveProductWithThreshold($token, $locationId, minThreshold: 0, qty: 10, expiryDate: now()->addDays(10)->toDateString());
    receiveProductWithThreshold($token, $locationId, minThreshold: 0, qty: 10, expiryDate: now()->addYear()->toDateString());

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/alerts/detect', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $nearExpiry = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/alerts?filter[type]=near_expiry');
    expect($nearExpiry->json('data'))->toHaveCount(1);
});

test('an alert can be manually resolved and cannot be resolved twice', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = alertTenantWithMember();
    $token = alertTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $locationId = alertLocationFor($tenant);
    receiveProductWithThreshold($token, $locationId, minThreshold: 50, qty: 10);
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/alerts/detect', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $alertId = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/alerts?filter[type]=low_stock')->json('data.0.id');

    $resolve = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/alerts/{$alertId}/resolve", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $resolve->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('state', 'resolved');

    $again = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/alerts/{$alertId}/resolve", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $again->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'ALERT_ALREADY_RESOLVED');
});

test('a viewer can read alerts but cannot resolve one (vertical escalation)', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = alertTenantWithMember(TenantRole::StockManager);
    $managerToken = alertTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $locationId = alertLocationFor($tenant);
    receiveProductWithThreshold($managerToken, $locationId, minThreshold: 50, qty: 10);
    $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson('/api/v1/alerts/detect', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $alertId = $this->withToken($managerToken)->getJson('/api/v1/alerts')->json('data.0.id');

    $viewer = User::create(['name' => 'V', 'email' => 'v-'.Str::lower(Str::random(8)).'@example.com', 'password' => Hash::make('correct-password')]);
    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $viewer->id, 'status' => 'active']);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $viewer->assignRole(TenantRole::Viewer->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);
    $viewerToken = alertTokenFor($tenant, $viewer);

    $this->withToken($viewerToken)->getJson('/api/v1/alerts')->assertOk();
    $this->withToken($viewerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/alerts/{$alertId}/resolve", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])
        ->assertStatus(403);
});

test('a practice never reaches another practice alerts (IDOR)', function () {
    [$tenantA, $userA] = alertTenantWithMember();
    [$tenantB, $userB] = alertTenantWithMember();
    $tokenA = alertTokenFor($tenantA, $userA);
    $tokenB = alertTokenFor($tenantB, $userB);
    $locationB = alertLocationFor($tenantB);
    receiveProductWithThreshold($tokenB, $locationB, minThreshold: 50, qty: 10);
    $this->withToken($tokenB)->postJson('/api/v1/alerts/detect', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $foreignAlertId = $this->withToken($tokenB)->getJson('/api/v1/alerts')->json('data.0.id');

    $this->withToken($tokenA)->postJson("/api/v1/alerts/{$foreignAlertId}/resolve", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])
        ->assertStatus(404);
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/AuthTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

function makeTenantMember(string $status = 'active'): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-test-'.uniqid()]);

    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.uniqid().'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);

    TenantUser::create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
        'user_id' => $user->id,
        'status' => $status,
    ]);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole(TenantRole::Owner->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

test('a member can log in and receive a tenant-scoped token', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = makeTenantMember();

    $response = $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertOk()
        ->assertJsonPath('user.email', $user->email)
        ->assertJsonPath('tenant.slug', $tenant->slug)
        ->assertJsonPath('token_type', 'Bearer');

    expect($response->json('token'))->toBeString();
});

test('wrong password is rejected with a stable error code', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = makeTenantMember();

    $response = $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'wrong-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(401)
        ->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS')
        ->assertJsonPath('error.request_id', fn ($id) => is_string($id) && $id !== '');
});

test('an unknown tenant slug is rejected', function () {
    [, $user] = makeTenantMember();

    $response = $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => 'does-not-exist',
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(404)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'TENANT_NOT_FOUND');
});

test('a disabled membership cannot log in', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = makeTenantMember(status: 'disabled');

    $response = $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(403)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'TENANT_MEMBERSHIP_DISABLED');
});

test('login without an Idempotency-Key is rejected', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = makeTenantMember();

    $response = $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ]);

    $response->assertStatus(400)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED');
});

test('replaying the same Idempotency-Key returns the same response without minting a new token', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = makeTenantMember();
    $idempotencyKey = (string) Str::uuid();
    $payload = [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ];

    $first = $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', $payload, ['Idempotency-Key' => $idempotencyKey]);
    $second = $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', $payload, ['Idempotency-Key' => $idempotencyKey]);

    expect($second->json('token'))->toBe($first->json('token'));
    expect($user->tokens()->count())->toBe(1);
});

test('reusing an Idempotency-Key with a different payload is rejected', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = makeTenantMember();
    $idempotencyKey = (string) Str::uuid();

    $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => $idempotencyKey]);

    $response = $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'wrong-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => $idempotencyKey]);

    $response->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED');
});

test('an authenticated member can fetch their own profile and sites, scoped to their tenant', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = makeTenantMember();
    $tenant->sites()->create(['name' => 'Cabinet Principal']);

    [$otherTenant] = makeTenantMember();
    $otherTenant->sites()->create(['name' => 'Cabinet Autre Pratique']);

    $login = $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $token = $login->json('token');

    $me = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/me');
    $me->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('tenant.slug', $tenant->slug);

    $sites = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/sites');
    $sites->assertOk();
    expect(collect($sites->json('data'))->pluck('name')->all())->toBe(['Cabinet Principal']);
});

test('an unauthenticated request to a protected endpoint is rejected with the standard error shape', function () {
    $response = $this->getJson('/api/v1/me');

    $response->assertStatus(401)
        ->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'UNAUTHENTICATED')
        ->assertJsonStructure(['error' => ['code', 'message', 'details', 'request_id']]);
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/ControlTestTest.php ====================

<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Str;

function sterilizationRunningCycleFor(string $token, string $deviceId): string
{
    $cycleId = test()->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/cycles', [
        'device_id' => $deviceId,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/items", [
        'description' => 'Item',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/start", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/complete", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    return $cycleId;
}

test('a control test can be recorded on a completed cycle and listed', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $cycleId = sterilizationRunningCycleFor($token, $deviceId);

    $create = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/control-tests", [
        'type' => 'bowie_dick', 'result' => 'pass', 'performed_at' => now()->toIso8601String(),
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $create->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('type', 'bowie_dick')->assertJsonPath('result', 'pass');

    $index = $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/control-tests");
    $index->assertOk();
    expect($index->json())->toHaveCount(1);
});

==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/CycleAttachmentTest.php ====================

<?php

use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

test('a photo can be attached to a cycle, listed with a temporary url, and removed', function () {
    Storage::fake('media');
    [$tenant, $user] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $cycleId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/cycles', ['device_id' => $deviceId], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $file = UploadedFile::fake()->image('ticket.jpg');
    $upload = $this->withToken($token)->post("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/attachments", [
        'file' => $file,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $upload->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('file_name', 'ticket.jpg');
    expect($upload->json('url'))->toBeString();
    $mediaId = $upload->json('id');

    $index = $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/attachments");
    $index->assertOk();
    expect($index->json())->toHaveCount(1);

    $this->withToken($token)->deleteJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/attachments/{$mediaId}")->assertNoContent();
    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/attachments")
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertJsonCount(0);
});

test('a practice never reaches another practice cycle attachments (IDOR)', function () {
    Storage::fake('media');
    [$tenantA, $userA] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    [$tenantB, $userB] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $tokenA = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantA, $userA);
    $tokenB = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantB, $userB);
    $deviceBId = sterilizationDeviceFor($tokenB, $tenantB);
    $cycleBId = $this->withToken($tokenB)->postJson('/api/v1/cycles', ['device_id' => $deviceBId], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $this->withToken($tokenA)->getJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleBId}/attachments")->assertStatus(404);
    $this->withToken($tokenA)->post("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleBId}/attachments", [
        'file' => UploadedFile::fake()->image('x.jpg'),
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertStatus(404);
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/CycleReleaseTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\CycleRelease;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

function releaserFor(Tenant $tenant): array
{
    $releaser = User::create([
        'name' => 'Releaser', 'email' => 'releaser-'.Str::lower(Str::random(8)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);
    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $releaser->id, 'status' => 'active']);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $releaser->assignRole(TenantRole::Releaser->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$releaser, sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $releaser)];
}

test('a releaser can release an awaiting cycle as compliant', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $managerToken = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($managerToken, $tenant);
    $cycleId = sterilizationRunningCycleFor($managerToken, $deviceId);
    $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/submit-for-release", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    [$releaser, $releaserToken] = releaserFor($tenant);

    $release = $this->withToken($releaserToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/release", [
        'decision' => 'compliant',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $release->assertCreated()
        ->assertJsonPath('decision', 'compliant')
        ->assertJsonPath('cycle_id', $cycleId)
        ->assertJsonPath('released_by_user_id', $releaser->id);

    $this->withToken($releaserToken)->getJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}")->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('status', 'released');
    $this->withToken($releaserToken)->getJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/release")->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('decision', 'compliant');
});

test('rejecting a cycle requires a reason', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $managerToken = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($managerToken, $tenant);
    $cycleId = sterilizationRunningCycleFor($managerToken, $deviceId);
    $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/submit-for-release", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    [, $releaserToken] = releaserFor($tenant);

    $this->withToken($releaserToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/release", [
        'decision' => 'rejected',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertStatus(422);

    $reject = $this->withToken($releaserToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/release", [
        'decision' => 'rejected', 'reason' => 'Failed Bowie-Dick control test.',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $reject->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('decision', 'rejected');

    $this->withToken($releaserToken)->getJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}")->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('status', 'rejected');
});

test('a cycle can only be released once', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $managerToken = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($managerToken, $tenant);
    $cycleId = sterilizationRunningCycleFor($managerToken, $deviceId);
    $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/submit-for-release", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    [, $releaserToken] = releaserFor($tenant);

    $this->withToken($releaserToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/release", [
        'decision' => 'compliant',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertCreated();

    $second = $this->withToken($releaserToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/release", [
        'decision' => 'compliant',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $second->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'CYCLE_INVALID_TRANSITION');
});

test('a cycle cannot be released before it is awaiting release', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $managerToken = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($managerToken, $tenant);
    $cycleId = $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson('/api/v1/cycles', ['device_id' => $deviceId], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');
    [, $releaserToken] = releaserFor($tenant);

    $response = $this->withToken($releaserToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/release", [
        'decision' => 'compliant',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $response->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'CYCLE_INVALID_TRANSITION');
});

test('a stock manager who runs cycles cannot release them (vertical escalation)', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $managerToken = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($managerToken, $tenant);
    $cycleId = sterilizationRunningCycleFor($managerToken, $deviceId);
    $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/submit-for-release", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/release", [
        'decision' => 'compliant',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertStatus(403);
});

test('a cycle_release row is immutable at the database level', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $managerToken = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($managerToken, $tenant);
    $cycleId = sterilizationRunningCycleFor($managerToken, $deviceId);
    $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/submit-for-release", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    [, $releaserToken] = releaserFor($tenant);
    $this->withToken($releaserToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/release", [
        'decision' => 'compliant',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $release = CycleRelease::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->where('cycle_id', $cycleId)->firstOrFail();

    expect(fn () => $release->update(['decision' => 'rejected']))->toThrow(Exception::class);
    expect(fn () => $release->delete())->toThrow(Exception::class);
});

test('a practice never reaches another practice cycle release (IDOR)', function () {
    [$tenantA, $userA] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    [$tenantB, $userB] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $tokenA = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantA, $userA);
    $tokenB = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantB, $userB);
    $deviceBId = sterilizationDeviceFor($tokenB, $tenantB);
    $cycleBId = sterilizationRunningCycleFor($tokenB, $deviceBId);
    $this->withToken($tokenB)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleBId}/submit-for-release", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $this->withToken($tokenA)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleBId}/release", [
        'decision' => 'compliant',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertStatus(404);
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/CycleTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Sterilization\Models\Cycle;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

function sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole $role = TenantRole::StockManager): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);
    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);
    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole($role->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

function sterilizationTokenFor(Tenant $tenant, User $user): string
{
    return test()->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('token');
}

function sterilizationDeviceFor(string $token, Tenant $tenant): string
{
    $siteId = $tenant->sites()->create(['name' => 'Cabinet Principal'])->id;

    return test()->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/devices', [
        'site_id' => $siteId, 'name' => 'Autoclave 1', 'serial_number' => 'SN-'.Str::random(8),
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');
}

test('a stock manager can run a cycle through its full state machine', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);

    $create = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/cycles', [
        'device_id' => $deviceId,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $create->assertCreated()
        ->assertJsonPath('status', 'draft')
        ->assertJsonPath('cycle_number', 1)
        ->assertJsonPath('device_id', $deviceId);
    $cycleId = $create->json('id');

    $item = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/items", [
        'description' => 'Kit chirurgical implant',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $item->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('sequence_in_cycle', 1);

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/start", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])
        ->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('status', 'running');

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/complete", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])
        ->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('status', 'completed');

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/submit-for-release", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])
        ->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('status', 'awaiting_release');
});

test('a cycle cannot be started with an empty load', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);

    $cycleId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/cycles', [
        'device_id' => $deviceId,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $response = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/start", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $response->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'CYCLE_LOAD_EMPTY');
});

test('cycle state transitions are enforced: cannot complete a draft cycle, cannot start a running one', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);

    $cycleId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/cycles', [
        'device_id' => $deviceId,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/complete", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])
        ->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'CYCLE_INVALID_TRANSITION');

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/items", [
        'description' => 'Item',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/start", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/start", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])
        ->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'CYCLE_INVALID_TRANSITION');
});

test('items cannot be added once a cycle is running', function () {

    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);

        'description' => 'Item 1',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/start", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/items", [
        'description' => 'Item 2',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $response->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'CYCLE_LOAD_LOCKED');
});

test('an item can be removed from a cycle while still in draft', function () {

    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $cycleId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/cycles', ['device_id' => $deviceId], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $itemId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/items", [
        'description' => 'Item',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $this->withToken($token)->deleteJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/items/{$itemId}")->assertNoContent();
    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/items")->assertOk()->assertJsonCount(0);
});

    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);

    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/DataExportRequestTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\AuditEvent;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Actions\RequestDataExportAction;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Enums\DataExportStatus;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Jobs\GenerateDataExportJob;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Mail\DataExportRequestedMail;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Models\DataExportRequest;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\ModelNotFoundException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Queue;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

test('an owner can request a full data export, which dispatches the generation job and notifies owners', function () {
    Queue::fake();
    Mail::fake();
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);

    $response = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/data-export-requests', [], [
        'Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid(),
    ]);

    $response->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('status', 'pending');
    $requestId = $response->json('id');

    Queue::assertPushed(GenerateDataExportJob::class, fn ($job) => $job->dataExportRequestId === $requestId);

    // Out-of-band control: the requester (an owner) is notified too, not
    // just some other admin — a compromised owner account must still leave
    // a visible trace.
    Mail::assertQueued(DataExportRequestedMail::class, fn ($mail) => $mail->recipient->is($owner));

    expect(
        AuditEvent::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)
            ->where('action', 'data_export.requested')
            ->where('subject_id', $requestId)
            ->exists()
    )->toBeTrue();
});

test('a request status can be read back once the job updates it', function () {
    Queue::fake();
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);

    $requestId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/data-export-requests', [], [
        'Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid(),
    ])->json('id');

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/data-export-requests/{$requestId}")
        ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('status', 'pending')->assertJsonPath('requested_by_name', $owner->name);
});

test('a practitioner (not owner/admin) cannot request a full account data export', function () {
    [$tenant, $practitioner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Practitioner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $practitioner);

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/data-export-requests', [], [
        'Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid(),
    ])->assertStatus(403);
});

test('a practice never reaches another practice export request (IDOR)', function () {
    Queue::fake();
    [$tenantA, $ownerA] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$tenantB, $ownerB] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $tokenA = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantA, $ownerA);
    $tokenB = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantB, $ownerB);

    $requestIdB = $this->withToken($tokenB)->postJson('/api/v1/data-export-requests', [], [
        'Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid(),
    ])->json('id');

    $this->withToken($tokenA)->getJson("/api/v1/data-export-requests/{$requestIdB}")->assertStatus(404);
});

test('only one export can be in flight per tenant at a time', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);

    TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => DataExportRequest::create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
        'requested_by_user_id' => $owner->id,
        'status' => DataExportStatus::Processing,
    ]));

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/data-export-requests', [], [
        'Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid(),
    ])->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'EXPORT_ALREADY_RUNNING');
});

test('no more than the weekly cap of exports can be requested per tenant', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);

    TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($tenant, $owner) {
        for ($i = 0; $i < RequestDataExportAction::WEEKLY_LIMIT; $i++) {
            DataExportRequest::create([
                'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
                'requested_by_user_id' => $owner->id,
                'status' => DataExportStatus::Completed,
            ]);
        }
    });

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/data-export-requests', [], [
        'Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid(),
    ])->assertStatus(429)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'EXPORT_WEEKLY_LIMIT_REACHED');
});

test('the export history can be listed, newest first', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);

    TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($tenant, $owner) {
        DataExportRequest::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'requested_by_user_id' => $owner->id, 'status' => DataExportStatus::Completed]);
        DataExportRequest::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'requested_by_user_id' => $owner->id, 'status' => DataExportStatus::Failed]);
    });

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/data-export-requests')
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertJsonCount(2, 'data');
});

test('a completed export can be downloaded, minting a fresh URL and auditing the click', function () {
    Storage::fake('backups');
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);

    $requestId = TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => DataExportRequest::create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
        'requested_by_user_id' => $owner->id,
        'status' => DataExportStatus::Completed,
        'file_path' => "data-exports/{$tenant->id}/export.zip",
        'expires_at' => now()->addDays(7),
    ])->id);

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/data-export-requests/{$requestId}/download")
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertJsonStructure(['download_url', 'url_expires_at']);

    expect(
        AuditEvent::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)
            ->where('action', 'data_export.downloaded')
            ->where('subject_id', $requestId)
            ->exists()
    )->toBeTrue();
});

test('downloading an export that is not ready yet is blocked', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);

    $requestId = TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => DataExportRequest::create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
        'requested_by_user_id' => $owner->id,
        'status' => DataExportStatus::Pending,
    ])->id);

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/data-export-requests/{$requestId}/download")
        ->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'EXPORT_NOT_READY');
});

test('downloading an expired export is blocked', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);

    $requestId = TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => DataExportRequest::create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
        'requested_by_user_id' => $owner->id,
        'status' => DataExportStatus::Completed,
        'file_path' => "data-exports/{$tenant->id}/export.zip",
        'expires_at' => now()->subMinute(),
    ])->id);

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/data-export-requests/{$requestId}/download")
        ->assertStatus(410)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'EXPORT_EXPIRED');
});

test('a practice never downloads another practice export (IDOR)', function () {
    Storage::fake('backups');
    [$tenantA, $ownerA] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$tenantB, $ownerB] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $tokenA = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantA, $ownerA);

    $requestIdB = TenantContext::run($tenantB, fn () => DataExportRequest::create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenantB->id,
        'requested_by_user_id' => $ownerB->id,
        'status' => DataExportStatus::Completed,
        'file_path' => "data-exports/{$tenantB->id}/export.zip",
        'expires_at' => now()->addDays(7),
    ])->id);

    $this->withToken($tokenA)->postJson("/api/v1/data-export-requests/{$requestIdB}/download")->assertStatus(404);
});

/**
 * The job's success path (dumpTables/copyMediaFiles) deliberately reads
 * through the 'pgsql_admin' connection — a genuinely separate DB session
 * from the default connection RefreshDatabase wraps in an uncommitted,
 * rolled-back transaction per test (see TenantIsolationTest's docblock:
 * "a genuinely separate connection could never see the fixture rows
 * anyway"). So the full round-trip can't be exercised under Pest the way
 * it is for every other feature here — it's verified manually against the
 * real running container instead, same as the S5-ANA-03 backup/restore
 * proof and Browsershot PDF rendering.
 */
test('the job fails loudly for a request id that does not exist rather than silently no-op', function () {
    expect(fn () => (new GenerateDataExportJob((string) Str::uuid()))->handle())
        ->toThrow(ModelNotFoundException::class);
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/DeviceProgramTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

test('a stock manager can create, update, and delete a program on a device', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = equipmentTenantWithMember();
    $token = equipmentTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $siteId = equipmentSiteFor($tenant);
    $deviceId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/devices', [
        'site_id' => $siteId, 'name' => 'Autoclave 1', 'serial_number' => 'SN-001',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $create = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/devices/{$deviceId}/programs", [
        'name' => 'Universal 134°C', 'target_temperature_celsius' => 134, 'plateau_minutes' => 18,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $create->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('name', 'Universal 134°C')->assertJsonPath('is_active', true);
    $programId = $create->json('id');

    $index = $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/devices/{$deviceId}/programs");
    $index->assertOk();
    expect(collect($index->json())->pluck('id'))->toContain($programId);

    $this->withToken($token)->patchJson("/api/v1/devices/{$deviceId}/programs/{$programId}", ['plateau_minutes' => 20])
        ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('plateau_minutes', 20);

    $this->withToken($token)->deleteJson("/api/v1/devices/{$deviceId}/programs/{$programId}")->assertNoContent();
    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/devices/{$deviceId}/programs")
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertJsonCount(0);
});

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/devices/{$deviceId}/programs", [
        'name' => 'Prion 134°C', 'target_temperature_celsius' => 134, 'plateau_minutes' => 18,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertCreated();

    $response = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/devices/{$deviceId}/programs", [
        'name' => 'Prion 134°C', 'target_temperature_celsius' => 134, 'plateau_minutes' => 20,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'DEVICE_PROGRAM_NAME_TAKEN');
});

==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/DeviceTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Equipment\Models\Device;
use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

function equipmentTenantWithMember(TenantRole $role = TenantRole::StockManager): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);
    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);
    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole($role->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

function equipmentTokenFor(Tenant $tenant, User $user): string
{
    return test()->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('token');
}

function equipmentSiteFor(Tenant $tenant): string
{
    return $tenant->sites()->create(['name' => 'Cabinet Principal'])->id;
}

test('a stock manager can create, read, update, and delete a device', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = equipmentTenantWithMember();
    $token = equipmentTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $siteId = equipmentSiteFor($tenant);

    $create = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/devices', [
        'site_id' => $siteId, 'name' => 'Autoclave 1', 'serial_number' => 'SN-001',
        'manufacturer' => 'Melag', 'model' => 'Vacuklav 44B',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $create->assertCreated()
        ->assertJsonPath('name', 'Autoclave 1')
        ->assertJsonPath('serial_number', 'SN-001')
        ->assertJsonPath('kind', 'autoclave')
        ->assertJsonPath('status', 'active');
    $deviceId = $create->json('id');

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/devices/{$deviceId}")
        ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('manufacturer', 'Melag');

    $this->withToken($token)->patchJson("/api/v1/devices/{$deviceId}", ['status' => 'maintenance'])
        ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('status', 'maintenance');

    $this->withToken($token)->deleteJson("/api/v1/devices/{$deviceId}")->assertNoContent();
    expect(
        Device::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->withTrashed()->find($deviceId)->trashed()
    )->toBeTrue();
});

test('creating a device with a duplicate serial number within the same tenant is rejected', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = equipmentTenantWithMember();
    $token = equipmentTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $siteId = equipmentSiteFor($tenant);

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/devices', [
        'site_id' => $siteId, 'name' => 'Autoclave 1', 'serial_number' => 'SN-DUP',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertCreated();

    $response = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/devices', [
        'site_id' => $siteId, 'name' => 'Autoclave 2', 'serial_number' => 'SN-DUP',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'DEVICE_SERIAL_NUMBER_TAKEN');
});

test('two different tenants can each use the same serial number (unique per tenant, not globally)', function () {
    [$tenantA, $userA] = equipmentTenantWithMember();
    [$tenantB, $userB] = equipmentTenantWithMember();
    $tokenA = equipmentTokenFor($tenantA, $userA);
    $tokenB = equipmentTokenFor($tenantB, $userB);

    $this->withToken($tokenA)->postJson('/api/v1/devices', [
        'site_id' => equipmentSiteFor($tenantA), 'name' => 'Autoclave 1', 'serial_number' => 'SN-SHARED',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertCreated();

    $this->withToken($tokenB)->postJson('/api/v1/devices', [
        'site_id' => equipmentSiteFor($tenantB), 'name' => 'Autoclave 1', 'serial_number' => 'SN-SHARED',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertCreated();
});

test('a viewer can read devices but cannot create one (vertical escalation)', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = equipmentTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Viewer);
    $token = equipmentTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $siteId = equipmentSiteFor($tenant);

test('a practice never reaches another practice device, even by guessing an id (IDOR)', function () {
    [$tenantA, $userA] = equipmentTenantWithMember();
    [$tenantB, $userB] = equipmentTenantWithMember();
    $tokenA = equipmentTokenFor($tenantA, $userA);
    $tokenB = equipmentTokenFor($tenantB, $userB);

    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

test('a device cannot be created against a site belonging to another tenant', function () {
    [$tenantA, $userA] = equipmentTenantWithMember();
    [$tenantB, $userB] = equipmentTenantWithMember();

<?php

test('a stock manager can create, update, and delete a dlu rule', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $create = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/dlu-rules', [
        'packaging_type' => 'Sachet papier-plastique', 'storage_condition' => 'Armoire fermée', 'shelf_life_days' => 180,
        'reason' => 'Initial rule.',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $create->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('shelf_life_days', 180);
    $ruleId = $create->json('id');

    $this->withToken($token)->patchJson("/api/v1/dlu-rules/{$ruleId}", ['shelf_life_days' => 365, 'reason' => 'Extended per updated guidance.'])
        ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('shelf_life_days', 365);

    $this->withToken($token)->deleteJson("/api/v1/dlu-rules/{$ruleId}")->assertNoContent();
    $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/dlu-rules')->assertOk()->assertJsonCount(0);

==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/EvidenceSearchTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Site;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * @return array{label_id: string, cycle_number: int, device_id: string, batch_id: string, patient_id: string, patient_reference: string}
 */
function fullEvidenceChainFor(string $token, Tenant $tenant, string $practitionerId): array
{
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $site = Site::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->firstOrFail();
    $locationId = $site->storageLocations()->create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'name' => 'Réserve'])->id;
    $received = receiveProductWithThreshold($token, $locationId, minThreshold: 0, qty: 10);

    $cycleId = test()->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/cycles', ['device_id' => $deviceId], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');
    $cycleNumber = test()->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}")->json('cycle_number');

    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/items", [
        'description' => 'Kit chirurgical', 'batch_id' => $received['batch_id'],
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/start", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/complete", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/submit-for-release", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    [, $releaserToken] = releaserFor($tenant);
    test()->withToken($releaserToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/release", ['decision' => 'compliant'], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    dluRuleFor($token);
    $labelId = test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/labels", [
        'packaging_type' => 'Sachet', 'storage_condition' => 'Armoire',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('0.id');
    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/print", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    test()->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}");

    $patient = test()->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/usage", [
        'patient_id' => $patient->json('id'),
        'practitioner_id' => $practitionerId,
        'procedure' => 'Détartrage',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    return [
        'label_id' => $labelId,
        'cycle_number' => $cycleNumber,
        'device_id' => $deviceId,
        'batch_id' => $received['batch_id'],
        'patient_id' => $patient->json('id'),
        'patient_reference' => $patient->json('reference'),
    ];
}

test('evidence search finds a usage by patient reference, cycle number, device, and period', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $chain = fullEvidenceChainFor($token, $tenant, $manager->id);

    $byPatient = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/evidence-search?patient_reference='.$chain['patient_reference']);
    $byPatient->assertOk();
    expect($byPatient->json('data'))->toHaveCount(1);
    expect($byPatient->json('data.0.label_id'))->toBe($chain['label_id']);

    $byCycle = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/evidence-search?cycle_number='.$chain['cycle_number']);
    expect($byCycle->json('data'))->toHaveCount(1);

    $byDevice = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/evidence-search?device_id='.$chain['device_id']);
    expect($byDevice->json('data'))->toHaveCount(1);

    $byPeriod = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/evidence-search?from='.now()->subDay()->toDateString().'&to='.now()->addDay()->toDateString());
    expect($byPeriod->json('data'))->toHaveCount(1);

    $outsidePeriod = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/evidence-search?from='.now()->addYear()->toDateString());
    expect($outsidePeriod->json('data'))->toBeEmpty();
});

test('evidence search finds a usage by batch number', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $chain = fullEvidenceChainFor($token, $tenant, $manager->id);

    $batchNumber = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/evidence-search?patient_reference='.$chain['patient_reference'])
        ->json('data.0.batch_number');
    expect($batchNumber)->not->toBeNull();

    $bySearch = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/evidence-search?batch_number='.$batchNumber);
    expect($bySearch->json('data'))->toHaveCount(1);
});

test('a search with no matching filters returns an empty result, not an error', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);

    $response = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/evidence-search?patient_reference=PAT-999999');
    $response->assertOk();
    expect($response->json('data'))->toBeEmpty();
});

test('a viewer can search evidence (view-only permission is enough)', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    fullEvidenceChainFor($token, $tenant, $manager->id);

    [$viewerTenant, $viewer] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Viewer);
    $viewerToken = sterilizationTokenFor($viewerTenant, $viewer);

    $this->withToken($viewerToken)->getJson('/api/v1/evidence-search')->assertOk();
});

test('a practice never finds another practice evidence, even without any filter (IDOR)', function () {
    [$tenantA, $managerA] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$tenantB, $managerB] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $tokenA = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantA, $managerA);
    $tokenB = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantB, $managerB);
    fullEvidenceChainFor($tokenB, $tenantB, $managerB->id);

    $response = $this->withToken($tokenA)->getJson('/api/v1/evidence-search');
    $response->assertOk();
    expect($response->json('data'))->toBeEmpty();
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/InventoryTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

function invTenantWithMember(TenantRole $role = TenantRole::StockManager): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);
    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);
    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole($role->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

function invTokenFor(Tenant $tenant, User $user): string
{
    return test()->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('token');
}

function invLocationFor(Tenant $tenant, string $name = 'Réserve'): string
{
    $site = $tenant->sites()->create(['name' => 'Cabinet Principal '.Str::random(4)]);

    return $site->storageLocations()->create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'name' => $name])->id;
}

/**
 * Receives 100 units of a fresh product/batch into $locationId via the
 * real purchasing flow (S2-ANA-03), so stock_movements/stock_levels are
 * populated exactly the way they would be in practice.
 */
function receiveStockFor(string $token, string $locationId, int $qty = 100): array
{
    $supplierId = test()->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/suppliers', [
        'name' => 'Supplier '.Str::random(6),
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $productId = test()->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/products', [
        'name' => 'Product', 'reference' => 'REF-'.Str::random(8),
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $po = test()->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/purchase-orders', [
        'supplier_id' => $supplierId,
        'lines' => [['product_id' => $productId, 'qty_ordered' => $qty]],
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $poId = $po->json('id');
    $lineId = $po->json('lines.0.id');

    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}/order", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $receipt = test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}/receipts", [
        'location_id' => $locationId,
        'lines' => [['purchase_order_line_id' => $lineId, 'batch_number' => 'B-'.Str::random(6), 'qty' => $qty]],
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    return ['batch_id' => $receipt->json('lines.0.batch_id'), 'product_id' => $productId];
}

test('receiving stock credits stock_levels at the receiving location', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = invTenantWithMember();
    $token = invTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $locationId = invLocationFor($tenant);

    $received = receiveStockFor($token, $locationId, 100);

    $levels = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/stock-levels');
    $levels->assertOk();
    $level = collect($levels->json('data'))->firstWhere('batch_id', $received['batch_id']);
    expect($level['quantity'])->toBe(100);
});

test('issuing stock debits the location and cannot overdraw it', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = invTenantWithMember();
    $token = invTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $locationId = invLocationFor($tenant);
    $received = receiveStockFor($token, $locationId, 100);

    $issue = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/stock-movements/issue', [
        'batch_id' => $received['batch_id'],
        'location_id' => $locationId,
        'qty' => 30,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $issue->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('qty', -30);

    $levels = $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/stock-levels?filter[batch_id]={$received['batch_id']}");
    expect($levels->json('data.0.quantity'))->toBe(70);

    $overdraw = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/stock-movements/issue', [
        'batch_id' => $received['batch_id'],
        'location_id' => $locationId,
        'qty' => 1000,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $overdraw->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'INSUFFICIENT_STOCK');
});

test('transferring stock debits the source and credits the destination', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = invTenantWithMember();
    $token = invTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $locationA = invLocationFor($tenant, 'A');
    $locationB = invLocationFor($tenant, 'B');
    $received = receiveStockFor($token, $locationA, 100);

    $transfer = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/stock-movements/transfer', [
        'batch_id' => $received['batch_id'],
        'from_location_id' => $locationA,
        'to_location_id' => $locationB,
        'qty' => 40,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $transfer->assertCreated();

    $levels = $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/stock-levels?filter[batch_id]={$received['batch_id']}");
    $byLocation = collect($levels->json('data'))->keyBy('location_id');
    expect($byLocation[$locationA]['quantity'])->toBe(60);
    expect($byLocation[$locationB]['quantity'])->toBe(40);
});

test('adjusting stock requires a reason and applies a signed correction', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = invTenantWithMember();
    $token = invTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $locationId = invLocationFor($tenant);
    $received = receiveStockFor($token, $locationId, 100);

    $missingReason = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/stock-movements/adjust', [
        'batch_id' => $received['batch_id'],
        'location_id' => $locationId,
        'qty' => -5,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $missingReason->assertStatus(422);

    $adjust = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/stock-movements/adjust', [
        'batch_id' => $received['batch_id'],
        'location_id' => $locationId,
        'qty' => -5,
        'reason' => 'Damaged during a count',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $adjust->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('qty', -5);

    $levels = $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/stock-levels?filter[batch_id]={$received['batch_id']}");
    expect($levels->json('data.0.quantity'))->toBe(95);
});

test('stock_levels can be fully rebuilt from stock_movements and matches what it had before', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = invTenantWithMember();
    $token = invTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $locationId = invLocationFor($tenant);
    $received = receiveStockFor($token, $locationId, 100);
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/stock-movements/issue', [
        'batch_id' => $received['batch_id'], 'location_id' => $locationId, 'qty' => 20,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $before = $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/stock-levels?filter[batch_id]={$received['batch_id']}")
        ->json('data.0.quantity');

    $rebuild = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/stock-levels/rebuild', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $rebuild->assertOk();

    $after = $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/stock-levels?filter[batch_id]={$received['batch_id']}")
        ->json('data.0.quantity');

    expect($after)->toBe($before)->toBe(80);
});

test('a viewer can read stock levels but cannot issue stock (vertical escalation)', function () {

});

test('a practice never reaches another practice stock levels, even by guessing a batch id (IDOR)', function () {
