==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/InvitationTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\DisableTenantMembershipAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Mail\InvitationMail;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\Invitation;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * Owner by default: has every permission this file's tests exercise
 * (invitations.create/revoke). Pass a different role to test the
 * permission boundary itself.
 */
function tenantWithActiveMember(string $password = 'correct-password', TenantRole $role = TenantRole::Owner): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);

    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make($password),
    ]);

    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole($role->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

function tokenFor(Tenant $tenant, User $user, string $password = 'correct-password'): string
{
    return test()->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => $password,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('token');
}

test('a member can invite a new person and an email is queued', function () {
    Mail::fake();
    [$tenant, $user] = tenantWithActiveMember();
    $token = tokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $response = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/invitations', [
        'email' => 'new-person@example.com',
        'role' => 'practitioner',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('email', 'new-person@example.com');
    Mail::assertQueued(InvitationMail::class);
    expect(Invitation::where('email', 'new-person@example.com')->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->exists())->toBeTrue();
});

test('inviting an existing member is rejected', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = tenantWithActiveMember();
    $token = tokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $response = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/invitations', [
        'email' => $user->email,
        'role' => 'practitioner',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'USER_ALREADY_MEMBER');
});

test('a second pending invitation for the same email is rejected', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = tenantWithActiveMember();
    $token = tokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/invitations', [
        'email' => 'dup@example.com', 'role' => 'viewer',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertCreated();

    $response = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/invitations', [
        'email' => 'dup@example.com', 'role' => 'viewer',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'INVITATION_ALREADY_PENDING');
});

test('accepting an invitation for a brand new email creates the account and a tenant-scoped token', function () {
    [$tenant, $inviter] = tenantWithActiveMember();
    $invitation = Invitation::create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
        'email' => 'new-person@example.com',
        'role' => 'practitioner',
        'token' => Str::random(64),
        'invited_by' => $inviter->id,
        'expires_at' => now()->addDays(7),
    ]);

    $response = $this->postJson('/api/v1/invitations/accept', [
        'token' => $invitation->token,
        'name' => 'New Person',
        'password' => 'a-brand-new-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('tenant.slug', $tenant->slug);
    expect(User::where('email', 'new-person@example.com')->exists())->toBeTrue();
    expect(TenantUser::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
        ->whereHas('user', fn ($q) => $q->where('email', 'new-person@example.com'))
        ->where('status', 'active')->exists())->toBeTrue();
    expect($invitation->fresh()->accepted_at)->not->toBeNull();
});

test('accepting an invitation for an existing email requires that account real password', function () {
    [$tenantA, $existingUser] = tenantWithActiveMember('the-real-password');
    [$tenantB, $inviter] = tenantWithActiveMember();

    $invitation = Invitation::create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenantB->id,
        'email' => $existingUser->email,
        'role' => 'viewer',
        'token' => Str::random(64),
        'invited_by' => $inviter->id,
        'expires_at' => now()->addDays(7),
    ]);

    $wrongPassword = $this->postJson('/api/v1/invitations/accept', [
        'token' => $invitation->token,
        'name' => 'Doesnt matter',
        'password' => 'guessed-wrong-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $wrongPassword->assertStatus(401)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS');

    $rightPassword = $this->postJson('/api/v1/invitations/accept', [
        'token' => $invitation->token,
        'name' => 'Doesnt matter',
        'password' => 'the-real-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $rightPassword->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('tenant.slug', $tenantB->slug);
});

test('accepting an expired invitation is rejected', function () {
    [$tenant, $inviter] = tenantWithActiveMember();
    $invitation = Invitation::create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
        'email' => 'late@example.com',
        'role' => 'viewer',
        'token' => Str::random(64),
        'invited_by' => $inviter->id,
        'expires_at' => now()->subDay(),
    ]);

    $response = $this->postJson('/api/v1/invitations/accept', [
        'token' => $invitation->token,
        'name' => 'Late Person',
        'password' => 'whatever-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(410)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'INVITATION_EXPIRED');
});

test('a revoked invitation can no longer be accepted', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = tenantWithActiveMember();
    $token = tokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $invitation = Invitation::create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
        'email' => 'revoke-me@example.com',
        'role' => 'viewer',
        'token' => Str::random(64),
        'invited_by' => $user->id,
        'expires_at' => now()->addDays(7),
    ]);

    $this->withToken($token)->deleteJson("/api/v1/invitations/{$invitation->id}")->assertNoContent();

    $response = $this->postJson('/api/v1/invitations/accept', [
        'token' => $invitation->token,
        'name' => 'Nope',
        'password' => 'whatever-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(410)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'INVITATION_REVOKED');
});

test('revoking a foreign tenant invitation is refused without leaking its existence', function () {
    [$tenantA, $userA] = tenantWithActiveMember();
    [$tenantB, $userB] = tenantWithActiveMember();
    $tokenA = tokenFor($tenantA, $userA);

    $foreignInvitation = Invitation::create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenantB->id,
        'email' => 'someone@example.com',
        'role' => 'viewer',
        'token' => Str::random(64),
        'invited_by' => $userB->id,
        'expires_at' => now()->addDays(7),
    ]);

    $response = $this->withToken($tokenA)->deleteJson("/api/v1/invitations/{$foreignInvitation->id}");

    $response->assertStatus(404);
    expect($foreignInvitation->fresh()->revoked_at)->toBeNull();
});

test('logout-everywhere revokes every token for the current tenant but not other tenants', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = tenantWithActiveMember();
    [$otherTenant] = tenantWithActiveMember();
    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $otherTenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    $tokenTenantA1 = tokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $tokenTenantA2 = tokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $tokenOtherTenant = tokenFor($otherTenant, $user);

    $this->withToken($tokenTenantA1)->deleteJson('/api/v1/auth/tokens')->assertNoContent();

    $this->withToken($tokenTenantA2)->getJson('/api/v1/me')->assertStatus(401);
    $this->withToken($tokenOtherTenant)->getJson('/api/v1/me')->assertOk();
});

test('disabling a membership revokes its tokens for that tenant only', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = tenantWithActiveMember();
    [$otherTenant] = tenantWithActiveMember();
    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $otherTenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    $tokenA = tokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $tokenOther = tokenFor($otherTenant, $user);

    $membership = TenantUser::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->where('user_id', $user->id)->first();
    app(DisableTenantMembershipAction::class)->execute($membership, $user);

    $this->withToken($tokenA)->getJson('/api/v1/me')->assertStatus(401);
    $this->withToken($tokenOther)->getJson('/api/v1/me')->assertOk();
    expect($membership->fresh()->status)->toBe('disabled');
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/LabelScanTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\AuditEvent;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Enums\LabelStatus;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

function generatedLabelFor(string $token, Tenant $tenant, string $deviceId): string
{
    [$cycleId] = releasedCompliantCycle($token, $tenant, $deviceId);
    dluRuleFor($token);

    return test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/labels", [
        'packaging_type' => 'Sachet', 'storage_condition' => 'Armoire',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('0.id');
}

test('scanning an unknown code returns a clean 404, not a database error', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/labels/not-a-real-code')
        ->assertStatus(404)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'LABEL_NOT_FOUND');

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/labels/'.Str::uuid())
        ->assertStatus(404)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'LABEL_NOT_FOUND');
});

test('scanning a printed label resolves it and marks it used', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $labelId = generatedLabelFor($token, $tenant, $deviceId);
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/print", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $scan = $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/labels/urn:steriqore:label:{$labelId}");
    $scan->assertOk()
        ->assertJsonPath('label_id', $labelId)
        ->assertJsonPath('status', 'used')
        ->assertJsonPath('sequence_in_cycle', 1);

    $label = Label::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->findOrFail($labelId);
    expect($label->status)->toBe(LabelStatus::Used);
});

test('scanning the same label again after it is used is not an error (idempotent read)', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $labelId = generatedLabelFor($token, $tenant, $deviceId);
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/print", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}")->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('status', 'used');
    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}")->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('status', 'used');
});

test('scanning a recalled label returns 410 with a blocking code and writes an audit event', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $labelId = generatedLabelFor($token, $tenant, $deviceId);
    Label::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->findOrFail($labelId)->update(['status' => LabelStatus::Recalled]);

    $scan = $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}");
    $scan->assertStatus(410)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'LABEL_RECALLED');

    expect(
        AuditEvent::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)
            ->where('action', 'label.scan_blocked_recalled')
            ->where('subject_id', $labelId)
            ->exists()
    )->toBeTrue();
});

test('scanning a voided label returns 410 with a blocking code', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $labelId = generatedLabelFor($token, $tenant, $deviceId);
    Label::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->findOrFail($labelId)->update(['status' => LabelStatus::Voided]);

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}")
        ->assertStatus(410)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'LABEL_VOIDED');
});

test('scanning a label past its use-by date auto-expires it, returns 410, and writes an audit event', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $labelId = generatedLabelFor($token, $tenant, $deviceId);
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/print", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    Label::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->findOrFail($labelId)->update(['use_by_date' => now()->subDay()]);

    $scan = $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}");
    $scan->assertStatus(410)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'LABEL_EXPIRED');

    $label = Label::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->findOrFail($labelId);
    expect($label->status)->toBe(LabelStatus::Expired);
    expect(
        AuditEvent::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)
            ->where('action', 'label.scan_blocked_expired')
            ->where('subject_id', $labelId)
            ->exists()
    )->toBeTrue();
});

test('a practice never resolves another practice label by guessing its id (IDOR)', function () {
    [$tenantA, $managerA] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    [$tenantB, $managerB] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $tokenA = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantA, $managerA);
    $tokenB = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantB, $managerB);
    $deviceBId = sterilizationDeviceFor($tokenB, $tenantB);
    $foreignLabelId = generatedLabelFor($tokenB, $tenantB, $deviceBId);

    $this->withToken($tokenA)->getJson("/api/v1/labels/{$foreignLabelId}")
        ->assertStatus(404)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'LABEL_NOT_FOUND');
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/LabelTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\LabelPrint;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\LaravelPdf\Facades\Pdf;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * @return array{0: string, 1: string} [cycleId, releaserToken]
 */
function releasedCompliantCycle(string $managerToken, Tenant $tenant, string $deviceId): array
{
    $cycleId = sterilizationRunningCycleFor($managerToken, $deviceId);
    test()->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/submit-for-release", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    [, $releaserToken] = releaserFor($tenant);
    test()->withToken($releaserToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/release", [
        'decision' => 'compliant',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    return [$cycleId, $releaserToken];
}

function dluRuleFor(string $token, string $packagingType = 'Sachet', string $storageCondition = 'Armoire', int $shelfLifeDays = 180): void
{
    test()->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/dlu-rules', [
        'packaging_type' => $packagingType, 'storage_condition' => $storageCondition, 'shelf_life_days' => $shelfLifeDays,
        'reason' => 'Test fixture.',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
}

test('labels can be generated for a released cycle, one per item, with the DLU frozen from the matching rule', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $managerToken = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($managerToken, $tenant);
    [$cycleId] = releasedCompliantCycle($managerToken, $tenant, $deviceId);
    dluRuleFor($managerToken, 'Sachet', 'Armoire', 180);

    $generate = $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/labels", [
        'packaging_type' => 'Sachet', 'storage_condition' => 'Armoire',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $generate->assertCreated();
    expect($generate->json())->toHaveCount(1);
    expect($generate->json('0.shelf_life_days'))->toBe(180);
    expect($generate->json('0.status'))->toBe('created');
    expect($generate->json('0.urn'))->toStartWith('urn:steriqore:label:');

    $index = $this->withToken($managerToken)->getJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/labels");
    $index->assertOk();
    expect($index->json())->toHaveCount(1);
});

test('label generation is blocked for a cycle that is not released (rejected cycle explicit block)', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $managerToken = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($managerToken, $tenant);
    $cycleId = sterilizationRunningCycleFor($managerToken, $deviceId);
    $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/submit-for-release", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    [, $releaserToken] = releaserFor($tenant);
    $this->withToken($releaserToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/release", [
        'decision' => 'rejected', 'reason' => 'Failed biological test',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    dluRuleFor($managerToken);

    $response = $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/labels", [
        'packaging_type' => 'Sachet', 'storage_condition' => 'Armoire',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'CYCLE_NOT_RELEASED');
});

test('label generation fails clearly when no matching dlu rule exists', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $managerToken = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($managerToken, $tenant);
    [$cycleId] = releasedCompliantCycle($managerToken, $tenant, $deviceId);

    $response = $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/labels", [
        'packaging_type' => 'Unknown', 'storage_condition' => 'Unknown',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(422)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'DLU_RULE_NOT_FOUND');
});

test('labels cannot be generated twice for the same cycle', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $managerToken = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($managerToken, $tenant);
    [$cycleId] = releasedCompliantCycle($managerToken, $tenant, $deviceId);
    dluRuleFor($managerToken);

    $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/labels", [
        'packaging_type' => 'Sachet', 'storage_condition' => 'Armoire',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertCreated();

    $second = $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/labels", [
        'packaging_type' => 'Sachet', 'storage_condition' => 'Armoire',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $second->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'CYCLE_LABELS_ALREADY_GENERATED');
});

test('a label can be printed the first time without a reason, and a reprint requires one and increments the counter', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $managerToken = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($managerToken, $tenant);
    [$cycleId] = releasedCompliantCycle($managerToken, $tenant, $deviceId);
    dluRuleFor($managerToken);
    $labelId = $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/labels", [
        'packaging_type' => 'Sachet', 'storage_condition' => 'Armoire',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('0.id');

    $first = $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/print", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $first->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('status', 'printed');

    $missingReason = $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/print", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $missingReason->assertStatus(422);

    $reprint = $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/print", [
        'reason' => 'Original label was damaged.',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $reprint->assertCreated();

    $label = Label::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->findOrFail($labelId);
    expect($label->print_counter)->toBe(2);
    expect(LabelPrint::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->where('label_id', $labelId)->count())->toBe(2);
});

test('a viewer can view labels but cannot print one (vertical escalation)', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $managerToken = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($managerToken, $tenant);
    [$cycleId] = releasedCompliantCycle($managerToken, $tenant, $deviceId);
    dluRuleFor($managerToken);
    $labelId = $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/labels", [
        'packaging_type' => 'Sachet', 'storage_condition' => 'Armoire',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('0.id');

    $viewer = User::create(['name' => 'V', 'email' => 'v-'.Str::lower(Str::random(8)).'@example.com', 'password' => Hash::make('correct-password')]);
    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $viewer->id, 'status' => 'active']);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $viewer->assignRole(TenantRole::Viewer->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);
    $viewerToken = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $viewer);

    $this->withToken($viewerToken)->getJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/qr-code")->assertOk();
    $this->withToken($viewerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/print", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])
        ->assertStatus(403);
});

test('the qr-code, datamatrix, and pdf endpoints all resolve for a generated label', function () {
    // Real Chromium rendering is verified manually in the Docker image
    // (where Node/puppeteer actually live) — Pdf::fake() keeps this test
    // environment-independent, same idea as Mail::fake()/Http::fake().
    Pdf::fake();

    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $managerToken = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($managerToken, $tenant);
    [$cycleId] = releasedCompliantCycle($managerToken, $tenant, $deviceId);
    dluRuleFor($managerToken);
    $labelId = $this->withToken($managerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/labels", [
        'packaging_type' => 'Sachet', 'storage_condition' => 'Armoire',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('0.id');

    $this->withToken($managerToken)->getJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/qr-code")

    $this->withToken($managerToken)->getJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/datamatrix")
        ->assertOk()->assertHeader('Content-Type', 'image/svg+xml');

    $this->withToken($managerToken)->get("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/pdf")->assertOk();
});

==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/LabelUsageTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Enums\LabelStatus;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\LabelUsage;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

function scannedLabelFor(string $token, Tenant $tenant, string $deviceId): string
{
    $labelId = generatedLabelFor($token, $tenant, $deviceId);
    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/print", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    test()->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}");

    return $labelId;
}

test('a practitioner can link a scanned label to a patient, procedure, and practitioner', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $labelId = scannedLabelFor($token, $tenant, $deviceId);
    $patientId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $usage = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/usage", [
        'patient_id' => $patientId,
        'practitioner_id' => $manager->id,
        'procedure' => 'Détartrage',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $usage->assertCreated()
        ->assertJsonPath('label_id', $labelId)
        ->assertJsonPath('patient_id', $patientId)
        ->assertJsonPath('practitioner_id', $manager->id)
        ->assertJsonPath('procedure', 'Détartrage');

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/usage")
        ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('procedure', 'Détartrage');
});

test('a label cannot be linked to a procedure before it has been scanned', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $labelId = generatedLabelFor($token, $tenant, $deviceId);
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/print", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $patientId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $response = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/usage", [
        'patient_id' => $patientId, 'practitioner_id' => $manager->id, 'procedure' => 'X',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'LABEL_NOT_SCANNED');
});

    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($managerToken, $tenant);
    $labelId = scannedLabelFor($managerToken, $tenant, $deviceId);

    $this->withToken($viewerToken)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/usage", [

    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertStatus(403);
});

<?php

use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\AuditEvent;

use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\BatchStatus;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;

test('raising a non-conformity against a cycle recalls every label it produced and quarantines the batch', function () {
    [$tenant, $manager] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $manager);
    $chain = fullEvidenceChainFor($token, $tenant, $manager->id);

    $cycleId = Label::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->findOrFail($chain['label_id'])->cycleItem()->withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->first()->cycle_id;

    $nc = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/non-conformities', [
        'subject_type' => 'cycle', 'subject_id' => $cycleId, 'description' => 'Discovered the biological indicator reader was mis-calibrated.',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $nc->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('subject_type', 'Cycle');

    $label = Label::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->findOrFail($chain['label_id']);
    expect($label->status)->toBe(LabelStatus::Recalled);

    $batch = Batch::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->findOrFail($chain['batch_id']);
    expect($batch->status)->toBe(BatchStatus::Quarantined);

    expect(
        AuditEvent::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->where('action', 'label.recalled')->where('subject_id', $chain['label_id'])->exists()
    )->toBeTrue();
    expect(
        AuditEvent::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->where('action', 'batch.quarantined')->where('subject_id', $chain['batch_id'])->exists()
    )->toBeTrue();
});

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/non-conformities', [
        'subject_type' => 'cycle', 'subject_id' => $cycleId, 'description' => 'X',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}")
        ->assertStatus(410)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'LABEL_RECALLED');

==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/OpenApiContractTest.php ====================

<?php

use Dedoc\Scramble\Generator;
use Dedoc\Scramble\Scramble;
use Symfony\Component\Yaml\Yaml;

/**
 * OpenAPI is generated by Scramble from the actual routes/controllers, not
 * hand-maintained — CLAUDE.md requires it "can never silently drift" from
 * the code. This regenerates the spec in-memory and diffs the paths and
 * schemas — the actual contract surface — against the committed
 * docs/openapi.yaml. `info`/`servers` are excluded: they carry
 * environment-specific values (APP_NAME, APP_URL) that legitimately vary
 * between the machine that last ran `scramble:export` and CI, without that
 * being a real contract change.
 */
test('docs/openapi.yaml matches what Scramble generates from the current routes', function () {
    $generator = app(Generator::class);
    $config = Scramble::getGeneratorConfig('default');

    // Round-trip through JSON, same as `scramble:export`, so "empty object"
    // vs "empty array" serialization quirks don't register as false drift.
    $generated = json_decode(json_encode($generator($config)), true);

    $committed = Yaml::parseFile(base_path('docs/openapi.yaml'));

    expect($generated['paths'])->toEqual($committed['paths']);
    expect($generated['components'])->toEqual($committed['components']);
})->skip(fn () => ! file_exists(base_path('docs/openapi.yaml')), 'docs/openapi.yaml has not been generated yet');


==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/PatientTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;

function traceabilityTenantWithMember(TenantRole $role = TenantRole::Practitioner): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);
    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);

function traceabilityTokenFor(Tenant $tenant, User $user): string
{
    return test()->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('token');
}

test('a practitioner can create a pseudonymized patient reference with no identifying fields accepted', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = traceabilityTenantWithMember();
    $token = traceabilityTokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $create = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [
        'name' => 'Jean Dupont', 'date_of_birth' => '1980-01-01', 'email' => 'jean@example.com',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $create->assertCreated();
    expect($create->json('reference'))->toMatch('/^PAT-\d{6}$/');
    expect($create->json())->toHaveKeys(['id', 'reference']);
    expect($create->json())->not->toHaveKey('name');
    expect($create->json())->not->toHaveKey('date_of_birth');
});

test('patient references are sequential per tenant', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = traceabilityTenantWithMember();
    $token = traceabilityTokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $first = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $second = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    expect($first->json('reference'))->toBe('PAT-000001');
    expect($second->json('reference'))->toBe('PAT-000002');
});

test('two different tenants each start their own reference sequence at 1', function () {
    [$tenantA, $userA] = traceabilityTenantWithMember();
    [$tenantB, $userB] = traceabilityTenantWithMember();
    $tokenA = traceabilityTokenFor($tenantA, $userA);
    $tokenB = traceabilityTokenFor($tenantB, $userB);

    $a = $this->withToken($tokenA)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $b = $this->withToken($tokenB)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    expect($a->json('reference'))->toBe('PAT-000001');
    expect($b->json('reference'))->toBe('PAT-000001');
});

test('a patient can be archived (soft delete) and past evidence keeps its identity', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = traceabilityTenantWithMember();
    $token = traceabilityTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    $patientId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $this->withToken($token)->deleteJson("/api/v1/patients/{$patientId}")->assertNoContent();

    $patient = Patient::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->withTrashed()->findOrFail($patientId);
    expect($patient->trashed())->toBeTrue();
    expect($patient->reference)->not->toBeEmpty();
});

test('a viewer can read patients but cannot create one (vertical escalation)', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = traceabilityTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Viewer);
    $token = traceabilityTokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/patients')->assertOk();
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])
        ->assertStatus(403);
});

test('a practice never reaches another practice patient, even by guessing an id (IDOR)', function () {
    [$tenantA, $userA] = traceabilityTenantWithMember();
    [$tenantB, $userB] = traceabilityTenantWithMember();
    $tokenA = traceabilityTokenFor($tenantA, $userA);
    $tokenB = traceabilityTokenFor($tenantB, $userB);

    $foreignPatientId = $this->withToken($tokenB)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $this->withToken($tokenA)->getJson("/api/v1/patients/{$foreignPatientId}")->assertStatus(404);
});

<?php

use App\Domain\Catalog\Models\Product;
use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

function catalogTenantWithMember(TenantRole $role = TenantRole::StockManager): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);
    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);
    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole($role->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

function catalogTokenFor(Tenant $tenant, User $user): string
{
    return test()->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('token');
}

test('a stock manager can create, read, update, search, and delete a product', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = catalogTenantWithMember();
    $token = catalogTokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $create = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/products', [
        'name' => 'Sterilization Pouch 90x260mm',
        'reference' => 'POU-90260',
        'unit' => 'box_of_200',
        'min_threshold' => 5,
        'barcode' => '1234567890123',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $create->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('reference', 'POU-90260');
    $productId = $create->json('id');

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/products/{$productId}")
        ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('name', 'Sterilization Pouch 90x260mm');

    $search = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/products?filter[reference]=POU-90260');
    $search->assertOk();
    expect(collect($search->json('data'))->pluck('reference'))->toContain('POU-90260');

    $update = $this->withToken($token)->patchJson("/api/v1/products/{$productId}", ['min_threshold' => 10]);
    $update->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('min_threshold', 10);

    $this->withToken($token)->deleteJson("/api/v1/products/{$productId}")->assertNoContent();

    // Outside of an HTTP request there's no "current tenant" bound (that's
    // only set by the `tenant` middleware for the duration of a request),
    // so TenantScope would fail closed here regardless of soft-deletion —
    // bypass it explicitly to assert on soft-delete specifically.
    expect(Product::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->find($productId))->toBeNull();
    expect(Product::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->withTrashed()->find($productId))->not->toBeNull();
});

test('creating a product with a duplicate reference is rejected', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = catalogTenantWithMember();
    $token = catalogTokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/products', [
        'name' => 'A', 'reference' => 'DUP-1',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertCreated();

    $response = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/products', [
        'name' => 'B', 'reference' => 'DUP-1',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'PRODUCT_REFERENCE_TAKEN');
});

test('a viewer can read products but cannot create one (vertical escalation)', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = catalogTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Viewer);
    $token = catalogTokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/products')->assertOk();

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/products', [
        'name' => 'A', 'reference' => 'V-1',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertStatus(403);
});

test('a practice never sees another practice products, even by guessing an id (IDOR)', function () {
    [$tenantA, $userA] = catalogTenantWithMember();
    [$tenantB, $userB] = catalogTenantWithMember();
    $tokenA = catalogTokenFor($tenantA, $userA);
    $tokenB = catalogTokenFor($tenantB, $userB);

    $foreignProduct = $this->withToken($tokenB)->postJson('/api/v1/products', [
        'name' => 'Secret Product', 'reference' => 'SECRET-1',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $this->withToken($tokenA)->getJson("/api/v1/products/{$foreignProduct}")->assertStatus(404);

    $index = $this->withToken($tokenA)->getJson('/api/v1/products');
    expect(collect($index->json('data'))->pluck('reference'))->not->toContain('SECRET-1');
});

test('a product can be created under a category, and category names must be unique per tenant', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = catalogTenantWithMember();
    $token = catalogTokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $category = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/product-categories', [
        'name' => 'Consumables',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $category->assertCreated();
    $categoryId = $category->json('id');

    $product = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/products', [
        'name' => 'Gloves', 'reference' => 'GLV-1', 'category_id' => $categoryId,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $product->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('category_id', $categoryId);

    $dup = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/product-categories', [
        'name' => 'Consumables',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $dup->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'CATEGORY_NAME_TAKEN');
});

test('assigning a foreign tenant category id to a product is rejected by validation', function () {
    [$tenantA, $userA] = catalogTenantWithMember();
    [$tenantB, $userB] = catalogTenantWithMember();
    $tokenA = catalogTokenFor($tenantA, $userA);
    $tokenB = catalogTokenFor($tenantB, $userB);

    $foreignCategoryId = $this->withToken($tokenB)->postJson('/api/v1/product-categories', [
        'name' => 'Foreign Category',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $response = $this->withToken($tokenA)->postJson('/api/v1/products', [
        'name' => 'X', 'reference' => 'X-1', 'category_id' => $foreignCategoryId,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(422);
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/PurchaseOrderTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * There's no "create a site/location" API endpoint yet (S1-ANA-01 built
 * the tenancy schema + scoping; management endpoints for sites/rooms/
 * locations weren't part of that item's scope) — created directly via
 * Eloquent, same pattern already used for tenants/users in these tests.
 */
function createLocationFor(Tenant $tenant): string
{
    $site = $tenant->sites()->create(['name' => 'Cabinet Principal']);

    return $site->storageLocations()->create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'name' => 'Réserve'])->id;
}

function poTenantWithMember(TenantRole $role = TenantRole::StockManager): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);
    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);
    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole($role->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

function poTokenFor(Tenant $tenant, User $user): string
{
    return test()->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('token');
}

function createSupplierAndProduct(string $token): array
{
    $supplierId = test()->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/suppliers', [
        'name' => 'MedSupply SAS',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $productId = test()->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/products', [
        'name' => 'Gloves', 'reference' => 'GLV-'.Str::random(6),
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    return [$supplierId, $productId];
}

test('a stock manager can create a purchase order, mark it ordered, and fully receive it', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = poTenantWithMember();
    $token = poTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    [$supplierId, $productId] = createSupplierAndProduct($token);
    $locationId = createLocationFor($tenant);

    $create = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/purchase-orders', [
        'supplier_id' => $supplierId,
        'lines' => [['product_id' => $productId, 'qty_ordered' => 100, 'unit_price' => 0.10]],
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $create->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('status', 'draft');
    $poId = $create->json('id');
    $lineId = $create->json('lines.0.id');

    $order = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}/order", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $order->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('status', 'ordered');

    $receipt = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}/receipts", [
        'location_id' => $locationId,
        'lines' => [[
            'purchase_order_line_id' => $lineId,
            'batch_number' => 'BATCH-001',
            'expiry_date' => now()->addYear()->toDateString(),
            'qty' => 100,
        ]],
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $receipt->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('lines.0.qty', 100);

    $show = $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}");
    $show->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('status', 'received')->assertJsonPath('lines.0.qty_received', 100);

    // No current tenant is bound outside an HTTP request (only the `tenant`
    // middleware sets it), so TenantScope would fail closed here regardless.
    expect(
        Batch::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)
            ->where('batch_number', 'BATCH-001')->where('product_id', $productId)->exists()
    )->toBeTrue();
});

test('a partial receipt moves the purchase order to partially_received, and a second receipt completes it', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = poTenantWithMember();
    $token = poTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    [$supplierId, $productId] = createSupplierAndProduct($token);
    $locationId = createLocationFor($tenant);

    $create = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/purchase-orders', [
        'supplier_id' => $supplierId,
        'lines' => [['product_id' => $productId, 'qty_ordered' => 100]],
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $poId = $create->json('id');
    $lineId = $create->json('lines.0.id');

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}/order", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $firstReceipt = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}/receipts", [
        'location_id' => $locationId,
        'lines' => [['purchase_order_line_id' => $lineId, 'batch_number' => 'B1', 'qty' => 60]],
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $firstReceipt->assertCreated();

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}")
        ->assertJsonPath('status', 'partially_received')
        ->assertJsonPath('lines.0.qty_received', 60);

    $secondReceipt = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}/receipts", [
        'location_id' => $locationId,
        'lines' => [['purchase_order_line_id' => $lineId, 'batch_number' => 'B2', 'qty' => 40]],
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $secondReceipt->assertCreated();

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}")
        ->assertJsonPath('status', 'received')
        ->assertJsonPath('lines.0.qty_received', 100);
});

test('the same receipt request submitted twice with the same Idempotency-Key is applied only once', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = poTenantWithMember();
    $token = poTokenFor($tenant, $user);
    [$supplierId, $productId] = createSupplierAndProduct($token);
    $locationId = createLocationFor($tenant);

    $create = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/purchase-orders', [
        'supplier_id' => $supplierId,
        'lines' => [['product_id' => $productId, 'qty_ordered' => 100]],
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $poId = $create->json('id');
    $lineId = $create->json('lines.0.id');
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}/order", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $payload = ['location_id' => $locationId, 'lines' => [['purchase_order_line_id' => $lineId, 'batch_number' => 'B1', 'qty' => 50]]];
    $idempotencyKey = (string) Str::uuid();

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}/receipts", $payload, ['Idempotency-Key' => $idempotencyKey])
        ->assertCreated();
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}/receipts", $payload, ['Idempotency-Key' => $idempotencyKey])
        ->assertCreated();

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/purchase-orders/{$poId}")
        ->assertJsonPath('lines.0.qty_received', 50);
});

test('receiving cannot happen while the purchase order is still a draft', function () {

        'lines' => [['purchase_order_line_id' => $lineId, 'batch_number' => 'B1', 'qty' => 50]],

==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/RateLimitTest.php ====================

<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Str;

test('the public-api rate limiter blocks excessive unauthenticated login attempts', function () {
    for ($i = 0; $i < 10; $i++) {
        $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
            'tenant_slug' => 'no-such-tenant', 'email' => 'nobody@example.com', 'password' => 'wrong',
        ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertStatus(404);
    }

    $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => 'no-such-tenant', 'email' => 'nobody@example.com', 'password' => 'wrong',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertStatus(429);
});

test('the authenticated api rate limiter is a much higher ceiling than the public one', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = sterilizationTenantWithMember();
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $user);

    for ($i = 0; $i < 15; $i++) {
        $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/devices')->assertOk();
    }
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/RbacIdorTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\Invitation;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * S1-ANA-03 DoD: "horizontal and vertical escalation both rejected
 * server-side." Vertical = a low-privilege role attempting an action its
 * role doesn't grant. Horizontal (IDOR) = a valid, in-role user reaching
 * across into a different tenant's resource by guessing/reusing an id —
 * REC-01, walked here across every resource that accepts a client-supplied
 * id (sites has none yet; invitations and members do).
 */
function memberWithRole(Tenant $tenant, TenantRole $role, string $password = 'correct-password'): User
{
    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Test User',
        'email' => 'user-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make($password),
    ]);

    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole($role->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return $user;
}

function freshSeededTenant(): Tenant
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);
    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);

    return $tenant;
}

function loginAs(Tenant $tenant, User $user, string $password = 'correct-password'): string
{
    return test()->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => $password,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('token');
}

test('registering a new practice creates an owner with every permission', function () {
    $response = $this->postJson('/api/v1/tenants', [
        'tenant_name' => 'Brand New Practice',
        'tenant_slug' => 'brand-new-'.Str::lower(Str::random(8)),
        'owner_name' => 'Founder',
        'owner_email' => 'founder-'.Str::lower(Str::random(8)).'@example.com',
        'password' => 'a-strong-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertCreated();
    $token = $response->json('token');

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/sites')->assertOk();

    $invite = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/invitations', [
        'email' => 'someone-'.Str::lower(Str::random(8)).'@example.com',
        'role' => 'viewer',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $invite->assertCreated();
});

test('registering with an already-taken slug is rejected', function () {
    $tenant = freshSeededTenant();

    $response = $this->postJson('/api/v1/tenants', [
        'tenant_name' => 'Someone Else',
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'owner_name' => 'Whoever',
        'owner_email' => 'whoever-'.Str::lower(Str::random(8)).'@example.com',
        'password' => 'a-strong-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'TENANT_SLUG_TAKEN');
});

test('a viewer can read sites but cannot create an invitation or disable a member (vertical escalation)', function () {
    $tenant = freshSeededTenant();
    $viewer = memberWithRole($tenant, TenantRole::Viewer);
    $otherMember = memberWithRole($tenant, TenantRole::Practitioner);
    $token = loginAs($tenant, $viewer);

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/sites')->assertOk();

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/invitations', [
        'email' => 'someone@example.com',
        'role' => 'viewer',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertStatus(403);

    $membership = TenantUser::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->where('user_id', $otherMember->id)->first();
    $this->withToken($token)->deleteJson("/api/v1/members/{$membership->id}")->assertStatus(403);
});

test('an admin can create invitations and disable a member', function () {
    $tenant = freshSeededTenant();
    $admin = memberWithRole($tenant, TenantRole::Admin);
    $otherMember = memberWithRole($tenant, TenantRole::Practitioner);
    $token = loginAs($tenant, $admin);

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/invitations', [
        'email' => 'someone-'.Str::lower(Str::random(8)).'@example.com',
        'role' => 'viewer',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertCreated();

    $membership = TenantUser::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->where('user_id', $otherMember->id)->first();
    $this->withToken($token)->deleteJson("/api/v1/members/{$membership->id}")->assertNoContent();
    expect($membership->fresh()->status)->toBe('disabled');
});

test('a member of practice A cannot disable a member of practice B (IDOR)', function () {
    $tenantA = freshSeededTenant();
    $tenantB = freshSeededTenant();
    $adminA = memberWithRole($tenantA, TenantRole::Admin);
    $memberB = memberWithRole($tenantB, TenantRole::Practitioner);
    $tokenA = loginAs($tenantA, $adminA);

    $membershipB = TenantUser::where('tenant_id', $tenantB->id)->where('user_id', $memberB->id)->first();

    $response = $this->withToken($tokenA)->deleteJson("/api/v1/members/{$membershipB->id}");

    $response->assertStatus(404);
    expect($membershipB->fresh()->status)->toBe('active');
});

test('a member of practice A cannot revoke an invitation of practice B (IDOR)', function () {
    $tenantA = freshSeededTenant();
    $tenantB = freshSeededTenant();
    $adminA = memberWithRole($tenantA, TenantRole::Admin);
    $adminB = memberWithRole($tenantB, TenantRole::Admin);
    $tokenA = loginAs($tenantA, $adminA);

    $foreignInvitation = Invitation::create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenantB->id,
        'email' => 'someone@example.com',
        'role' => 'viewer',
        'token' => Str::random(64),
        'invited_by' => $adminB->id,
        'expires_at' => now()->addDays(7),
    ]);

    $response = $this->withToken($tokenA)->deleteJson("/api/v1/invitations/{$foreignInvitation->id}");

    $response->assertStatus(404);
    expect($foreignInvitation->fresh()->revoked_at)->toBeNull();
});

test('a member of practice A cannot see practice B sites even with a guessed limit/cursor (IDOR)', function () {
    $tenantA = freshSeededTenant();
    $tenantB = freshSeededTenant();
    $tenantB->sites()->create(['name' => 'Secret Site B']);
    $memberA = memberWithRole($tenantA, TenantRole::Owner);
    $tokenA = loginAs($tenantA, $memberA);

    $response = $this->withToken($tokenA)->getJson('/api/v1/sites');

    $response->assertOk();
    expect(collect($response->json('data'))->pluck('name'))->not->toContain('Secret Site B');
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Api/V1/SupplierTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Purchasing\Models\Supplier;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

function purchasingTenantWithMember(TenantRole $role = TenantRole::StockManager): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);
    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);
    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole($role->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

function purchasingTokenFor(Tenant $tenant, User $user): string
{
    return test()->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('token');
}

test('a stock manager can create, read, update, and delete a supplier', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = purchasingTenantWithMember();
    $token = purchasingTokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $create = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/suppliers', [
        'name' => 'MedSupply SAS', 'email' => 'contact@medsupply.example',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $create->assertCreated()->assertJsonPath('name', 'MedSupply SAS');
    $supplierId = $create->json('id');

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/suppliers/{$supplierId}")
        ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('email', 'contact@medsupply.example');

    $this->withToken($token)->patchJson("/api/v1/suppliers/{$supplierId}", ['phone' => '0102030405'])
        ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('phone', '0102030405');

    $this->withToken($token)->deleteJson("/api/v1/suppliers/{$supplierId}")->assertNoContent();
    expect(
        Supplier::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->withTrashed()->find($supplierId)->trashed()
    )->toBeTrue();
});

test('creating a supplier with a duplicate name is rejected', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = purchasingTenantWithMember();
    $token = purchasingTokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/suppliers', ['name' => 'Dup Supplier'], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])
        ->assertCreated();

    $response = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/suppliers', ['name' => 'Dup Supplier'], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(409)->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'SUPPLIER_NAME_TAKEN');
});

test('a viewer can read suppliers but cannot create one (vertical escalation)', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = purchasingTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Viewer);
    $token = purchasingTokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/suppliers')->assertOk();
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/suppliers', ['name' => 'X'], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])
        ->assertStatus(403);
});

test('a practice never reaches another practice supplier, even by guessing an id (IDOR)', function () {
    [$tenantA, $userA] = purchasingTenantWithMember();
    [$tenantB, $userB] = purchasingTenantWithMember();
    $tokenA = purchasingTokenFor($tenantA, $userA);
    $tokenB = purchasingTokenFor($tenantB, $userB);

    $foreignSupplierId = $this->withToken($tokenB)->postJson('/api/v1/suppliers', [
        'name' => 'Secret Supplier',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $this->withToken($tokenA)->getJson("/api/v1/suppliers/{$foreignSupplierId}")->assertStatus(404);
});

test('a product can be linked to a supplier with a supplier reference, price, and pack size', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = purchasingTenantWithMember();
    $token = purchasingTokenFor($tenant, $user);

    $supplierId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/suppliers', [
        'name' => 'MedSupply SAS',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $productId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/products', [
        'name' => 'Gloves', 'reference' => 'GLV-1',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $link = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/suppliers/{$supplierId}/products", [
        'product_id' => $productId,
        'supplier_reference' => 'MS-GLV-100',
        'pack_size' => 100,
        'price' => 12.5,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $link->assertCreated()
        ->assertJsonPath('supplier_reference', 'MS-GLV-100')
        ->assertJsonPath('pack_size', 100);

    $index = $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/suppliers/{$supplierId}/products");
    $index->assertOk();
    expect(collect($index->json())->pluck('product_id'))->toContain($productId);
});

test('linking a foreign tenant product to a supplier is rejected by validation', function () {
    [$tenantA, $userA] = purchasingTenantWithMember();
    [$tenantB, $userB] = purchasingTenantWithMember();
    $tokenA = purchasingTokenFor($tenantA, $userA);
    $tokenB = purchasingTokenFor($tenantB, $userB);

    $supplierIdA = $this->withToken($tokenA)->postJson('/api/v1/suppliers', [
        'name' => 'Supplier A',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $foreignProductId = $this->withToken($tokenB)->postJson('/api/v1/products', [
        'name' => 'Foreign product', 'reference' => 'FP-1',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $response = $this->withToken($tokenA)->postJson("/api/v1/suppliers/{$supplierIdA}/products", [
        'product_id' => $foreignProductId,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $response->assertStatus(422);
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/ApiDocsUiTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Http\Middleware\HandleInertiaRequests;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Routing\Route;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

function apiDocsTenantWithMember(): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Docs', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);

    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Docs User',
        'email' => 'docs-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);

    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole(TenantRole::Owner->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

test('authenticated users can open the Scramble docs UI without resolving tenant permissions', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = apiDocsTenantWithMember();

    // RestrictedDocsAccess only opens freely in local.
    $this->app->detectEnvironment(fn (): string => 'local');

    $this->actingAs($user)
        ->withSession(['current_tenant_id' => $tenant->id])
        ->get('/docs/api')
        ->assertOk();
});

test('HandleInertiaRequests skips tenant permission sharing on scramble routes', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = apiDocsTenantWithMember();

    $request = Request::create('/docs/api', 'GET');
    $request->setLaravelSession($this->app['session']->driver());
    $request->session()->put('current_tenant_id', $tenant->id);
    $request->setUserResolver(fn () => $user);
    $request->setRouteResolver(function () {
        $route = new Route(['GET'], '/docs/api', fn () => response('ok'));
        $route->name('scramble.docs.ui');

        return $route;
    });

    $shared = app(HandleInertiaRequests::class)->share($request);

    expect($shared['auth']['user'])->toBeNull()
        ->and($shared['auth']['permissions'])->toBe([])
        ->and($shared['tenant'])->toBeNull()
        ->and($shared['tenants'])->toBe([]);
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Auth/AuthenticationTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter;
use Laravel\Fortify\Features;

test('login screen can be rendered', function () {
    $response = $this->get(route('login'));

    $response->assertOk();
});

test('users can authenticate using the login screen', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    $response = $this->post(route('login.store'), [
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'password',
    ]);

    $this->assertAuthenticated();
    $response->assertRedirect(route('dashboard', absolute: false));
});

test('users with two factor enabled are redirected to two factor challenge', function () {
    $this->skipUnlessFortifyHas(Features::twoFactorAuthentication());

    Features::twoFactorAuthentication([
        'confirm' => true,
        'confirmPassword' => true,
    ]);

    $user = User::factory()->withTwoFactor()->create();

    $response = $this->post(route('login'), [
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'password',
    ]);

    $response->assertRedirect(route('two-factor.login'));
    $response->assertSessionHas('login.id', $user->id);
    $this->assertGuest();
});

test('users can not authenticate with invalid password', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    $this->post(route('login.store'), [
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'wrong-password',
    ]);

    $this->assertGuest();
});

test('a soft-disabled user cannot authenticate even with the correct password', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->create(['disabled_at' => now()]);

    $response = $this->post(route('login.store'), [
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'password',
    ]);

    $this->assertGuest();
    $response->assertSessionHasErrors();
});

test('users can logout', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    $response = $this->actingAs($user)->post(route('logout'));

    $response->assertRedirect(route('home'));

    $this->assertGuest();
});

test('users are rate limited', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    RateLimiter::increment(md5('login'.implode('|', [$user->email, '127.0.0.1'])), amount: 5);

    $response = $this->post(route('login.store'), [
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'wrong-password',
    ]);

    $response->assertTooManyRequests();
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Auth/EmailVerificationTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\Events\Verified;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\URL;
use Laravel\Fortify\Features;

beforeEach(function () {
    $this->skipUnlessFortifyHas(Features::emailVerification());
});

test('email verification screen can be rendered', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->unverified()->create();

    $response = $this->actingAs($user)->get(route('verification.notice'));

    $response->assertOk();
});

test('email can be verified', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->unverified()->create();

    Event::fake();

    $verificationUrl = URL::temporarySignedRoute(
        'verification.verify',
        now()->addMinutes(60),
        ['id' => $user->id, 'hash' => sha1($user->email)],
    );

    $response = $this->actingAs($user)->get($verificationUrl);

    Event::assertDispatched(Verified::class);

    expect($user->fresh()->hasVerifiedEmail())->toBeTrue();
    $response->assertRedirect(route('dashboard', absolute: false).'?verified=1');
});

test('email is not verified with invalid hash', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->unverified()->create();

    Event::fake();

    $verificationUrl = URL::temporarySignedRoute(
        'verification.verify',
        now()->addMinutes(60),
        ['id' => $user->id, 'hash' => sha1('wrong-email')],
    );

    $this->actingAs($user)->get($verificationUrl);

    Event::assertNotDispatched(Verified::class);
    expect($user->fresh()->hasVerifiedEmail())->toBeFalse();
});

test('email is not verified with invalid user id', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->unverified()->create();

    Event::fake();

    $verificationUrl = URL::temporarySignedRoute(
        'verification.verify',
        now()->addMinutes(60),
        ['id' => 123, 'hash' => sha1($user->email)],
    );

    $this->actingAs($user)->get($verificationUrl);

    Event::assertNotDispatched(Verified::class);
    expect($user->fresh()->hasVerifiedEmail())->toBeFalse();
});

test('verified user is redirected to dashboard from verification prompt', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    Event::fake();

    $response = $this->actingAs($user)->get(route('verification.notice'));

    Event::assertNotDispatched(Verified::class);
    $response->assertRedirect(route('dashboard', absolute: false));
});

test('already verified user visiting verification link is redirected without firing event again', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    Event::fake();

    $verificationUrl = URL::temporarySignedRoute(
        'verification.verify',
        now()->addMinutes(60),
        ['id' => $user->id, 'hash' => sha1($user->email)],
    );

    $this->actingAs($user)->get($verificationUrl)
        ->assertRedirect(route('dashboard', absolute: false).'?verified=1');

    Event::assertNotDispatched(Verified::class);
    expect($user->fresh()->hasVerifiedEmail())->toBeTrue();
});

<?php

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\Notifications\ResetPassword;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Laravel\Fortify\Features;

beforeEach(function () {
    $this->skipUnlessFortifyHas(Features::resetPasswords());
});

test('reset password link screen can be rendered', function () {
    $response = $this->get(route('password.request'));

    $response->assertOk();
});

test('reset password link can be requested', function () {
    Notification::fake();

    $user = User::factory()->create();

    $this->post(route('password.email'), ['email' => $user->email]);

    Notification::assertSentTo($user, ResetPassword::class);
});

test('reset password screen can be rendered', function () {
    Notification::fake();

    $user = User::factory()->create();

    $this->post(route('password.email'), ['email' => $user->email]);

    Notification::assertSentTo($user, ResetPassword::class, function ($notification) {
        $response = $this->get(route('password.reset', $notification->token));

        $response->assertOk();

        return true;
    });
});

test('password can be reset with valid token', function () {
    Notification::fake();

    $user = User::factory()->create();

    $this->post(route('password.email'), ['email' => $user->email]);

    Notification::assertSentTo($user, ResetPassword::class, function ($notification) use ($user) {
        $response = $this->post(route('password.update'), [
            'token' => $notification->token,
            'email' => $user->email,
            'password' => 'password',
            'password_confirmation' => 'password',
        ]);

        $response
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors()
            ->assertRedirect(route('login'));

        return true;
    });
});

test('password cannot be reset with invalid token', function () {
    $user = User::factory()->create();

    $response = $this->post(route('password.update'), [
        'token' => 'invalid-token',
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'newpassword123',
        'password_confirmation' => 'newpassword123',
    ]);

    $response->assertSessionHasErrors('email');
});

use Laravel\Fortify\Features;

test('new users can register', function () {

        'name' => 'Test User',

        'password' => 'password',
