==================== ./tests/Feature/BackupTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\MirrorMediaBackupAction;
use App\Domain\Compliance\Actions\RestoreMediaBackupAction;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

/**
 * Storage::fake() proves the mirror/restore logic itself (right paths,
 * right content, round-trips cleanly) the same way every other S3-backed
 * feature in this codebase is tested — the real MinIO round-trip is
 * verified manually inside the Docker container (docs/open-questions.md
 * OQ-11), same reasoning as S3-ANA-04's Browsershot PDF rendering.
 */
test('every file on the media disk is mirrored to the backups disk under media-backup/', function () {
    Storage::fake('media');
    Storage::fake('backups');
    Storage::disk('media')->put('cycles/1/photo.jpg', 'photo-bytes');
    Storage::disk('media')->put('cycles/2/photo.jpg', 'other-bytes');

    $count = app(MirrorMediaBackupAction::class)->execute();

    expect($count)->toBe(2);
    Storage::disk('backups')->assertExists('media-backup/cycles/1/photo.jpg');
    Storage::disk('backups')->assertExists('media-backup/cycles/2/photo.jpg');
    expect(Storage::disk('backups')->get('media-backup/cycles/1/photo.jpg'))->toBe('photo-bytes');
});

test('a lost media file can be fully recovered from its backup mirror', function () {
    Storage::fake('media');
    Storage::fake('backups');
    Storage::disk('media')->put('cycles/1/photo.jpg', 'original-bytes');
    app(MirrorMediaBackupAction::class)->execute();

    // Simulate data loss.
    Storage::disk('media')->delete('cycles/1/photo.jpg');
    expect(Storage::disk('media')->exists('cycles/1/photo.jpg'))->toBeFalse();

    $count = app(RestoreMediaBackupAction::class)->execute();

    expect($count)->toBe(1);
    Storage::disk('media')->assertExists('cycles/1/photo.jpg');
    expect(Storage::disk('media')->get('cycles/1/photo.jpg'))->toBe('original-bytes');
});

test('mirroring an empty media disk is a no-op, not an error', function () {
    Storage::fake('media');
    Storage::fake('backups');

    expect(app(MirrorMediaBackupAction::class)->execute())->toBe(0);
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Compliance/AuditEventTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\AuditEvent;
use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

function auditTenantWithMember(TenantRole $role = TenantRole::Owner, string $password = 'correct-password'): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);
    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make($password),
    ]);
    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole($role->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

test('a successful login writes an audit event with the actor and tenant', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = auditTenantWithMember();

    $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertOk();

    $event = AuditEvent::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)
        ->where('action', 'auth.login_succeeded')
        ->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
        ->first();

    expect($event)->not->toBeNull();
    expect($event->actor_id)->toBe($user->id);
    expect($event->actor_label_snapshot)->toContain($user->email);
});

test('a denied login (wrong password) writes an audit event with the reason', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = auditTenantWithMember();

    $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'wrong-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertStatus(401);

    $event = AuditEvent::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)
        ->where('action', 'auth.login_denied')
        ->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)
        ->first();

    expect($event)->not->toBeNull();
    expect($event->reason)->toBe('INVALID_CREDENTIALS');
});

test('the actor label snapshot survives a later rename — history keeps the identity as it was', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = auditTenantWithMember();

    $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $event = AuditEvent::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)
        ->where('action', 'auth.login_succeeded')->firstOrFail();
    $originalSnapshot = $event->actor_label_snapshot;

    $user->update(['name' => 'Someone Completely Different']);

    expect($event->fresh()->actor_label_snapshot)->toBe($originalSnapshot);
});

test('an owner can list this practice audit events and a viewer cannot', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = auditTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $viewer = User::create(['name' => 'V', 'email' => 'v-'.Str::lower(Str::random(8)).'@example.com', 'password' => Hash::make('pw')]);
    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $viewer->id, 'status' => 'active']);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $viewer->assignRole(TenantRole::Viewer->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    $ownerToken = $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug, 'email' => $owner->email, 'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('token');

    $viewerToken = $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug, 'email' => $viewer->email, 'password' => 'pw',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('token');

    $this->withToken($ownerToken)->getJson('/api/v1/audit-events')->assertOk();
    $this->withToken($viewerToken)->getJson('/api/v1/audit-events')->assertStatus(403);
});

test('a practice never sees another practice audit events', function () {
    [$tenantA, $ownerA] = auditTenantWithMember();
    [$tenantB] = auditTenantWithMember();

    $tokenA = $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenantA->slug, 'email' => $ownerA->email, 'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('token');

    $response = $this->withToken($tokenA)->getJson('/api/v1/audit-events');

    $response->assertOk();
    $tenantIds = collect($response->json('data'))->pluck('tenant_id')->filter();
    expect($tenantIds->contains($tenantB->id))->toBeFalse();
});

test('audit_events is append-only at the database level: update and delete are refused even for the admin role', function () {
    [$tenant, $user] = auditTenantWithMember();

    $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => 'correct-password',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $event = AuditEvent::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->first();

    expect($event)->not->toBeNull();

    // Each attempt runs in its own transaction (a Postgres savepoint nested
    // inside RefreshDatabase's outer per-test transaction): once a
    // statement fails, Postgres poisons the rest of that transaction
    // ("current transaction is aborted") until it's rolled back, which
    // would otherwise break the next assertion in this same test.
    expect(fn () => DB::transaction(
        fn () => DB::table('audit_events')->where('id', $event->id)->update(['reason' => 'tampered'])
    ))->toThrow(QueryException::class);

    expect(fn () => DB::transaction(
        fn () => DB::table('audit_events')->where('id', $event->id)->delete()
    ))->toThrow(QueryException::class);

    expect(AuditEvent::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->find($event->id)->reason)
        ->not->toBe('tampered');
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Compliance/SecurityEventTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Compliance\Enums\SecurityEventType;
use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\AuditEvent;
use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\SecurityEvent;
use App\Domain\Equipment\Models\Device;
use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Site;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Debug\ExceptionHandler;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * security_events is the operator-only channel this feature adds — see
 * database/migrations/2026_08_09_000001_create_security_events_table.php
 * and app/Support/Security/SecurityEventRenderer.php for the full
 * reasoning. Never exercised through the app's normal connection: every
 * assertion here reads the table directly (SecurityEvent itself always
 * talks to pgsql_admin), the same way the app can never read it either.
 */
function securityTenantWithMember(TenantRole $role = TenantRole::Owner, string $password = 'correct-password'): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);
    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make($password),
    ]);
    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole($role->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

function securityLoginToken(Tenant $tenant, User $user, string $password = 'correct-password'): string
{
    return test()->postJson('/api/v1/auth/login', [
        'tenant_slug' => $tenant->slug,
        'email' => $user->email,
        'password' => $password,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('token');
}

test('an authorization failure writes a security event, not an audit event', function () {
    [$tenant, $viewer] = securityTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Viewer);
    $token = securityLoginToken($tenant, $viewer);

    $auditCountBefore = AuditEvent::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->count();

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/invitations', [
        'email' => 'someone-'.Str::lower(Str::random(8)).'@example.com',
        'role' => 'viewer',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertStatus(403);

    $event = SecurityEvent::where('type', SecurityEventType::AuthorizationFailure)
        ->where('actor_id', $viewer->id)
        ->latest('occurred_at')
        ->first();

    expect($event)->not->toBeNull();
    expect($event->tenant_claimed_id)->toBe($tenant->id);
    expect($event->actor_label_snapshot)->toContain($viewer->email);
    expect($event->route_name)->toBe('api.v1.invitations.store');
    expect($event->method)->toBe('POST');
    expect($event->request_id)->not->toBeNull();

    // The 403 is a routine, in-tenant permission denial, not a
    // cross-tenant probe — it belongs on the operator channel, and
    // nowhere on the practice's own business audit trail.
    expect(AuditEvent::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->count())->toBe($auditCountBefore);
});

test('a genuine cross-tenant resolution attempt writes a security event with both tenants', function () {
    [$tenantA, $ownerA] = securityTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $tokenA = securityLoginToken($tenantA, $ownerA);

    // Practice B's device has to be genuinely committed, not just sitting
    // inside this test's own uncommitted RefreshDatabase transaction: the
    // renderer confirms a real cross-tenant match through the pgsql_admin
    // connection — a physically separate DB session that can never see an
    // uncommitted row from the default connection's transaction (the same
    // limitation TenantIsolationTest and DataExportRequestTest already
    // document). Created via that same connection so both sessions agree
    // it exists, and torn down explicitly since it won't roll back the
    // way every other fixture here does.
    $tenantB = Tenant::on('pgsql_admin')->create(['name' => 'Cabinet B', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);
    $siteB = Site::on('pgsql_admin')->create(['tenant_id' => $tenantB->id, 'name' => 'Practice B Site']);
    $deviceB = Device::on('pgsql_admin')->create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenantB->id,
        'site_id' => $siteB->id,
        'name' => 'Autoclave B',
        'serial_number' => 'SN-'.Str::random(8),
        'kind' => 'autoclave',
        'status' => 'active',
    ]);

    try {
        $response = $this->withToken($tokenA)->getJson("/api/v1/devices/{$deviceB->id}");
        $response->assertStatus(404);

        $event = SecurityEvent::where('type', SecurityEventType::CrossTenantResolutionAttempt)
            ->where('subject_id', $deviceB->id)
            ->first();

        expect($event)->not->toBeNull();
        expect($event->tenant_claimed_id)->toBe($tenantA->id);
        expect($event->tenant_actual_id)->toBe($tenantB->id);
        expect($event->actor_id)->toBe($ownerA->id);
        expect($event->subject_type)->toBe(Device::class);
    } finally {
        DB::connection('pgsql_admin')->table('tenants')->where('id', $tenantB->id)->delete();
    }
});

test('a wholly made-up id produces no security event — 404 noise is not a probe', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = securityTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = securityLoginToken($tenant, $owner);

    $madeUpId = (string) Str::uuid();

    $this->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/devices/{$madeUpId}")->assertStatus(404);

    expect(
        SecurityEvent::where('type', SecurityEventType::CrossTenantResolutionAttempt)
            ->where('subject_id', $madeUpId)
            ->exists()
    )->toBeFalse();
});

test('the restricted app role can neither read nor write security_events — only pgsql_admin can', function () {
    // The test suite's default connection runs as the elevated migrations
    // role (phpunit.xml), same reason TenantIsolationTest exercises RLS via
    // `SET LOCAL ROLE steriqore_app` rather than the default connection —
    // see that file's own docblock. security_events has zero permissive
    // policies at all (unlike every tenant table, which at least allows
    // its own tenant to SELECT), so both directions must fail even with a
    // tenant bound.
    [$tenant] = securityTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    // RLS with no policy at all means a default-deny for every command,
    // but SELECT and write commands fail differently: a SELECT with no
    // matching policy simply returns zero rows (Postgres filters silently,
    // no error) while an INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE with no WITH CHECK policy is
    // an outright QueryException — verified below.
    $count = DB::transaction(function () use ($tenant) {
        DB::statement('SET LOCAL ROLE steriqore_app');
        DB::select("select set_config('app.tenant_id', ?, true)", [$tenant->id]);

        return DB::table('security_events')->count();
    });

    expect($count)->toBe(0);

    expect(function () use ($tenant) {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($tenant) {
            DB::statement('SET LOCAL ROLE steriqore_app');
            DB::select("select set_config('app.tenant_id', ?, true)", [$tenant->id]);

            DB::table('security_events')->insert([
                'id' => (string) Str::uuid7(),
                'type' => 'authorization_failure',
                'method' => 'GET',
                'path' => '/x',
                'request_id' => (string) Str::uuid7(),
                'occurred_at' => now(),
            ]);
        });
    })->toThrow(QueryException::class);
});

test('security_events is append-only at the database level, even through the admin connection', function () {
    [$tenantV, $viewer] = securityTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Viewer);
    $tokenV = securityLoginToken($tenantV, $viewer);
    $this->withToken($tokenV)->postJson('/api/v1/invitations', [
        'email' => 'someone-'.Str::lower(Str::random(8)).'@example.com',
        'role' => 'viewer',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertStatus(403);

    $event = SecurityEvent::where('type', SecurityEventType::AuthorizationFailure)
        ->where('actor_id', $viewer->id)
        ->firstOrFail();

    expect(fn () => DB::connection('pgsql_admin')->transaction(
        fn () => DB::connection('pgsql_admin')
            ->table('security_events')->where('id', $event->id)->update(['path' => 'tampered'])
    ))->toThrow(QueryException::class);

    expect(fn () => DB::connection('pgsql_admin')->transaction(
        fn () => DB::connection('pgsql_admin')
            ->table('security_events')->where('id', $event->id)->delete()
    ))->toThrow(QueryException::class);

    expect($event->fresh()->path)->not->toBe('tampered');
});

test('a genuine RLS policy rejection writes a security event via the render pipeline', function () {
    // Same technique as TenantIsolationTest's "rejects an insert whose
    // tenant_id does not match" — a real SQLSTATE[42501] under the
    // restricted role, not a hand-typed message, fed into the exact
    // Handler::render() entrypoint a live request would hit.
    [$tenantA, $ownerA] = securityTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$tenantB] = securityTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $caught = null;

    try {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($tenantA, $tenantB) {
            DB::statement('SET LOCAL ROLE steriqore_app');
            DB::select("select set_config('app.tenant_id', ?, true)", [$tenantA->id]);

            DB::table('sites')->insert([
                'tenant_id' => $tenantB->id, // mismatched on purpose
                'name' => 'Should be rejected',
                'created_at' => now(),
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ]);
        });
    } catch (QueryException $e) {
        $caught = $e;
    }

    expect($caught)->not->toBeNull();

    $request = Request::create('/sites', 'POST');
    $request->setUserResolver(fn () => $ownerA);
    // RecordSecurityEventAction resolves Request via constructor injection
    // from the container, same as a real request's own lifecycle binds it
    // (Kernel::handle() does this before render() is ever reached) — a
    // manually built Request here has to be bound the same way, or the
    // action would pick up whatever request the container already held.
    app()->instance('request', $request);

    app(ExceptionHandler::class)->render($request, $caught);

    $event = SecurityEvent::where('type', SecurityEventType::RlsPolicyRejection)
        ->latest('occurred_at')
        ->first();

    expect($event)->not->toBeNull();
    expect($event->method)->toBe('POST');
    expect($event->path)->toBe('sites');
});

==================== ./tests/Feature/DataExportExpiryTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Enums\DataExportStatus;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Models\DataExportRequest;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * Mirrors the other tenant-fixture helpers scattered across the suite,
 * renamed to avoid a global-function clash when the whole suite loads.
 */
function dataExportExpiryTenantWithOwner(): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);

    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);

    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);
    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

/**
 * data_export_requests has a Postgres RLS policy (invariant #7's second
 * line of defence) — the command must bind the full tenant context
 * (TenantContext::run), not just Eloquent's TenantScope via makeCurrent(),
 * or the query fails closed and silently expires nothing.
 */
test('the scheduled command reclaims the S3 object and expires the row past retention', function () {
    Storage::fake('backups');
    [$tenant, $owner] = dataExportExpiryTenantWithOwner();

    $filePath = "data-exports/{$tenant->id}/export.zip";
    Storage::disk('backups')->put($filePath, 'zip-bytes');

    TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => DataExportRequest::create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
        'requested_by_user_id' => $owner->id,
        'status' => DataExportStatus::Completed,
        'file_path' => $filePath,
        'expires_at' => now()->subMinute(),
    ]));

    Artisan::call('data-exports:expire');

    TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($tenant) {
        $request = DataExportRequest::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->sole();
        expect($request->status)->toBe(DataExportStatus::Expired);
        expect($request->file_path)->toBeNull();
    });

    Storage::disk('backups')->assertMissing($filePath);
});

test('an export that has not reached its retention window is left alone', function () {
    Storage::fake('backups');
    [$tenant, $owner] = dataExportExpiryTenantWithOwner();

    $filePath = "data-exports/{$tenant->id}/export.zip";
    Storage::disk('backups')->put($filePath, 'zip-bytes');

    TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => DataExportRequest::create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
        'requested_by_user_id' => $owner->id,
        'status' => DataExportStatus::Completed,
        'file_path' => $filePath,
        'expires_at' => now()->addDays(7),
    ]));

    Artisan::call('data-exports:expire');

    TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($tenant, $filePath) {
        $request = DataExportRequest::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->sole();
        expect($request->status)->toBe(DataExportStatus::Completed);
        expect($request->file_path)->toBe($filePath);
    });

    Storage::disk('backups')->assertExists($filePath);
});

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\URL;

    $app = $this->app;
    $app['env'] = 'production';

    (new AppServiceProvider($app))->boot();

    expect(url('/login'))->toStartWith('https://');
});

    $app = $this->app;
    $app['env'] = 'local';

    URL::forceScheme('http');

    (new AppServiceProvider($app))->boot();

    expect(url('/login'))->toStartWith('http://');
});

==================== ./tests/Feature/Tenancy/TenantIsolationTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\RegisterTenantAction;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Site;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * REC-01 / R-06: a user of practice A must never be able to read practice
 * B's data. Two independent layers are exercised here:
 *   - the ORM's TenantScope global scope (App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope)
 *   - PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, exercised as the restricted,
 *     non-superuser role the running application actually connects as
 *     (App\Http\Middleware\Api\SetCurrentTenant, docker/postgres/init/01-create-app-role.sql)
 *
 * The RLS tests use `SET LOCAL ROLE steriqore_app` rather than a second
 * physical connection to that role: RefreshDatabase's per-test transaction
 * on the default (admin) connection is rolled back, never committed, so a
 * genuinely separate connection could never see the fixture rows anyway.
 * `SET LOCAL ROLE` changes the effective role — and therefore RLS
 * enforcement — for the rest of the current transaction, on the same
 * session, which is the standard way to test RLS as another role without
 * a second connection.
 */
function makeTenantWithSite(string $siteName): Tenant
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Practice '.$siteName, 'slug' => 'practice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);
    $tenant->sites()->create(['name' => $siteName]);

    return $tenant;
}

test('the ORM global scope only returns the current tenant sites', function () {
    $tenantA = makeTenantWithSite('Cabinet A');
    $tenantB = makeTenantWithSite('Cabinet B');

    $tenantA->makeCurrent();
    expect(Site::pluck('name')->all())->toBe(['Cabinet A']);
    Tenant::forgetCurrent();

    $tenantB->makeCurrent();
    expect(Site::pluck('name')->all())->toBe(['Cabinet B']);
    Tenant::forgetCurrent();
});

test('the ORM global scope fails closed with no current tenant bound', function () {
    makeTenantWithSite('Cabinet A');
    Tenant::forgetCurrent();

    expect(Site::count())->toBe(0);
});

test('creating a site auto-fills tenant_id from the current tenant', function () {
    $tenant = makeTenantWithSite('Cabinet A');
    $tenant->makeCurrent();

    $site = Site::create(['name' => 'Cabinet A - Annexe']);

    expect($site->tenant_id)->toBe($tenant->id);

    Tenant::forgetCurrent();
});

test('Row-Level Security enforces isolation for the restricted role, independent of the ORM', function () {
    $tenantA = makeTenantWithSite('Cabinet RLS A');
    $tenantB = makeTenantWithSite('Cabinet RLS B');
    Tenant::forgetCurrent();

    $namesForTenant = function (string $tenantId) {
        DB::statement('SET LOCAL ROLE steriqore_app');
        DB::select("select set_config('app.tenant_id', ?, true)", [$tenantId]);

        return DB::table('sites')->pluck('name')->all();
    };

    // Each call runs in its own transaction (RefreshDatabase's outer test
    // transaction plus a nested one here) so `SET LOCAL ROLE` from the first
    // call doesn't leak into the second.
    expect(DB::transaction(fn () => $namesForTenant($tenantA->id)))->toBe(['Cabinet RLS A']);
    expect(DB::transaction(fn () => $namesForTenant($tenantB->id)))->toBe(['Cabinet RLS B']);
});

test('Row-Level Security denies every row when app.tenant_id is not set, even for the restricted role', function () {
    makeTenantWithSite('Cabinet RLS C');
    Tenant::forgetCurrent();

    $count = DB::transaction(function () {
        DB::statement('SET LOCAL ROLE steriqore_app');

        // Deliberately not calling set_config — app.tenant_id is unset here.
        return DB::table('sites')->count();
    });

    expect($count)->toBe(0);
});

test('registering a new tenant succeeds under the restricted DB role (roles/model_has_roles are RLS-protected too)', function () {
    // Found via S5-ANA-03's real backup/restore proof against the live
    // container: RegisterTenantAction ran fine in every test only because
    // the test suite's default connection is the elevated migrations
    // role — under the actual restricted app role, SeedTenantRolesAction's
    // inserts into `roles` failed the RLS policy outright, since nothing
    // had bound app.tenant_id yet for a tenant that didn't exist a moment
    // ago. Fixed via App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext.
    $slug = 'cabinet-rls-register-'.Str::lower(Str::random(8));

    $result = DB::transaction(function () use ($slug) {
        DB::statement('SET LOCAL ROLE steriqore_app');

        return app(RegisterTenantAction::class)->execute(
            tenantName: 'Cabinet RLS Register',
            tenantSlug: $slug,
            ownerName: 'Owner',
            ownerEmail: 'owner-'.Str::lower(Str::random(8)).'@example.com',
            password: 'correct-password-123',
        );
    });

    expect($result['tenant']->slug)->toBe($slug);
    expect(
        DB::table('model_has_roles')
            ->join('roles', 'roles.id', '=', 'model_has_roles.role_id')
            ->where('model_has_roles.model_uuid', $result['user']->id)
            ->where('roles.tenant_id', $result['tenant']->id)
            ->where('roles.name', 'owner')
            ->exists()
    )->toBeTrue();
});

test('Row-Level Security rejects an insert whose tenant_id does not match the session tenant', function () {
    $tenantA = makeTenantWithSite('Cabinet RLS D');
    $tenantB = makeTenantWithSite('Cabinet RLS E');
    Tenant::forgetCurrent();

    expect(function () use ($tenantA, $tenantB) {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($tenantA, $tenantB) {
            DB::statement('SET LOCAL ROLE steriqore_app');
            DB::select("select set_config('app.tenant_id', ?, true)", [$tenantA->id]);

            DB::table('sites')->insert([
                'tenant_id' => $tenantB->id, // mismatched on purpose
                'name' => 'Should be rejected',
                'created_at' => now(),
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ]);
        });
    })->toThrow(QueryException::class);
});

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;

        );

    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $locationId = alertLocationFor($tenant);
    receiveProductWithThreshold($token, $locationId, minThreshold: 50, qty: 10);
    receiveProductWithThreshold($token, $locationId, minThreshold: 0, qty: 10, expiryDate: now()->subDay()->toDateString());
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/alerts/detect', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/alerts?filter[type]=expired')
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->has('alerts.data', 1)
            ->where('alerts.data.0.type', 'expired')
        );

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/alerts?filter[state]=resolved')
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->has('alerts.data', 0));
});

    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $locationId = alertLocationFor($tenant);
    receiveProductWithThreshold($token, $locationId, minThreshold: 50, qty: 10);
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/alerts/detect', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    $alertId = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/v1/alerts')->json('data.0.id');

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->post("/alerts/{$alertId}/resolve")

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/alerts')
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page

==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/BatchesTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\BatchStatus;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\StockLevel;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\StorageLocation;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;

/**
 * Batches have no create/update route anywhere in the domain — they only
 * ever come into existence as a side effect of ReceiveGoodsAction
 * (GoodsReceiptsTest). Created directly here via Eloquent, the same way
 * StorageLocation fixtures already are (storageLocationFor), purely as
 * fixture setup so this read-only list has rows to show without going
 * through a full order->receive HTTP round trip for every expiry variant.
 */
function batchFor(Tenant $tenant, string $productId, ?string $supplierId, array $overrides = []): string
{
    return TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($tenant, $productId, $supplierId, $overrides) {
        return Batch::create(array_merge([
            'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
            'product_id' => $productId,
            'supplier_id' => $supplierId,
            'batch_number' => 'BATCH-'.Str::random(6),
            'expiry_date' => now()->addYear(),
            'received_at' => now(),
            'status' => BatchStatus::Active,
        ], $overrides))->id;
    });
}

function stockLevelFor(Tenant $tenant, string $batchId, int $quantity): void
{
    TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($tenant, $batchId, $quantity) {
        $siteId = $tenant->sites()->create(['name' => 'Cabinet Principal'])->id;
        $locationId = StorageLocation::create([
            'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
            'site_id' => $siteId,
            'name' => 'Main storeroom',
        ])->id;

        StockLevel::create([
            'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
            'batch_id' => $batchId,
            'location_id' => $locationId,
            'quantity' => $quantity,
        ]);
    });
}

test('an owner sees a received batch in the tenant-wide list with its on-hand quantity', function () {

            ->has('batches.data', 1)

        );
});

    // ApiExceptionWebRenderer converts the domain's CYCLE_NOT_READY_FOR_TESTS
    // into a normal redirect-back, not the API's JSON envelope or a raw 500.
    $response->assertRedirect();
    $response->assertSessionHas('_flash');
});

test('a label can be printed the first time without a reason, and a reprint requires one', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    [$cycleId] = releasedCompliantCycle($token, $tenant, $deviceId);
    dluRuleFor($token);
    $labelId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/labels", [
        'packaging_type' => 'Sachet', 'storage_condition' => 'Armoire',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('0.id');

    $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/labels/{$labelId}/print")->assertRedirect();

    $missingReason = $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/labels/{$labelId}/print");
    $missingReason->assertSessionHasErrors('reason');

    $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/labels/{$labelId}/print", [
        'reason' => 'Original label was damaged.',
    ])->assertRedirect();

    $label = Label::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->findOrFail($labelId);
    expect($label->print_counter)->toBe(2);
});

==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/CycleReleaseTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;

function advanceCycleToAwaitingRelease(mixed $owner, string $cycleId): void
{
    test()->actingAs($owner)->post("/cycles/{$cycleId}/items", ['description' => 'Scaler kit'])->assertRedirect();
    test()->actingAs($owner)->post("/cycles/{$cycleId}/start")->assertRedirect();
    test()->actingAs($owner)->post("/cycles/{$cycleId}/complete")->assertRedirect();
    test()->actingAs($owner)->post("/cycles/{$cycleId}/submit-for-release")->assertRedirect();
}

test('an owner can release a cycle as compliant', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $cycleId = cycleFor($token, $deviceId);
    advanceCycleToAwaitingRelease($owner, $cycleId);

    $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/cycles/{$cycleId}/release", [
        'decision' => 'compliant',
    ])->assertRedirect();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/cycles/{$cycleId}")
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->where('cycle.status', 'released')
            ->where('release.decision', 'compliant')
            ->where('release.reason', null)
        );
});

test('an owner can reject a cycle with a reason', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $cycleId = cycleFor($token, $deviceId);
    advanceCycleToAwaitingRelease($owner, $cycleId);

    $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/cycles/{$cycleId}/release", [
        'decision' => 'rejected',
        'reason' => 'Bowie-Dick test failed.',
    ])->assertRedirect();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/cycles/{$cycleId}")
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->where('cycle.status', 'rejected')
            ->where('release.decision', 'rejected')
            ->where('release.reason', 'Bowie-Dick test failed.')
        );
});

test('rejecting a cycle without a reason is a validation error', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $cycleId = cycleFor($token, $deviceId);
    advanceCycleToAwaitingRelease($owner, $cycleId);

    $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/cycles/{$cycleId}/release", [
        'decision' => 'rejected',
    ])->assertSessionHasErrors('reason');
});

==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/CycleShowTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;

function addCycleItem(string $token, string $cycleId, string $description): void
{
    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/items", [
        'description' => $description,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
}

function recordControlTest(string $token, string $cycleId): void
{
    // Control tests can only be recorded once a cycle has completed
    // running (a real, existing business rule — CYCLE_NOT_READY_FOR_TESTS)
    // — advance the state machine for real rather than seeding the row
    // directly, so this fixture can never drift from what the domain
    // actually allows.
    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/start", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/complete", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);

    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/control-tests", [
        'type' => 'vacuum',
        'result' => 'pass',
        'performed_at' => now()->toIso8601String(),
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
}

test('an owner can view a cycle detail with its load composition and control tests', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $cycleId = cycleFor($token, $deviceId);
    addCycleItem($token, $cycleId, 'Scaler kit, pouch 1');
    recordControlTest($token, $cycleId);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/cycles/{$cycleId}")
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('sterilization/cycles/show')
            ->where('cycle.id', $cycleId)
            ->where('cycle.status', 'completed')
            ->where('device.label', 'Autoclave 1')
            ->has('items', 1)
            ->where('items.0.description', 'Scaler kit, pouch 1')
            ->has('controlTests', 1)
            ->where('controlTests.0.result', 'pass')
            ->where('attachments', [])
            ->where('release', null)
        );
});

test('a practice cannot view another practice cycle detail (IDOR)', function () {
    [, $ownerA] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$tenantB, $ownerB] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $tokenB = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantB, $ownerB);
    $deviceIdB = sterilizationDeviceFor($tokenB, $tenantB);
    $cycleIdB = cycleFor($tokenB, $deviceIdB);

    $this->actingAs($ownerA)->get("/cycles/{$cycleIdB}")->assertNotFound();
});

test('a nonexistent cycle id returns 404, not a 500', function () {
    [, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $this->actingAs($owner)->get('/cycles/'.(string) Str::uuid())->assertNotFound();

==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/CyclesTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;

function cycleFor(string $token, string $deviceId): string
{
    return test()->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/cycles', [
        'device_id' => $deviceId,
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');
}

test('an owner can view the cycles list, scoped to their own tenant', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    cycleFor($token, $deviceId);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/cycles')
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('sterilization/cycles/index')
            ->where('tenant.id', $tenant->id)
            ->where('auth.role', 'owner')
            ->has('auth.permissions')
            ->has('cycles.data', 1)
            ->where('cycles.data.0.status', 'draft')
            ->has('devices', 1)
        );
});

    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);

            ->component('sterilization/cycles/index')
            ->has('cycles.data', 0)
            ->where('filters.status', 'running')
        );

    $this->actingAs($owner)

test('a user without the cycles.view permission is refused by the Policy, not just hidden from the nav', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    // cycles.view comes from the 'owner' role, not a direct grant — remove
    // the role itself (rather than revokePermissionTo(), which only ever
    // touches direct user-level grants) to prove the Policy check is real
    // and not just a decorative call that always passes for this fixture.

test('the full draft -> running -> completed -> awaiting_release arc works', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

        ->get("/cycles/{$cycleId}")

        ->get("/cycles/{$cycleId}")

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/cycles/{$cycleId}")

});

/**

 * BuildDashboardAction::buildAttentionCards defines (0: cycles_awaiting_
 * release, 1: cycles_rejected_no_non_conformity, 2: open_non_conformities,
 * 3: batches_expired_in_stock, 4: batches_near_expiry, 5: products_low_stock,
 * 6: labels_past_dlu_unused) — role-aware reordering happens client-side
 * only (attention-queue.tsx), so asserting by fixed index here is exact,
 * not fragile.
 */

    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/dashboard')

        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('dashboard')
            ->where('dashboard.is_new_practice', true)
            ->where('dashboard.attention_cards', [])
            ->has('dashboard.onboarding_steps', 4)
            ->where('dashboard.onboarding_steps.0.key', 'add_site')
            ->where('dashboard.onboarding_steps.0.done', false)
            ->where('dashboard.onboarding_steps.0.can_act', true)
            ->where('dashboard.onboarding_steps.3.key', 'run_first_cycle')
            ->where('dashboard.onboarding_steps.3.done', false)
        );
});

test('a rejected cycle without a non-conformity is counted, and clears once one is raised', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $cycleId = sterilizationRunningCycleFor($token, $deviceId);
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/submit-for-release", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    [, $releaserToken] = releaserFor($tenant);
    $this->withToken($releaserToken)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/release", [
        'decision' => 'rejected', 'reason' => 'Failed biological test',

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/dashboard')
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->where('dashboard.attention_cards.1.count', 0)
        );
});

/**
 * The real N+1 guard: query count must not grow with the number of rows —
 * two tenants (fresh cache keys, no pollution between them) with 1 vs 5
 * cycles today should cost the exact same number of queries, proving the
 * eager-loaded device/release relations aren't re-queried per row.
 */
test('the dashboard issues the same number of queries regardless of how many cycles ran today', function () {
    [$tenantA, $ownerA] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $tokenA = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantA, $ownerA);
    $deviceIdA = sterilizationDeviceFor($tokenA, $tenantA);
    cycleFor($tokenA, $deviceIdA);

    [$tenantB, $ownerB] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $tokenB = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantB, $ownerB);
    $deviceIdB = sterilizationDeviceFor($tokenB, $tenantB);
    for ($i = 0; $i < 5; $i++) {
        cycleFor($tokenB, $deviceIdB);
    }

    DB::enableQueryLog();
    $this->actingAs($ownerA)->get('/dashboard')->assertOk();
    $countA = count(DB::getQueryLog());
    DB::flushQueryLog();

    $this->actingAs($ownerB)->get('/dashboard')->assertOk();
    $countB = count(DB::getQueryLog());
    DB::disableQueryLog();

    expect($countB)->toBe($countA);
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/DataExportRequestTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Enums\DataExportStatus;
use App\Domain\Reporting\Models\DataExportRequest;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Queue;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * Mirrors tests/Feature/Api/V1/DataExportRequestTest.php's
 * sterilizationTenantWithMember, renamed to avoid a global-function clash
 * when the whole suite loads.
 */
function dataExportTenantWithMember(TenantRole $role = TenantRole::Owner): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);

    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);

    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole($role->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/DeviceProgramsTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Equipment\Models\DeviceProgram;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;

test('the device detail page shows its programs', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);

    $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/devices/{$deviceId}/programs", [
        'name' => '134°C Standard',
        'target_temperature_celsius' => 134,
        'plateau_minutes' => 18,
    ])->assertRedirect();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/devices/{$deviceId}")
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->has('programs', 1)
            ->where('programs.0.name', '134°C Standard')
            ->where('programs.0.target_temperature_celsius', 134)
            ->where('programs.0.is_active', true)
        );
});

test('a program can be updated and removed', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/devices/{$deviceId}/programs", [
        'name' => '134°C Standard',
        'target_temperature_celsius' => 134,
        'plateau_minutes' => 18,
    ]);
    $programId = DeviceProgram::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)
        ->where('device_id', $deviceId)->firstOrFail()->id;

    $this->actingAs($owner)->patch("/devices/{$deviceId}/programs/{$programId}", [
        'is_active' => false,
    ])->assertRedirect();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/devices/{$deviceId}")
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->where('programs.0.is_active', false));

    $this->actingAs($owner)->delete("/devices/{$deviceId}/programs/{$programId}")->assertRedirect();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/devices/{$deviceId}")
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->has('programs', 0));
});

test('a viewer cannot add a program', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);

    TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($owner) {
        $owner->removeRole(TenantRole::Owner->value);
        $owner->assignRole(TenantRole::Viewer->value);
    });

    $this->actingAs($owner->fresh())->post("/devices/{$deviceId}/programs", [
        'name' => '134°C Standard',
        'target_temperature_celsius' => 134,
        'plateau_minutes' => 18,
    ])->assertForbidden();
});

    [$tenantB, $ownerB] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $tokenB = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantB, $ownerB);
    $deviceIdB = sterilizationDeviceFor($tokenB, $tenantB);

    $this->actingAs($ownerA)->post("/devices/{$deviceIdB}/programs", [
        'name' => '134°C Standard',
        'target_temperature_celsius' => 134,
        'plateau_minutes' => 18,
    ])->assertNotFound();
});

==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/EvidenceSearchTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;

/**
 * Reuses fullEvidenceChainFor (tests/Feature/Api/V1/EvidenceSearchTest.php)
 * — the real receive -> cycle -> release -> label -> scan -> usage chain,
 * same SearchEvidenceAction/EvidenceSearchResultData the mobile API uses.
 */
test('an owner finds evidence by patient, cycle, batch, device, operator, and period', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $chain = fullEvidenceChainFor($token, $tenant, $owner->id);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/evidence-search?patient_reference='.$chain['patient_reference'])
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('traceability/evidence-search/index')
            ->has('results.data', 1)
            ->where('results.data.0.label_id', $chain['label_id'])
        );

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/evidence-search?cycle_number='.$chain['cycle_number'])
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->has('results.data', 1));

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/evidence-search?device_id='.$chain['device_id'])
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->has('results.data', 1));

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/evidence-search?operator_id='.$owner->id)
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->has('results.data', 1));

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/evidence-search?from='.now()->subDay()->toDateString().'&to='.now()->addDay()->toDateString())
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->has('results.data', 1));

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/evidence-search?from='.now()->addYear()->toDateString())
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->has('results.data', 0));
});

==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/GoodsReceiptsTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Domain\Purchasing\Models\PurchaseOrder;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\StorageLocation;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;

/**
 * StorageLocation has no Action/API/Web route anywhere yet (flagged and
 * confirmed with the product owner while building this screen) — a real
 * practice can't create one through the app until that lands (S-ANA "Sites,
 * rooms, storage locations"). Created directly here, the same way Sites
 * already are in sterilizationDeviceFor() elsewhere in this test suite,
 * purely as fixture setup for a record type nothing in the domain writes
 * yet.
 */
function storageLocationFor(Tenant $tenant): string
{
    return TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($tenant) {
        $siteId = $tenant->sites()->create(['name' => 'Cabinet Principal'])->id;

        return StorageLocation::create([
            'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
            'site_id' => $siteId,
            'name' => 'Main storeroom',
        ])->id;
    });
}

test('goods can be received in full, updating the purchase order to received', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$supplierId, $productId] = supplierAndProductFor($owner);
    $locationId = storageLocationFor($tenant);

    $create = $this->actingAs($owner)->post('/purchase-orders', [
        'supplier_id' => $supplierId,
        'lines' => [['product_id' => $productId, 'qty_ordered' => 10]],
    ]);
    $orderId = Str::afterLast($create->headers->get('Location'), '/');
    $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/purchase-orders/{$orderId}/order")->assertRedirect();

    $lineId = TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => PurchaseOrder::find($orderId)->lines()->first()->id);

    $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/purchase-orders/{$orderId}/receipts", [
        'location_id' => $locationId,
        'lines' => [[
            'purchase_order_line_id' => $lineId,
            'batch_number' => 'BATCH-001',
            'expiry_date' => now()->addYear()->toDateString(),
            'qty' => 10,
        ]],
    ])->assertRedirect();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/purchase-orders/{$orderId}")
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->where('purchaseOrder.status', 'received')
            ->where('purchaseOrder.lines.0.qty_received', 10)
            ->has('goodsReceipts', 1)
            ->where('goodsReceipts.0.lines.0.qty', 10)
        );

    expect(Batch::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->where('batch_number', 'BATCH-001')->exists())->toBeTrue();
});

test('goods can be partially received, with a discrepancy reason, leaving the order partially received', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$supplierId, $productId] = supplierAndProductFor($owner);
    $locationId = storageLocationFor($tenant);

    $create = $this->actingAs($owner)->post('/purchase-orders', [
        'supplier_id' => $supplierId,
        'lines' => [['product_id' => $productId, 'qty_ordered' => 10]],
    ]);
    $orderId = Str::afterLast($create->headers->get('Location'), '/');
    $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/purchase-orders/{$orderId}/order");
    $lineId = TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => PurchaseOrder::find($orderId)->lines()->first()->id);

    $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/purchase-orders/{$orderId}/receipts", [
        'location_id' => $locationId,
        'lines' => [[
            'purchase_order_line_id' => $lineId,
            'batch_number' => 'BATCH-002',
            'qty' => 6,
            'discrepancy_reason' => '4 units damaged in transit.',
        ]],
    ])->assertRedirect();

        ->get("/purchase-orders/{$orderId}")
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->where('purchaseOrder.status', 'partially_received')
            ->where('purchaseOrder.lines.0.qty_received', 6)
            ->where('goodsReceipts.0.lines.0.discrepancy_reason', '4 units damaged in transit.')
        );
});

==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/LabelsTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;

/**
 * Scans the label (Printed -> Used), then records its usage — the last
 * link of "pouch -> cycle -> device -> practitioner -> procedure ->
 * pseudonymized patient" (CLAUDE.md). This is normally the mobile scan-at-
 * chair flow (RecordLabelUsageAction), not something the web UI triggers;
 * driven via the real API here purely as a fixture so the web label detail
 * page's *display* of that data can be tested honestly.
 */
function useDemoLabel(string $token, Tenant $tenant, User $owner, string $labelId): void
{
    test()->withToken($token)->getJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}")->assertOk();

    $patientId = test()->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])
        ->json('id');

    test()->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/usage", [
        'patient_id' => $patientId,
        'practitioner_id' => $owner->id,
        'procedure' => 'Scaling and root planing',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertCreated();
}

test('the labels index shows a generated label', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    [$cycleId] = releasedCompliantCycle($token, $tenant, $deviceId);
    dluRuleFor($token, 'Sachet', 'Armoire', 180);
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/cycles/{$cycleId}/labels", [
        'packaging_type' => 'Sachet', 'storage_condition' => 'Armoire',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertCreated();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/labels')
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('sterilization/labels/index')
            ->has('labels.data', 1)
            ->where('labels.data.0.cycle_number', 1)
            ->where('labels.data.0.status', 'created')
        );
});

test('the labels index can be filtered to a status with no matches', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    [$cycleId] = releasedCompliantCycle($token, $tenant, $deviceId);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/labels?filter[status]=recalled')
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->has('labels.data', 0));
});

});

test('the label detail page shows the full usage chain once the label has been used', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

        ->get("/labels/{$labelId}")

            ->where('usage.procedure', 'Scaling and root planing')

    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('0.id');

    $this->actingAs($ownerA)->get("/labels/{$labelIdB}")->assertNotFound();

==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/LabelUsagesTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Enums\LabelStatus;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Domain\Traceability\Models\LabelUsage;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;

/**
 * The web fallback for the mobile scan (UI-20) — reuses
 * ResolveLabelScanAction + RecordLabelUsageAction exactly as a real scan
 * would, so these tests deliberately start from a PRINTED (not yet
 * scanned) label, proving the web endpoint performs the scan transition
 * itself rather than assuming it already happened.
 */
test('linking a printed, not-yet-scanned label to a procedure via the web transitions it to used', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $labelId = generatedLabelFor($token, $tenant, $deviceId);
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/print", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $patientId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->post("/labels/{$labelId}/usage", [
            'patient_id' => $patientId,
            'practitioner_id' => $owner->id,
            'procedure' => 'Détartrage',
        ])
        ->assertRedirect();

    $label = Label::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->findOrFail($labelId);
    expect($label->status)->toBe(LabelStatus::Used);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/labels/{$labelId}")
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->where('usage.procedure', 'Détartrage')
            ->where('usage.patient_id', $patientId)
            ->where('label.status', 'used')
        );
});

test('a recalled label cannot be linked to a procedure via the web fallback either', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $labelId = generatedLabelFor($token, $tenant, $deviceId);
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/print", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $patientId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');
    Label::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->findOrFail($labelId)->update(['status' => LabelStatus::Recalled]);

    $response = $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/labels/{$labelId}/usage", [
        'patient_id' => $patientId,
        'practitioner_id' => $owner->id,
        'procedure' => 'X',
    ]);

    $response->assertRedirect();
    $response->assertSessionHas('_flash');
    expect(LabelUsage::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->where('label_id', $labelId)->exists())->toBeFalse();
});

test('a viewer cannot record a label usage (server-side, not just a hidden form)', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $labelId = generatedLabelFor($token, $tenant, $deviceId);
    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/print", [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()]);
    $patientId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($owner) {
        $owner->removeRole(TenantRole::Owner->value);
        $owner->assignRole(TenantRole::Viewer->value);
    });
    $viewer = $owner->fresh();

    $this->actingAs($viewer)
        ->post("/labels/{$labelId}/usage", [
            'patient_id' => $patientId,
            'practitioner_id' => $owner->id,
            'procedure' => 'X',
        ])
        ->assertForbidden();

    $this->actingAs($viewer)
        ->get("/labels/{$labelId}")
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->where('canRecordUsage', false));
});

test('a practice cannot link another practice label to a procedure (IDOR)', function () {
    [, $ownerA] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$tenantB, $ownerB] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $deviceIdB = sterilizationDeviceFor($tokenB, $tenantB);
    $labelIdB = generatedLabelFor($tokenB, $tenantB, $deviceIdB);

            'patient_id' => (string) Str::uuid(),

            'procedure' => 'X',
        ])
        ->assertNotFound();

==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/NonConformityTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Compliance\Models\NonConformity;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\BatchStatus;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Enums\LabelStatus;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\Label;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantScope;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;

/**
 * Reuses fullEvidenceChainFor (tests/Feature/Api/V1/EvidenceSearchTest.php)
 * and mirrors tests/Feature/Api/V1/NonConformityTest.php's fixtures — same
 * RaiseNonConformityAction/ResolveNonConformityAction the mobile API uses.
 */
test('the cycle detail page shows the blast radius before confirming a recall', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $chain = fullEvidenceChainFor($token, $tenant, $owner->id);
    $cycleId = TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => Label::findOrFail($chain['label_id'])->cycleItem->cycle_id);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/cycles/{$cycleId}")
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->where('nonConformityBlastRadius.labels_to_recall', 1)
            ->where('nonConformityBlastRadius.batches_to_quarantine', 1)
        );
});

test('raising a non-conformity from the web recalls every label the cycle produced and quarantines the batch', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $chain = fullEvidenceChainFor($token, $tenant, $owner->id);
    $cycleId = TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => Label::findOrFail($chain['label_id'])->cycleItem->cycle_id);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->post('/non-conformities', [
            'subject_type' => 'cycle',
            'subject_id' => $cycleId,
            'description' => 'Discovered the biological indicator reader was mis-calibrated.',
        ])
        ->assertRedirect();

    $label = Label::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->findOrFail($chain['label_id']);
    expect($label->status)->toBe(LabelStatus::Recalled);

    $batch = Batch::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->findOrFail($chain['batch_id']);
    expect($batch->status)->toBe(BatchStatus::Quarantined);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/non-conformities')
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('compliance/non-conformities/index')
            ->has('nonConformities.data', 1)
            ->where('nonConformities.data.0.subject_type', 'Cycle')
        );

    // The blast radius is now zero — the labels are already recalled.
    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/cycles/{$cycleId}")
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->where('nonConformityBlastRadius.labels_to_recall', 0)
        );
});

test('a non-conformity can be resolved once, with a resolution note', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $chain = fullEvidenceChainFor($token, $tenant, $owner->id);
    $cycleId = TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => Label::findOrFail($chain['label_id'])->cycleItem->cycle_id);

    $this->actingAs($owner)->post('/non-conformities', [
        'subject_type' => 'cycle', 'subject_id' => $cycleId, 'description' => 'X',
    ]);
    $ncId = TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => NonConformity::first()->id);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->post("/non-conformities/{$ncId}/resolve", ['resolution' => 'Re-tested; sensor glitch.'])
        ->assertRedirect();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/non-conformities')
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->where('nonConformities.data.0.resolution', 'Re-tested; sensor glitch.')
        );

    $again = $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/non-conformities/{$ncId}/resolve", ['resolution' => 'Y']);
    $again->assertRedirect();
    $again->assertSessionHas('_flash');
});

test('a stock manager (operational role) cannot raise a non-conformity from the web', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $chain = fullEvidenceChainFor($token, $tenant, $owner->id);

    });
