        ->post('/non-conformities', [
            'subject_type' => 'label', 'subject_id' => $chain['label_id'], 'description' => 'X',
        ])
        ->assertForbidden();
});

test('a viewer can read non-conformities but cannot raise or resolve one (vertical escalation)', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $chain = fullEvidenceChainFor($token, $tenant, $owner->id);
    $this->actingAs($owner)->post('/non-conformities', [
        'subject_type' => 'label', 'subject_id' => $chain['label_id'], 'description' => 'X',
    ]);
    $ncId = TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => NonConformity::first()->id);

    TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($owner) {
        $owner->removeRole(TenantRole::Owner->value);
        $owner->assignRole(TenantRole::Viewer->value);
    });
    $viewer = $owner->fresh();

    $this->actingAs($viewer)
        ->get('/non-conformities')
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->where('canManage', false));

    $this->actingAs($viewer)->post('/non-conformities', [
        'subject_type' => 'label', 'subject_id' => $chain['label_id'], 'description' => 'Y',
    ])->assertForbidden();

    $this->actingAs($viewer)->post("/non-conformities/{$ncId}/resolve", ['resolution' => 'Z'])->assertForbidden();
});

test('a practice never reaches another practice cycle or label when raising a non-conformity from the web (IDOR)', function () {
    [, $ownerA] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$tenantB, $ownerB] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $tokenB = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantB, $ownerB);
    $chainB = fullEvidenceChainFor($tokenB, $tenantB, $ownerB->id);

    $this->actingAs($ownerA)
        ->post('/non-conformities', [
            'subject_type' => 'label', 'subject_id' => $chainB['label_id'], 'description' => 'X',
        ])
        ->assertSessionHasErrors('subject_id');
});

test('a practice never sees another practice non-conformities in the list (IDOR)', function () {
    [, $ownerA] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$tenantB, $ownerB] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $tokenB = sterilizationTokenFor($tenantB, $ownerB);
    $chainB = fullEvidenceChainFor($tokenB, $tenantB, $ownerB->id);
    $this->actingAs($ownerB)->post('/non-conformities', [
        'subject_type' => 'label', 'subject_id' => $chainB['label_id'], 'description' => 'X',
    ]);

    $this->actingAs($ownerA)
        ->get('/non-conformities')
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->has('nonConformities.data', 0));
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/PatientsTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;

test('an owner can create a patient and is redirected to its detail page', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $response = $this->actingAs($owner)->post('/patients');
    $response->assertRedirect();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/patients')
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('traceability/patients/index')
            ->has('patients.data', 1)
            ->where('patients.data.0.reference', 'PAT-000001')
        );
});

test('an owner sees a linked procedure in the patient detail procedure history', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $deviceId = sterilizationDeviceFor($token, $tenant);
    $labelId = scannedLabelFor($token, $tenant, $deviceId);
    // Every token/API call happens before the first actingAs() below —
    // mixing Sanctum bearer auth and web session auth out of that order
    // in the same test breaks guard resolution (established convention
    // throughout this suite, e.g. LabelsTest.php).
    $patientId = $this->withToken($token)->postJson('/api/v1/patients', [], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->json('id');

    $this->withToken($token)->postJson("/api/v1/labels/{$labelId}/usage", [
        'patient_id' => $patientId,
        'practitioner_id' => $owner->id,
        'procedure' => 'Détartrage',
    ], ['Idempotency-Key' => (string) Str::uuid()])->assertCreated();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/patients/{$patientId}")
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('traceability/patients/show')
            ->where('patient.id', $patientId)
            ->has('usages', 1)
            ->where('usages.0.procedure', 'Détartrage')
            ->where('usages.0.label_id', $labelId)
            ->where('usages.0.practitioner_name', 'Alice Dupont')
        );
});

test('a patient with no procedures yet shows the empty state', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $patientId = Str::afterLast($this->actingAs($owner)->post('/patients')->headers->get('Location'), '/');

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/patients/{$patientId}")
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->has('usages', 0));
});

test('patients can be filtered by reference', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    // CreatePatientAction generates PAT-000001, PAT-000002, ... sequentially
    // per tenant — deterministic, so no need to read back the first one.
    $this->actingAs($owner)->post('/patients');
    $this->actingAs($owner)->post('/patients');

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/patients?filter[reference]=PAT-000001')
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->has('patients.data', 1)
            ->where('patients.data.0.reference', 'PAT-000001')
        );
});

test('an owner can archive a patient, which then no longer appears in the list', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $patientId = Str::afterLast($this->actingAs($owner)->post('/patients')->headers->get('Location'), '/');

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->delete("/patients/{$patientId}")
        ->assertRedirect('/patients');

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/patients')
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->has('patients.data', 0));
});

test('a user without patients.manage cannot create or archive a patient (server-side, not just a hidden button)', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $patientId = Str::afterLast($this->actingAs($owner)->post('/patients')->headers->get('Location'), '/');

    TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($owner) {
        $owner->removeRole(TenantRole::Owner->value);
        $owner->assignRole(TenantRole::Viewer->value);
    });
    $viewer = $owner->fresh();

    $this->actingAs($viewer)->post('/patients')->assertForbidden();
    $this->actingAs($viewer)->delete("/patients/{$patientId}")->assertForbidden();

    $this->actingAs($viewer)
        ->get("/patients/{$patientId}")
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->where('canManage', false));
});

test('a practice cannot see or archive another practice patient (IDOR)', function () {
    [, $ownerA] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$tenantB, $ownerB] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $foreignPatientId = Str::afterLast($this->actingAs($ownerB)->post('/patients')->headers->get('Location'), '/');

    $this->actingAs($ownerA)->get("/patients/{$foreignPatientId}")->assertNotFound();
    $this->actingAs($ownerA)->delete("/patients/{$foreignPatientId}")->assertNotFound();

    $this->actingAs($ownerA)
        ->get('/patients')
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->has('patients.data', 0));
});


==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/PracticeSettingsTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\AlertSettings;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\DigestSubscription;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Actions\CreateDluRuleAction;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\DluRule;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\DluRuleVersion;
use App\Domain\Labeling\Models\LabelFormatVersion;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;
use Spatie\LaravelPdf\Facades\Pdf;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * Mirrors tests/Feature/Api/V1/CycleTest.php's sterilizationTenantWithMember,
 * renamed to avoid a global-function clash when the whole suite loads.
 */
function practiceSettingsTenantWithMember(TenantRole $role = TenantRole::Owner): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);

    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);

    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole($role->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

test('an owner can view the settings page with defaults for every section', function () {
    [, $owner] = practiceSettingsTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/practice-settings')
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('tenancy/practice-settings/index')
            ->where('identity.name', 'Cabinet Test')
            ->where('labelFormat', null)
            ->has('dluRules', 0)
            ->where('alertSettings.near_expiry_days', 30)
            ->has('digestSubscriptions', 6)
            ->where('canManageEvidence', true)
        );
});

test('an owner can update the practice identity with a reason, audited', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = practiceSettingsTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->patch('/practice-settings/identity', [
            'name' => 'Cabinet Test',
            'legal_name' => 'Cabinet Test SARL',
            'city' => 'Lyon',
            'timezone' => 'Europe/Paris',
            'locale' => 'fr',
            'reason' => 'Correcting the legal name.',
        ])
        ->assertRedirect();

    expect($tenant->fresh()->legal_name)->toBe('Cabinet Test SARL');
});

test('updating the identity without a reason is rejected', function () {
    [, $owner] = practiceSettingsTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->patch('/practice-settings/identity', ['name' => 'New Name'])
        ->assertSessionHasErrors('reason');
});

test('an owner can upload a logo', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = practiceSettingsTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    Storage::fake('media');

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->post('/practice-settings/logo', [
            'logo' => UploadedFile::fake()->image('logo.png'),
            'reason' => 'New branding.',
        ])
        ->assertRedirect();

    // App\Support\Media\Media is itself BelongsToTenant (RLS + a global
    // scope) — reading it back outside the request needs the same tenant
    // context the request had, exactly like resolving an archived Site
    // (UI-27) does.
    TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($tenant) {
        expect($tenant->fresh()->getFirstMedia('logo'))->not->toBeNull();
    });
});

test('an owner can add and update a dlu rule, versioned with a required reason', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = practiceSettingsTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->post('/practice-settings/dlu-rules', [
            'packaging_type' => 'Sachet', 'storage_condition' => 'Armoire', 'shelf_life_days' => 180,
            'reason' => 'EN 868 starting point for pouches.',
        ])
        ->assertRedirect();

    $rule = TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => DluRule::firstOrFail());
    expect($rule->shelf_life_days)->toBe(180);
    expect($rule->current_version_id)->not->toBeNull();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->patch("/practice-settings/dlu-rules/{$rule->id}", [
            'shelf_life_days' => 365,
            'reason' => 'Extended after review.',
        ])
        ->assertRedirect();

    // The old version is never overwritten — it's a new, immutable row.
    TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($rule) {
        expect($rule->fresh()->shelf_life_days)->toBe(365);
        expect(DluRuleVersion::where('tenant_id', $rule->tenant_id)->count())->toBe(2);
    });
});

test('creating a dlu rule without a reason is rejected', function () {
    [, $owner] = practiceSettingsTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->post('/practice-settings/dlu-rules', [
            'packaging_type' => 'Sachet', 'storage_condition' => 'Armoire', 'shelf_life_days' => 180,
        ])
        ->assertSessionHasErrors('reason');
});

test('an owner can update the label format, versioned, applying to future prints only', function () {

    $this->actingAs($owner)

            'show_product_name' => false,
            'reason' => 'Practice prefers QR as primary.',
        ])
        ->assertRedirect();

    $version = TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => LabelFormatVersion::where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->latest('effective_from')->first());
    expect($version->primary_code->value)->toBe('qr');

});

        ->post('/practice-settings/dlu-rules', [

        ->post('/practice-settings/label-format', [

        ])
        ->assertForbidden();
});

test('a viewer cannot reach the settings page at all', function () {
    [, $viewer] = practiceSettingsTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Viewer);

    $this->actingAs($viewer)->get('/practice-settings')->assertForbidden();
});

test('a practice never reaches or writes another practice dlu rule from the settings page (IDOR)', function () {

    [$tenantB, $ownerB] = practiceSettingsTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

        ->assertNotFound();

==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/PurchaseOrdersTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;

/**
 * @return array{0: string, 1: string} [supplierId, productId]
 */
function supplierAndProductFor(mixed $owner): array
{
    $supplierCreate = test()->actingAs($owner)->post('/suppliers', ['name' => 'Acme Medical '.Str::random(6)]);
    $supplierId = Str::afterLast($supplierCreate->headers->get('Location'), '/');

    $productCreate = test()->actingAs($owner)->post('/products', [
        'name' => 'Sterilization pouch', 'reference' => 'SKU-'.Str::random(8),
    ]);
    $productId = Str::afterLast($productCreate->headers->get('Location'), '/');

    return [$supplierId, $productId];
}

test('an owner can view the purchase orders list', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$supplierId, $productId] = supplierAndProductFor($owner);

    $this->actingAs($owner)->post('/purchase-orders', [
        'supplier_id' => $supplierId,
        'lines' => [['product_id' => $productId, 'qty_ordered' => 50]],
    ])->assertRedirect();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/purchase-orders')
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('purchasing/purchase-orders/index')
            ->has('purchaseOrders.data', 1)
            ->where('purchaseOrders.data.0.supplier_id', $supplierId)
            ->where('canCreate', true)
        );
});

test('a purchase order can be created with lines, viewed, and marked as ordered', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$supplierId, $productId] = supplierAndProductFor($owner);

    $create = $this->actingAs($owner)->post('/purchase-orders', [
        'supplier_id' => $supplierId,
        'lines' => [['product_id' => $productId, 'qty_ordered' => 50, 'unit_price' => '12.50']],
    ]);
    $create->assertRedirect();
    $orderId = Str::afterLast($create->headers->get('Location'), '/');

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/purchase-orders/{$orderId}")
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('purchasing/purchase-orders/show')
            ->where('purchaseOrder.status', 'draft')
            ->has('purchaseOrder.lines', 1)
            ->where('purchaseOrder.lines.0.qty_ordered', 50)
            ->where('canManage', true)
        );

    $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/purchase-orders/{$orderId}/order")->assertRedirect();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/purchase-orders/{$orderId}")
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page->where('purchaseOrder.status', 'ordered'));
});

test('marking an already-ordered purchase order as ordered again is blocked with a real message, not a broken page', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $create = $this->actingAs($owner)->post('/purchase-orders', [

    $response->assertRedirect();
    $response->assertSessionHas('_flash');
});

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;

/**
 * Read-only (UI-24) — the only writer is RaiseNonConformityAction
 * (UI-23), so every fixture here goes through the real recall flow
 * rather than setting Batch::status directly.
 */
test('a batch quarantined by a recall appears with who, why, and when', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $chain = fullEvidenceChainFor($token, $tenant, $owner->id);
    $cycleId = TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => Label::findOrFail($chain['label_id'])->cycleItem->cycle_id);

    $this->actingAs($owner)->post('/non-conformities', [
        'subject_type' => 'cycle',
        'subject_id' => $cycleId,
        'description' => 'Discovered the biological indicator reader was mis-calibrated.',
    ]);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/quarantine')
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('inventory/quarantine/index')
            ->has('batches.data', 1)
            ->where('batches.data.0.reason', 'Discovered the biological indicator reader was mis-calibrated.')
            ->where('batches.data.0.quarantined_by', fn ($value) => str_starts_with($value, 'Alice Dupont'))
            ->where('batches.data.0.qty_on_hand', 10)
        );
});

==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/SiteTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Catalog\Models\Product;
use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Enums\StockMovementType;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\Batch;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\StockLevel;
use App\Domain\Inventory\Models\StockMovement;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Room;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Site;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\StorageLocation;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * Mirrors tests/Feature/Api/V1/CycleTest.php's sterilizationTenantWithMember,
 * renamed to avoid a global-function clash when the whole suite loads.
 */
function siteTenantWithMember(TenantRole $role = TenantRole::Owner): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);

    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);

    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole($role->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

test('an owner can view the sites list with rooms/locations/devices counts', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = siteTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($tenant) {
        $site = Site::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'name' => 'Cabinet Principal']);
        $room = Room::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'site_id' => $site->id, 'name' => 'Sterilization room']);
        StorageLocation::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'site_id' => $site->id, 'room_id' => $room->id, 'name' => 'Cupboard A']);
    });

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/sites')
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('tenancy/sites/index')
            ->has('sites', 1)
            ->where('sites.0.name', 'Cabinet Principal')
            ->where('sites.0.rooms_count', 1)
            ->where('sites.0.storage_locations_count', 1)
            ->where('sites.0.devices_count', 0)
            ->where('canManage', true)
        );
});

test('an owner can create a site, then add a room and a storage location to it from the show page', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = siteTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->post('/sites', ['name' => 'Cabinet Principal', 'city' => 'Lyon'])
        ->assertRedirect();

    $site = TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => Site::firstOrFail());

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->post("/sites/{$site->id}/rooms", ['name' => 'Sterilization room'])
        ->assertRedirect();

    $room = TenantContext::run($tenant, fn () => Room::firstOrFail());

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->post("/rooms/{$room->id}/storage-locations", ['name' => 'Cupboard A'])
        ->assertRedirect();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/sites/{$site->id}")
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('tenancy/sites/show')
            ->has('rooms', 1)
            ->where('rooms.0.name', 'Sterilization room')
            ->has('storageLocations', 1)
            ->where('storageLocations.0.name', 'Cupboard A')
        );
});

test('archiving a site cascades to its rooms and storage locations, none of them hard-deleted', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = siteTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$site, $room, $location] = TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($tenant) {
        $site = Site::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'name' => 'Cabinet Principal']);
        $room = Room::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'site_id' => $site->id, 'name' => 'Room A']);
        $location = StorageLocation::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'site_id' => $site->id, 'room_id' => $room->id, 'name' => 'Shelf 1']);

        return [$site, $room, $location];
    });

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->delete("/sites/{$site->id}", ['reason' => 'Practice closed this location.'])
        ->assertRedirect();

    TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($site, $room, $location) {
        expect(Site::find($site->id))->toBeNull();
        expect(Site::withTrashed()->find($site->id))->not->toBeNull();
        expect(Room::find($room->id))->toBeNull();
        expect(Room::withTrashed()->find($room->id))->not->toBeNull();
        expect(StorageLocation::find($location->id))->toBeNull();
        expect(StorageLocation::withTrashed()->find($location->id))->not->toBeNull();
    });
});

test('an archived storage location still resolves on a historical stock record (invariant #6)', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = siteTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$location, $stockLevel] = TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($tenant) {
        $site = Site::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'name' => 'Cabinet Principal']);
        $location = StorageLocation::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'site_id' => $site->id, 'name' => 'Fridge']);
        $product = Product::create([
            'tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'name' => 'Gauze', 'reference' => 'REF-'.Str::random(6), 'unit' => 'box',
        ]);
        $batch = Batch::create([
            'tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'product_id' => $product->id, 'batch_number' => 'B1', 'received_at' => now(),
        ]);
        $stockLevel = StockLevel::create([
            'tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'batch_id' => $batch->id, 'location_id' => $location->id, 'quantity' => 5,
        ]);
        StockMovement::create([
            'tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'type' => StockMovementType::Receipt, 'batch_id' => $batch->id,
            'location_id' => $location->id, 'qty' => 5, 'occurred_at' => now(),
        ]);

        return [$location, $stockLevel];
    });

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->delete("/storage-locations/{$location->id}", ['reason' => 'No longer used.'])
        ->assertRedirect();

    TenantContext::run($tenant, function () use ($stockLevel) {
        expect($stockLevel->fresh()->location)->not->toBeNull();
        expect($stockLevel->fresh()->location->id)->toBe($stockLevel->location_id);
    });
});

==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/StockTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;

/**
 * Reuses invLocationFor/receiveStockFor (tests/Feature/Api/V1/InventoryTest.php)
 * — the real purchasing flow that actually populates stock_movements/
 * stock_levels, rather than writing rows directly. Both screens here are
 * read-only (CLAUDE.md invariant #1: stock is derived, never set), so
 * every fixture in this file goes through that real flow or the mobile
 * API's issue/adjust/transfer endpoints — never a direct Eloquent write.
 */
test('an owner sees stock on hand for a received batch, by product, batch and location', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $token = sterilizationTokenFor($tenant, $owner);
    $locationId = invLocationFor($tenant);
    ['batch_id' => $batchId, 'product_id' => $productId] = receiveStockFor($token, $locationId, 20);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/stock')
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('inventory/stock/index')
            ->has('levels.data', 1)
            ->where('levels.data.0.batch_id', $batchId)
            ->where('levels.data.0.product_id', $productId)
            ->where('levels.data.0.location_id', $locationId)
            ->where('levels.data.0.quantity', 20)
        );
});

test('an owner sees the receipt movement in the ledger with a positive signed quantity', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

            ->where('movements.data.0.reason', 'Used for cycle #1.')
        );
});

test('a product can be linked to a supplier, and linking it again updates rather than duplicates', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    $supplierCreate = $this->actingAs($owner)->post('/suppliers', ['name' => 'Acme Medical']);
    $supplierId = Str::afterLast($supplierCreate->headers->get('Location'), '/');
    $productCreate = $this->actingAs($owner)->post('/products', [
        'name' => 'Sterilization pouch 90x230', 'reference' => 'SKU-001',
    ]);
    $productId = Str::afterLast($productCreate->headers->get('Location'), '/');

    $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/suppliers/{$supplierId}/products", [
        'product_id' => $productId,
        'supplier_reference' => 'ACME-POUCH-001',
        'pack_size' => 200,
        'price' => '45.90',
    ])->assertRedirect();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/suppliers/{$supplierId}")
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->has('supplierProducts', 1)
            ->where('supplierProducts.0.supplier_reference', 'ACME-POUCH-001')
            ->where('supplierProducts.0.pack_size', 200)
        );

    $this->actingAs($owner)->post("/suppliers/{$supplierId}/products", [
        'product_id' => $productId,
        'supplier_reference' => 'ACME-POUCH-001-V2',
        'pack_size' => 100,
    ])->assertRedirect();

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get("/suppliers/{$supplierId}")
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->has('supplierProducts', 1)
            ->where('supplierProducts.0.supplier_reference', 'ACME-POUCH-001-V2')
            ->where('supplierProducts.0.pack_size', 100)
        );

    expect(SupplierProduct::withoutGlobalScope(TenantScope::class)->where('supplier_id', $supplierId)->count())->toBe(1);
});

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Actions\SeedTenantRolesAction;
use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Mail\InvitationMail;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\Invitation;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use App\Domain\Tenancy\Models\Tenant;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\Tenancy\TenantContext;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Mail;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia as Assert;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

/**
 * Mirrors tests/Feature/Api/V1/InvitationTest.php's tenantWithActiveMember,
 * renamed to avoid a global-function clash when the whole suite loads.
 */
function teamTenantWithMember(TenantRole $role = TenantRole::Owner): array
{
    $tenant = Tenant::create(['name' => 'Cabinet Test', 'slug' => 'cabinet-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10))]);

    $user = User::create([
        'name' => 'Alice Dupont',
        'email' => 'alice-'.Str::lower(Str::random(10)).'@example.com',
        'password' => Hash::make('correct-password'),
    ]);

    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenant->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);

    app(SeedTenantRolesAction::class)->execute($tenant);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenant->id);
    $user->assignRole($role->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    return [$tenant, $user];
}

test('the team page lists members and invitations for an owner', function () {
    [$tenant, $owner] = teamTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    Invitation::create([
        'tenant_id' => $tenant->id,
        'email' => 'pending@example.com',
        'role' => 'viewer',
        'token' => Str::random(64),
        'invited_by' => $owner->id,
        'expires_at' => now()->addDays(7),
    ]);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->get('/team')
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (Assert $page) => $page
            ->component('team/index')
            ->has('members', 1)
            ->where('members.0.email', $owner->email)
            ->has('invitations', 1)
            ->where('invitations.0.email', 'pending@example.com')
        );
});

test('an owner can invite a new member and an email is queued', function () {
    Mail::fake();
    [$tenant, $owner] = teamTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $this->actingAs($owner)
        ->post('/team/invitations', [
            'email' => 'new-person@example.com',
            'role' => 'practitioner',
        ])
        ->assertRedirect();

    expect(Invitation::where('email', 'new-person@example.com')->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->exists())->toBeTrue();
    Mail::assertQueued(InvitationMail::class);
});

==================== ./tests/Feature/Web/TenantSwitchTest.php ====================

<?php

use App\Domain\Identity\Enums\TenantRole;
use App\Domain\Identity\Models\TenantUser;
use Spatie\Permission\PermissionRegistrar;

test('a member of two practices can switch which one is active for their session', function () {
    [$tenantA, $user] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$tenantB] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenantB->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'active']);
    $registrar = app(PermissionRegistrar::class);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId($tenantB->id);
    $user->assignRole(TenantRole::Viewer->value);
    $registrar->setPermissionsTeamId(null);

    $this->actingAs($user)->get('/cycles')
        ->assertInertia(fn ($page) => $page->where('tenant.id', $tenantA->id));

    $this->actingAs($user)->post('/tenant/switch', ['tenant_id' => $tenantB->id])
        ->assertRedirect(route('dashboard'));

    // A fresh model instance, not the same $user object reused above:
    // Spatie's HasRoles caches the loaded roles/permissions relations on
    // the model instance itself, and since this is one PHP process (not a
    // new one per simulated request, unlike a real request), that cache
    // would otherwise survive the tenant switch and still report tenantA's
    // role here — a test-simulation artifact, not a real request's
    // behavior (every real request resolves $request->user() fresh).
    $this->actingAs($user->fresh())->get('/cycles')
        ->assertInertia(fn ($page) => $page->where('tenant.id', $tenantB->id)->where('auth.role', 'viewer'));
});

test('a user cannot switch into a practice they are not an active member of', function () {
    [, $user] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$otherTenant] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    $this->actingAs($user)->post('/tenant/switch', ['tenant_id' => $otherTenant->id])
        ->assertSessionHasErrors('tenant_id');
});

test('a disabled membership cannot be switched into', function () {
    [$tenantA, $user] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);
    [$tenantB] = sterilizationTenantWithMember(TenantRole::Owner);

    TenantUser::create(['tenant_id' => $tenantB->id, 'user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'disabled']);

    $this->actingAs($user)->post('/tenant/switch', ['tenant_id' => $tenantB->id])
        ->assertSessionHasErrors('tenant_id');

    $this->actingAs($user)->get('/cycles')
        ->assertInertia(fn ($page) => $page->where('tenant.id', $tenantA->id));
});

==================== ./tests/TestCase.php ====================

<?php

namespace Tests;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\TestCase as BaseTestCase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Laravel\Fortify\Features;
use ReflectionClass;

abstract class TestCase extends BaseTestCase
{
    /**
     * The 'array' cache store (phpunit.xml's CACHE_STORE) survives across
     * every test in the same process — including the request-count keys
     * S5-ANA-01's 'api'/'public-api' rate limiters write. Without this,
     * tests would trip each other's throttle after enough shared-IP/no-op
     * requests accumulate across the suite, not because any single test
     * actually exceeded a limit.
     */
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Cache::flush();
    }

    protected function skipUnlessFortifyHas(string $feature, ?string $message = null): void
    {
        if (! Features::enabled($feature)) {
            $this->markTestSkipped($message ?? "Fortify feature [{$feature}] is not enabled.");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Illuminate\Auth\RequestGuard caches the resolved user on itself once
     * per instance, and Illuminate\Auth\AuthManager caches guard instances
     * by name — both survive across multiple `$this->withToken(...)->json()`
     * calls within a single test (the container isn't rebuilt between them).
     * A second simulated request with a *different* (or freshly revoked)
     * Sanctum token would otherwise silently authenticate as whichever user
     * the "sanctum" guard resolved first. Real requests never hit this —
     * each is a fresh PHP process — it's purely a test-simulation artifact.
     *
     * Only the "sanctum" guard is dropped: AuthManager::forgetGuards() would
     * also drop the "web" session guard, breaking every actingAs()-based
     * Inertia test (actingAs() pre-sets the user directly on that cached
     * guard instance, before the request is even dispatched).
     *
     * A second, related trap: Illuminate\Auth\Middleware\Authenticate calls
     * Auth::shouldUse($guard) on every successful check — so a prior
     * `auth:sanctum`-protected request (any web/API test that mints a
     * token via the mobile login endpoint to set up fixtures, then also
     * exercises a web/Inertia route in the same test) silently makes
     * "sanctum" the default guard for the rest of the test. Resetting the
     * default back to "web" here — the only guard this app's web routes
     * ever use — before every simulated request closes that off the same
     * way forgetCachedGuard() closes the first, for any code that resolves
     * the user via a guard-less $request->user()/auth()->user() call.
     */
    public function call($method, $uri, $parameters = [], $cookies = [], $files = [], $server = [], $content = null)
    {
        $this->forgetCachedGuard('sanctum');
        $this->app['auth']->shouldUse('web');

        return parent::call($method, $uri, $parameters, $cookies, $files, $server, $content);
    }

    /**
     * actingAs($user) with no driver resolves the guard to set the user on
     * via the *current* default at the moment it's called — which the
     * Authenticate-middleware trap above can have already left pointing at
     * "sanctum" before this even runs (call()'s own reset only takes
     * effect on the *next* dispatched request, not retroactively). Every
     * web/Inertia test in this app authenticates via the session guard, so
     * defaulting explicitly to "web" here — rather than trusting whatever
     * the last request happened to leave as current — is correct for all
     * of them and avoids the same silent-wrong-user failure mode.
     */
    public function actingAs(Authenticatable $user, $guard = null)
    {
        return parent::actingAs($user, $guard ?? 'web');
    }

    private function forgetCachedGuard(string $name): void
    {
        $auth = $this->app['auth'];
        $property = (new ReflectionClass($auth))->getProperty('guards');
        $guards = $property->getValue($auth);
        unset($guards[$name]);
        $property->setValue($auth, $guards);
    }
}
